IIT Bombay Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Excellent placements, world-class faculty, tough but fair academics, & campus life are hard to beat.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 to 90 percent of students from our batch opted for placements. Majority of them are successfully placed. While others chose higher studies, research, startups, or civil services preparation. The highest package offered in our course went above 1 crore per annum (international offers). The average package is around 20 LPA to 25 LPA, and the lowest package is around 10 LPA to 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Qualcomm, etc. Around 70-80% of students are able to secure internships through campus and off-campus opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The academic side is honestly pretty solid. Labs are well-equipped, especially for core branches like CSE, EE, mechanical, and chemistry. We get access to good machinery software and research facilities. Classrooms are great. Library is huge 24/7, and has almost every book we need. Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus but speed drops during peak hours and can be frustrating in hostels. There is new hostel and much better than the old ones. There are big rooms, maintained mess, and games are equipment whereas old hostels are smaller with poor sports equipment, mostly damaged. H1 (old hostel) mess is a great thought.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is one of the best things about IITB. Most professors are highly qualified, very knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about their subjects. Many are doing serious research and bringing that into teaching. Like the BB101 biology course included bits of research stuff into class teaching curriculum is rigorous and mostly relevant. Core courses build strong fundamentals, and electives give flexibility. Most exams are moderate to tough level, and sometimes like during mid-semester for biology there is a huge mismanagement in the venue allotment which resulted in cancelling the exam.
detailed_review.Other: Aerospace has been my interest since childhood. At IITB, with only 70-75 people in the aerospace department, it's really nice to be a part of it.

reviews.review_title: IIT Bombay dual degree review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in our course is extremely good. The highest package offered in our course is 52 LPA. The average package is around 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Devex, Org India, etc. Almost all students got internship offers. Top roles are scientists.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi facility is available. Modern classroom and world-class infrastructure. Library with an automated entry and exit system. The hostel quality was like a premium hotel. Mess and canteen food are excellent.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are very knowledgeable, well-qualified and teach us in a very high-level thinking method. The teaching quality of our faculty members is good. The course curriculum is relevant. Students gain real industry-level knowledge. Semester e. am was very tough.

reviews.review_title: Four years  heavenly life.

detailed_review.Placements: During campus placement at my college 90% of students from my department got placed. The highest package offered is 80LPA and the average CTC is something around 12 to 13 LPA. Mass hiring companies for civil services are Godrej and ICICI Bank. 70% got internship. Top role offered was a Data Scientist Role.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classroom is fully equipped with Wi-Fi and AC. The college has a central library where all kinds of books are available. The food and other facilities like gym culture room TV room everything is good. Time to time a special dinner is provided in the mess. All states' major festivals are celebrated in college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are quite outstanding and highly qualified in their subjects. They are helpful too like you can approach them regarding taking guidance related to internship or for referral for higher studies too. Semester examination difficulty level is moderate to slightly hard. Passing percentage totally depends on the professor mostly it is in the range of 35 to 40% percent.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course based on my JEE Advanced rank. I got a degree in civil engineering from IIT Bombay. Civil engineering is the fundamental discipline for infrastructure development of any country and this fascinates me to take this course. Many events and fest keep happening on campus, like Mood Indigo and Techfest.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering + M.Tech. in Communication and Signal Processing
reviews.review_title: Great campus life, and you get to work with top professors in varied domains.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are really good in the EE branch, with opportunities from all the domains, including Core, Development, CSE, Consulting, and Finance, being thrown open to the students, so no dearth of opportunities. For sure 90% of students get placements and internships, and any student should least worry about those things. You get all the top recruiting MNCs here for the interviews. I feel EE is at a bit of a sweet spot compared to CSE in many regards.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: While new residential buildings are coming up, the existing hostel infrastructure is a bit old, so there are some issues in that regard, and students should be mentally prepared for that. Academic infrastructure, including classrooms, labs, and a library, is at par with what students should expect from a good college.
detailed_review.Faculty: It may feel like teaching is done in the same way as we go through the schools, since it's mostly the lectures and then you go through the exams (pen and paper), so it may feel like the same pattern but after 3rd year you get many opportunities to be more research oriented and curriculum becomes more project based. Course is enough for students to be industry-ready if they put in enough work.
detailed_review.Other: EE as a department will be much better due to higher batch strength, as well as if people take integrated 5-year course, they do get an extra year to spend on the campus if they like.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: M.Tech experience at IIT Bombay - Placements, faculty members, and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: I did my M.Tech in CSE from IIT Bombay in 2025. 95-98% of candidates got placed. The highest package is 46 LPA, average is 30 LPA, and the lowest is 15 LPA. Top companies that come for recruitment are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and NVIDIA. Approximately 90% of students got placed for internships at Microsoft, Qualcomm, Adobe, and Samsung R&D. Overall, placement support is very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: CSE department boasted world-class facilities with 24X7 Wi-Fi, world-class labs, smart classrooms, and access to a world-class library. Hostels are hygienic with 24X7 internet, clean rooms, and housekeeping. Mess food is hygienic and good with two canteen options. Medical facilities are easily accessible. The campus boasted world-class sports grounds, gym, and recreational facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, experienced, and easily accessible. The teaching is of excellent quality with good practical as well as theoretical stress. The course is practically based with a focus on core and emerging topics like AI, ML, and systems. Semester exams are moderately challenging, requiring in-depth knowledge. The pass rate is very high at 95-98% with excellent academic guidance from teachers.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science
reviews.review_title: It is good because of the faculty. There are good placements every year.

detailed_review.Placements: Good placements are there in our college. The highest package is 3 crores per annum, and the lowest package is 25 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Flipkart and top MNCs. Around 80-90% of students get internships from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course/department like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are very clean. We feel good to spend time there and they are very good. The quality of facilities in our hostel is good. The quality of food in the mess is delicious.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable on my campus. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is relevant and it makes students industry-ready. Semester exams in this college are difficult but if we do hard work, we can get a good percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is easy so that I can give time for extra skills and it is useful for placements. The best thing about my course is it is easy and interesting.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: About the dream college, IIT Bombay.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80% of students have been placed in our senior batch in CSE, and the rest have gone for higher studies abroad. The highest package offered is 2.4 crores per annum, and the lowest is 20 LPA. The average is somewhere around 40 LPA. Very famous quant companies and development companies visit IITB.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The only problem with being at IITB is that hostels were built way back in the 1960s and 1970s. Rooms were originally designed for a single student, but as time passed and the number of students increased, rooms became shared, which is somewhat comfortable. The food is adjustable. The academic infrastructure is excellent. We have Wi-Fi throughout most of the campus. Classrooms are well maintained. The library is big and has many resources. Canteens are affordable, and tasty food is served there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very intellectual individuals who hold many patents in their research. I feel very lucky to be taught by faculty at IITB. They are well-versed in what they teach. Coming to exams, the semester exams are tough. This is intended to prepare us for future challenges. The average score in exams is usually around 30% of the total marks.
detailed_review.Other: I hope people who read this also come to IIT Bombay. There is an entrance test for this college, which is the JEE Advanced exam. To write this exam, you have to first clear the JEE Main exam.

reviews.review_title: Overall, it offers a fantastic package and there are no problems.

detailed_review.Placements: I got placed in mechanical engineering and in that course, I got some packages from the biggest companies like Eicher, Tata, etc. I got a package of 25 LPA and one of my friends got a package of 18 LPA and it is a good package. Top roles like builder, enhance, etc., are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. The hostel has 24x7 electricity with a water supply. A good speed Wi-Fi is provided. The food of the canteen is very good. There are many choices for food. The food is prepared with hygiene and cleanliness.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified and support students from every perspective. Sometimes, they provide challenges to students and give the test paper so hard. They make students industry-ready. The course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are not very difficult but easy to pass with regular studies. By the way, many students pass exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with every corner.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Bombay is very famous for placements. I got a placement with a package of 20 LPA in the games app development role. There are many courses in the college, and so not many students but a good amount of students got placed in my course. Every student gets internships or jobs. Top roles offered are app development, app beta checker, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Bombay campus is very big. I got a hostel room for just only Rs. 15 per year and that is pretty good. Rooms in the hostel have almost 150 Mbps Wi-Fi. The food of the canteen is fantastic. There are no charges for the canteen food and sometimes there is no good food in the canteen so we can go to any other canteen on the campus. Free medical facilities and sports are provided to students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified and their teaching style is also very good. They teach by giving real-life examples and sometimes they organise real-life experiments. The course curriculum is relevant as per the new educational policies and it makes students industy-ready.
detailed_review.Other: There is a huge budget for the fest and events. Here, events organised are very fantastic. The college also provides some trips for students.

reviews.review_title: The college has provided decent placements in 2025 despite the bad market.

detailed_review.Placements: Decent placements concerning the fee charge. Most of the students get placed in good roles. Summer internships are top-notch for 70 - 80% of the batch with legacy recruiters like Asian Paints, Marico, PNG, Ebay, etc. Roles are spread across consulting, analytics, supply chain, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: You get to experience campus life at the IIT hostel with excellent sports amenities, and medical facilities. SJMSOM has a separate building with state-of-the-art classrooms and seating facilities. Hostel food is decent enough, and you also have outlets like Chaayos and CCD giving food at subsidized prices for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and helpful. They give projects for hands-on learning as well. Some work needs to be done in terms of introducing proper specialization and elective selection. They provide guest lectures from reputed industry leaders and alumni as well.
detailed_review.Other: It is a good course with respect to ROI and brands that come to campus.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college in India in every field like facilities, placements, research, etc.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package offered is 23 LPA for the civil course, and the highest package is 98 LPA. All Students who are willing to get jobs get placed. Many students who do not get placements are the ones who are already clear with the thought about what they have to do like government jobs, startups, or further studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Top-class facilities are there at IIT Bombay in every field. Our college provides Wi-Fi in hostels, AC classrooms, AC library, many canteens, good quality food and free medical facilities, a top class sports facilities with so many grounds and courts. It even has 3 indoor volleyball courts which is very rare in India.
detailed_review.Faculty: Everything is perfect. Semester exams are pretty hard, and only the one who has cracked JEE advanced can solve them. Professors are very helpful and kind. But any malpractices are not avoided. Attendance is compulsory, and we can't take it in a chill way.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science
reviews.review_title: It is absolutely the best experience of life with a green campus and the best placements.

detailed_review.Placements: The overall placement of IIT Bombay is good. Around 90% of the batch is placed every year with a good amount of package. The highest domestic package is around 1 crore per annum, while the international package is around 3 crore per annum. The average package is 20 LPA to 30 LPA for Computer Science and related branches, while the other branches in core domains have an average package of around 12 LPA to 20 LPA. The top recruiting companies are all the big MNCs and tech companies like FAANG. Top roles offered are in consulting, finance, software, ML, data science, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall facilities in classrooms and the library are really good. All classrooms, library, and study rooms are complete equipped with AC, Wi-Fi, and LAN. Overall, hygiene is also maintained everywhere. The hostel facilities vary depending on the year we belong to. The hostel for 1st-year students is really good, with enough space in all rooms and clean. But in our 2nd and 3rd-year hostels, the infrastructure is not good, and the buildings are also old, but hygiene is still maintained. The mess food is not up to expectations, but we can easily survive eating that food.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are highly educated and experienced in the teaching field. Most of the professors are from big colleges like IITs/NITs and have done their higher studies from great foreign universities. So, the teaching quality is really good. The course curriculum is also perfect, as it gives a proper taste of the actual work that happens at the industrial level. Some field trips are also carried out by professors for students in some of the courses to give students proper experience of how work actually happens on a big scale in industries.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course as I want to explore the metallurgical engineering field, learn more about metals, their extraction, and properties. The college life here is the best part. There are many fests organized throughout the year, creating a vibrant environment on the campus. The campus has sports fields for every sport we want to play, like both indoor and outdoor courts. We also have a gym, yoga rooms, and rooms for cultural activities. There are scholarships are also provided by the college based on parental income.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering + M.Tech. in Communication and Signal Processing
reviews.review_title: IIT Bombay review of campus, course curriculum, and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: In my department, in a dual degree program in electrical engineering, around 98% of students get placed in total as of 2022-23 records, which included tech, core, consult, finance, and other sectors. The highest package is 1.2 crores per annum. The lowest package is 10 LPA. The average package is 27 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Jane Street and HFT firm. In core, top recruiting companies are Qualcomm and Texas Instruments, which hire students in the core sector. The percentage of internships varies, with the number of students and along with the sector they are in, and mainly IT interns at 50% of PPOs around.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Bombay has a central library and a reading hall for 24x7 studying. It has full AC rooms. Wi-Fi is around the whole campus. The department labs are all high-end technical and clean. Faculty members provide full interest to help us learn devices. In hostels, food varieties are immense and there is a 4 meals per day system. The quality of food is good enough and it may seem different in different hostels. Each hostel has its own canteens, with a few of them only open after night.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are super helpful here. In later years, they attach more with students and more in case the students are working under the professor. They have dozens of patents, journals, research papers, and books. Semester exams are easy if we attend all lectures, or else we have to struggle a bit.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this branch, as electrical engineering has immense learning and multiple fields. It is related to my future aim. There is literally nothing much to improve. This course is the best course to provide in the whole country. Fests and events are organised at another level, along with the beautiful campus of 550 acres. It is full of greenery and eco-friendly.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Bombay - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: I would say campus placements are just above average. Placements are not as grand as the newspapers show, but the peer group is quite engaging. Students grow a lot in these 4 years with a good peer group and an awesome alumni network. The highest packages generally are bagged in the software domains. In my branch, the highest package is 35 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi enabled, There is a central library and almost all departments have their own libraries too. There are 3 dedicated lecture complexes and all departments have their own classrooms too. The hostel infrastructure of the new hostels are really good and the old ones are also continuously improving. There is an on-campus hospital. The institute gymkhana has many sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of my department are extremely supportive and helpful, just that you need to be ready to seek help. The course curriculum is relevant just a little cramped in the new curriculum, but this curriculum leaves us with 1 full year to choose courses of our choice. This is good for students who have an interdisciplinary interest. Semester exams' level of difficulty varies but they are passable. We really need to work hard to pass exams.
detailed_review.Other: There are a ton of things to do and explore. There is no matter what branch we choose based on our JEE rank, we should go for a better college. It will all make sense once we are a year or 2 into the campus, we will have to figure out a lot of things and maybe discover where our interest lies.

reviews.review_title: Everything you need to know about IIT Bombay.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are as expected this year, 92% of students get placed. The highest package goes up to 54 LPA, the average package is 22 LPA, and the median is 24 LPA. The top recruiters are DLF, L&T, and Adani Infrastructure. Almost 62% of students from my course get internships in L&T and DLF. The top roles offered are Structural Design Engineer, Manager, and Reviewer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are pretty good, with plenty of smart classrooms equipped with high-speed internet and air conditioning. There is no library as such in the department, but there is a huge central library for the institute. The hostel facilities are good. Rooms are a bit small, but the mess food is very good. Hostel culture is very good, all festivals are celebrated. There is a pool/table tennis room, a music room with equipment worth 2 Lakhs, a gym in the hostel, a common TV room, and much more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are nice, well, some of them are, but not all. Teaching quality depends on the professor. The course curriculum is a bit irrelevant since this is a government institute. The semester exams are pretty chill, everyone studies just the night before and gets decent grades. But if you want to score really good grades, you have to put in great effort. Almost 75% of students pass the semester.
detailed_review.Other: Civil Engineering is taught best in my college in the whole country, and that’s why I choose my college. I think the connectivity with the city could be better, but it’s okay. The crowd is decent, the top cream from all over the country is here. We host Asia’s largest college festival, MOOD INDIGO. Also, we are the host of Asia’s largest technical fest, TECHFEST. Many scholarships are also available, like the tuition fee is waived for SC/ST students, and different scholarships are provided by private institutions as well, like Tata and SBI Bank. Sports facilities here are just supreme.

reviews.review_title: The best educational institution.

detailed_review.Placements: About 14% of total students enrolled in my course in a year. The highest package is 2.5 crores per annum, the lowest package is 12 LPA, and the average package is 25 LPA. Top companies are JLR, DRDO, and Tata. Around 40% of the students got internships at Tata Consultancy, JLR, etc. Top roles offered in internships are coordinator, tech team head, and general secretary of the hostel affairs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi available in each classroom as well as in the seminar halls of our department, and also in the core course labs. Wi-Fi is also present in our central library. The food available is a little above average in mess. But you can get better food in the canteens in each hostel. There is a central hospital on campus, and there are different tracks for different games.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful, as well as having a good sense of humour and are highly qualified as well as experienced in their particular domains. The course is very much relevant to the curriculum and can make the students industry-ready. Sometimes, the semester exams are a little bit tough. But the pass percentage is around 95%.

reviews.review_title: Overall, good in terms of placement, infrastructure, academics, college life and all.

detailed_review.Placements: At IIT Bombay, placement statistics vary by department. In most core engineering courses, around 80%-90% of students secure placements. The highest package can go beyond 4 crores per annum, while the lowest package is around 8 LPA-12 LPA, with an average of 20 LPA-30 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Reliance, and McKinsey. Around 85%-90% of students secure internships.  The internship scope is more as compared to other institutes, one just needs to develop networking opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. There is a specific infrastructure for each department. Every year is available with a Wi-Fi facility. Each hostel has LAN cables, library, sports room, music room, and other facilities. Some parent's hostels are not that good but the new hostels have the best facility in terms of everything.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are concept-heavy and challenging, requiring deep understanding and problem-solving skills, with good preparation. Mostly it is divided into quizzes, midterms, and end-sems. Sometimes assignments, attendance, and projects do have some weightage. Professors are highly qualified and supportive, ensuring excellent teaching quality. The curriculum is getting improved and getting industry-oriented projects.
detailed_review.Other: Some events are organized on a much bigger scale. Overall it is very good.

reviews.review_title: Life of a student at IIT Bombay.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 to 85 percent of the students in our course department get placed on campus every year. The rest choose higher education. Top recruiters were Boeing, Airbus, HAL, and a few automobile companies like BMW and TATA. Mainly offered roles were lead engineer, production engineer, chief designer, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are separate department buildings. There's a Wi-Fi connection all over the campus which runs with full speed. World-class lab facilities, air-conditioned classrooms, and labs. A huge library building has millions of books, research papers, journals, etc. Hostels are well-maintained, and proper cleaning happens every day by respective staff. The mess has good food. A multi-specialty hospital within the campus provides treatment. A big gymkhana ground with multiple indoor stadiums for volleyball, basketball, Kho-Kho, and badminton. Huge hockey court and football court. An athletic-level swimming pool too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-educated and qualified professionals with various research published under their name and the best teaching experience. Course curriculums are well-planned for the overall development of the students. Semester examinations are often made difficult to make the students learn from their mistakes, thus giving an opportunity to succeed better in life's problems.
detailed_review.Other: This course has been my dream course since the start of my preparation for exams. Every moment is the best thing at this college, especially the campus life. Multiple events like Techfest and Mood Indigo, the institute's cultural fest, are both known as Asia's largest college fests. Huge crowds, a green environment, and good scholarship facilities are provided by the institution.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has beautiful infrastructure and excellent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Bombay is mainly known for its placement records. Last year, students received offers from international countries like Japan, UAE, Singapore, and Taiwan. The average package of the 2023 batch is around 23 LPA, and the highest package is 3.5 crores per year. The placement percentage is nearly 75%. Students can apply for internships in the third-year summer, and last year, more than 400 students got internships in core companies, and 700+ students got internships in non-core companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has its own big ground and a beautiful campus. Classrooms are equipped with digital gadgets like projectors and smart boards. The best thing about our college is the hostel because it provides students with all the facilities, such as cleaned rooms, cleaned washrooms, and high-speed internet. The hostel mess food is also good. Girls and boys have separate hostels with privacy and safety.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of our college is excellent. All the faculty members are experienced. Their method of teaching depends on concepts and particular topics, and they teach us using digital boards and presentations. In my experience, the teachers here are very good, and they help us in every situation where we get stuck. Exams are taken by the college on a semester basis, and they are easy if you prepare with the study material provided by the faculty.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: As a summary, my college is the best in all aspects, and students love college environment as well.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are available for students in the seventh semester. The college has a placement team which works so hard for students, and they bring lots of companies to the campus. Last year, around 500 companies visited the campus, and more than 1400 students got placed. The average package offered at IIT Bombay is 23 LPA. From my department, Computer Science, around 307 students have been offered IT/Software jobs by more than 84 companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is amazing, and the size of the campus is huge. Students from various states come to study in the college, and so the college environment is also very nice. The classrooms are large and can accommodate more than 70-80 students per classroom. The classrooms have fans and are air-conditioned as well. The college has a total of 17 hostels, which have both undergraduate and postgraduate students. The mess food quality depends upon the hostel; in my hostel, it is good. Overall, we can say the infrastructure and facilities in the college are great.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. They support those students who do the work sincerely and also help in getting research papers published on different sites. We can approach them through mail or go to their cabins. Although there might be difficulties for them to teach so many students, they keep helping and solving our doubts. For exams, notes are enough, and the faculty provides us with PYQs, which are helpful for studies.

admission.title: IIT Bombay Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
IIT Bombay admissions are quite competitive. IIT Bombay comes under top IITs and is also ranked at '3' under the 'Engineering' category in NIRF 2025 rankings. Admission to its flagship BTech programme requires candidates to have a high JEE rank. With lakh of students appearing for JEE and only a few getting admission, it is required to prepare well-in advance. Aspirants need to pass JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced to get into BTech programme of IIT Bombay.

Admission to all other programmes of IIT Bombay is also entrance-based. The institute offers MTech, MSc, MBA, BDes, MDes, etc. through its various schools. The institute accepts scores in GATE for MTech, CAT for MBA, IIT JAM for MSc, UCEED for BDes and CEED for admission to MDes programme.

Check out the following video to get an insight on which is better among IIT Bombay and other related institutes:

faqs.answer: Yes, IIT Bombay conducts Common Entrance Exam for Design or CEED for admission to MDes programme. It is a national-level entrance exam conducted in online mode. Candidates apart from the tuition fee are required to pay examination fee, medical fee, etc. Students not staying in hostel are exempted from the payment of hostel fee. Step 2: IIT Bombay selects candidates for MDes programme based on CEED score. After qualifying CEED, the institute releases a category-wise merit list for each stream. Eligible candidates are required to appear for an IDC (written test) and an interview round. Step 3: After the completion of the selection rounds, IITB releases a final merit list. Selected candidates will then have to appear for the verification of documents in order to complete the admission.

data.title: IIT Bombay Placement Report 2024
summary: IIT Bombay placement process 2024 was completed on July 7, 2024. As usual a hybrid campus placement model was followed by IITB this placement season, which started in December 2023 and the interview process was conducted throughout the year for PhD students along with personal campus interviews during the summer placements. As of June 30, 1475 students were placed , which was the second highest number of students placed among all the IITs.

More than 1350 unique job offers were granted during this placement season at IIT Bombay. During IITB placements 2024, 543 companies registered out of which 388 participated in the placement drive and 364 companies made offers . According to the official placement report 2024, increase of 12% was witnessed in the number of recruiters as compared with the previous year. Importantly, 78 international offers were accepted during both the phases of IIT Bombay placements 2023-24. The highlight of IIT Bombay placement 2024 was – 22 offers of above INR 1 Crore per annum were accepted this year.

The average package and median packages offered during IIT Bombay placements 2024 were INR 23.5 LPA and INR 17.92 LPA , respectively. In addition, the overall placement rate recorded during IIT Bombay placements 2024 was 74.53% . Other than this, the overall placement rate recorded during BTech and Dual Degree (BTech + MTech) placements 2024 was 83.39% and 79.16% , respectively. Under the MTech course, 415 students were placed out of 497 participating students with a recorded placement rate of 83.5%.

The overall placement rate recorded during IIT Bombay placements 2024 was 74.53% with 1,475 students participating in the process out of 1,979 students. A total of 930 students registered,  819 students participated and 683 students were placed durinng BTech placements 2024. The placement percentage went this low because of minimal or no participation in the placement process from over 400 students. Most of them went for higher studies, such as MS / MTech / PhD and MBA courses, while many opted for entrepreneurship or civil services.

placement_faqs.question: What is the salary of MBA in IIT Bombay SJMSOM?
placement_faqs.answer: The placement rate recorded during SJMSOM IIT Bombay MBA placements 2023 was 100%. Students get a good salary package after completing MBA from a reputed institute like SJMSOM. The highest package and average package offered during SJMSOM IIT Bombay MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 54 LPA and INR 28.88 LPA , respectively. The top recruiters of SJMSOM IIT Bombay in 2023 included leading companies such as GEP, HUL, Google, Accenture, Cargill, etc.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Bombay is considered the top choice among Engineering aspirants not only because of its high-tech advanced studies and curriculum but also for its state-of-the-art campus. The institute’s campus is spread over 550 acres . It is located on the outskirts of Powai, Mumbai , which is distant from an hour from the main city. The campus is easily accessible via the Bus Terminal, the Railway station and the Airport from the main city. IIT Bombay campus is surrounded by lush greenery and houses distinctive amenities such as banks, a shopping centre, two excellent schools for children, a well-equipped hospital, hostels, modern libraries and more. For more details on IIT Bombay infrastructure , check out the campus tour video below:

sections.heading: IIT Bombay Campus Highlights
text: The IIT Bombay campus provides all the facilities for the holistic development of students. Ranging from hi-tech classrooms to libraries and comfortable hostel facilities, the institute manages to be at the top in every sphere. IIT Bombay infrastructure includes several advanced R&D facilities, including sophisticated state-of-the-art laboratories, instructional facilities, and teaching aids. The institute has excellent recreational facilities for sports, including gymnasiums, a swimming pool, and courts for tennis, basketball, volleyball, hockey, football and cricket, athletics tracks and much more. A few more highlights are tabulated below:

tables.IIT Delhi Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Sports Complex, Auditorium, Research centres, Banks, Medical services, Gym, etc.
Availability of 5 lakh+ Books, Journals, Theses and E-books

sections.heading: IIT Bombay Hostel
text: IIT Bombay hostel facilities are well-known for their advanced amenities and attractive hostel life. The institute has a total of 18 hostels, which are managed and coordinated by the Hostel Coordinating Unit (HCU) of IIT Bombay. Students living inside the hostel premises of the institute get a private caterer serving meals. A well-equipped sports complex is also available separately for every hostel.

The first-year students from all the UG & PG courses are allocated the same hostel. This hostel-sharing facility is only applicable in the first year of the respective courses. Apart from the regular students, the hostel rooms are also allotted to external interns during summer and winter internships. Other than that, the Guest accommodation facility is also provided for one week to parents visiting their children at the campus.

text: IIT Bombay provides one of the best hostel facilities among other premier institutions of the nation. Check out the video below for the IIT Bombay review:

sections.heading: IIT Bombay Library
text: The Central Library of IIT Bombay has a repository of knowledge for its students. The library has a mix of both traditional and modern learning resources. The Central Library is indexed with an overall of 5 lakh books , extensive theses, publications, journals and various other reading materials. Moreover, there are around 1000 CDs , 231 DVDs and E-books in store. Along with that, the library is equipped with modern plagiarism detection software and provides an electronic collection of research to boost digital learning.

sections.heading: IIT Bombay Sports Facilities
text: IIT Bombay facilitates students by promoting their physical development through sports. The institutes provide a dynamic range of gaming options such as Athletics, Basketball, Badminton, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Lawn Tennis, Squash, Swimming, Table Tennis, etc. Every individual hostel has its own Volleyball and Basketball courts. Alongside Cricket Pitches and Football fields, other fields are also available. Furthermore, indoor games like Snooker, Table Tennis , and Football Tables are also provided at the hostel.
First-year students must register for extracurricular activities, including sports, as per the scheme of the National Sports Organisation.

IIT Bombay Sports Festival- AAVHAN : Every year, IIT Bombay organises a three-day sports festival for sports enthusiasts. A total of 13 sports are played in the festival. Over three thousand sportspersons from universities, clubs and organisations across the nation take part and give tough competition.

sections.heading: Places to visit in and around the IIT Bombay campus
text: College life is not only restricted to the classrooms and libraries. To explore and enjoy the free time at the institute, students can visit the main city of Mumbai, which is easily accessible within an hour's drive.

IIT Bombay has many canteens and cafeterias inside the campus that run up to late night and provide affordable options. Many nearby places can also be visited during the free hours or to relax on weekends. IIT Kanpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: First, clear the CAT, then think about this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements commence for us in the 3rd semester, and there is a 100% placement rate. Companies like Wells Fargo, McKinsey, Axtria, etc., visit and give about 50+ offers. The highest package is around 24 lac/annum, and the average is about 16 lac/annum. For internships, companies like ICICI Bank and Emphasis visit. The roles offered are diverse, from Data Analyst to Product Management, and the total stipend ranges from 1-200,000 for most internships. It gives the students very good industry exposure.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel rooms are pretty basic but not bad at all. The meal quality is very good. The hostel fee is about 10-15000 for a semester. The library offers a wide range of books from academic to non-academic. We can also make their virtual copy available via the library app and website. The classrooms have AC, a blackboard, & a projector. The IITK offers a wide range of sports, from football, cricket, skating, and boxing etc. Anyone who is interested in any of these activities can come and play.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is very rigorous and depends on the student's requirements. The course consists of 4 semesters. The faculty have a great subjective knowledge that they pass on to the students. They are all very experienced in teaching management. There is 1 faculty member for every 25 students. The exams are very hard, but subject-based.

reviews.review_title: IIT Kanpur College review.

detailed_review.Placements: Every single student who went for placement ended up getting a spot in coaching institutes like Physics Wallah and Prutor, with packages typically ranging from about 6 to 7 LPA. When it comes to math, it seems like a lot of folks are looking to pursue their Ph.D., whether in India or overseas, if we are talking placements, Statistics is actually doing better than Mathematics in our department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Talking about the colleges infrastructure, it includes all the basics, clean water supply, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports, there is also a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students can take advantage of transportation and on-campus housing if they do not have their own rides, the mess is kept clean, and while the food is pretty good, I think adding more choices that students like would be a bonus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty and staff do a solid job here. First-year classes felt a lot like high school, which made the transition smoother, the college does a nice job recognizing academic achievements and really goes out of its way to celebrate the top performers.

reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied because of faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package is 9 LPA, and the average package is 7 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. About 60% of the students got placed in our batch. Many reputed companies reached our college campus for recruitment, and several students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and labs are average and not cleaned on a daily basis. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is not acceptable. Wi-Fi facilities are only for faculty members. The hostel rooms are not so comfortable and very small. Sports and medical facilities are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified and knowledgeable but they are not much helpful. They became angry if students asked about their doubts. The teaching quality is good but the behaviour of faculty members is not acceptable. Only few curriculum activities are conducted.

reviews.review_title: IIIT Kanpur College review.

detailed_review.Placements: Honestly, when it comes to placements for this course, it’s pretty much non-existent. Hardly any companies show up for recruitment. Now, if you look at other courses, though, the situation is much brighter. They actually have solid placement opportunities. And here’s a little silver lining: students from this course can still throw their hats in the ring for placements in those other programs. On average, the packages can reach anywhere from 10 to 15 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities, You know, the on-campus housing is actually quite comfy and well-managed. A lot of students choose to live there. As for the food service, it’s okay, meets the basic standards, nothing fancy.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty here is just fantastic. Every single member really knows their stuff when it comes to their field. They’re super accessible and are always ready to lend a hand to students, the way they teach works well, giving students a solid grasp of the material, the curriculum is modern, and the test questions strike a nice balance, not too easy, not too hard.

reviews.review_title: IIT Kanpur College review.

detailed_review.Placements: In our senior batch, 55 out of 70 students have secured placements so far, with an average package of 15 LPA as a base. The big names hiring include Microsoft, Intel, Flipkart, and Saplabs, among others. As for the roles, we are talking about SDE, data scientists, and cybersecurity engineers. The highest package is 60 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus comprises all the required academic and research buildings, a central library, well-equipped labs, and classrooms that have Wi-Fi accessibility. In addition to this, students may use the residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation is generally considered satisfactory. The food in the mess is middling, and the health center is staffed with medical professionals who are there to help if someone falls sick.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff comprises faculty members who possess good qualifications and have sufficient knowledge. They are very creative in their activities, and this attracts listeners. They are using the method of storytelling and participating in discussions to explain the concepts. The curriculum is on point and perfectly suitable. Otherwise, students who are well-covered in the concepts are mostly good at finding ways to clear the exams.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 75% of students get placed every year in my course. The highest package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. The percentage of students who got internships in my course is 60%. Companies like Visa, Tech Mahindra, and Axis Bank visit the college every year for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library, and all things are present. The food is very good. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games are also present in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my course are so good helpful and qualified. They all have great teaching qualities. The course curriculum is not relevant. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams in my course are so easy. The pass percentage is more than 70% in this course.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to get the best knowledge, and we got a job in my course. Events and campus crowd are good. Scholarships are available in my course.

reviews.review_title: IIT Kanpur for Ph.D. CE and other stream course admission information.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college, there are many companies interested in this course and providing the best package, like 7 LPA to 30 LPA. The highest salary is present. This company provides a 2 to 3 years agreement for employees who do not resign from the company. This course is held every year, and the maximum number of students is placed in the company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In this college, infrastructure is also good because it is a top college for this course. In this college, facilities are provided like classrooms, labs, a hostel, a bathroom, a library, a canteen, an auditorium, a lift, CCTV, etc. Facilities are available. Sports and games facilities are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: In this course, faculty is very good and manages the organisation to follow the rules and regulations of the college. In this college, professors and teachers with high level qualifications are present, and the best quality of teaching knowledge is available. This exam was very difficult, but this college provides some important questions to be asked in the exam.

reviews.review_title: IIT Kanpur is about admission, campus, faculty, students, and exams.

detailed_review.Placements: This college provides placement facilities. Every year, the placement cell is organized for many departments of students. The college offers courses for both IT and non-IT jobs. Companies provide packages ranging from 4 LPA to 20 LPA for average students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college provides good facilities such as fast Wi-Fi, Ethernet connections, labs, computers, CCTV, lifts, a campus canteen, and water purifier machines. Sports committees organize many sports and game tournaments, and gym facilities are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is relevant and good. But the college enforces many rules and regulations that students must follow compulsorily. In this college, attendance of 75% or above is compulsory to attend the practical and theoretical exams. The exams are not difficult because internal marks are included.

reviews.review_title: The best four years that I will spend.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from Chemical Engineering, and in my branch, around 80% of students get placed. The highest package offered is 50 LPA, the median is 21 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. The top recruiting company from my branch is Microsoft, offering 50 LPA. The top roles offered are SDE, consulting, and data analytics roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility is great, and labs are a bit hectic, but the infrastructure is top-class. The library has an occupancy of around 500 students and is a three-storey building. The infrastructure of hostels is quite old, so in the beginning, it might be difficult to live as there is no AC. The food quality in the mess is better than that of any other engineering college. The health centre at IIT Kanpur provides medicine and treatment completely free of cost. The campus provides facilities for all sorts of games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors here are among the most educated in the world, having completed their Ph.D. from the best universities globally. There is no limit to the knowledge at IIT Kanpur. The semester exams are much more difficult than those of other IITs, and the grading here is also tough.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this branch because it is the only one I am getting according to my rank. The fest is the best thing here, as we enjoy amazing concerts by renowned artists like Sonu Nigam, Badshah, Ritviz, etc.

reviews.review_title: Review of Vishnu Shiksha.

detailed_review.Placements: Highest percentage of students who can get placed in my course in the year is high. The highest package offered to students is more than 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are in my course. The percentage of students who got internships in this course is more than 60%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are very good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, library ,all these things are available in my course. The quality and facilities present in my hostel, including food, are very good. Medical help is also present in this course. Sports and games are available in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my course are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They have great teaching qualities. This course is curriculum relevant, and students are industry-ready. Semester exams in my course are very difficult, yet the pass percentage is more than 60%.
detailed_review.Other: I am choosing this course for getting very knowledge is no which came to in my perceivements and campus so good but its scholarship is not present.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Shaswat's review of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: At my college, more than 80% of students got placed in top companies in India. The highest package offered to students in my course was more than 3 lakhs per month, and the lowest package was nearly Rs. 20,000 per month. The percentage of students who got internships in companies from my course was 95%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course were super. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and the library were all available. The quality of food in the college canteen was very good. Medical facilities were available. Sports and games were also provided for students at the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my course were very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They had great teaching qualities. This course was curriculum-relevant, and students were industry-ready. The semester exams in my course were easy. The pass percentage was more than 70%.
detailed_review.Other: There was nothing that needed improvement in my course, events, or campus, as everything was very good. However, scholarships were not available in my course.

reviews.review_title: Excellent college, good facilities, enjoyable fests, but hard academics.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 70% of the students of Mechanical Engineering got placed in 2024–25. The average package is 20 Lacs per annum. The top recruiting companies are Tata, Mahindra, and L&T. Nearly 50% of the students got internships in automobile and sales companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The lecture halls are excellent, fully furnished, and equipped with AC. There are different labs for various purposes, equipped with computers for student use. A vast library is also available for the use of students and faculty, with a large number of books. The hostel has all the facilities for mess and sports. The quality of food being served in the mess is above average. Medical facilities are also provided on campus, with an ambulance available whenever needed
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very helpful and knowledgeable. They teach each topic briefly and encourage doubts. The course curriculum is relevant  prepares students to work at the industrial level. Semester exams are much harder compared to other colleges. The pass percentage is nearly 70%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest, and also I got this only from my JEE Advanced rank. This course enables you to solve real life problems in the industry. Several fests are organized on campus through out the year, like sports fest, cultural fest, and tech fest. Scholarships are provided for students. There are many clubs and societies for extracurricular activities, from media and culture to science and technology.

reviews.review_title: The culture here is nice, but academics are a bit hectic.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80% of students get placed. The highest package is around 2.25 crore per annum. The minimum package is 10 LPA in 2024. The top recruiting companies for our course are Optiver and Google. Internship percentage is about 15%. Students do internships in companies like Google and Nvidia. The top roles offered are PIO-PPO.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have high-speed Wi-Fi in our hostels, classrooms, and labs. The infrastructure for EE is a bit old, as it is one of the oldest branches, but it's fine. Labs are working well. The quality of food in hostels is fine. Sports here are top tier. Medical facilities are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very well qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is also good. The course curriculum is very relevant, and it makes students both office-wise and industry-wise ready. Semester exams are a bit tough, and mostly, the pass percentage is 25%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had an interest in EE. Placements were good in EE. It should improve labs and theoretical classes, and be able to make everyone understand it.

reviews.review_title: Very satisfied with services and faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package is 16 LPA, the average package is 10 LPA, and the lowest package is 5.5 LPA. Many big and reputed companies visit our institute, and about 30% of students get internships. Around 70% of students are placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is very clean and surrounded by plants and trees everywhere. Classrooms and labs are well-maintained and modified with all requirements. A well-stocked library is also available. Multiple sports and medical facilities, along with coaches, are present.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members for our course are very experienced and skilled. They are very knowledgeable and helpful. They provide both online and offline resources for studies. Our course curriculum is relevant, and many activities are conducted by the institute.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Kanpur - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements of IIT Kanpur are very good. Everyone is provided with resources and knowledge for getting offers for placements. Every now and then different companies are invited to let us know about the prerequisites to get internships and placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the hostel, library, and classrooms, Wi-Fi is always available. They are very clean and hygienic. Even food tastes like home-made food. Sports and game facilities are available to interested students. We can also develop games by joining clubs which teach these things.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very learned people in terms of knowledge as well and they are always available to help us. Academics are tough here but can be handled with a little bit of discipline and management. Semester exams are mostly moderate to tough. The grading system is also good.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am interested in things that are taught in this course. Events and fests are very pompous and crowded which I find very enjoying. Different types of clubs are there to strengthen their interest and ensure confidence.

reviews.review_title: The best thing about IIT Kanpur is its ongoing events and study going together.

detailed_review.Placements: 70-80% of students usually got placed and almost everyone got an offer. Sometimes, companies can apply cutoff criteria but it is fine. Many high-level companies like Microsoft, Google, BCG, and many other foreign as well as Indian companies hire students from my campus. The average package of all the departments ranges from 30-40 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of IIT Kanpur is already known and raised by everyone. It is 2nd in area-wise after IIT Kharagpur. Wi-Fi facilities are top-notch. We can get a Wi-Fi signal on roads too. The quality of the food is already known by everyone and it has the best of all IITs in serving mess facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not like our school teachers and more like professors as they teach and go. But some of the teachers also try to be friendly with students. Semester exams are usually moderate to tough but if we study well, we can end up well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Materials Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed in my course of material science and engineering. The average package is around 17 LPA. Prominent recruiters include Tata Steel, Reliance Industries, Larsen and Toubro, and Infosys. Internship opportunities are less in this course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have modern classrooms with smart boards, projectors, and comfortable seating. IIT Kanpur has one of the largest technical libraries in India known as PK Kelkar library. We have access to high-speed internet all over the campus. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is amazing.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Kanpur has highly qualified faculty members. They are known to be highly knowledgeable and research-driven. Professors here set a very tough exam paper but if we attend the class regularly and listen carefully to the things the professor has taught in the class, it won't be that tough.

reviews.review_title: Review from undergraduate of IIT Kanpur.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in the mechanical engineering department of IIT Kanpur. There are 150 students in my department. More than 1,200 students are placed in my batch for the year 2022. The highest package is 4 crores per annum and the lowest package ranges from 6-8 LPA. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Nvidia, Texas Instruments, and Adobe are some big companies that visit the college for placements. Around 50 to 60% of students got internships on the campus. Companies that came for internships are mostly the same who came for placements here. Roles like software, core, finance, data analytics, etc., are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good here. It provides big lecture halls with all the facilities and labs with all the facilities. It has a huge library with every book we need to study. We will get every facility in the hostel itself like a canteen and mess. The quality of food is also good here. For medical facilities, we have a health center here where we can go if we have any problems. Sports facilities are also good here. We have three big grounds for hockey, cricket, and football. It has a sports complex for indoor games like badminton, table tennis, yoga, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of IIT Kanpur are highly educated. Their teaching quality is pretty good and it also depends on faculty to faculty. The course curriculum is a bit difficult here, and it will make us ready for any industry. Semester exams are not that difficult, and if we study we can achieve good marks or good grades in our courses. Grading is relevant here so I cannot say the exact percentage where we will be passing in any course. At 30%, we will be considered as passed in every course.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the B.Tech in mechanical department course because it is better than all the other options and I got it through my rank. I do not think there is anything to improve, and everything is good here. Many events are conducted on campus just like fests. We have two or three major festivals like an annual technical, an annual cultural festival, and a sports fest. The annual technical first name is Techkriti, the annual cultural fest name is Antaragni, and the annual sports fest name is Udghosh. Connectivity is moderate. We have a metro line just outside the campus so if we want to go anywhere we can use that. We have a scholarship on MCM where students' tuition fee is waived if their annual parental income is less than 6 lakhs. There are many extracurricular activities like sports, fine, arts, dance, music, etc.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Mathematics and Scientific Computing
reviews.review_title: The college has a good infrastructure and environment.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 90% of students got placed in our course. Top recruiters are Graviton, Optiver, Goldman Sachs, Adobe, Dream 11, and Amazon. They recruit students from our department for quant research, software development, data analysis, data science, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for my department are average somewhat lower than the departments like CSE and electrical. The quality of the facilities of the hostel is quite good including mess and canteen. Sports equipment is also available for use.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers or faculty members are helpful, highly qualified, and knowledgeable. The courses are more oriented towards core mathematics and quite helpful for higher studies. Semester exams are difficult in some courses and the pass percentage is relative to the performance of other students.

reviews.review_title: Very hectic academics, very bad experience with Maths courses really tough, and very hard grading.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good, obviously as it is IIT. Overall average package is between 25 LPA to 30 LPA. Branches like CS have an average package of 50 LPA. My branch of chemical engineering has an average of 20 LPA with almost 90% placement rate. Internships are also very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are not of that good quality, Wi-Fi is good and 24X7 available. Food is not that good if anyone has high expectations from IIT and it is an old IIT. All sports facilities are available on the campus and hostel. All sports equipment and all kinds of sports are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Courses are tough. There is a perception of people about IIT Kanpur that academics are quite tough and it is true to a certain extend. The first-year mathematics course fees and the grading of professors are really bad. There are also useless courses like Biology, Ethics, and English.

admission.title: IIT Kanpur Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
IIT Kanpur admissions are mainly offered based on student's score in the accepted entrance . The test is followed  by counselling for admission to courses, such as BTech and MTech. The institute offers UG, PG, and PhD level courses in the fields of Engineering and Technology. BTech is the flagship course of IIT Kanpur . Other than BTech, students are also offered BSc, MSc, and MTech courses.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Kanpur?
faqs.answer: Check below IIT Kanpur admission process:

faqs.question: Can I get admission in IIT Kanpur without JEE?
faqs.answer: No, IIT Kanpur admissions are not possible without JEE scores if the students wants to join BTech or BSc courses. For both courses, JEE Main is mandatory. Also, for BTech admissions, students also need to appear for the JEE Advanced exam.

faqs.question: What if my rank isn't good enough for IIT Kanpur? Are there any other options?
faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur JAM Cutoff 2024 has been released for Round 2. The most competitive course was M.Sc in Statistics, with the Cutoff of 63 . For the OBC AI category candidates, the Cutoff stood at 187 , for M.Sc in Statistics. If the Cutoff rank is more than 63, there is no scope of admission to IITs for M.Sc in Statistics.

faqs.question: What minimum marks are required in JEE Mains to be eligible for JEE Advanced?
faqs.answer: The minimum marks required in JEE Mains to qualify for JEE Advanced 2026 will be announced with the JEE Main 2026 final result after session 2 exams. Last year's minimum marks in JEE Mains to qualify for JEE Advanced were: 2025: 2024: 2023: Candidates aiming for admission to the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) need to meet these cutoff marks in JEE Mains to be eligible for JEE Advanced 2026.

faqs.question: Can I get into IIT Kanpur with 60% in Class 12?
faqs.answer: No, you can't get admission in IIT Kanpur with 60% in Class 12. The institute accepts students who have a minimum of 75% (for general category) in Class 12. Even for the reserved categories, the minimum score is 65%. Hence,  60% is not enough to get admission in IIT Kanpur UG courses.

faqs.question: What are the Cutoff marks for IIT Kanpur BSc Economics course?
faqs.answer: The closing rank of round one for the IIT Kanpur BSc Economics course for the year 2023 through the JEE Advanced was 3,242 while on another hand the closing rank of last round for the BSc Economics course was 3,653.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for IIT Kanpur admission?
faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur eligibility is different for each course. Students need to meet the basic admission requirements to get admission. faqs.question: What is the cutoff of IIT Kanpur for 2025 admission?
faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur JEE Advanced cutoff 2025 ranged between 271 and 10482 for BTech admission for multiple specialisations, based on the last round closing ranks for the General AI category candidates, wherein, according to JEE Advanced cutoff 2025, BTech in Computer Science and Engineering had the toughest competition. Students aiming for admission should strive for a rank of 10482 or preferably lower to increase their chances for admission. Please note that different cutoffs are released for different categories and rounds.

faqs.question: What is the last date to fill the choices in JoSAA counselling?
faqs.answer: The dates for JoSAA counselling 2026 choice filling will be announced once the result of JEE Main 2026 is declared. Candidates can fill choices only during the choice filling period. Also, candidates need to lock their choices before the last date.

faqs.answer: No, you can't get direct admission in IIT Kanpur. The institute only offers entrance-based admissions. Students must meet both the general eligibility and selection requirements to get a seat at the institute. Some of the accepted exams include JEE Mains/ JEE Advanced/ GATE/ IIT JAM, etc.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for Surge IIT Kanpur Program?
faqs.answer: Students-Undergraduate Research Graduate Excellence (SURGE) is an internship programme of IIT Kanpur. The programme is offered to the three categories - SAARC students, Non-IITK students, and IIT Kanpur students. The eligibility to get the SURGE IIT Kanpur internship may vary depending on the category of the students. The minimum eligibility requires the candidates to complete 3rd of BTech course.

faqs.question: Can I get admission for BTech at IIT Kanpur without JEE?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech programme at IIT Kanpur is entrance exam-based, i.e., based on JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced scores. Candidates seeking admission to BTech can not get admission to IIT Kanpur with only the scores of JEE Main. JEE Advanced followed by JoSAA counselling is the final selection criteria followed by the institute. However, to be eligible for the BTech programme, students are required to have passed their Class 12 with at least 75% aggregate with Science subjects (i.e., Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics). Read on to know more around IIT Kanpur BTech course .

faqs.question: Is it difficult to get into IIT Kanpur for BTech?
faqs.answer: IIT Kanpur is ranked 4 for Engineering by NIRF 2022. Considered under the top 5 eminent institutes in the country for Engineering education, the cutoffs are comparatively higher. In JoSAA Round 6 of 2022, BTech CSE was the top course with the highest cutoff score of 237. For other courses, such as Aerospace Engineering, the cutoff score stood at 4683 in the R-6. Hence, it is true that it is difficult to get into IIT Kanpur. However, with the right preparation and study strategy, it is never impossible to achieve the goal.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Kanpur for MTech?

faqs.question: Is there a provision of pursuing an integrated BTech degree at IIT Kanpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, IIT Kanpur also offers an option of a dual degree, i.e., Bachelors-Masters Dual Degree to the students. A student earns both a bachelor’s and a master’s degree at the end of this five-year course. The dual degree programme has three categories: Category  In this case, both degrees are in the same discipline/department. Example: BTech-M Tech. Category B: This is a two-discipline/ department programme where the bachelor’s degree is in the parent discipline/ department and the master’s degree is in a different discipline/ department. Thus, three combinations are possible in this category, ex: BTech-M Tech, BTech-MS and BTech-MDes. Students can choose any one of the aforementioned combinations. Category C: In this case, the bachelor’s degree is in the parent discipline/ department and the master’s degree is MBA. Ex: BTech-MBA. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT
