reviews.review_title: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur B.Sc. Geology Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Bachelor of Science placements are decent. Around 60-70% students of students in the batch get placed every year. The average package offered to the students is good enough; it's like 18 -20 Lacs per annum. Core + PSU roles dominate.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur has decent labs, classrooms, modern libraries with 24/7 Wi-Fi facility, sports facilities. There are primary healthcare centers, auditoriums, banks, shops, and restaurants available on the campus of IIT Kharagpur itself.
detailed_review.Faculty: Experienced faculty with strong research and industry experience, many of the professors have PHDs or Master's degrees, a high-class degree in their fields. The curriculum covers rock/mineral Science, geomorphology, geophysics, petroleum geology, fieldwork, labs, mapping, etc. That keeps Practical+ theory balanced.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best part of my life is spent here at IIT Kharagpur.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college, they are providing the best salary packages, and every year, a total of 40 percent of students are placed in these companies. In this college, there are many companies providing internships because it is the very best college in India. The top recruiters are TCS, Accenture, Tata Group, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college's infrastructure and quality of things are very high and provide many facilities to the students. In this course, facilities are available like fast Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, fans, bathrooms, branches, hostels, canteens, etc. In this college, the canteen food is very tasty; it is like homemade food.
detailed_review.Faculty: This college's faculty and curriculum are very good. The teachers are very knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is very good. This course is a total of 4 years in duration, and 5 semester exams are conducted by the college. So they are so helpful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, good peer connection, and night walks.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college, they are providing the best package salary, and every year, a total of 40 percent of students are placed in these companies. In this college, there are many companies providing internships because it is the very best college in India. The top recruiters are TCS, Accenture, Tata Group, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college's infrastructure and quality of facilities are very high and provide many facilities to the students. In this course, facilities are available like fast Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, fans, bathrooms, branches, hostels, canteens, etc. In this college, the canteen food is very tasty. It is like homemade food.
detailed_review.Faculty: This college's faculty and curriculum are very good. The teachers are very knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is very good. This course is a total of 4 years in duration, and 5 semester exams are conducted by the college. All types of books are available. One special thing is that at IIT Kharagpur.

reviews.review_title: Mother of all IITs - IIT Kharagpur.

detailed_review.Placements: During the current placement, there were 1000+ offers in just two days. In my department, Mechanical Engineering, about 70% of students get placed. The average placement package is 17-18 LPA, the highest going upto 50-55 LPA. If we talk about the maximum package offered, it sometimes crosses 2 crores.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: State-of-the-art infrastructure is present for all the students. Labs, classes and libraries are best. The hostels can be a little disappointing, the food there is not that good, and it will take time to adjust to the taste of the mess food. But you can always find night canteens and restaurants inside the campus if you want to treat yourself to good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are the best in their fields. Every one of them is highly qualified and has studied at the best universities in the world. Well, their approachability and bonding with the students can be debatable, as it depends on the proof of whether he is friendly or not. The curriculum is relevant, after all, it's an IIT. The semester exams are fairly difficult, they test us on all aspects of the subject.
detailed_review.Other: For me, choosing this course was very easy. I was always very interested in physics and mathematics, so mechanical engineering is a department that has the best of both worlds. Talking about the fests of our college, these are the best days of our campus life.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. (Hons.) + M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Its the top college in India, you have to qualify for this.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements in IITKP are very good, as a lot of companies visit due to the placements. The B.Tech students are available to sit for placements in their 4th year, while the dual degree students are available to sit for placements in their 5th year. In my course, the highest package in general lies around 1.5 crores per annum, and the lowest package lies around 10 to 20 LPA. There are five profiles that students choose during placements. The software development is the one I am choosing, and the companies offer, on average, around 20LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities in IITKGP are not up to the mark. The hostels are mostly run based on Hall tempo and bonding. The library here is also one of the biggest libraries of all the IITs, and it has a lot of rooms where you can sit and study. It stays open till 12 o'clock. Almost all of the books are available in the library that you want to read, or it has access to the national digital library, and you can read anything that you want. The facilities of technological aspects are also really good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members here are really approachable moreover, the relationship between the faculty members and the students is very good. The exams are held on a semester basis. There are two main exams for theory, which are mid semester and end semester examinations, where for most of the courses the end semester examination holds a weightage of 50 percent and the mid sem holds about 30 percent. The rest of the 20 percent are on the hands of the professors.

reviews.review_title: An engineering life at IIT Kharagpur is very joyful and good.

detailed_review.Placements: 85 to 90 percent of students got placed in my course. The highest package ranges from 20-24 LPA. The lowest package ranges from 4-5 LPA. The average package ranges from 8-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course are Accenture, TCS, Infosys, etc. 70-77 percent of students got internships. Top roles offered are software engineer, project associate, analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Many facilities are available in our college. Wi-Fi is very good and useful for our academic career. High-speed Wi-Fi is also available at our central library. Hostel facilities are available and comfortable. Hostel food is satisfactory, but it is not good. There are good games to play, like cricket, carrom, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, technically qualified, and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is very good. They are teaching theoretical knowledge and practical skills. Semester exams are very difficult and tricky. In physics, the weave topic is difficult. I don't know about the pass percentage now.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course on my own because I'm not interested in coding and in core subjects. Best part of our course is the balance of practical labs and theoretical depth. Events and fests are not very enjoyable.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Hydraulic and Water Resources Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Kharagpur.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of students get placed in IIT Kharagpur M.Tech Hydraulics. The average package is around 13 to 14 LPA, and around 70-75% of students get internships in firms/companies. Top roles are hydraulics engineer, research and development engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of IIT Kharagpur is very good, as it has high-speed Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi), and it also has many labs that are very good and well-maintained by the college. The mess food is also very good and hygienic, and the hostels are also well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at IIT Kharagpur are very nice and good for students, as many of them hold PhDs or master's degrees in their field. They are well-experienced in their respective fields, and they make the students industry-ready, so they don't have to suffer.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Kharagpur is one of the top 10 IIT colleges. It is difficult to get a seat, the seats are allocated by writing the JEE Advanced. Many students are showing interest in getting a seat in an IIT college. 90 percent of students got placed from our course. The highest package is 70 LPA, the lowest package is 12 LPA, and the average package is 22 LPA. The top companies visited are Microsoft, Flipkart, and Amazon.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The IIT Kharagpur infrastructure is old, but it's clean and filled with greenery. All facilities are available in our college, with full speed of Wi-Fi, all resources are available in our college, with full security, and the hostel rooms are clean, and the hostel food is tasty and hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are well-trained after completing post-graduation, and their teaching skills are excellent. They explain clearly. The faculty members are friendly with students, the academics of IIT colleges are tougher and difficult to get good marks, but the education prepares the students to get ready to pace. The semesters are difficult, but it is easy to pass the semester exam.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. (Hons.) + M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Top student in India to get into this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements were wonderful expected from a top IIT. Many multinational companies visited our college. Almost all students got jobs abroad or in India. Microsoft, Google, Facebook, Apple, Samsung, etc, were the recruiters. The highest package offered was 44LPA and the lowest package offered was 12LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was world class. This was the best campus in all of India. Classrooms were made fully furnished by the British Empire. All facilities were available in the classrooms. Library is like a university campus, with all types of books in the world available. There are gardens, a swimming pool, different grounds for different sports and many extracurricular activities present. Hostels are very good. Mess food is very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: This is the IT all world class professors are available here. All topmost professors are present at IIT Kharagpur. The course curriculum is very good but many students' thought processes are far away. The course Curriculum consists of two semesters in a year. The IIT question papers are very tough. Many students are doing internships and projects throughout the year.

reviews.review_title: It is a big place where you can definitely find someone with the same vibe as you.

detailed_review.Placements:
Around 64 per cent of students got placed after college, and others are going for higher studies.
The highest package has been around 64 LPA, the lowest is around 12 LPA, and the average is at 19 LPA.
Some of the government companies are ISRO, DRDO, and HAL, as well as some international giants, such as Airbus. 
Some of the roles are aviation engineer and aircraft engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
The Wi-Fi connection is smooth and good, and is available through the hostel's classroom library and even the auditoriums. 
It has one of the biggest libraries, but some books are not so well-maintained. 
The quality of food is enough to survive in terms of taste, but it is also nutritious for the body.
There is a hospital on the campus, which is open 24/7
We have a court for basketball, volleyball and badminton in every respective hall, with the seniors allowing anyone interested to play to go to the hostel to play.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The teachers were very helpful and supportive, and every teacher was ready to address individual student doubts.
The course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready
The semester exam is not difficult if a person just attends every class and focuses on the class without any extra studying or problem solving, they can get quite good marks, but not the best. 
The pass percentage is around between 30 and 40 per cent.
detailed_review.Other:
I chose it because I love JET engines, and in future, I want to study it and make an aircraft with the best JET engine that I will design. 
There are springs fest inter IITs societies and many more fun extracurricular activities with top-notch labs for those interested in further studies.

reviews.review_title: Everything is excellent, only sometimes the infrastructure may seem to be old.

detailed_review.Placements: Our batch is called semi-circular. Some companies consider us as circular, and some of them don't because of the course structure. 70-80% companies will be open to us, except the HFTs ( some of them are only open for the CS branch). Depending on the skills you have, you can get an internship or placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The academic section is excellent. Wi-Fi (avg speed 200mbps) is available throughout the whole campus. Hostels are not up to date. In the first year, you will get a triple-sharing room. From the second year, you may get a triple sharing or a single room, depending on the hostel you are allotted. From the third year onwards, you are allotted single rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are friendly. They try to explain everything, but the rest is upon you, that's how you manage your studies. Some of the subjects are very easy rest of them are tough. If you just follow the lectures and class notes, it is easy to score well on the exam.
detailed_review.Other: IIT Kharagpur is the oldest one. There are lots of places to explore and pass free time inside the campus itself. You can't expect city life here, as it is situated near a small town.

reviews.review_title: Good placements but bad gender ratio.

detailed_review.Placements: There is a CDC (Career Development Centre) which manages placement-related activities. CDC conducts various sessions before placements and internships. There are many companies that visit our Institute. The renowned companies are Google, Microsoft, Adobe, JP Morgan, BlackRock, and many more. The highest package is usually in crores, and the average is around 15 LPA to 20 LPA. Almost 80% students get placed in on-campus placement. Almost 50% students get internship through CDC. Rest apply for off-campus. Top roles are quant, software, and consulting.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are around 21 hostels in the institute, approximately 16 hostels for boys and 5 for girls. I live in Nehru Hall. This is one of the oldest hostels in IIT Kharagpur. Sundar Pichai also stayed here. There are facilities like Wi-Fi, cooler, geyser, LAN connection, etc. The mess food quality is average, as in most of the hostels. They serve food 4 times a day, 2 heavy meals and 2 light meals. Hostel and mess fees are usually around Rs. 40,000 per semester. There are also gyms, basketball courts, and football grounds in most of the hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: In my department, the faculty members are good. They are very enthusiastic and ready to help if you reach out to them for any doubts. Most of the faculty members have done their Ph.D. This is from various prestigious institutions across the world. Most of the professors teach on a blackboard by writing things with chalk, and they also make little use of PPTs. In recent years, IIT KGP has changed its curriculum to incorporate AI in most of the courses. There are mid-semester and end-semester. Midsem carries 30% weightage, and end-semester carries 50% weightage. You have to score 30% to pass.
detailed_review.Other: Overall, campus life is pretty good. The campus offers a beautiful nightlife. You can roam on the campus throughout the night and no one will ask a question. There is a specific event called Illumination, which happens during Diwali every year. It is an event of light and is considered one of the most prestigious events of the Institute. There are many events such as hackathons, marathons, dance, musical performances, and so on. There are two main fests, one is Kshitij and the other is Springs. There are various scholarships, usually, the amount is Rs. 60,000 per year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: We have the best campus and the largest of all the IITs. Teachers and placements are good.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 60% of students are placed in the Biotech course, mostly in pharmaceutical companies, and most of them are also from abroad. The percentage of students who got internships in this course is 55%, and the roles offered are engineers of machinery used in Pharmacy.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 24/7 Wi-Fi is available with good speed. The Department building is huge, and advanced machinery and devices are present in the lab. There is a Nescafe just outside the department for refreshment, and there is a personal departmental library for the Biotech students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are really helpful and supportive in all ways. Most of them are Ph.D. holders from some IITs, and their communication is really good. The semester exams depend fully on what is taught in the lectures, and 2-3% of students fail for some reason.

reviews.review_title: Great place with decent perks.

detailed_review.Placements: A good percentage of people are placed, and it can offer exploration to a wide variety of fields in different sectors. The average package will be around 20 LPA, and it is very decent. A good number of internships are offered, and the placements will be good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a decent infrastructure and a great place to learn. The library is one of the best of its kind. Hostels are the things that could be better in some way or another. Hostel life is, in another way, mostly beautiful with our people around, and food quality is also good. Need to adjust sometimes.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are very helpful. The curriculum of this course gives a brief introduction to all fields related to engineering so that we can explore the things that we enjoy learning more about. Regarding the difficulties and grading policy, it's neither bad nor good. It will be average based on the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Perfect regarding semester exams and good regarding infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: According to the review given by the head of our college, overall, 88% of students got placed from our course. The highest package is 1 crore per annum, the lowest is considered to be 15 LPA, and the moderate is 25 LPA to 30 LPA. Top companies regarding semiconductors and DSP are offering jobs in our department. Overall, 80% to 90% of students got internships in semiconductors and electronics. Top roles are offered in the semiconductors course, which are highly paid, and it is very useful for a person's life in the future.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. But it works slowly in certain places. Labs are good for understanding your interest in the subject. All the equipment present in the lab is also working in good condition. Our classroom complex is named Nalanda, which is very good-looking, and the classrooms are also very good with an AC supply. Medical facilities are free on our campus. Doctors are also good. But it will not be open all the time. If you want to meet the doctor for an emergency situation, you can apply an appointment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are qualified. Some people are very good at making us understand and very few or rare teachers can make us understand. But they are also very good in that subject. The course curriculum is very relevant. It provides very high job opportunities for students. The difficulty of semester exams is moderate. If you study properly, every student will pass. The pass percentage is expected to be very high. It might lie between 90% to 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as our seniors suggested that you can enter the software side through this course easily, so this is the main reason I took this course, since I am interested in software. All things are very perfect regarding this course. So, I don't have any suggestions for the improvement of the course. Mainly, three fests take place, which are okay but not too good. Events occur frequently on our campus to chill and vibe. Connectivity is strong if you are present in any society. The campus crowd is automatically formed when you talk with more people.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech.(Hons.) + M.Tech. in Biotechnology and Biochemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best part of my life is spent here at IIT Kharagpur.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the 2020–2025 UG batch. In my course, almost 90% of students get placed. For internships, the rate is about 95%. The highest package exceeds crores per annum, while the average package ranges from 15–16 LPA and the lowest package is approximately 7 LPA. The top recruiting companies include BCG, Google, Microsoft, Adobe, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Laboratories are fully equipped with various research facilities from molecular biology to bioinformatics. Everything is available. The classrooms are well-lit, air-conditioned, equipped with projectors, and have Wi-Fi access throughout the campus. The Central Library here is the largest in Asia. I am from the MMM Hall, which is the largest hostel with a capacity of over 2,000. All rooms are double-sharing here. However, the food quality in the mess is going down day by day. The authorities should take care of it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Almost all professors hold a Ph.D. from elite institutions across the world. They are all active in research, publishing in high-impact journals. The core curriculum is a fusion of Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Computational Modelling. It also includes wet lab training. The semester exams are concept-heavy. Only this department follows an absolute grading scheme.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my strong interest in Biotechnology. There are two main fests. Spring Fest and Kshitij.

reviews.review_title: This is the one of the best college.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 75% of students got placed. The highest package is 60 LPA and the average package is 23 LPA. Some students got offers from Indian companies like Coal India, and Tata Steel, and a few got packages from Australian top companies. Around 80% of students got internship offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of college is good. Wi-Fi system is available at every corner of campus. Labs, classrooms, library are well managed and have good air-conditioned systems. Mess food is so good. There is a hospital inside the campus as well. Sports facilities are so good. Students can make their career in sports also.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers of my course are so helpful and qualified. They have good knowledge about the subjects. Course curriculum is also so good and relevant and it makes them ready for industry and field trips are also there. Difficulty level of exams are good enough.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in this. The uses of this course are everywhere. Every industry needs raw materials and for that, we need to do mining. The strength of the campus is around 20000. There are some fests also one is technical and the other is a cultural and sports fest as well. Intelligent students got a good amount of scholarship.

reviews.review_title: The faculty and infrastructure at IIT KGP are particularly very good.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed in our course has been increasing a lot since there is a booming growth in the aerospace industry. Nearly 60-70% have been getting placed in our course. The lowest packages were nearly 6 LPA maybe the least one in the highest would be nearly 30 LPA. There are many good recruiting companies for our course like Clock Head, Martin, and GE Aerospace. Nearly 80-90% of the students are getting internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure in our department are very good. I like my department very much since I am more interested in it. The Wi-Fi and the labs are well maintained, and there is a large library in our institute that is also well maintained; it is our main resource to prepare effectively for examinations. I am from the South, and while I don't like the food that much, it's healthy.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams are very tough at IIT Kharagpur, but the faculty in our department is excellent. The curriculum is well-structured and exposes students to all kinds of levels in the courses. They are conducted very well, and we have mid-semester and end-semester examinations.
detailed_review.Other: The campus at KGP is wonderful. I chose this place because I am interested in aerospace engineering; there are many events, and I cannot mention just one. Fashion events happen every month in KGP, providing us exposure to the outside world.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Manufacturing Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A place where you can explore wholesome of opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: My branch is under the Department of Mechanical Engineering, and it is a very mediocre branch. Here, the things are similar to those of the Mechanical, with no such difference. But what makes it good is that the workload is less compared to others, and the batch size is also good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our campus is well-equipped with all necessary facilities. We have Wi-Fi access across the campus with a decent speed and good latency. The food available in the hostel and mess is horrendous. It seems very bad to say that IIT Kharagpur cannot provide well-cooked food to students.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members are well-educated, and their experience is at par than any other institute in India. The curriculum here is very vast, and we get many courses. The best thing is exposure to new fields of study, like while engineering, you get to know about consulting and stuff.
detailed_review.Other: My passion to explore various fields has attracted me here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Electrical Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Most beautiful campus and lavish greenery.

detailed_review.Placements: 75% of students are placed in my department. The highest package is 2.1 crores, and the lowest is 10 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are Amazon, Google, BlackRock, Microsoft, and some other top companies in all fields. Jobs in the core are also very high nearly most students get internships from my course and top companies like Amazon, Google, Texas, and Nvidia.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Kharagpur is very beautiful, and Wi-Fi or internet facility is available 24/7 in almost all places on the campus. There is a vast library. I don’t like the food very much here, but the canteen, medical facilities, and hostel rooms are good. There are many grounds on the campus, and there are three big stadiums.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. Everyone has a Ph.D. and they have a very high level of knowledge. They are very friendly. This course is curriculum-relevant. The pass percentage depends on the professor. The semester exams are based on what the professor teaches in classes. If we attend classes regularly and manage our time, the semester exams are okay you can easily pass.
detailed_review.Other: There are also many clubs that we can participate in based on our interests.

faqs.question: Which is better for a BTech in Electrical Engineering, IIT Kharagpur or IIT Bombay?
faqs.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur and IIT Bombay are one of the best colleges in India that provides BTech along with various other programmes to students. They both are among the top-ranked Indian colleges. IIT Bombay is ranked three by NIRF 2023 for Engineering and IIT Kharagpur is ranked fifth by NIRF 2024 for Engineering. faqs.answer: The basic eligibility requirement for the M.Tech programme IIT Kharagpur is pass in Class 12 th with a min. of 75% aggregate, bachelor's degree holder with a 60% aggregate and the accepted entrance exams are GATE and others. Students must secure good marks in entrance tests to match the cut off released by the college.

faqs.question: What is the JEE Advanced cut off for Integrated BTech (Hons) in Industrial Engineering + M.Tech at Industrial Engineering and Management?

faqs.question: Who is eligible for M.Tech at IIT Kharagpur?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for IIT Kharagpur's Joint MTech/MCP PhD programme, candidates need a BE/BTech/BArch degree or a master's in Science/Arts with a minimum of 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST/PwD). Qualifications from exams by recognised professional societies are also accepted. Applicants must have a valid GATE score relevant to their qualifying discipline, and in the absence of a specific GATE paper, XE/XL/XH papers can be considered. NET-qualified candidates with a fellowship in MA/MSc Economics/Sociology/Geography, having studied Mathematics/Statistics, are eligible for MCP-PhD.

faqs.question: Does IIT Kharagpur accept GATE score?
faqs.answer: Yes, IIT Kharagpur does accept GATE scores for admission to its M.Tech programme. Applicants must have a valid GATE score relevant to the discipline of their qualifying degree. In cases where there is no specific GATE paper available for a particular discipline, XE/XL/XH papers of the GATE examination can be considered. GATE is the accepted entrance exam for admission to IIT Kharagpur's M.Tech programme.

faqs.question: How can I get into BSc at IIT Kharagpur?
faqs.answer: The Science and the HSS Department of IIT Kharagpur started four-year BSc programme admission to which is subject to a valid rank in JEE Advanced exam.  Aspirants seeking IIT Kharagpur BSc and Integrated MSc admission need to qualify for both JEE Main and JEE Advanced exams to get shortlisted. For eligibility, candidates are required to have completed their Class 12 with a minimum of 75% aggregate. Those who would like to earn an MSc degree are given the option to do so at the end of the sixth semester of the BSc programme. Accordingly, the seventh and eighth semesters are planned so that a candidate gets an MSc degree at the end of the tenth semester.

faqs.question: Is BSc available at IIT Kharagpur?
faqs.answer: IIT Kharagpur offers a four-year BSc course along with a five-year Integrated MSc course across six specialisations each. Those willing to pursue a postgraduate integrated course can take admission in BSc-MSc Integrated, criteria and admission process of which is same as that of BSc. Admission to both these programmes is based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced scores followed by JoSAA counselling. Aspirants seeking admission must qualify for both the entrance exams for admission to IIT Kharagpur. Read IIT-KGP BSc course details here .

faqs.question: What is the fee for Integrated MSc at IIT Kharagpur?

faqs.question: Can I get admission in MSc at IIT Kharagpur without JAM?
faqs.answer: Admission to IIT Kharagpur to the MSc course is mainly based on the IIT JAM entrance test. JAM in most cases will be mandatory in order to take admission in core streams in sciences such as Physics, Chemistry and Mathematic. JAM is standard at interdisciplinary MSc programs, although there are other requirements in some programs. You should always look at the departmental requirements prior to the application.

faqs.question: Does IIT Kharagpur offer a Joint MSc-PhD programme?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is the Joint MSc-PhD five-year programme in eight specialisations in IIT Kharagpur. It is a combination of intensive master degree level studies along with doctoral research. This is combined course which is offered to students who are interested in a career in research. One has to pass the IIT JAM exam and then is interviewed to be allowed through.

faqs.question: What is the final selection process for MBA at VGSOM (IIT KGP) takes place?
faqs.answer: The selection of candidates for admission to the MBA programme at VGSoM (IIT Kharagpur) is a two-step procedure. Applicants, who are shortlisted based on the eligibility criteria are called for an online Personal Interview (PI). Final admission to the MBA programme is then offered on the basis of a cumulative score of the application rating (AR), performance score in CAT 2024, and the candidate’s performance in the online PI process. Check out more details on IIT Kharagpur MBA selection process here .

faqs.question: How can I get MBA admission at IIT Kharagpur?
faqs.answer: For admission to MBA at VGSOM (IIT Kharagpur), candidates need to qualify CAT followed by group discussion and personal interview round. The minimum CAT percentile required is 90 for general category students. For NC-OBC and SC/ ST/ PwD the minimum CAT percentile required is 80 and 75 respectively. faqs.question: Does IIT Kharagpur consider sectional or overall cut-offs for MBA admission?
faqs.answer: The institute has given weightage to all the sections in CAT cut-off for the final shortlisting of the students. For General category candidates, the minimum CAT overall percentile is 90. This is relaxed for reserved category students and stands at 80 percentile for NC-OBC category students and 75 for SC, ST and PwD students. However, for final admisison, there is only an overall cutoff. For General category candidates, minimum CAT percentile is 90. This will be relaxed for category students as per the Government of India norms.

faqs.question: Can I get into PhD at IIT Kharagpur without GATE?
faqs.answer: The admission of a candidate to the PhD programme of IIT Kharagpur is conducted by the Departmental Academic Committee (Post-Graduate and Research), abbreviated as DAC (PG&R), of the Department/Centre concerned, on the basis of The academic units shortlist the students for final interview based only on the overall academic performance or based on both overall academic performance and written test/ PI. However, final selection will be based on overall academic performance and performance in written test and final interview only. However, to be eligible to get into this course, candidates must possess a valid GATE score that is above the cut-off level of students admitted for M.Tech or MCP admission or NET qualification with Assistant Professorship.

faqs.question: What is the closing rank for MSc + PhD in Physics at IIT Kharagpur?

faqs.question: I am getting 250 rank in IIT JAM 2025. I want MSc+PhD in Mathematics at IIT Kharagpur. Is it achievable?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is possible to get admission to IIT Kharagpur for MSc+PhD in Mathematics with a rank of 250 in IIT JAM for candidates belonging to the General AI category. faqs.question: What happens after students are done with their application process at IIT Kharagpur?

placement_faqs.question: Which branch should I choose at IIT Kharagpur? Are the placements better than other similarly ranked IITs?
placement_faqs.answer: IIT Kharagpur, IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati are three similarly-ranked Engineering institutes in India that are closely ranked by the NIRF Ranking Institution. Needless to say, these institutes have outstanding academic and placement achievements. Students look for informed decisions while choosing between the three. In NIRF Engineering ranking 2025 , IIT Kharagpur stands at 5th position, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad are ranked at 8th and 7th position, respectively . Thus, indicating a close competition between the three. IIT Kharagpur outshines IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati for having the largest campus area and being the oldest IIT. IIT Kharagpur came into existence in 1951, whereas, IIT Guwahati and IIT Hyderabad were established in 1994 and 2008, respectively. Comparing the institutes on academic grounds, IIT Kharagpur (108) offers a larger number of full-time courses than IIT Hyderabad and IIT Guwahati. In terms of placements, IIT Guwahati has released the overall statistics for BTech. IIT Kharagpur wins the race with the highest package of INR 2.40 crore per annum. The second slot is taken by IIT Guwahati with the highest package of INR 1.20 crore per annum. Then comes, IIT Hyderabad highest package of INR 90 LPA. The table below represents the IIT Kharagpur highest package comparison with other closely ranked IITs for the BTech placements: - INR 1.20 crore per annum (domestic) - INR 72 LPA (international) Students looking for more elaborated branch-wise placement information can read the below section comparing IIT Kharagpur and IIT Hyderabad. The highest package grabbed by the CE batch 2022 during the IIT Kharagpur phase-I placements was INR 55 LPA. The IIT Hyderabad CE highest package was very close and stood at INR 52 LPA. For other branches, such as CH, CS, EE, and ME, IIT Kharagpur beats IIT Hyderabad in terms of the highest package offered. sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Kharagpur which is one of the most renowned academic institutes in the country has one of the largest college campuses. It is even bigger than the IIT Bombay , IIT Delhi and IIT Kanpur campuses combined. The IIT Kharagpur campus is spread across 8.5 km (2100 acres). IIT Kharagpur is located at a distance of 120 km from Kolkata. IIT Kharagpur being the mother of all IITs have always been on the list of top 10 IITs ranked by NIRF which makes IIT KGP one of the top most choice of students willing to pursue engineering and many other courses offered there.
Given below is the IIT Kharagpur students review videos:

sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Campus Highlights
text: IIT Kharagpur campus area is over 2100 acres, over a total of 55 kilometres of roadways and approximately 10,000 students live on the campus. There are plenty of facilities and centres for extracurriculars available inside the IIT Kharagpur campus such as the Student Activity Center better known as the Technology Students' Gymkhana, Jnan Ghosh and Tata Sports Complex for various sports activities, Social and Cultural Centre, Counselling Centre, B C Roy Technology Hospital and various cafeterias.

sections.heading: More highlights of the IIT Kharagpur campus are as follows:
text: Boy’s and Girl’s Hostel: There are various hostels available with separate accommodation for boys and girls enrolled at IIT Kharagpur.
Gymkhana: Technology Students' Gymkhana acts as a centre for numerous extra-curricular and co-curricular activities ranging from sports to socio-cultural events.

Library: The Central Library of IIT Kharagpur is one of the finest and largest technical libraries in Asia which is accessed by the institute’s students of UG, PG, and research scholars. It also has the facility of the digital library.
Hospital: B C Roy Technology Hospital is located centrally within the IIT Kharagpur campus. The facility has 32 beds, including a 2-bed ICU, Cabins and Isolation Ward.

The quantity of the aforementioned things may vary depending upon the occupancy of the room whether it’s single room, double sharing or triple occupancy sharing.

highlights.summary:
IIT Roorkee was established in 1847 and is the seventh IIT recognised as an Institution of National Importance. IIT Roorkee is NAAC accredited and AICTE &UGC approved . IIT Roorkee is a public technical research university located in Uttarakhand. The college is the oldest technical institution in Asia that was given university status in 1949. According to the NIRF ranking 2025, the institute ranked 1 in Architecture category and 6 in Engineering category.
IITR offers 14 UG, 24 PG, and many other PhD courses through its school and 23 departments in the domains of Engineering, Science, Architecture, and Social Sciences. Internationally, IIT Roorkee is ranked 335 by the QS World University in the category of Top Global Universities Rankings 2024. IITR fees range from INR 12,000 to INR 10.70 lakh.
IIT Roorkee course admission is based on the entrance exam. To get admission, the institute accepts entrance exams such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced, IIT JAM, CEED, and NATA. IIT Roorkee cutoff 2025 for the BTech courses ranged between 481 and 19885 for the General All India category students. During IIT Roorkee placements, a placement rate of 100% was recorded. The highest domestic and average package during IIT Roorkee placements 2024 stood at INR 150 LPA and INR 20 LPA, respectively. IIT Roorkee has separate boys' and girls' hostels, one coed hostel, and married couples' hostels. IITR also has a well-equipped library with a collection of over 3.20 lakh documents, online databases, CD-ROMs, and more. The major highlights of IIT Roorkee are tabulated below:

IIT Roorkee Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.review_title: Vibrant college life that you'll remember for a lifetime.

detailed_review.Placements: Out of 30, 15 got placed, 10 go for off-campus, 5 go for higher studies 30 LPA being the highest, the lowest goes to 10 LPA, and the average is 16 LPA. Companies like Schlumberger, British Petroleum, and mainly recruit for core jobs. Internships are very few, like fewer than 5 students get core internships, and for this also CG should be above 9. Geotechnical roles or office roles also are also offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available throughout campus (except in bathrooms), and every department has well-equipped labs (note that lab supervisors may occasionally give you bad advice, so be cautious). Classrooms also have good infrastructure, including teaching boards and projectors. The library is accessible except at night (it is also open at night during exams). Additionally, there is a 24/7 reading room. New hostels are very luxurious, old ones are decent. The mess food is very good, as there are various options available. The canteen provides a 24/7 menu at a good rate. Medical facilities are provided well, MBBS doctors are available, and with insurance, free medicine and consultation. Every sport has enough sports grounds or courts, and fun games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are knowledgeable but can't deliver well enough to be understood by everyone. You have to learn from the side to be industry-ready, and it's possible as the peer group is supportive. 1st semester is common for everyone, so your understanding of Physics and Maths would decide toughness, then onwards, core courses decide, like GT has an easy course (as I listen from seniors). Most of the students pass, with around 2-3 percent having a backlog.
detailed_review.Other: I like Earth Sciences and want to learn about rock and minerals, as I had studied in my 8th-grade geography. If online resources could be given in an organised way and with a good planner, then it would have been better. If you have good friends, all the fests and events become a memory for a lifetime. All staff and professors are supportive and kind. You get regular emails about various opportunities, and the channel has lots of information.

reviews.review_title: My college campus is very nice.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80-85 percent of students are placed in our college every year. The highest package from our college is approximately 1.5 crores. Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Oracle, and Bajaj are some of the major recruiting companies. There are a total of 163 companies for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Our college has the famous James Thomson building, which is famous across the country. The Wi-Fi is very good. Wi-Fi is available in hostels and classrooms. Hostels are better, but three students live in a single room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. Their teaching style is nice, but some teachers are not good, and their voice does not reach the back of the class. Semester exams are very difficult and not easy to pass. They are similar to previous year papers, and students cannot score well by studying only one night before.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because it is the only option I have. Events and fests are conducted every few months.

reviews.review_title: It is one of the best institute.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Roorkee is situated in Roorkee. This university offers the best placement opportunities for students. The highest package offered in this university is 80 LPA. The lowest package is 7 LPA. Many well-known tech companies visit this university every year for placement purposes. Many opportunities are provided by this university for internship purposes. Top role offered to students in this course is a software developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of this course is good for students. Many facilities are provided by this college. It includes all-time Wi-Fi for the university students and faculty. There are many classrooms in this university for students, which are fully furnished and air-conditioned. Many hostels are available for students where students live together. In this university, the medical facilities are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of this university are very kind and supportive. They help students in every aspect. They are highly knowledgeable and qualified. The course curriculum provided by this college is relevant for students, and it makes students industry-ready. Many exams are organised in this university for students, so students perform well in the sessional examinations.
detailed_review.Other: Many fests and events are organised on the campus. The university also provides scholarship facilities for students.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied. Placements are very good, which makes this a perfect Tier 1 college.

detailed_review.Placements: Honestly, 95 percent of students get placed in our department. The highest package is 1.20 crores per annum, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Deloitte, Jio, and many others. All students get internships in the 2nd year. Top roles are HR, product management, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are excellent, with single rooms available. Classrooms are five-star and fully air-conditioned. The library is impressive, with all types of books available. The food in the mess is very good, fresh, and hygienic. All types of sports are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and understanding. They provide 24-hour support. Teachers are of high quality and have master’s degrees in their subjects. The course curriculum makes students industry-ready, and companies are impressed by our college students. Semester exams are very hard. You have to be consistent in your studies to score well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My journey and experience at IITR.

detailed_review.Placements: In our CSE batch, around 90% of students get placed. Coming to packages, the highest package is at the crore level, the average package is 15 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Top companies include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, quant companies, etc. The roles offered are SDE, data science, ML engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For our department/course, we have fast Wi-Fi, modern labs, smart classrooms, and rich central libraries. Hostel facilities are decent enough with 24/7 internet. Even the mess food is good and decent. Medical centres are always available. Coming to the sports section, it is excellent and well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff is highly qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is concept-oriented and very practical. The curriculum is relevant and industry-oriented. Semester exams are tough, but grading is very fair. The pass percentage is around 98% with regular attendance and effort.
detailed_review.Other: I chose computer science because I had a strong interest in coding and problem-solving. My best parts are strong fundamentals and projects. IIT Roorkee has vibrant fests, good connectivity, a green campus, scholarships, and active clubs.

reviews.review_title: Excellent but dissatisfied with faculty and course structure.

detailed_review.Placements: This time IIT Roorkee is having the worst placement season with only 47 companies coming for this placement/internship season. 100 students are placed from the mechanical branch. The highest package offered is 51 LPA the average package offered is 19 LPA and the lowest package offered is 6.6LPA. Top recruiting company is Amazon and it came for various posts. Top roles offered are management and software development. 40 people got on campus internships and others went for off campus internships. This is not a good result as the PIC is failing to bring more core companies and negotiate better offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department has many facilities including smart classrooms and laboratories. Classrooms are good they have all the facilities but laboratories are still developing. There are some outdated methods that are still being used considering them to be basic experiments. Some of them are really outdated. There is a central library which is very good well maintained. Hostels are good they have many facilities including Wi-Fi gyms canteens and sports rooms. The main problem is the mess it offers really bad quality and taste of food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are experienced qualified knowledgeable and helpful. Some faculty members are really rude towards the students and some faculty members also do favoritism towards a particular community of students. They are trying to make it relevant they introduce some new courses like AI/ML and Data Science but they are still unable to deliver quality content about the course. The professor with little knowledge about the course is assigned to teach the course instead of assigning a good faculty. It does not make students industry ready. They are very hard and the grading system is relatively so we do not have a pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: ]I got the course by JEE Advanced Rank although I will have gone for a higher branch if I am eligible. Mechanical branch is good if one is really interested in understanding the dynamics and the core functionality of the secondary sector of the country. Personally the best thing about the course is that I get to work with 3D printers and CNC machines. The course should cater more to be industry specific for contemporary times rather than teaching the old stuff that is no longer used in industries. Events fest campus crowd extracurricular activities are 1000 on 10.

reviews.review_title: Excellent infrastructure, but dissatisfied with placements and internships.

detailed_review.Placements: This year IIT Roorkee has the worst placement season with only 47 companies coming to the college. The placement cell is an absolute mess. They are not working properly, have little communication with branch DPRs, and limited interaction with company HRs for any further vacancies or offers that might be available if they negotiate. 45 students get internships from my course batch. The highest package is 10 lakhs for a 6 months internship, and the lowest is Rs. 25,000 for two months. Top recruiting and most internships go to Amazon. Top roles so far are management and software development.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course is a complete 4 out of 5. Classrooms are amazing with excellent seating, AC, and heaters in winters. The practical labs cater to job-ready skills that mechanical engineers require, such as CAD modeling and sessions on 3D printing. Hostels are 3.5 out of 5 because the management is good, but the rooms could be more modern. The Wi-Fi system and balconies score 5 out of 5. The canteen and mess food are good, both 3.5 out of 5. Medical facilities and sports are excellent, 5 out of 5.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is too vast, and some subjects are outdated, like manufacturing technology. The majority of the portion is related to old-style casting and holding methods, while newer methods like CNC machines and 3D printers are taught briefly, even though it is an advanced course. I would score faculty members 2 out of 5 because of some good professors. The professors are excellent at their craft, but they should listen to the students’ needs more. Exams are tough, but from a teacher’s point of view, they are excellent. The exact pass percentage varies from subject to subject, but on average, it is around 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose my course mainly because I get it according to my JEE Advanced rank and IIT Roorkee is among the top 7 colleges of India. I am also fascinated by the mountain life. Mechanical is a very good branch with average packages of placement going up to 25 LPA. More efforts are needed to update the syllabus so that students are more industry efficient. The campus, people, fests, surroundings, campus life, and extracurricular activities are 1000 out of 10. I do not have any scholarships but, my friend receives around Rs. 67,000 per sem. Connectivity is awesome too.

reviews.review_title: Sometimes, prioritize college over the desire.

detailed_review.Placements: In the core branches, placements are a bit low, no specific companies are visiting the college for branch oriented courses. Students get job opportunities in different domains, in which they get average package of 5 to 7LPA, and the highest goes to 10 to 15LPA. PSUs like ONGC, BARC, and IOL are recruiting. They hire for the manager role and the system engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Departmental infrastructure is average, not like the whole campus, with a limited lab for the core branches. Wi-Fi enabled departments and classrooms are, on average, not equipped with many facilities, like comfortable seating. Libraries are there, which are accessible all the time. Hostel facilities are just okay, it depends on which hostel you are living in. Canteen and mess food have average taste. Sports facilities are there where you can explore all games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of my department are okay, they have proper knowledge and skills regarding their courses, which is very helpful for the students to clear. They teach from the very basic to the advanced level. The course is not helpful for getting industry ready. Semester exams are easy to moderate, with a level 90% of the students pass.
detailed_review.Other: Events and extracurricular activities of this college are best when you really enjoy them, the campus crowd provides a versatile behavior and mindset.

reviews.review_title: A short review of IIT Roorkee and its earth science department.

detailed_review.Placements: It has good placement and internship opportunities for higher branches. For core, you have to maintain 8+ CGPA atleast as it plays a major factor. The highest package for our branch is around 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 12 LPA. Top recruiters are ONGC, Schlumberger, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Department facilities are decent with well-equipped labs, and all the instruments work properly. Classrooms are also mostly tidy. Regarding the hostel, for me it's been 3 years now on the campus so I have experience living in 3 hostels. I think the best one is Jawahar by far in terms of mess, canteen, and extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are pretty helpful and friendly in nature. They are pretty qualified and knowledgeable as well. Doubt-solving sessions are also conducted. The course curriculum is relevant but mostly depends on student's focus and interest whether he or she is industry-ready or not.
detailed_review.Other: Found this very unique course and wanted to explore more of it. I wish that we had more job opportunities in the core industry.

reviews.review_title: IIT Roorkee - The IIT of your dreams.

detailed_review.Placements: 85% is the placement percentage. 1.5 crores per annum is the highest package. Top recruiting companies are Jaguar, DE Shaw, Microsoft, Intuit, BCG, Google, Amazon, Mastercard, Sprinkle, Zepto, JP Morgan, BNY Mellon, and many more. Top roles offered are quant roles, SDE roles, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The whole campus is Wi-Fi equipped. The library and other academic facilities are state-of-the-art. Some hostels are better than others and are good, others are okayish. Mess food is so bad, but breakfast is awesome and nutritional. Sports facilities and gym are top-notch.
detailed_review.Faculty: Course Curriculum is relevant for the most part, and it does make students industry-ready, though more practical knowledge is needed. Teachers are very knowledgeable, but some professors don't interact that much, which is the case in every college, still, overall, good professors. Semester exams are average to above average here. The pass grade for a course is 4.
detailed_review.Other: Electrical Engineering is a very versatile course in terms of placements, most technical and non-technical companies allow you to sit in their tests, and you can target core companies. Betterment is needed in the mess and hostels, but it's still not that bad. Fests are amazing here, and the campus life is just too much fun.

reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with the campus and faculty. The core placements are not satisfactory.

detailed_review.Placements: About 60% of students got placed in 2024 with an average package of 20 LPA. The highest package is 36 LPA, and the lowest package is 12 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Schlumberger, OIL, etc. About 50% of students got internship opportunities. Most of them got a data analyst intern or a product analyst intern position in various companies. Many students are placed in non-core roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. There is Wi-Fi on the whole campus. Labs are well-maintained with all the modern equipment. The condition of classrooms of our department is a little bit deteriorated. The mess food is good, and the canteen food is reliable. There are good facilities for sports. Medical facilities are the best, and we can consult a doctor at any time.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is top-notch. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. If we want to do further studies, then it is one of the best courses. Semester exams are easy to pass. Almost all students pass exams.

reviews.review_title: World-class infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course was 32 LPA. The lowest package was 8 LPA. The average package was 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Siemens, Bharat Biotech, etc. Almost all students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were of a premium class. Wi-Fi-enabled campus. Modern design library with huge books. The laboratory was also equipped with all the updated instruments and machines. The hostel was also very nice. Multiple sports complexes are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective domains. The teaching quality of our faculty members was extremely good. The course curriculum was relevant. It makes students industry-ready. The semester examination was at a moderate level.

reviews.review_title: Review of Roorkee IIT for the Post Graduate Diploma in Hydrology course.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has the best placements. The highest package offered in the college ranges from 3-8 LPA. Many companies provide internships in college. The one condition for participating in placements is that it requires 60% marks in all semesters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college's infrastructure quality is very good. The college canteen food is also good, very tasty, and hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very intelligent and very helpful to students. They provide more knowledge of multiple sources. This course is practical, so teachers are different for it and not the same as theoretical subjects. This course is a total of 2 years in duration. There are 2 semester exams, and they are very difficult.
detailed_review.Other: Every year, the sports committee organises sports and games tournaments like kabaddi, cricket, football, tug of war, etc. It also organises cultural events.

reviews.review_title: IIT Roorkee College in M.Tech course admission information.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college, placement facilities were very good. Big companies were interested to the college, and provided 4 LPA to 9 LPA salary. TCS, Accenture, Wipro, Infotech, Infosys, etc., companies were involved.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: High-quality infrastructure was available, and many facilities were provided to students. There were facilities like classroom, labs, Wi-Fi router, bathroom, hostel, canteen, etc. In this college, every year sports and games facilities were organised for many students but it was charged for participating in events.
detailed_review.Faculty: In this college, teachers were very intelligent. High degree education completed like Ph.D, M.Tech, etc. These types of courses were completed with teachers and professors present. This course was total 4 years course duration and 8 semester exam. There was one semester exam and 900 to 1100 marks of exam paper conducted by the college.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college with a gate to Himalayas.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students got placements (2022 batch). The lowest package is 7 LPA, and the highest package is 60 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Myntra, Microsoft, Jaguar, EXL, Licious, etc. 55% of students get Internships. Roles like SDE, data analytics, and mechanical engineering are offered here. They come to recruit for almost all roles from teaching to acting to finance to product. If we name it, then they take it. There are very supportive seniors to help us crack interviews.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on the whole campus. Classrooms are full of AC. The central library has a sitting capacity for more than 1,000 students. The hostel is there with a mess. Food is good, and a lot of variety is available. There is a canteen open 24 hours. Sports complex is also open for 24 hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and very interested in research. The quality of teaching is okay. The course curriculum is not highly relevant. Exams are full of difficulty and not so difficult to make us depressed. Relatively marking is there to help students. If a student fails, then they get a chance for a re-exam without any sort of issues. The best part of the exam is that it gets over in 2-3 days, and does not stretch to 1 month like other colleges, so students get ample time for extracurricular activities.
detailed_review.Other: Two big events are organised, one is a technical fest named Cognizance, and the other is a cultural fest named Thomson. It is India's 2nd largest fest after IIT Bombay's Mood Indigo. There are different groups like Himalyan explore club, dramatics, dancing, IIT Roorkee Motors, sports, and Knox for all-terrain vehicles.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Academics, campus, and placements - IITR ECE Review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rate for ECE is approximately 90%, with around 90% of students getting placed every year. The highest is more than 60 LPA, the lowest is 6-7 LPA, and the average is 17-18 LPA. Top recruiters are Texas, Intel, JP Morgan, Google, Oracle, and Cisco. Roles offered range from data science, software development, hardware design, VLSI, product management, to quant research.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: More than 10 hostels are there. We also have a coed hostel (married). Every hostel has its mess, stationery shops, gyms, study rooms, cyber rooms, fruit corners, and a tailor. Speak of any facility, we have it. The hospital has 24/7 facilities. The central library is open 24/7 around exam time and is fully air-conditioned. Food is fair and healthy; there are plenty of canteens available 24/7. Our college encourages sports and games and conducts intra/inter-bhawan sports events and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, with most holding PhDs and conducting active research. They are helpful and very approachable. The curriculum is a bit tough, but can be cracked easily if you are a regular student. It’s very relevant. Exams are moderately difficult and focus more on conceptual questions. The pass percentage is very high at our institute.
detailed_review.Other: I don’t think I need to talk about IIT Roorkee’s events, fests, and campus crowd; everybody knows about its cultural fest THOMSO and tech fest CONGNIZANCE. These are the absolute highlights. I chose my course because I am deeply passionate about learning core ECE and hardware.

reviews.review_title: IIT Roorkee is heaven for me.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college and also in my course, almost 70% of students get placed. In my course, the highest package is 50 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. The average package is 16 LPA. Quantbox, Graviton, and Google are the top recruiters. The top roles are analyst and senior development engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Each hostel room has a Wi-Fi connection. You can access Wi-Fi throughout the whole campus. Our department has multiple labs and a microscope worth 2.0 crores. Each hostel is good, and the messy food is also recommendable. Each hostel has a night and day canteen, which helps students get things at any time. Each hostel has its own sports ground and common areas like study rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are very good. They are highly qualified as well as interactive. Our course is very relevant, and its relevance is increasing because of the upcoming merger of biotech and AI. The future is moving towards sustainable development and a healthier lifestyle, so the relevance of our degree is rapidly increasing.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I have an interest in Biology and Genetics. In our course, more practical knowledge would be a better way of teaching. Our college has two main fests, a cultural fest named Thomso and a technical fest named Cognizance, held in October and March, respectively. Multiple clubs and societies run by students help you build a career in your passion area.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied because of the best faculty members and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 85% of students get placed in our course. The highest package is nearly 1 crore per annum. The lowest package is nearly 10 LPA and the average package is 40 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Google, Microsoft, and IBM. Nearly 95% of students got internships at Google, Microsoft, IBM, and Bank of America. The top roles offered are software engineer, mobile app developer, and cybersecurity specialist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college provides free high-speed Wi-Fi, highly equipped labs, high infrastructure in the classroom with more capacity, and a huge library with books related to all branches and with an online book learning facility. The food is good mainly North Indian. The mess and canteen food will be good and even there will be a fruit stall, day canteen, night canteen, gym, TV room and study hall in every hostel. Medical facilities are 24x7 and even in an emergency, there is an ambulance. There are many sectors for sports with flexible timings.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are knowledgeable and qualified. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is very relevant, very useful in the future, and even interesting. There will be tutorials for 20-30 students to explain doubts regarding the lectures by PhD students. Semester exams are a bit difficult and the pass percentage is 90%.
detailed_review.Other: It is one of the oldest IITs. We will get better scholarships every year. Fests organised are great like Thomson, and E-summit.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Students will experience a very interesting life here with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: I am not sure about other branches but in our computer science branch this year, 105 out of 110 students got placed on campus. The highest package ranges from 1.5 or 2 crores per annum. The average package is 35 LPA and the lowest package is 16 LPA. Major companies like Microsoft, Google, and all others have offered placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no doubt about Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library. I think our Wi-Fi is the fastest Wi-Fi in all IITs. When it comes to food I am from South India so it is somewhat difficult to have hostel food but we have pretty good canteens. Students of North India will not have any problem I think.
detailed_review.Faculty: First of all, it is IIT and it is the top among the top 6 IITs, so I don't know about curriculum and courses. Professors are there to help us any time. They are ready at any time to clarify our doubts. They don't even hesitate how many we ask and we can do projects under their guidance.
detailed_review.Other: Events are fabulous. I chose IIT because it has nice placements with packages.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The campus looks so beautiful. The placements and infrastructure are really great.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students will definitely get placed, as we are all from a Computer Science background, and that too from a NIRF 5 college. All that matters here is CGPA, if it is 8.5 and above, then we can apply to any on-campus companies related to software and prepare according for the selection. Some of the well-known companies coming to our campus are Google, Microsoft, and Dream11. But note that a company gives the same CTC to all the students once placed there, apart from independent of their talent. For example, Google gives 19- 20 LPA and Microsoft gives 50 LPA as CTC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are single, double, and triple rooms allotted, and I got a single room, which is very spacious. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Also, for each hostel, there are 2 canteens, 1 study room with AC, a gym, and a play area too. The classrooms are well built and there are projectors, televisions, AC, and room heaters, so that students can focus well. The same works for the library, too. The labs are also well-equipped, and any damage will be repaired as soon as possible.
detailed_review.Faculty: There won't be any pass percentage, as most of the exams will be relatively graded. The teachers really have a great knowledge, but most of the time we can't understand their teaching, and we need to study on our own. I feel it happens in every top college, but the materials and resources they provide are good. Recently, some changes were made in our curriculum, which I personally did not like, as some less useful courses have been added and more useful courses have been removed.

faqs.question: How to apply for BTech course at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: IIT Roorkee offers a four-year BTech programme across 11 specialisations along with a five-year integrated BTech + MTech programmes across two specialisations. The BTech course is the flagship programme of IIT Roorkee. The selection of candidates for the IIT Roorkee BTech programme is based on their JEE Advanced score. To be eligible for the same, aspirants must have completed their Class 12 with a valid score. The centralised counselling process is managed and regulated by the JoSAA , based on which the candidates are allotted seats. In order to apply for BTech and Integrated MTech at IIT Roorkee, students are required to apply via JEE Main, followed by JEE Advanced. The process of applying for JEE Mains 2025 consists of three steps: registration, form filling, and document upload, followed by payment of application fees. Not satisfied with answer? faqs.question: I got 200 rank in IIT JAM for Mathematics. Can I get admission in IIT Roorkee in the EWS category?

faqs.question: Do I need to give any entrance exam for admission to BSc at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: Yes, in order to take admission in IIT Roorkee BSc courses, candidates must first qualify JEE Main. Students who qualify JEE Main are then required to register and appear for JEE Advanced. This exam is conducted by one of the IITs every year by rotation under the supervision of a Joint Admission Board, which comprises of representatives from all the IITs. IIT Roorkee makes the selection based on candidate’s rank according to the merit in JEE Main+ JEE Advanced.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for BSc at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: In order to be eligible to apply for BSc at IIT Roorkee , candidate must have completed Class 12 with a minimum of 75%. Moreover, interested students must qualify JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced exam. Admissions to IIT Roorkee BSc courses will be made based on merit in JEE Main+ JEE advanced and seat availability intake of IIT Roorkee.

faqs.question: What is the fees for BSc courses at IIT Roorkee?

It is, however, subject to changes and hence, is indicative. Apart from this tuition fees, the college also charges students for few more components mentioned below. Hostel Fees - INR 7,500 Onetime payment - INR 6,000 Mess Charges- INR 26,250

faqs.question: What is the admission process to get into BSc at IIT Roorkee?
faqs.answer: In order to get into BSc at IIT Roorkee candidate must have passed Class 12 with a minimum of 75%. Further, the candidate is required to qualify JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced. IIT Roorkee admits students based on merit in JEE Main+JEE Advanced. Once the JEE Advanced results are out, students must register at the JoSAA counselling portal. Further counselling and seat allocation is done through this particular portal. Upon allocation of seat, candidates must pay partial fees on the JoSAA portal itself. After that, students will be required to report to the allocated institute in the stipulated time frame. Students will be successfully admitted upon payment of the remaining fees.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIT Roorkee MBA?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for MBA programme offered at IIT Roorkee, candidates need to possess a graduation degree/ professional qualification in any stream from a UGC-recognised university with a minimum of 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates). Final year students are also eligible to apply. The MBA admission process at IIT Roorkee is as under: Candidates must apply for CAT by the last date On clearing the required CAT cutoff, candidates are called the for PI round Final selection is done on the basis of the final cumulative score, which takes into account past academic record, performance in PI and work experience (if any)

summary: As per the media reports, overall 742 offers were made out of which 222 were PPOs during IIT Roorkee placements 2025 (Phase 1). Further, 163 companies visited the campus during placements 2025. The average package received by students of top branches such as CSE, ECE, and EE was INR 34.05 LPA, INR 30.81 LPA and INR 28.36 LPA . SDE emerged as the top profile wherein 60 recruiters made 201 offers during the phase 1 of IIT Roorkee placements 2025.

Earlier, as per media reports, the highest domestic and international package offered during IIT Roorkee placements 2024 was INR 150 LPA and INR 205 LPA . The average package offered during IIT Roorkee placements 2024 was around INR 20 LPA . As per the official report, 938 full-time offers and 213 PPOs were made during IIT Roorkee placements 2024. A total of 261 companies visited the campus during IIT Roorkee placements 2024.

The average package given during BTech CSE , Electrical , ECE branch was INR 34.07 LPA , IN R 22.1 LPA and INR 23.52 LPA . The average and median package provided to MTech in 2024 was INR 13.48 LPA and INR 12 LPA .

text: The Institute has over three campuses namely a 365-acre campus at Roorkee, a 25-acre campus at Saharanpur, and a 10-acre campus of Greater Noida Extension Centre at Greater Noida. IIT Roorkee has 8,000+ students, hostels , clubs, sports facilities, guest houses, 10 boys' hostels, three girls' hostels, one coed hostel, and six married couples' hostels. The institute has UG, PG, Alaknanda clubs, and various other facilities for the students. IIT Roorkee's library has a collection of more than 3.20 lakh documents, Online databases, CD-ROMs, standards, audio-video material, specifications, theses, reports, etc

highlights.summary:
IIT Hyderabad is a second-generation IIT that was founded in 2008 along with seven other IITs. Itranks 7th under the Engineering category by the NIRF 2025 Rankings. Indian Institute of Technology Hyderabad ranking are also given by many international ranking bodies. The institute has been ranked in the band of 664 by the QS World University Rankings 2026. The institute is currently one of the top IIT government colleges in Hyderabad and other states of India.
IITH is an Institute of National Importance (INI). Started by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, IIT Institute Hyderabad is a government institute that offers various UG, PG, and doctoral courses in branches like Engineering, Science and Liberal Arts, Design, and Management. IIT Hyderabad courses include BTech, MTech, MSc, and various other courses. IITH has signed numerous national and international MoUs with corporations and universities for collaboration on academic and professional fronts. Indian Institute of Technology in Hyderabad has established MoUs with institutions such as Auckland University of Technology, Osaka University, Kathmandu University, Istanbul Gedik University, University of Siegen, and Allied Telesis Labs Limited.
Admission is done basis national-level entrance exams such as JEE Advanced. IIT Hyderabad admission follows counselling sessions such as JoSAA to grant admissions to students. The highest and average packages offered during IIT Hyderabad placements 2023 were INR 63.78 LPA and INR 20.07 LPA, respectively. The institute offers two types of scholarships at the institutional level - merit-cum-means and ST/SC scholarships.
