reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Hyderabad College.

detailed_review.Placements: Honestly, the campus placements here are fantastic. If you have skills, it's pretty straightforward to get placed with a decent package. We're talking about a 100% placement rate because more than enough companies are coming to our campus. It's not unusual for a student to end up with two job offers. The highest and the lowest packages vary by branch, but I'd say the top package can reach up to 50 LPA, while the lowest sits around 15 LPA-16 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In spite of the college's overall infrastructure being just alright, the campus-wide Wi-Fi, well-used labs, comfortable classrooms, and extensive library become a great source of satisfaction. The vast array of textbooks and other materials available on campus removes the necessity for students to buy many of the resources from outside. Students can also avail themselves of transportation and on-campus housing facilities in case they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we talk about the food menu, it is quite good, but if more items of students' choice are introduced, it will surely be beneficial.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here always excel, but they do their job well. First year teaching was very similar to high school, which made the change quite easy. The yearly tests are not too hard. The college also recognized academic successes and took special care to award the highest achievers.

reviews.review_title: Campus Life at IIT Hyderabad.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% were placed in my college last year. The highest package is  30 LPA. All students got an internship in our branch. It is one of the best branches at IIT Hyderabad. You can also prepare for tech. The course of our branches is well prepared and organised.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our course is also very nice. Our department consists of a building in which most of the rooms belong to labs. In every room, you will get free Wi-Fi. The canteen will serve at least five items per day, and the taste is also very nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching is excellent, and they have mostly done their Ph.D. in IIT. Professors at IIT Hyderabad are highly knowledgeable and always helpful. They clear the doubts of the students at any time in the class. And the exams are above average in terms of difficulty.

reviews.review_title: My review about this college.

detailed_review.Placements: We could learn a lot during internships. If it were an industrial, field internship, we could really learn how companies work, how it was different from academics, etc. Placements were pretty much good compared to all new IITs. The average package was around 10 LPA - 12 LPA. The highest salary was 40 LPA, and the lowest salary was 4 LPA. There were many companies visiting the campus thus providing enough opportunities for placements. Nearly every student could get an internship opportunity if they applied to appropriate firms. The stipend depends on how you work at the firm.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities were world-class, and every student would love to get such world-class facilities. Buildings were seven-storeyed hostels. All kinds of sports grounds and well-furnished. A multipurpose gym was well-built. Music and recreation rooms were well built. Huge stages and open stands were ultimate open places. Course curriculum was very simple in our college. Our college followed fractal academics which help students to easily cope up with their studies while doing other activities. So it helped every student. Even if you were weak at some point, this exams were so easy. It provided wireless networking electives, machine learning, and databases.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members had been excellent in molding the students in various streams of specialisations. They had been trained from old IITs so that being a new IIT we were not missing that experience and expertise from the professors and faculty members. They had been really good job teaching with their experience. For 2 years, there were 4 semesters. All the exams also had lab exams as part of end-semester exams. Lab activities included, programming, coding, machine learning, digital signal processing, operation systems, embedded systems, micro processors, etc.

reviews.review_title: Awesome infrastructure and faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: The course I chose, engineering physics is more research-oriented. This year, only 5 out of 25 students got placed. But I am sure only 10-15 applied for placements as most are inclined to research. Internships are offered by multiple types of companies like software companies but also other ones like LIGO. Some people did internships in universities in Germany too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is excellent, spacious, and has charming architecture. There are single rooms for 2nd years and above. The food in the mess is good too with lots of variety even if it tends to get boring after a while. The library is also known as the Knowledge Research Center. It is very big with lots of books and e-resources. Labs are equipped with the best possible and updated equipment. The Wi-Fi is super fast here, in the full campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful, especially when you want to do projects and learn more things under their tutelage. The course curriculum is pretty updated and gives a lot of time for individual learning. The resources for the courses are many. Exams usually depend on the professors, as their grading scheme. The syllabus is the deciding factor for the CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: I was always interested in Physics so I chose this course. The course has a lot of room for exploring all the different areas of Physics. Events and fests here are many and awesome. They are lots of fun and something that people shouldn't miss. There are many clubs here to meet people passionate about the same topics as you, to learn something that has always interested you, to meet like minded people and do projects with them. About scholarships, general students below 500 AIR and girls below 1000 AIR are exempt from tuition feels.

reviews.review_title: Indian Institute of Technology has the best architecture.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Hyderabad 2024 placements showcase impressive statistics. 305 companies participated, extending 500 offers, including 43 international ones. The highest domestic salary package reached 90 lacs per annum, while the median salary for 4-year UG courses was 21 lacs per annum. Top recruiters included industry leaders such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Goldman Sachs, Cognizant, and Qualcomm. These figures highlight IIT Hyderabad's commitment to facilitating excellent career opportunities for its students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Hyderabad's 576-acre campus features sustainable architecture, single-occupancy hostels with radiant cooling, diverse dining options, and modern sports facilities. The college has a well-equipped gym, 24/7 medical services, banking, and a supermarket. It ensures a holistic student experience.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are nice for the chemical engineering branch as if they have experience of around 20- 35 years. They graduate from different IITs and Ph.D. scholars are more. I would say that the faculty members of the chemical engineering branch are the best. IITs stand on its own.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the chemical engineering branch because of my interest in it and as I was preferred it has good opportunities in the coming future.

reviews.review_title: My experience in college is good. Everything is fine with no remarks.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2023, approximately 58% of Chemical Engineering students secure job offers, with the highest package reaching 41 LPA, the median at 20 LPA, and the average at 21 LPA. In the year 2022, we got 84% placements the highest package at 33 LPA and the average at 19 LPA. 50% of students get internships approximately. Students secured positions at Microsoft, BPCL, and others and were engaged with research under professors.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities they provide are pretty good and the infrastructure is awesome. We get single-room occupancy. The food is okay, quite good for South Indians but not for North Indians. The canteen is pretty decent. Medical and sports were superb and there is no remark on them.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and they give a lot of knowledge to us. The teaching quality is good. The curriculum is relevant to us. The semester is okay a little bit tough. We should get more than 50% in exams to pass﻿﻿. Teachers who teach us were highly qualified ones.
detailed_review.Other: We have a lot of fests and enjoy on campus, but the point is that many people did not attend the events, was a low crowd for some events. I wish to give more practical knowledge to get better improve. We get a lot of scholarships in the sem 1. We do a lot of extracurricular activities and we have a lot of time to read, play, and enjoy life on campus.

reviews.review_title: IIT Hyderabad: The Dream College.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently in 1st year in the biotechnology department at IIT Hyderabad. In the placement year 2023, 72% of students were placed from our college, with major companies visiting our campus such as Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Goldman, sacs, etc. The highest package is 93. LPA and the lowest package is 6.5 LPA. Internships are pretty good in the college. Most of the students from my department had easily got on-campus internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since the hostels for the UG students were recently constructed they are neat clean and spacious. There is also the facility of radiant cooling which is a game change in the scorching heat of Hyderabad. The sports complex offers a wide range of sports facilities which are world-class. Though the mess food is hygienic and nutritional but the taste is not so good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of IIT Hyderabad are qualified and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is also relevant. The examination pattern is that of a typical engineering college and happens in three phases mid-seems, end-seems, and quizzes. Out of 100 students, roughly 4-5 people get back. So the pass percentage is nearly 95%.
detailed_review.Other: If you are planning to take admission, just go for it.

reviews.review_title: IIT Hyderabad and its beauty.

detailed_review.Placements: 60% of students are placed this year. The highest package is 90 LPA in Computer Engineering. Companies like Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, and other core companies are hiring. 70% of students got internships from my course. Roles offered include Data Analyst, SDE, and positions like Product Managers, Biotechnologists, and Professors.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and the infrastructure is inspired by Japanese architecture. There is unlimited Wi-Fi on the campus, and classrooms are well-air-conditioned. The hostel rooms use radiant cooling techniques. The mess food is good in the canteen, and get everything we need.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is quite relevant it makes students industry-ready and helps them deal with real-life problems in the industry. The semester exams are a bit difficult.

reviews.review_title: The highest-growing IIT is IIT Hyderabad.

detailed_review.Placements: Engineering science is an integrated degree, which is more famous abroad. It is also in top universities like MIT. This is the perfect branch if you are confused about taking any branch and confused about your interest. Number of students in branch is 41. Placements of this branch are one of the best in institutes with an average salary package of 23 LPA. Last year, the highest salary package was offered at IITH in the ES branch. The percentage of students who got placed is around 85-93% and for internships, it is around 80-85%. All types of companies and roles are offered for this course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All types of facilities are provided in IITs. IITH also has all types of facilities. IITH have one of the best architecture in India inspired by Japanese architecture. It has all types of labs, research facilities, and full Wi-Fi all over the campus. The mess, canteen, medical facilities, and sports are the best in India.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at IIT Hyderabad are great. They are highly qualified. Most are from top universities in the world. Some also have good industry experience. They also have very great contacts all over the world. The course curriculum is decent in relevancy, but it will make you industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it gives me flexibility and time for exploring my interests. Events at IIT are one of the best. IITH also have GATE events and fests like Elan Vision, Diesta, Milan, etc. The campus surroundings are very cool and charming.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied & amazed by the awesome infrastructure, but would have loved some more greenery on campus.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students being placed is around 50%. The highest package lies around 55 LPA, and the average is around 14 LPA. The top recruiters are Google, Amazon, Uber, Paytm, Ola, Oracle for software jobs, and L&T, etc., for core jobs. The number of students who got internships is also similar, around 50%, in companies like Thomson Reuters, ServiceNow, Oracle, Google, Amazon, etc. The roles offered are software developer, ML intern, product manager, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-class. We have 10-floor hostel buildings with single-sharing rooms equipped with a radiant cooling system. The rooms are of single occupancy. The campus has multiple department buildings, and every building is unique and magnificent. The library is also very huge, with a lot of study rooms, discussion rooms, study tables, etc. The food in the mess is also quite satisfactory. The quality is good, and they have a fixed weekly menu. Each room in the hostel has a LAN port, and there is Wi-Fi available in lecture halls and the library. The campus has a sports center with almost all sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, friendly, and supportive. The exams are quite regular, along with weekly assignments for some courses. The evaluation depends completely on the professor. The curriculum is very well-designed and sufficient for students to be ready for a job in the civil industry. The semester exams are of medium difficulty, and the pass percentage varies due to the relatively grading pattern.

reviews.reviewer_name: chandra vamsi sai kumar reddy Gowreddy
reviews.review_title: IITH is one of the best campuses for research and it is the fastest-growing IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: In the civil engineering course, about 60-70% of students get placed. Most of the students choose software jobs and not the core jobs. Some students opt for government jobs via GATE UPSC, etc. BPCL visits the college and recruits around 6-10 students with a salary package of 20 LPA on the core side.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Here we will get all the facilities in a good manner like Wi-Fi, classrooms and library. The library is one of the best places to enjoy on campus. Mess food is not up to the mark. We have good sports facilities. The canteen is also good. There are around 20 hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers teaching quality is good. They provide good knowledge if we focus. The course curriculum is also good. Here the semester runs by the segment-wise system which is too good. If anyone wants further details then they can visit the IITH website. If we focus on the classes the semester exams will be easier.

reviews.review_title: IIT Hyderabad boasts excellent placements and a fantastic infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: The majority of students were placed on campus, and IIT Hyderabad offers the greatest placements in prestigious firms around the nation. Other students launched their own businesses or improved their own jobs. There are internships available, and students are compensated for them. In 2024, the average package size was between 15 and 20 lakhs annually, while the largest package provided was 46 lakhs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are first-rate, including first-rate labs and amenities like Wi-Fi. The library is excellent, and the classrooms are spacious. Additionally, the college offers hostel accommodation where we may eat well. Compared to the canteen, the mess is clean and has a wider selection of food. Sports and games materials and activities are offered, as are medical amenities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The instructors are incredibly informed and helpful. Many of the instructors at my college are skilled educators who make sure that the curriculum is easily understood by breaking down difficult ideas into manageable chunks. Exams during the semester are challenging, but thanks to our teachers, we all pass with high grades. New technology is applicable to the course. They prepare pupils for the workforce. With a 96% passing percentage, the semester exams are challenging to pass.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Materials Science and Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: IITH - A detailed review.

detailed_review.Placements: There is a separate cell for placements. This placement is run by 3rd year and 4th year students and is handled by professors. Placements here are good. According to last statistics, the average salary package offered ranges from 18 LPA - 20 LPA. Placements are very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms have good infrastructure. There is a good Wi-Fi connection. We also have library which is the best on campus. Medical facilities are available 24/7 and we also have a sports and cultural complex which would be open till 9:00 PM. Sports complex has various games to play and enjoy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very well-qualified and knowledgeable. Top 2% of the world researchers also teach here. Curriculum is relevant and useful mostly. Grading here is relatively graded 90% of the time which means our grade depends on all other members' grade.
detailed_review.Other: Fests and all are very well celebrated here. We get to know a lot of things and explore because of these.

reviews.review_title: IIT, Hyderabad in my view.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80% of the people accept PPOs offered during their internships. Recently even other students who sat for placements got an average salary package of 24 LPA which is pretty decent. Recruiting companies are Deuce Bank, Zomato, and DE Shaw. Roles offered include SDE, ML, and quant. As a student for MNC we have a wide range of new opportunities and no one fails to get into top companies with high-paying jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A new building dedicated to math is built where we have good infrastructure with required instruments and classrooms. Library is very well designed and timings are flexible enough to work and study together even late night. There are group discussion rooms which are really helpful.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are trained and they are IIT graduates. They are friendly and make topics interesting by involving applications in real life. Tube curriculum is designed such a way that a student learns math applications in computer science and AI.
detailed_review.Other: There are many clubs to get involved in and learn management skills like Cell, FCC, and Tedx. Elan and vision is the annual techno-cultural fest of IIT Hyderabad which is one of the largest fests in south India. It lasts for 3 days and epic nights to make it most memorable evening of students' college life.

reviews.review_title: The best, the latest IIT over there.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly all of them will be placed. There are many opportunities. The highest is around 22 LPA and the lowest is 6 LPA. The average is around 15 LPA. Many of them go to the IT sector. Around 50% members got internships in companies like JSW, L and T, Ultratech.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is top class, the latest technology, the best IIT for infra. The hostels are also good, single rooms. The quality of food is also maintained properly. Medical facilities are top class, sports is also too good. The hostels are provided with radiant cooling, so your rooms wouldn't even require any ACs.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified, their teaching quality is too good. Yes, the course curriculum is also relevant and also makes the student understand the industry pretty well. The semester exams are not that difficult if we attend the classes properly.
detailed_review.Other: This is the best IIT out there.

reviews.review_title: Very satisfied because of infrastructure and faculties.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of the students were placed in my department was 72 percent. The highest package was 13 lacs and the average package was 8 lacs and the lowest package was 4 lacs. The top recruiting companies were Capgemini, L&T Infotech, TCS etc. Many students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for my course are very good. The classrooms and labs are well maintained and organized properly.  A well stocked library is present. The hostel rooms are average. Multiple sports and medical facilities are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very skilled and experienced. The teaching quality is good. Curriculum activities are only conducted in the starting of semester. The semester exams are quite difficult. All the faculties and college staff is very supportive and helpful.

reviews.review_title: IIT Hyderabad has an amazing infrastructure and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Hyderabad provides the best placements in top companies all over the country, and the maximum students got campus placements. Other students got better jobs themselves or started their own ventures. Internships are provided, and the students got paid for the internship. The highest package offered in 2024 was 44 lacs per annum, and the average package size was 14 to 18 lacs per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IITs are always best in infrastructure, and like that, IIT Hyderabad provides each facility which a student can think of: well-stocked library, well-equipped classrooms, good-quality food, etc., and other facilities, but the hostel rooms are small. Sports opportunities and medical facilities are also provided by the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were very helpful and well established. Teachers here are quite knowledgeable and experienced. Their teaching style is modern and it focuses on practicals rather than theory. The curriculum is totally relevant and it makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are very tough and projects are also time-consuming. Students need to maintain at least a 7 CGPA.

reviews.review_title: I am quite dissatisfied because of the infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75 percent of the students were placed in my course. The highest package was 12 lacs, the average package was 7.5 lacs, and the lowest package was 5 lacs. Many reputed companies visited our college during the session, and several students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall facilities and infrastructure available for our department are good, but the technologies like computers and projectors are outdated. A well-stocked library with all the requirements is present. Multiple sports facilities and a medical center are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very experienced and qualified. They provide both online and offline resources for studying so that students can perform well in the examinations. Our course is curriculum-relevant, and many activities are conducted. The semester exams are not very difficult.

reviews.review_title: A learners haven, good for learning and realizing one’s potential.

detailed_review.Placements: According to what I have heard this time, placements were average, with 60 percent placed and our course having the highest package of 60 lakh/annum and a median of 28 lakh/annum. In internships, as of now, the process is still going on, with the majority for SDE roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our institute infrastructure with library lecture halls and each department building is top-notch and better than most private colleges and older institutions. Hostels are also pretty luxurious, with Japanese architecture and radiant cooling. The mess food is actually pretty tolerable, with a special dinner served once a month having more varieties. The food is balanced and occasionally has fruits and sweets.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are extremely qualified, though some have hard time communicating with students. The courses are updated and useful and semester exams are hard but grading is relatively easy, so manageable. The majority of the courses are passable, whereas some courses, due to the complex concepts and strict professors, are hard to crack.
detailed_review.Other: Extracurricular activities and clubs are pretty good but locations are not nice, as they're not accessible and far from Hyderabad city.

reviews.review_title: It is a dream come true to get admission in this college.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students accepted into our college is 100%. The brand of IIT is so significant that most of the top MNCs in the country come and visit the campus for a recruitment drive every year. The highest package reaches 35 LPA. The college also provides 100% internships to the students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The IITs in our country are known for the infrastructure they provide to the students. The course offers us a wide range of benefits and perks such as Wi-Fi, library access, AV classrooms, etc. The food served by our mess is the best in class.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers at our college are really helpful; they are very well qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality has also been very good, and they make sure that the content of the course is not compromised. The college exams are difficult to crack.

admission.title: IIT Hyderabad Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: IIT Hyderabad Admission 2025 includes UG, PG, professional, and doctoral programmes in Engineering, Design, Sciences, and Liberal Arts. Admissions to IIT Hyderabad are primarily entrance-based. BTech applicants must clear JEE Main and JEE Advanced, followed by JoSAA counselling. BDes requires UCEED, MTech requires GATE, and MDes requires CEED scores. Selection to PG and PhD programmes may also involve departmental screening and interviews. Direct admission is offered to eligible IIT graduates in select PG programmes.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for B.Tech at IIT Hyderabad? What is the minimum JEE Main percentile required admission?
faqs.answer: Candidates wanting to get admission to IIT Hyderabad for BTech course must clear JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced. The minimum eligibility includes scoring at least 75% aggregate marks in Class 12 exam. For SC/ST/PwD students, the minimum score required in Class 12 is 65%. The minimum JEE Main percentile required at IIT Hyderabad for BTech course is 98-99 percentile. This percentile may vary from year to year.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Hyderabad provides modern amenities with state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. The institute is spread over 576 acres of land and offers various facilities to the students, such as a canteen, transportation, library, auditorium, and other facilities. The college also has a badminton court, basketball court, cricket and football ground, among others. In addition to this, the college also has separate hostels for boys and girls. sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Campus Highlights
text: IIT Hyderabad is one of the top-tier institutes in the country in terms of academic excellence, as well as infrastructure facilities. The institute has well-maintained classrooms, laboratories, a library and an auditorium. Since it is a fully residential institute, hostel facility is provided to boys and girls. There are well-structured facilities for sports as well as other recreational activities. Have a look at the table below to know about a few details of the campus:

tables.IIT Hyderabad Campus Highlights: High Performance Computing Centre, Library, Specialised Labs, Hostels, High-speed internet, and more

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Hyderabad is known for its academic excellence, the reason for which, apart from the excellent faculty and ranking, includes the well-structured academic and research infrastructure. The institute has laboratories with the latest technology and equipment. It consists of a world-class library , apart from an expanding campus that includes a hospital and AI-powered driverless buses for transportation. There is a research park that indicates the emphasis on innovation and development. One of the aims of the institute is to offer holistic development for education, research and entrepreneurship.

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: IIT Hyderabad is a residential campus, having modern hostel blocks under the care of the Council of Wardens and the Hostel Office. There are separate hostel blocks for boys and girls. There are 23 hostel blocks (17 for boys and 5 for girls). Most students get individual rooms with a cot, study table, cupboard, and radiant cooling system. Kalpana Chawla, Ramanuja, Vivekananda, and SN Bose blocks have double‑sharing rooms, while the Kapila block is a dual-sharing block for Non‑Regular Students.

Each hostel has a dining hall that fulfils the food needs of the students and a cafeteria for tea, snacks, etc. There are vending machines serving snacks present in the campus. The hostel has a pantry area for storage and cleaning purposes. A pharmacy is present for the medical needs of the students. Bank service and ATM services are smooth. A recreation centre is being created at the hostels for students to play indoor games. There are outdoor sports facilities and a gym to encourage physical fitness among students. There is a Tinker's Lab, a Dance Room and a TV room for recreational purposes. Elevators and CCTV cameras are installed for comfort and security.

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Library
text: IIT Hyderabad has a library named Knowledge Resource Centre, which offers digital and traditional resources of learning. The library is open 24/7 , has electronic resources and comprehensive services.

The library is well-stocked with more than 20,000 books and 10,000 periodicals . The reference books as well as regular books are open for circulation. IITH also has an internal repository of scholarly publications made by its faculty and students.

sections.heading: IIT Hyderabad Sports Facilities
text: IIT Hyderabad offer different sports facilities to promote holistic development and sportsmanship among students. The institute offers both indoor and outdoor facilities. There is a modern sports complex with cricket grounds, football fields, hockey fields, tennis courts, etc. The indoor sports facilities at the institute include a gymnasium, badminton courts, squash and table tennis.

highlights.summary:
IIT Guwahati was established by the Government of India in 1994. It is the sixth IIT established. It has been ranked 8 under the 'Engineering' category and 11 under the Overall category by the NIRF Ranking 2025. Talking about the international rankings, IIT Guwahati has been ranked 334th in the 'World University' category by the QS World University Rankings 2026.
Located on the banks of the river Brahmaputra in Guwahati, Assam, the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is home to the first research park in North East India. It holds the status of an Institute of Importance like other IITs. The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati IIT Guwahati has signed MoUs with numerous national and international institutions across the globe to promote student and faculty exchange programmes and bring in more opportunities for international internships, joint conferences, and workshops. It has 5 academic centers and 5 extramural centers. Candidates can check the highlights of IIT Guwahati in the table provided below:

college_info_program.intro:
IIT Guwahati flagship courses are BTech and MTech. The institute offers 4-year BTech and BDes across various specialisations. Both BTech and BDes courses are for 8 semesters. At the PG level, IIT Guwahati courses include a 2-year MTech across 9 departments, a 2-year MDes, a 2-year MS (by Research), and a 2-year MA course. All the PG courses are for 4 semesters. IIT Guwahati Assam, offers PhD courses across 11 departments, 6 centres, and two joint PhD courses. Also, the institute offers dual degrees such as MTech+ PhD in Computer Science & Engineering and MS (Engineering) + PhD in Electronics and Electrical Engineering. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: It has an amazing infrastructure infused with greenery.

detailed_review.Placements: Top recruiting companies for our course, like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle, JP Morgan Chase, PwC, Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, Schlumberger, HPCL, and Piramal, frequently hire students from this branch. Approximately 60-85 percent of students secure internships, primarily starting in their third year. Companies offering internships are Google, Microsoft, Uber, Amazon, and core firms like Hilabs. Monthly stipend offered to top roles can exceed up to 1 lakh per month, and internship up to 85 percent. In the B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology course 2025, the lowest salary package offered is 8 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 18-22 LPA. The highest salary package offered is 54 LPA. The placement percentage is 70 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are superb. Wi-Fi problem persists. The library is peaceful, and books are available. Facilities are excellent. The mess provides quality food. Lohit hostel has the best canteen on the whole campus. Free medical facilities are available on campus till 8 PM. Sports facilities are excellent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and knowledgeable. The teaching style is good and understandable. Almost all faculty members hold PhD degrees from premier institutions, including other IITs and renowned international universities. Many professors are global leaders in their fields, such as nanotechnology, green chemistry, computational biology, etc. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes us industry-ready. Semester examinations have moderate to difficult questions. The pass percentage is 100 percent, as per my knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in Chemistry. I don't want to change anything in this course. Fests organised are awesome. The campus is beautiful and looks very natural.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good campus life and infrastructure, no city life, good mess and food counter.

detailed_review.Placements: Very nice placement. A different body is framed every year to organise the placement and accommodation related to all the companies and organisations. Good overall placement and packages. A lot of companies come to recruit for different roles, and the lowest package is above 12 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good sports facility. Average facility for accommodation and training. Nice infrastructure for classrooms. Good libraries. Low-speed Wi-Fi services in the classroom and hostel. All types of sports equipment are available in or out of the hostel. Nice and clean mess service.
detailed_review.Faculty: Nice and helpful teachers and professors. A little off the track curriculum. Good curriculum for the industry. Difficult semester examination. A lot of study material is provided by the institute to help students. A lot of practical knowledge is provided.
detailed_review.Other: A lot of festivals and functions are organised very often.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: Outstanding campus life with satisfactory placements and nice infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, the placement percentage of my branch (Chemical Science and Technology) is about 81 percent. The highest package is 85 LPA, the lowest is 8 LPA, and the average is 21 LPA. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Infosys, Tata, etc., offer jobs to us. Around 50 percent of students of each batch get an internship, but it primarily depends on an individual's skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is an academic complex consisting of 5 different scores numbered from 1 to 5. The campus is 700 acres with a central library, 5 lakes, 2 guest houses, 13 active hostels, and 1 closed hostel. The classrooms have proper sitting arrangements, AC, Wi-Fi, plug-in boards, and lots of other facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers have a doctorate in their respective fields, they are highly knowledgeable, and they teach really well. The course curriculum is relevant to make students industry-ready. There are 2 exams in one semester, the first is mid-semester and the second is end-sem. The exams are easily crackable with some effort. The pass percentage is above 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I had so much interest in Chemistry class 8th, analyzing chemical relations and equations. Because of this interest in Chemistry, I took Chemical Science and Technology as my branch at IIT Guwahati. I think with knowledge of chemistry, they should increase technical subjects in this course.

reviews.review_title: This college gives an enormous amount of opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year, 65% of students from my branch got placed. The highest package was 52 LPA, the lowest was 7.2 LPA, and the average package was 20 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, etc. 60% of students got internships from my course. Roles offered were SDE roles, product management roles, and research roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the lecture hall, lab, and hostel rooms is quite good. Hostels have double occupancy for first and second-year students and single occupancy for third and fourth-year students. The lecture hall and lab are fully Wi-Fi connected. We have two types of library: one in central and the other one in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching is quite helpful, but an old curriculum is followed. Professors are highly qualified and have studied and taught in various different institutes around the world. There are various types of professors. A few professors are very chill, and a few are very strict.
detailed_review.Other: One will get connected to the top brains of the country.

reviews.review_title: Gems of knowledge reside in the beauty of nature.

detailed_review.Placements: About 60% of students were placed in our course this year. The highest package was 51 LPA, the average was 16 LPA, and the lowest was 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, etc. Only about 20% of students from my course got internships. Students were placed in companies like Microsoft, Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classes and labs have Wi-Fi facilities. There are also AC facilities, and the cleanliness in classes and labs was very good. In the hostel, food was not that good, but average. Academic and sports facilities at the hostel were good. Medical facilities were also good; in case of an emergency, an ambulance is always ready to move in.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our professors were highly qualified and knowledgeable. They clear the concepts in a very easy way and also address students' doubts and listen to them. Teaching quality was very good. However, the subjects that were given to us are not relevant; for example, we had to study engineering mechanics, data science, and modern physics courses, and I don't think these courses are relevant to us. The calculus course was very tough. The pass percentage was only 50%, and half of the class failed.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because, from childhood, I wanted to do both things related to medical science, but during school, I realized that I had to choose one. When gathering information about both fields, I found that the bioscience course in engineering encompasses both fields. My course academics were good, but I think they can improve aspects like placements and internships. Events and fests were amazing, as they helped us increase our social skills and also enjoy a lot.

reviews.review_title: The most beautiful campus.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% were placed, the highest was around 50 LPA, and the average was around 20 LPA. The top core recruiting company was Texas Instruments, whereas many people went for finance companies. A few students got internships from my course ( mostly quant). Many students opted for higher studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classroom complex is great, but the quality of food in the mess is not good; there is more masala in the buttermilk than in the food. There is a hospital inside the campus, and another one is being built. There are 2 big sports complexes on the campus and many sports clubs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. They are always ready to help (except for a few rude ones). The curriculum is relevant. The exams are tough, especially in mathematics. Many people failed in that subject (especially people from lower branches such as Biosciences).
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course because I was interested in studying Physics. Fests are great, and the surrounding areas are also very beautiful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Expectations meet reality here, and it is one of the best IITs of India.

detailed_review.Placements: There is a 70-80 percent placement rate in the B.Tech in EEE of Guwahati. The average package offered is 27 LPA, and now it has gotten closer to 23-24 LPA. The highest package offered is 75 LPA. The highest package offered in the previous year ranged from 55-60 LPA. The lowest package is generally not reported. There is a 50% internship rate. Top roles offered here include SDE at some of the multinational companies, including Nvidia, Microsoft, and Google.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The central library is very big and spacious with a modern infrastructure. Apart from the central library, we have a library in each hostel where we can find standard books, and they are of a sufficient size with AC. The food served here is above average, and it is pretty good. Apart from the mess, we have a canteen and paid food additives too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is pretty decent. Some teachers are really good. Others are very knowledgeable but lack teaching quality a bit. The course curriculum is very relevant. I am a fresher, so I do not yet know about the industry-ready curriculum. But I have heard this course makes students industry-ready from seniors. Semester exams are pretty much easier compared to the JEE Advanced that we gave to come in. Studying about 1-2 hours daily apart from college studies is sufficient to excel in it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best college of my life.

detailed_review.Placements: For now, I have not seen any campus placements, but I know from seniors that the average package is 33 LPA for the DSAI batch, and the maximum is 96 LPA, where the median is 25 LPA. Top companies include JP Morgan, Samsung, Microsoft, and many more MNCs. Most people are placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is good, but the buildings of hostels are too old for new students, so you have to wait for new hostels. Meanwhile, everything is available, like Wi-Fi with good speed. All sports facilities, including cricket, tennis, football, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: It has an advanced syllabus, including AI. Teachers teach every topic in a very exciting way. The syllabus is updated every year. As industry demands grow, our syllabus is also not steady with old topics. Teachers are well-qualified and experts in their domains.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review_title: The review of IIT Guwahati BS degree.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Guwahati's first-ever BS in Data Science & AI batch got 91% placements with offers from big names like Google, Microsoft, and Warner Bros Discovery. Students also went for higher education/studies (e.g., Carnegie Mellon University, United States of America).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Guwahati's infrastructure is a bit far away from bigger IITs. But still great enough compared to many colleges and universities in India as IITs are the biggest and most prestigious chain of Indian colleges. It has modern classrooms, AC-enabled labs, and other facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty, curriculum, and exams are among the best in most of the colleges in India. Many of the professors have PhDs and master's degrees in their respective fields, and the curriculum is up to date according to the generation and needs of companies and brands.

reviews.review_title: Great experience overall, with supportive teachers and a lively campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Out of around 93 civil students who registered, about two thirds 66% landed a job. Placements are decent but not 100%. The highest package is 65LPA this is an outlier, usually non core. The lowest package is around 6LPA. The average package is around 18 to19LPA. Big tech & non core companies like Google, Microsoft, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, etc., and core & infra side such as Larsen & Toubro L&T, Tata Projects, Adani Group, Afcons, NBCC, and HPCL/ONGC., visit the campus. Many civil students actually take non core jobs in tech, finance, and consulting, but core recruiters do come. IITG students together got 230 PPOs pre placement offers from internships. Typical internship companies are Google, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, L&T, Tata Projects, Schlumberger, Adani, TVS, HPCL, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In civil engineering, we have all the labs and classrooms we need, with Wi-Fi and a great library to study from. I live in the Siang hostel. The rooms are decent with LAN and Wi-Fi, and the mess food is okay, with the canteen for variety when we get bored. The campus has a 24/7 medical center, so health is not a worry, and sports facilities are really good. Grounds, courts, gym, and even a swimming pool are available. Overall, its a pretty comfortable place to live and study.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the professors in civil are really qualified and quite helpful if you reach out, though, like anywhere, some classes feel more engaging than others. The curriculum itself is solid and covers the basics well, but to be honest, if you really want to feel industry ready, you need to back it up with internships or extra skills outside the classroom. Semester exams are usually on the tougher, concept based side, but they are not impossible. If you study regularly, you can manage fine, and almost everyone passes, probably around 90% or more.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Civil Engineering because I want to become an IES officer in the future. The best part of the course is that it gives a good foundation through labs and projects. I feel could be improved is adding more industry oriented training. Campus life is lively with big fests like Alcheringa and Techniche, a friendly crowd, and a beautiful location by the Brahmapur. The hostels, sports facilities, scholarships, and extracurricular activities make student life comfortable and balanced.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT University, Guwahati.

detailed_review.Placements: We are IIT students, so definitely each one got a placement. So many M.Tech students have joined the CSE course. Highest package is about 2.4 crore, and lowest package is 35 Lacs. So many top MNC companies came to our college, they are Google, Microsoft, Flipkart, Amazon, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In IIT, the best infrastructure is placed. We have labs for every department and for every course. We have all AC classrooms and a well-stocked library. We have Wi-Fi available here. We have so many canteens here, and a medical hospital is available. We also have sports for any year students.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have the best faculty here, and they are very friendly with us. They teach classes very nicely, and the explanation is super. We have weekly 3 to 4 events. Seniors conduct the events. We also join these events and participate. Our dean conducts exams very strictly.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Guwahati - A great college .

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85-90 percent students from my college got into one or more companies. Many big companies like IBM, Google, Amazon visits for the campus placement as it is an IIT. So we got benefit for being an IITian. The average package bagged by students in M.Teach was around 15LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The building and infrastructure of our college hostel is very great. Also the mess is great we get variety of food through out the week. The hostel is very NEET and clean also there is separate hostel for girls and boys and each hostel have security guards .
detailed_review.Faculty: The professor in our college were highly professional and knowledgeable. They helps a lot not only in our college exams but during the placement season. They possess high practical experience in the field of computer Science and engineering. I am very satisfied with the faculty here.
detailed_review.Other: As It is an IIT you will surely get benefitted from the name of college. Also there is a lot of on campus placement opportunities .

reviews.review_title: IIT Guwahati is an awesome college.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Guwahati campus is very large. Since I am a Ph.D. scholar, the research facilities in this college are very good.  Around 80-85% of students get placed in our course. The highest salary package in our college is 57 LPA, the average salary package is 11 LPA, and the lowest salary package is 6 LPA. Companies like Aditya Birla, Tata, and PhonePe recruit students from our course. Every student gets an internship in the 2nd or 3rd year through hard work.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available in our hostel include Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Fully air-conditioned classrooms are available in our college. A central library is also available on our campus, and books can be issued by students. The quality of food in the mess is average. There are three canteens on our campus, and the fast food is good. We have a small ground to play different sports like volleyball, football, and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. All of them are PhD holders. The course curriculum is relevant to industry needs. Besides, one has to prepare themselves too. Each semester has 2 exams, mid-term and end-term. One needs to have at least 35% in order to pass the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a nice place with good vibes and makes memories to always be remembered.

detailed_review.Placements: Definitely more than 90% of students get placed every year, and the rest students opt for higher studies or choose other career paths. In the CSE, students rarely opt for other non-tech profiles, and students majorly focus on SDE, quantitative, developer, etc., roles. Few students go for embedded roles as well. The average package offered is more than 30 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We do not have restricted internet. LAN points are present in every hostel room. The campus's main buildings have centralised Wi-Fi known as IITG-Connect, and we can log in through our ID and ERP password. Internet speed is mediocre. Each hostel has an AC library and gym of its own. There is a big central library and a gym for the whole campus. Classroom infrastructure is way beyond what we will see in other tier 2 colleges. There are canteens in every hostel. There are 10 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are genuinely always helpful, and we just need to approach them well. They are mostly always open to help. Courses are surely relevant after the renewal of the syllabus, and more relevance will be achieved by this year. Making industry-ready is something the students also must focus on and gather their skills to stand out to the public.
detailed_review.Other: There's a fest for every board and every genre. The biggest and the best cultural fest, named Alcheringa is organised in January to February. Then comes Techniche, the tech fest during September. Our college also organises a sports fest named Spirit and a welfare fest named Prayatna.

reviews.review_title: Beautiful college.

detailed_review.Placements: A very reputable institute of India in all dimensions, including placement. The placement was very good. The highest package offered was 20 LPA. The average package in our course was around 8 LPA. Around 80% of students received placement offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. It is one of the most beautiful institutions in India. Wi-Fi campus and library were present. A hostel with a family was available in this IIT. Food quality in the canteen and mess was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors were helpful, qualified, knowledgeable, and well-experienced in their respective domains of study. Teaching quality of our faculty members was extremely good. The course curriculum was relevant. The semester examinations were quite tough.

reviews.review_title: The Best IIT in India with good packages and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed in IIT Guwahati was 98% of our batch. In our course, more than 90% got placed. The highest package offered was 39 LPA and the lowest was 10 to 15 LPA. Recruiting companies included Tata Chemical, BAFS, Apollo, and other top companies. Students internships in companies with stipends. Roles offered in the course were process engineering, analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure were very good. Each branch had different building blocks, including separate libraries, labs, and classrooms. Our course provided all resources and facilities, including materials, lab facilities, and library facilities. Hostel food was not very good. The canteen food was good but costly. Medical facilities were available for all.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were like friends. They supported us academically and in gaining industry experience. The teaching quality was very good. Teachers were well qualified with Masters and Ph.D. They had good knowledge. The course curriculum was relevant to the industry. Semester exams were hard to pass. The pass percentage was 83%.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with college and campus.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Guwahati is well known for good placements. Almost 90% of students are placed in our Ph.D. Chemistry course. The highest package offered is 39 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 12 LPA. Recruiting companies of our course are Dhrma, Asian Paints, Cipla, and many other companies. Nearly 80% of students got internships with stipends. Roles offered such as research analyst, associate manager, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities available in our course are like we have well-equipped with all materials and resources. Infrastructure is very strong and beautiful. Libraries are more. The college facilities are very helpful. The quality of food available in the canteen is very good and very tasty.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-trained under top universities and have more knowledge. They have many years of experience. The teaching quality is very good. Course curriculum is relevant to chemistry. It makes students ready for the industry. The semester exams are hard to pass. Pass percentage is 75%.

reviews.review_title: The best college to take admission in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: 93% of students who were in my course got placed. The highest package was 2.30 crores per annum. The lowest was 16 LPA. The average package was around 31 LPA. Top recruiting companies included Google, Microsoft, Facebook, IBM, etc. The roles offered to students were at the level closer to CEO and managers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We had everything in our hostel including cupboards, indoor games, indoor courts, gym, and Wi-Fi at a very high speed. The quality of food depends on the mess you prefer, so the quality was based on the mess similarly. We had luxury rooms in the first year where we could make new connections. Also, college campus was very beautiful with natural beauty.
detailed_review.Faculty: The core opportunities provided by this course were good. The course curriculum was very relevant, and the teachers were highly qualified, helpful, easily approachable, skilled, and knowledgeable too. The teaching quality was very good and easy for students to understand. Semester exams were hard according to the standards of IITS with a high pass percentage of around 94%-95%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's not just a college but second home.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage based on 2024 data is around 64.% It is a decent percentage as many of the students opt for further studies and other streams other than campus placements. SDE is the top role and is more beneficial for CSE and MNC students. Other branch students can have core placements too as per their interests.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is college Wi-Fi overall campus except hostels. There is Wi-Fi in each room inside the hostels. The network quality is really good. Medical facilities are very good and are available 24 hours including ambulance facility. There are courts for every sport and well-maintained by the gymkhana.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and always open to any kind of issues. The frequency of exams is manageable. The difficulty of exam is dependent on the course instructor. Some are really strict but mostly are good. They connect real-life problems with the subject which makes students focus more.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for this course as I was interested in maths in my 12th grade. The college is really good and the course too. Fests and events are next level. Everyone is friendly in their own way.

reviews.review_title: The campus is peaceful serene and beautiful.

detailed_review.Placements: From 3rd year the students become eligible for campus placements. The college also allows them to sit in placements even after passing out. The average package that our college offers is around 3.6 LPA while the highest one can reach up to 16-18 LPA it is based on the student's merit and performance. Many renowned companies visit and offer career opportunities to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus life may just be the best part of IIT Guwahati be it the general championship or Alcheringa the college truly comes alive multiple times a semester. There is a club for everything and if you find an interest that does not have a club then you can just grab your friends and make one.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-student ratio is proper as it should be in a college. I personally like Debraj Roy sir since he is very fun-loving and at the same time explains Maths as if it might be the easiest subject in our course. I can't recall any of the faculty members whom I might not like. There are 4 internal exams CA1, CA2, CA3, & CA4, and a semester exam at the end (IT A Makaut Affiliated College).

faqs.question: How to apply for BDes at IIT Guwahati?
faqs.answer: All the students seeking admission to the Bachelor of Design (BDes) programme offered at IIT Guwahati must apply for UCEED first, and then submit a duly filled application to the institute. faqs.question: How much does it cost to study M.Tech at IIT Guwahati?

faqs.question: Who is eligible for M.Tech in IIT Guwahati?
faqs.answer: Candidates with BTech or BE/ MCA/ MSc/ Graduation (AMIETE) with 60% aggregate or 6.0 CPI are eligible for the M.Tech in IIT Guwahati. Further, there is 0.5% CPI or 5% marks relaxation for SC/ST/PwD category candidates. Candidates must also have valid score in the national level exam GATE exam and they must also participated in the COAP Counselling (GATE not required for the sponsored category).

faqs.question: How can I get into IIT Guwahati for MTech?
faqs.answer: The selection criteria for the M.Tech programme offered at IIT Guwahati comprises a valid GATE score followed by COAP counselling. Applications must be submitted within the due date. The GATE application fee for boys is INR 1,700, INR 850 for girls, and INR 850 for SC/ST/PwD category students.

faqs.question: What is the basic eligibility for PhD at IIT Guwahati?

Candidates with a four-year bachelor’s degree/ equivalent qualification with a minimum of 70% aggregate or 7.0 CPI can also apply. The aspirants must also hold the relevant documents as a proof of eligibility.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Guwahati is located on the north bank of the Brahmaputra River and is spread across an area of 700 acres. The infrastructure of the college is very strong and includes an academic complex, well-equipped labs, a library, a sports complex with various facilities, and much more. The institute also offers hostel facilities with a canteen and recreational spaces. The institute offers adequate and well-maintained infrastructure where students can learn and grow. Apart from the goodwill, highly competent faculty and academic excellence, the infrastructure of the institute is also the reason that students feel confident and secure, which helps them later in their careers.

sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Campus Highlights
text: IIT Guwahati is one of the top institutions in India for engineering and other courses. The well-maintained infrastructure of the institute helps the students in many aspects of their college life. For instance, the classrooms are well-maintained and are equipped with all the modern amenities. There are various departments, all of which have the latest labs with all the modern equipment required. The institute also offers hostel facilities for boys and girls separately. These hostels offer a homely and comfortable environment to the students. To know more details about the infrastructure facilities offered by IIT Guwahati, read further:
Campus View:

tables.IIT Guwahati Campus Highlights: North bank of the Brahmaputra River
Classrooms, Labs, Auditorium, Hostels, Library and more

sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Guwahati provides the best academic facilities to promote academic excellence. The classrooms are well-ventilated, spacious and are equipped with modern audio-visual aids. The institute has a Central Instruments Facility (CIF) that houses 26 advanced instruments for chemical/material analysis, which are used by 11 academic departments and 38 external institutes.

The CSE department has 7 labs - Robotics, Speech, IDS, ISEA, VLSI, Aakash, RTDLS and 24*7 UG/PG research scholar labs. The department also has high-availability server farms, high-end computer clusters, and robust networking.

School of Rural and Agro Technology has specialised labs - Agro-Eco, Food and Bio Process, Water and Sanitation, Microbiology and shared wet labs- all equipped with instruments such as gas chromatographs, HPLC, fibre analysers, etc.

The institute has CNT (Centre for Nanotechnology) , which has around 37 crore funding, comprising 25 advanced labs, including clean rooms. The institute has a supercomputer- PARAM Kamrupa , which is one of the fastest supercomputers in northeast India, supporting advanced simulation and AI-driven research. The institute has a Research Park, which offers Industry Collaboration.

sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Library
text: The central library of IIT Guwahati is named Lakshminath Bezbarao Central Library . The name is given in honour of an Assamese literary figure. It is housed in a four-storey building with around 7500 square feet of floor area. All the in-house facilities of the library are fully computerised, and wifi is available throughout the building for seamless access to electronic resources.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around IIT Guwahati
text: IIT Guwahati offers a serene environment with the Brahmaputra River on one side and hills on the other. There are many beautiful places to visit near the campus. Meanwhile, the campus of the college itself is a beautiful setting. In a short distance, there are picturesque attractions such as Umananda Island , Saraighat Bridge Area , and the town of Amingaon , which can be visited to know about the local life of North Guwahati. college_info_program.intro:
NIT Trichy popular programmes are BTech and MTech. BTech is given in nine specialisations for a four-year duration spread over eight semesters. NIT Trichy BTech in Computer Science and Engineering students can look for career opportunities and can become Computer Engineers, Testing Engineers, Multimedia programmers, Full Stack Developers, and others. After doing a BTech in Civil Engineering, students will gain the ability to implement infrastructure development by using various sustainable technologies and materials.
NIT Trichy's MTech programme is a two-year postgraduate programme given in 23 specialisations. Some of the specialisations in which MTech is taught are Geotechnical Engineering, Thermal Power Engineering, VLSI Systems, and others. NIT Trichy is ranked 9th under the Engineering category. Also, NIT Trichy students are placed in top companies such as Google, Infosys, Facebook, Oracle, ITC, Intel, and others. Overall, the National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is one of the best colleges offering one of the best Engineering programmes to students.
