reviews.review_title: I felt absolutely good about joining this college because of its good infrastructure and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Now I am a fresher here. If we look at the placements at NIT Trichy, they are amazing. To be honest, I am from the Civil Engineering branch, so we cannot expect high packages, but our seniors get into many PSUs. The alumni here help the most with placements. Last year, nearly 78% of students were placed in my course. The highest package is 34 LPA and 20 LPA for core jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities on campus are good. We can find everything in the campus supermarket (2k). If we talk about the hostels, as you know, NIT Trichy is an old college, so it has very old hostels, but the good thing is that they have been renovated this year. Wi-Fi is very good. For the first few years, they accommodated us in the Kailesh mess. The food here is not very good, but in the second year, we can choose any mess we want, and those are very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here is outstanding. Everyone has in-depth knowledge. They have completed their PhDs or Master's from top institutes in India. They are very helpful and provide a faculty mentor, which is the best thing I have ever experienced. If we talk about the semester exams, the grading is relatively strict, so professors give moderately difficult papers.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is the branch I got into at NIT Trichy. The best thing about this course is that there is more scope for it in the future. It is one of the oldest courses in NIT Trichy. If we talk about the events, they are amazing. After working hard for JEE, the events here are worth it. It is an 800-acre campus, and there are around 6000–7000 students in NIT Trichy. The connectivity includes various clubs and communities, which provide good interactions.

reviews.review_title: The institute offers strong academics and campus life, with scope for better industry exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: CSE / IT placements are around 95–100%, while the overall placement percentage at NIT Trichy is above 90%. The highest package offered is 45–55 LPA from international and top product companies, the average package is 25–30 LPA, and the lowest package is 6–8 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, and the major roles offered are Software Development Engineer (SDE), Backend / Full-Stack Developer, Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, and AI Engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus provides 24×7 high-speed Wi-Fi across academic blocks and hostels. Laboratories consist of computer labs with high-performance systems. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. They are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and audio systems.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most faculty members are highly qualified, many with PhDs from IITs, IISc, and foreign universities. Professors are strong in core fundamentals and research. The curriculum is updated regularly as per AICTE guidelines and industry trends. Strong fundamentals help crack top tech interviews. Labs and projects build problem-solving skills. The difficulty level is moderate to slightly difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Civil Engineering because it is a core engineering branch. It plays a vital role in nation-building and infrastructure development. The course allows me to understand how real-world structures like buildings, bridges, roads, and dams are designed and constructed. Studying Civil Engineering at NIT Trichy, which has a strong reputation, experienced faculty, and excellent labs, gives both theoretical strength and practical exposure. Excellent faculty, strong fundamentals, and well-equipped labs.

reviews.review_title: Campus life and experience in NIT Trichy.

detailed_review.Placements: Actually, I am a fresher who joined NIT Trichy in 2025 in the civil engineering course. I hear that many of my seniors are placed with good packages. However, many of them go for higher studies like M.Tech through GATE in civil engineering and the research side. Overall, the placement cell is good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Classes for all department students occur in academic blocks like Orion and Logos, but we suffer in summer due to the high temperature of Trichy. The hostel facilities are also quite good. Every room has Wi-Fi. This year, they also introduced washing machines, which are on a pay-and-use system. I give 3/5 for the food because the taste does not seem good, and the varieties are also repeated. You can find many canteens, and you can also find Domino’s and CCD. The medical facilities are extremely good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors here are highly qualified and knowledgeable. There is no need to worry about academics on this campus. NIT Trichy offers a flexible curriculum. This allows students to get exposure to different kinds and types of fields. The difficulty level of the exam depends on the professor, but the paper is moderate and not that difficult. People here study just one night before the exam and score very good grades. The pass percentage depends on the performance of students in the class.
detailed_review.Other: The fests at NIT Trichy are incredible. These fests not only provide entertainment but also make us show interest in many academic and non-academic aspects. It makes our college life fulfilling. You can not only gain entertainment but also communication skills through PIs at the fest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure but disappointing in some aspects.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80 percent of students are placed in our branch. All branches also have good placements. Companies like Nvidia and Qualcomm will come in placement for ECE branch. Placement package will depend on the students, I think. The highest package is around 64 LPA which is taken by Qualcomm.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is nice. Hostels are not that much good as their NIRF is 9 but not too bad, it's okay to have such a hostel. College infrastructure is very nice. Library is also good. Food is not good in the first year but for North and South people they have different messes in college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are not that much difficult but the subject is excellent. Here in first year, they will teach you the basics of all branches to everyone. It doesn't cause stress for the students. The total semester marks are divided into parts. So you don't need to take that much stress.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is too good because it's a very good campus. Fests are held every month, and we can enjoy a lot. We can explore so much on campus with friends.

reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with the course.

detailed_review.Placements: About 90 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is 36 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 6 LPA. The average package offered is 12 LPA. BPCL, Meesho, and ICICI Bank are top recruiting companies. The percentage of students who got internships from our course is 15 percent in companies like Pernod Record, Abinbev, Reliance, Jindal Steel Limited, and P&G. Roles offered are graduate engineer trainee, SDE, management trainee, and process engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Almost everything is right in its place. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel rooms with routers in each room. Labs are there in every department, and classrooms will be happening in Orion. The library is present with well-structured and department-wise sections. Every day, the hostel is cleaned by workers and is maintained very hygienically. For food, we have Annapurna mess, Mega mess, and Sabari mess. The quality of food varies from mess to mess, and overall quality is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are professional and highly skilled. I would rate them 4.8 out of 5. The course curriculum is perfectly relevant to the domain. I would say they are on a medium level. The pass percentage is around 35 percent out of 100 percent. Overall, the course structure offers freedom to delve into extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a very good college for this course.

detailed_review.Placements: The students start sitting for placement from the 6th semester, i.e., the end of the third year itself, while many students start getting job offers at the start of the 7th semester itself. The placement percentage here is very good, it is around 90% and the average placement for the 2025 placement session is around 15.76 LPA or maybe higher, since results are not made available to us yet. The highest offer is around 55 lakh+, according to some fourth-year students. The number of companies visiting us is many. They include tech giants such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Sony, Samsung, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities provided in the room include a table, chair, almirah and a bed. The mess food is okay, not so good, but one will get used to it. If we talk about the books and journals available in the library, they are easily accessible to all the students and professors. The classrooms have high-quality projectors and speakers, and teachers use a microphone to deliver their lectures. There are a lot of sports available on campus, and everyone can play any sport they want to play.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members of this college are like those of all the colleges, some of them are very good, but some of them are here just to read the PPT and time pass. About the exams, there are 3 exams conducted in the entire semester, the first one is this CT1, then CT2, and then end sem exams. CT1 and CT2 are easy, which anyone can score well just by studying 1 or 2 days before the exam, but for end sem exams, one needs to start studying almost 10-15 days earlier because they consist of the entire syllabus.

reviews.review_title: If you want, then you can join, but you have to score well on the GATE entrance.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage here is very good, it is around 90%, and the average placement for the 2025 placement session is around 15.76 LPA or maybe higher. Since results are not made available to us yet, the highest offer is around 55 lakh+, according to some fourth-year students. The number of companies visiting us is many. They include tech giants such as Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Sony, Samsung, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, AMD, Yahoo and highlighting companies are Ceat, Volvo, Volkswagen, LT, Bosch, McAfee, and the list goes on and on and on.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are decent, I think. In the first year, there are 3 people in a single room, while the room can hold three people, the cupboards provided are for only two people. Wi-Fi all over the campus with cctv security. Labs are good. The library is good, it has all types of books. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are many grounds for different sports. There is also a swimming pool.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. They are highly educated and experienced. All courses are two or three credits. Exams are getting very strict. Marking is average. The paper is too tough. Lab exams are good. If someone cheats in the exam, the faculty will give an F in the exam. Some questions are in the exam outside the syllabus. It's like a GATE entrance exam.

reviews.review_title: Good college, good location, good IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are good every year. But this year it was somewhat close to disaster. Most of the companies came, and the intake is less this year. The highest package offered is by Qualcomm, 2,500,000/annum. Internship opportunities are great. I haven't applied for any internship because the college itself has better technology labs, and M.Tech students can use them with the permission of the guide, and a PhD student should accompany you.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are good, like every other college. Cleanliness is a factor that the hostels possess. Sports and extracurricular activities are good in college. But unlike many IITs, they won't offer coaches to the respective college teams. There is Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and all types of books are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course was amazing. There are good and bad faculty members. The best in the electrical department was Dr Saravano Ilango Ganesan, who is really knowledgeable and is a great helping hand. Term exams were easy. An average person can easily pass it. There are two semesters in a year, and each semester has two sessionals which are conducted by the college.

reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students are placed in my course in my college. The highest package is 80 LPA offered in my course, the average package is 30 LPA offered in my course, and the lowest package is 10 LPA offered in my course. 90% of students got internships from my course in my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good in teaching. They approach students in a friendly manner. They are very knowledgeable, and teaching is good. In the semester, we have two mid exams and a final exam. The pass percentage of exams is 40%, we need to get 40% marks in the final exam only to pass the entire semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I like my institute so much for the best environment.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are so good, it is around 90% and the institute also helps in an internship programme during the third year of your college period. The top technical recruiters are Infosys and Tata. They also provide internships to non-circuital branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The buildings of my institute, that is NIT Trichy, are so good and well structured, and the most important thing is that the greenery here is so good. The hostel is well-furnished and also provides Wi-Fi facilities, and the mess food is not that bad to eat.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers here are good and helpful, educated, and also friendly. The semester exams are not that tough, almost everyone who attended the class can pass, and the institute's curriculum is strict but helpful for students to learn things about real college life.
detailed_review.Other: I like programming.

reviews.review_title: Good environment and peaceful campus.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% of students have placed in by the placement cell. 24 LPA is the highest and 2.5 LPA is the lowest salary offered. Top companies are recruiting. 100% students got internship from the course. There are good placement available.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
It's a good environment to stay in, and it's full of facilities available. 
The library is filled with all types of journals, and e-books are also available in the library. 
Classrooms are neat, and good seating facilities are available on the campus. 
There are all types of sports and training available.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The teachers are helpful in giving quality teaching, and they help students grow. Their knowledge is awesome, their explanation are good and neat. 
The course is curriculum-related, and it makes students industry-ready. 
Some difficulties are the semester exams.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely wonderful campus life and alumni association, which will help you in a lot of ways.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 75-80% of the students of the passing-out batch from my course got placed, the highest package is 33 LPA, while the averageis 10.3 LPA and the lowest is 6 LPA, almost everyone in the batch got good internships. The top roles are offered in software.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty old but well-maintained. There is Wi-Fi facility in the hostel 24/7. The classrooms are well maintained. There is also a library with 1L+ books. Hostels are old too but well maintained. The mess food is decent. You will be able to see canteens and other shops near your hostel itself.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are friendly, while some may seem a little strict. But every faculty member is well qualified. The curriculum is pretty much the same as all first years. There will be two cycle tests and one end-semester examination when we talk about exams and tests.
detailed_review.Other: The campus life here is great. There are a lot of clubs and fests which will help in your overall development and shape you as a better person. Name any common sport, and that will be here with proper courts and equipment.

reviews.review_title: A student in the 1st year joined 1 month ago.

detailed_review.Placements: I don't have much information about placements, but I see some students in NCC, and a much larger number of seniors are getting placed. Seniors are getting almost 12 LPA-13 LPA of average package. 80% of students got placed, and for the rest, I see many students interested in sports and NCC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is excellent. Each room has a new and separate Wi-Fi, I mean personal Wi-Fi for each room, with a speed of 300- 400 Mbps. Labs are good, a huge building dedicated to labs only. The classroom doesn't have AC, but it has enough lighting and fans. Food is usual. Sports are encouraged. Teams are selected in induction.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are too cooperative. I saw a PDF of the NIRF ranking, and almost every professor is a Ph.D. scholar. I think the course curriculum is industry-relevant. Currently, they are showing different types of civil construction that have been made and why it is important.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about this course is that you are always relevant and needed. No matter how developed we become, a civil engineer is still needed.

reviews.review_title: A geniune feedback on NIRF 9.

detailed_review.Placements: The mechanical engineering department is one of the oldest and most recognized departments not only in NITT but also in the country. It offers decent placement figures, such as the highest package is 35 LPA, the average package is 12.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 5 LPA. Placement percentage is 93%. Most of the students get recruited in companies such as Caterpillar, L&T, DRDO, NTPC, BHEL, Texas Instruments, Oracle, Samsung, Google, TATA, Mahindra, etc. The roles that they get are Design, Management, Consultancy, and mostly Core Engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are decent but not up to the mark if we consider the feels. It has all the necessary facilities like Wi-Fi, TV, Water Coolers, Geysers, Washing Machines etc. There are 5 messes to choose from second year onwards and food in each mess depends upon caterer. Most of the food served is good just the thing lagging is the cleanliness of the mess and punctuality.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors here are masters of their field and have a vast knowledge of the work they do. Many are very helpful and supportive, so you can approach them anytime during working hours. The course curriculum followed is now as per NEP 2020, which started from the 2024 batch, and it contains a lot of flexibility for students to choose the subjects they like. The exams are a bit tough, but are manageable with 3 days of study before the exam.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course due to my passion for automobile engineering and wanted to explore my career in this field. NITT provides an excellent opportunity to develop the required knowledge in every field due to its diverse club culture. There is a club for everything, whether it's robotics or ATV building. The crowd here is very competitive, and everyone actively participates in campus activities, guest, and Sports. You can get many scholarship opportunities here at NITT.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The things at last, I want to say that my institute is worth coming here.

detailed_review.Placements: As I am in the CSE department of my institute, the placements are nearly complete. The highest package is of around one crore and twenty Lacs, the average package is around twenty-four Lacs, and the lowest package is around six Lacs. If you want funds, they will also be provided.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If I start telling about the facilities provided to us, this would go nicely as they provide personal cleanliness in the bathroom, and also provide a clean restroom. They also provide wi-fi facilities too and if you'd like to know about the mess food, it would go better as the years passed.
detailed_review.Faculty: The knowledge of teachers is too good. Some teachers have a Tamil accent in their English, so as a North Indian, I found it a little bit confusing, but I got used to it after some time. The level of the test paper is so good that if you attend class, you can score good.
detailed_review.Other: I would also like to share some things about the club and association. You have to be so active if you want to join any club or sports team and study well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: The above review covers all aspects of NIT Trichy, how it is good, and the points where it lacks.

detailed_review.Placements: At NIT Trichy, the placement rate is very good. Almost everyone who appears for placements gets placed, with a placement percentage of around 85–90%. Last year, the highest package offered was approximately 65 LPA, while the lowest was 4.5 LPA. Companies that visit the college include Microsoft, Google, Qualcomm, Nvidia, and many more. For the MME branch, top recruiting company is Tata Steel. In the third year, many students secure internships, with almost 70%–80% obtaining internships in the companies mentioned above.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course, MME, are adequate but could be improved. For example, in some areas, we need more machines or additional lab technicians to conduct our labs, but these are not available, so we have to wait for our turn. Otherwise, it would have been much better. As for the hostel, it currently has all the basic facilities such as electricity, clean water, and high-speed Wi-Fi in every room. The quality of food in the mess is satisfactory.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here at NIT Trichy are like teachers of any other college like they come read PPT and go but some of them are good. They come to teach with all the feel and answer all the doubts of the students. The curriculum is not really relevant as it is all old and outdated, it does not really make students industry-ready. We have to study for internships and placements by ourselves only. The semester exams are medium difficult, if we start studying a week before exam then it's okay to score good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I am really not interested in the MME course I took, I chose this course just because of the college and its placement statistics. The best thing about this course is really the peer group I am interacting with. Most of them are ambitious about their goals in life and want to achieve something from this college, which motivates me to work hard too. The syllabus of this course could have been better, more practical, and industry-oriented, then it would have been more beneficial for those who want to work in the core sector. Pragyan, Festember, Sportsfete, and Nittfest are some of the fests.

reviews.review_title: BEST #9 NIRF ranking among all NITs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering

Labs, library, and sports facilities are available in college. Medical facilities are also available and are very good because the doctors have MBBS degrees.

There are many types of curriculum, and the teaching quality is good, i don’t know much about the problems that come during semester exam preparation because I am a first-year student, my classes are held 2 or 3 days a week. My hostel life is good, and the library is very useful for studying.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because in my college, placement and teaching quality are good. In the future, I think I will improve my new skills and communication skills. All types of activities are conducted, such as fests, campus crowd events, and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: Academics are really good. Placement-wise, it's also good.

Some of them get an internship in FAANG companies. Placement percentage is about 90% with the highest in core branches. In starting, you will feel a big language barrier.

detailed_review.Faculty: Almost all faculty members have done Ph.D. from IITs and foreign reputed universities. But a great language barrier in starting, although they speak in English. But their accent is much similar to Tamil. On campus, no problem at all but outside college, everyone speaks Tamil, not even English, and forget about Hindi.

reviews.review_title: A good start to my career.

detailed_review.Placements: Basically, they had a principle, like passing out, students are invited to college, to help them in preparing for the placement grounds, along with the MNC trainers. HCL Technologies Ltd, LTI Mindtree Ltd, and Persistent Systems are usual recruiters of ours, with some more companies added on every year.

admission.title: NIT Trichy Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: The course admission of National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli (NIT Trichy) is largely entrance-based. NIT Trichy admission is also provided to undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral courses on fields such as Technology, Architecture, Management, and Science as well as Arts among others. The institute has some of the popular courses, which include BTech, MTech, MSc, MBA, MA, MS (by Research) and PhD. NIT Trichy admission to different courses is done through national level entrance exams, including JEE Main, CAT, GATE, etc. The following article can be read by interested students who might want to know everything about the requirements and process of NIT Trichy.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to BTech at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Trichy does not provide direct admission for BTech. NIT Trichy BTech admission is entrance-based. The institute accepts admission to the BTech course through a valid score of JEE Main. Every aspirant needs to qualify for the exam in order to get admission. Selected candidates further need to take part in JoSAA counselling as well. There is no other procedure for admission.

faqs.question: How many marks required in JEE Main for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: If you belong to the General AI quota, the maximum required JEE Main cutoff rank was 24515 in 2025. faqs.question: Can I get admission to MBA at NIT Trichy? I have not given the CAT exam.
faqs.answer: At the postgraduate level, NIT Trichy offers two-year MBA courses to students. Without CAT , candidates can't get admission to MBA at NIT Trichy. A relevant score in CAT is necessary to get admission at NIT Trichy for MBA. The selection criteria also include personal interview rounds and relevant work experience. The total fee for MBA at NIT Trichy is INR 1.4 lakh. So prepare well in advance for a successful admission to MBA course at NIT Trichy.

faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: NIT Trichy does not conduct any in-house entrance test. It grant admission to the courses on the basis of merit in national-level examinations. The accepted entrance examinations are JEE Main,  GATE,  IIT JAM,  CAT, and NIMCET. Only the candidates with a valid score in the accepted exams as per the applied course are admitted.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MSc at NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: Candidates willing for admission to MSc at NIT Trichy must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the course in the first place. Students who want to get admission to MSc at NIT Trichy must graduate with a minimum 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (for SC/ ST/PwD, a minimum 55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA is required) in the respective subjects. faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Trichy for BTech?

Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks further becomes eligible for participation in the JoSAA counselling round. faqs.question: Is JEE Main required for NIT Trichy?
faqs.answer: Admissions to NIT (National Institute of Technology), Trichy is Entrance Based for almost all of the courses. The college accepts different exam scores for different levels of courses. sections.heading: Introduction
text: NIT Trichy provides undergraduate and postgraduate students with all the needed facilities. National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli is well-equipped with a modern library, classrooms, hostels, and computer labs, among others. Some of the other campus facilities include:
Check out more on NIT Trichy Infrastructure in the below videos:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
The Institute has a modern Central Library with more than two and half lakhs of documents consisting of Technical books, reports, standards, CD-ROMS, audio visual educational cassettes and volumes of journals.

Library has subscription to 164 periodicals (print) plus 7000+ e-Journals and 7000+ e-books besides a holding of 17690 back volumes of journals and also having 1,26,982 numbers of books. The library also contains 16,750 books in the Book Bank scheme

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: There are 18 boys' and 5 girls' hostels. Together they accommodate 5320 undergraduate and postgraduate students.Each hostel was provided with a television, two DOT telephones, intercom(s), aquaguard, water cooler and kit for indoor games and outdoor games. The Hostel office consisting of Hostel Manager, one Senior Superintendent and supporting staff looks after the day-to-day operations.

facilities.name: Gym
facilities.description:
Fitness Center has a wooden flooring house having exercise machines such as multi-station gym, tread mill, stairs, air walker, rowing machine, Exercycle, etc.
Gym has separate timings for men and women.

data.description: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli has an experienced faculty. National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli faculty are diploma, PhD, and degree holders. Trichy NIT faculty have worked as professors, lecturers, and teachers. NIT Trichy also arranges guest lectures and student and faculty exchange programmes.

reviews.review_title: Very good college ancient college in India.

detailed_review.Placements: In the placement of the current batch, there are 87 companies that offered internships to students. Major companies like Microsoft, Apple, Nvidia, Goldman Sachs, Rubric, VISA, ThoughtSpot, Axxela, American Express etc. The highest package of our college is 2.20 Crore at present year and the average package of the college is 22 LPA. There are 1128 students placed in the present year. The percentage of students getting placements is about 80 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a wide range of books available in our college. The variety of books is very nice. There we get books of spirituality, competitive exams, novels, biographies, self development and many more. The classrooms of our college are decent. The facilities is vey nice. The sports facilities in our college are excellent. There are 23 sports that are introduced in our college. In our college there are multiple clubs for the interests of every individual in our college. Our hostel is the newly built in our college. In our hostel there are 10 floors.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty to student ratio is 1/22. The faculty to student relationship is good. We approach faculty by doing mail on their mail inbox to ask any doubt or we can ask doubts after the class. All the faculty members are good. I like all of them. All faculty members are best in their respective subjects. There are two exams in our college, one is mid semester and another is end semester exam in one semester. The difficulty of exams is hard. Almost all students pass the exam but a few of them fail in exams.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Thermal and Fluid Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Bhu is a vibe, go enjoy it.

reviews.review_title: Our college is nice we love it.

Our top recruiting companies are all worldwide famous cooperative companies. 440 internship in the winter placement season and 240 ppo. The top role offered is os sde. reviews.review_title: College is the support for all the sports and infrastructure, and the food is good.

Core civil engineering roles are project engineer, structural engineer, geotechnical engineer, transportation engineer, and planning and scheduling engineer.

Wi-Fi in the classroom is somewhat limited, but in the library it's excellent. Some subjects are difficult, like fluids and Fourier Maths, while others are easy, like Chemistry subjects. The course makes students industry-ready, as working with a professor on a project is a compulsory course that is given to us.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about this course is the opportunity that I will get in this branch. Events and fests are held at the national level, and competition from different IITs and NITs comes to our college to compete. Here, they celebrate even festivals like Sarawati Pooja and Janmastami with full joy.

reviews.review_title: Overview for freshers in 2026.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80 to 90 percent of students are placed in the recent placement season. The lowest package is around 8 to 10 LPA, and the highest package offered is 1cr+. The offers include Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, and Texas Instruments. Some of the top roles offered are SDE and QUANT roles.

Wi-Fi is great all over the campus from the start, hostel rooms and bathrooms are good as well for a government college. There is a variety of food in the mess at a time and the menu is not repeated all week.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are all well qualified in their teaching fields, both theoretically and practically, but the variety of teaching quality is not grand. Exams are scheduled on time, and the curriculum is atleast turned to modern needs if not industry ready. The difficulty of the exam is always on the higher side, but its bearable.

reviews.review_title: It is a good college if you are going for placement.

Many companies are open to it, and SDE is the top role offered in my course. I think the placement is good at my college. If you work hard, you will get placed in a decent company.

The food provided in the mess is good. Sports and games facilities are also good. The infrastructure is kind of old, and we do not have AC in the lecture theatre (now being installed).
detailed_review.Faculty: They are more qualified than I, so I can't judge them. Chemical is chill compared to other branches. Semester exams are good, but sometimes the schedule is hectic. Academic is chill compared to other IITs. The grading system is decent, but try to maintain above 8.5 CPI.

reviews.review_title: My college is good, the best for placements and much more. You will have quality time for a duration

detailed_review.Placements: 90 percent of students are placed. The average Package offered is 30 LPA, the lowest package offered is 12 LPA and the highest package offered is 90LPA. Top recruiting companies are ZS, Oracle, Microsoft, and Google. 55 percent in Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Natwest De Shaw, Atlassian, Nvidia, QuantBox, Mastercard, Visa, Palo Alto Networks, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is okay, not that good. There is no such AC and no more big building new hostels are being built but those are for seniors because for 1 st year there are good hostels. Sports facilities are not good in hostels. You have to go to college facilities for that, and the medical facilities are good.

Old professors are good, they teach well, but new professors are somewhere selfish and egoistic, they do not give grades. detailed_review.Other: My course has rigorous mathematical problems which I enjoy, and the best thing is electrical better grading. Fests are good.

reviews.review_title: Best engineering college in Uttar Pradesh.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered is approximately 90 LPA. The average package is approximately 34 LPA. Most of them get placed in core companies, and some of them choose tech companies. The top recruiters are Samsung and Qualcomm. Nivea takes fewer students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my department is good. The past is the nearest department. Hostels have CCTV cameras, a water cooler, vending machines, and a canteen. The quality of the food is good. We have a study room in the hostel. There is a common room on each floor in which we play table tennis.

The first year curriculum is a slight mixture of all subjects and makes students industry ready in other ways. Semester exams are not difficult. The batch size is approximately 150, of which 15 are branch changes.

reviews.review_title: IIT BHU offers a college life, placements, and a curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 65% of students get placed in the 2025–26 session. The highest package is bagged by a student from Electrical Engineering at NK Securities, 1.67 crores PA (off-campus). Top recruiting companies for the Electrical core are Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, and many others. Top software/quant companies open to Electrical students are NK Securities, Squarepoint Capital, Google, Microsoft, and many more. Almost all of them also offer internships. Around 50% of students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd-year boys are very good and well-maintained as they are newly built. The hostels for other years have older infrastructure. Wi-Fi is good everywhere. Labs are in good condition. The library and reading rooms of IIT BHU are good. The mess food quality is quite good compared to other IITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers do not teach very well, but several are very good at explaining the courses. The curriculum at IIT BHU is relatively easier compared to other IITs. The courses do not make students fully industry-ready. The pass percentage depends on the professor and the course because most courses use relative grading.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about this course is that it is not very complex and is easy for students to catch up. To improve Electrical Engineering, the college could include more practical knowledge in the course. Fests are organized with great enthusiasm and are very enjoyable. The campus is lush, green, and beautiful despite some old infrastructure. Various state governments and private scholarships are available. The college also supports extracurricular activities and spends on clubs, outfests, and Inter IIT events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Pharmaceutics Engineering and Technology
reviews.review_title: Lifetime experience in IIT BHU.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are a core strength of IIT BHU, with students becoming eligible from the 7th semester. The placement rate is excellent, consistently above 87%. Top-tier companies from all sectors (IT, Core, Finance, Consulting) like Google, Microsoft and Goldman Sachs recruit heavily. The average package is very high, often exceeding 20 LPA, with top offers going much higher while others pursue higher studios or startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library has vast resources, and classrooms are a mix of modern smart rooms and older halls. Hostels are mandatory for B.Tech students & very affordable. Rooms are mostly double/triple sharing for juniors with basic facilities, a bed, table, chair and cupboard. The mess food is average with a varied menu of North/South Indian dishes.
detailed_review.Faculty: B.Tech curriculum is highly comprehensive and theoretically strong. Exams, mainly mid-semester and end-of-semester, are frequent and conceptually difficult. It requires a deep understanding of the subject. At IIT BHU, the faculty-to-student ratio is 1:15. Professors are highly qualified experts, though their teaching style and approachability vary. The best faculty are those who serve as excellent mentors and make complex subjects engaging.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is vibrant, defined by student-run clubs. Major festivals include Technex (Tech, March) & Kashiyatra (Cultural, Jan). An extensive range of sports and extracurricular clubs (teach, art, social) from the heart of the community. Registration is simple, done along with admission. A primary reason students choose it is for a solid foundation in core engineering. It enhances the Master's degree. However, it could be improved by interacting more hands-on with projects and modern, industry-aligned case studies.

reviews.review_title: Review of Indian Institute of Technology, BHU, Varanasi.

The library is an absolute part of our college, and it has all types of book collections needed for a student. The hostel rooms are too cozy and small. The food is not that good in taste, but the quality is good enough.

Courses are very helpful and make us ready in all ways for our jobs and internships. The difficulty level of semester exams is very high. The pass percentage is around 80 percent.

reviews.review_title: The best college for placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60-70 percent of students are placed in this course. Almost everyone chooses non-core jobs over core jobs due to the very low placement package in core jobs. The highest package is 51 LPA, and the average is around 18 LPA. The companies Indian Oil Corporation, BASF, ONGC, etc.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the good faculty members and placements.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering

reviews.review_title: It is the best college with good campus life and placements.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: One of the best engineering colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage based on 2025 data is around 64%. It is a decent percentage, as many of the students opt for further studies and other streams, other than campus placements. SDE is the top role and is more beneficial for CSE and MNC students. Other branch students can have core placements too, as per their interests.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We do not have restricted internet. LAN points are present in every hostel room. The campus's main buildings have centralized Wi-Fi known as IITG-Connect, and we can log in through our ID and ERP password. Internet speed is mediocre. Each hostel has an AC library and gym of its own. There is a big central library and a gym for the whole campus. Classroom infrastructure is way beyond what we will see in other Tier 2 colleges. There are canteens in every hostel. There are 10 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful, very qualified in their specialties, and knowledgeable in every aspect. There is a slight language barrier between teachers, professors, and faculty members due to different accents. The course curriculum is very relevant, and all data is shared at the start of the tenure.

admission.title: IIT BHU Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: IIT BHU Varanasi Admission 2025 is currently ongoing and is primarily entrance-based. The candidates are selected through national-level tests conducted by various authorities. Popular as IIT Varanasi (BHU), the Indian Institute of Technology Varanasi offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses in Engineering, Science, and Humanities. It runs under the Banaras Hindu University . It offers degree programmes like BTech, BTech-MTech (Dual Degree), BArch, BPharma, MTech, MPharma, MSc, and PhD. IIT Varanasi application form 2025 for all these courses can be filed by visiting the official website of the respective national/ state-level exams. However, PG applicants also need to register on the official admission portal of IIT Varanasi (BHU). Admission to all the courses is based on the scores obtained by the candidates in the respective entrance exams. IIT Varanasi (BHU) has developed an online international summer school on industrial CFD and FEM, a one-month job-oriented training programme .

faqs.question: How can I prepare for admission to IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: The preparation for JEE Main begins two years in advance. It is a national-level exam, which can be passed with a good base of concepts and preparation. A good preparation strategy is what helps a student clear JEE Main 2025 exam. Some of the pointers to include in the action plan are mentioned below:

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: How can I get admission to the IIT BHU BTech course?
faqs.answer: IIT BHU admission process is conducted through online registrations. Students visit the official website and fill the application form. The IIT BHU application process mentioned below to apply for the BTech course: Visit the website and register for the accepted entrance exam such as JEE Main. Appear for the JEE Main exam. Register for the counselling. Take part in the seat allotment round. Report at the college.

faqs.question: What is the last date to fill the choices in JoSAA counselling?
faqs.answer: The dates for JoSAA counselling 2026 choice filling will be announced once the result of JEE Main 2026 is declared. Candidates can fill choices only during the choice filling period. Also, candidates need to lock their choices before the last date.

faqs.question: I have 3000 rank under OBC quota in JEE Advanced. Will I get selection at IIT Varanasi?
faqs.answer: IIT Varanasi has released the category-wise cutoffs for various BTech specialisations. For BTech admissions, JEE Advanced is conducted widely by IITs. A JEE Advanced rank of 3000 under OBC category can be considered as the decent rank, however, this rank is insufficient to secure BTech in CSE programme in 2024. Other than CSE, the top courses for which candidates have the option to get a seat at IIT BHU are Chemical Engineering , Mechanical Engineering , Metallurgical Engineering , Mining Engineering and Ceramic Engineering.

faqs.answer: IIT BHU accepts JEE Advanced score, followed by JoSAA Counselling for admission to the BTech courses. faqs.question: Is it easy to get admission in IIT BHU Varanasi?
faqs.answer: IIT BHU admissions are done solely on the basis of entrance tests as prescribed by the state/national norms. Students must appear for the entrance tests like JEE Main or JEE advanced for Engineering admissions. Candidates must note that admissions into the BTech CSE Branch are particularly competitive in India, with IIT BHU as no exception. Other courses worth exploring can be MPharma, BArch, ME , among others. Other entrance tests accepted at IIT BHU include GPAT , GATE , ICAR AIEEA , IIT JAM , CUET PG , and others.

faqs.question: Can I join IIT BHU directly?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking IIT BHU admissions must note that admissions are conducted strictly on the basis of entrance tests . The students can visit the official website and check the course relevant conditions like fees, eligibility, etc. Students must appear for the prominent Engineering entrance tests like the JEE Mains and JEE Advanced exams. Candidates looking for admissions to other courses must check for other relevant entrance tests.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for IIT BHU MTech?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have BE/BTech/MSc or equivalent with (a) CGPA 6.00 on a 10-point scale or 60% marks in aggregate for General/OBC (Non Creamy Layer)/EWS. Category with valid GATE score BTech from IITs with CGPA of 8.00 without GATE are also eligible for admission. AMIE / Grad. IETE are eligible for the M.Tech programme at IIT BHU.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted by IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: IIT BHU Varanasi provides a large number of courses in a variety of courses. These courses are offered mainly in the Engineering field, as well as a few others. For Engineering admissions, the students must appear for the JEE Mains and JEE Advanced exams. For admissions into other courses, students can visit the official website and check the relevant details. For instance, other entrance tests accepted at IIT BHU include names like GPAT , GATE , ICAR AIEEA , IIT JAM , CUET PG , etc.

faqs.question: What are the essential qualifications for admission to BTech course at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: IIT Varanasi BTech admission is based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced. Students qualify Class 12 from the recognised board with 75% marks for general category and 65% marks for SC/ ST. PwD candidates.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for BTech admission at IIT (BHU)?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission into BTech programme of IIT (BHU), a candidate should have passed Class12 with a minimum of 75 percent in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. They have to as well pass the JEE Main and JEE Advanced exams. Selection and JoSAA counselling is done by JEE Advanced rank. Counselling is only an option to those who meet all the criteria.

faqs.question: Does IIT BHU offer BTech integrated courses?
faqs.answer: IIT BHU does provide combined programmes of BTech and M.Tech in many specialisation. These programmes enable the students to pursue both their undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in a combined format. The admission requirements to such integrated courses frequently have a minimum of 75% board examination marks (or equivalent) in Class 12 (or equivalent) besides other conditions.

faqs.question: What rank is required for SC category to get core BTech branches at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: For the SC category students under the AI quota, the JEE Advanced cutoff ranks varied between 283 and 2261 for core branches, including CSE, Civil, Chemical, etc. For the core branches, mostly the cutoffs are on the higher side for admission. Candidates seeking admission to core branches must target securing a cutoff rank of up to 2000 to improve their chances of admission at IIT BHU. Refer to the table below to view the last round closing ranks of IIT Varanasi core branches for 2025.

faqs.question: Can I do MTech at IIT BHU without GATE?
faqs.answer: As part of the admission procedure, the prospective candidates must also take a Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE). However, BTech qualified in IITs with an overall CGPA of 8.00 or above in 10 point scale are exempted with regard to the GATE and are directly eligible to the process. It is also worth mentioning that the minimum eligibility requirements are as well mandatory to the candidates who would like to join IIT BHU MTech programme in 2025.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to the M.Tech programme at IIT BHU?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for the M.Tech programme at IIT BHU the aspiring candidates need to have a minimum of 60% in BTech. Aspirants with a score equal to or more than the cutoff also have to go through a counselling round. Once selected, aspirants have to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

sections.heading: IIT BHU Hostel
text: IIT BHU has 16 hostels, out of which some are dedicated to honouring illustrious Indian mathematicians and scientists. It is situated in the Principal Colony of the IIT(BHU) Campus and can house 51 students in twenty rooms. At IIT Varanasi, the newest boys' dormitory, Dhaulagiri-2, was opened in May 2022. The dormitory has a total of 402 rooms spanning across seven floors and equipped with six elevators, which can accommodate over 1200 people. One of the largest hostels at BHU, the residence boasts two large mess halls that can accommodate all the students. The hostel rooms are equipped with a mess room, basketball court, and a playground. Dhaulagiri-2 Hostel is the most recent addition to the male hostels, inaugurated in May 2022 at IIT (BHU) Varanasi.

sections.heading: IIT BHU Library
text: IIT BHU library consists of the Shreenivas Deshpande Library and five departmental libraries, which assist in teaching, research, and extension programs of the institute. The students and the faculty members are allowed to use the library upon taking the membership. The library of IIT BHU offers various facilities to the users, like a collaboration learning space, a Document delivery service, a Remote Access facility, an e-library, a Modern reading room, etc., and programs/workshops for the faculty and research scholars. IIT BHU library has more than 139,871 volumes of books, journals, theses, reports, standards, and pamphlets. The library is home to an excellent print collection. The library's operating hours are from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM, including weekends, and it extends its opening hours into late night during mid-semester and semester exams.
