reviews.review_title: It provides freedom to explore personal interests.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements of BITS Hyderabad are very good at around 91% and throughout the years, it has also seen a constant rise. Overall Average CTC for BITS Hyderabad is around 20LPA. Top recruiters include Atlassian, Dell, Google, Microsoft, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels at BITS are clean and spacious. Each hostel also includes common rooms with indoor games like air hockey and table tennis, and outside courts for badminton and volleyball. Mess food is a well-balanced meal and made in hygienic places. The medical centre is open 24/7, and also ambulances come to the hostel gate in case of emergency. Courts and other playing facilities are well-maintained for every sport.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. Students can visit their chambers at given hours for one-to-one doubt clearing as well as in either lectures or tutorial sessions. Semester exams can be a bit stressful because of the good competition, but students also help each other alongside the faculty.
detailed_review.Other: To counter the stress due to exams, we have many fests in college. ATMOS and Pearl are the main fests that happen every year.

reviews.review_title: Worth the high fees due to ROI, but after entering, hard work is expected to excel.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage placement is high, due to the brand name as well as quality of students. More than 80% of batch was planned with highly reputed companies with high packages in fields of tech, finance, and core came to hire, eg, Google, BlackRock, Nvidia, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Entire campus is Wi-Fi covered, and classrooms are well maintained with blocks assigned to departments like mechanical, CS, and electrical. Library is also pretty big, with a capacity of 600+, and it has a great interior, and provides a peaceful vibe for studying. Quality of hostel and mess is also good, food taste is decent with a different menu.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers, especially in my department, are very helpful, supportive, interactive, and open to doubts all the time. All are Ph.D. holders from reputable institutions and have great knowledge of the subject. Curriculum is also up to the mark, exams are an integral part of evaluation, combined with continuous evaluation. Pass percentage is high.

reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure, environment, facilities, and placement prospects.

detailed_review.Placements: The better part is that over 80% of students find placements. The lowest salary would be around 8 LPA, while the highest could exceed 40 LPA, with the average being 12 LPA. Top recruiters include Mercedes, L&T, and BHEL from the mechanical stream, and students can also choose to pursue non-teaching roles, which many do. As mentioned above, the top roles include analyst, management, and R&D.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Ethernet connectivity is available in hostel rooms and the library (1 Gbps speed), with Wi-Fi throughout the hostel and academic block, and in the library (100 Mbps). The food can be considered fair, with the menu undergoing slight changes every two months. For the mechanical department, we have dedicated labs, workshops, and sandbox areas.
detailed_review.Faculty: The pass percentage should be well over 90%. Exams can be considered difficult and hectic, especially the midterms. Teachers are very knowledgeable, and I believe what we are taught is largely relevant to the industry. The course doesn't feel outdated, and students have benefited from industry training through internship programs, preparing them to be industry-ready, in my opinion.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of BITS Pilani K K Birla, Goa Campus.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 80% of students got placed. A lot of companies recruit students, including Microsoft, Google, Rubric, Dell, Deloitte, Oracle, Adobe, Nestle, etc. Top roles include software developer, analyst, app developer, product management, etc. The median package is 17 LPA. Core branches like electrical have an average salary of 18 LPA - 20 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facility is very good. The academic block is beautiful, consisting of 4 lecture theatres and a lot of classrooms. Some labs are also present. A big canteen includes a kitchen and a Nescafe shop. There is also a big auditorium in the basement. There is a football and cricket ground with floodlights. Other sports facilities are also available. Hostels of the new block are very good with fully furnished rooms and 2 common washrooms on each floor. The campus is beautiful and green.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified. They have doctorates and master's degrees in several fields. The exams are conducted every month (quizzes, mid-semester, and final exams). Labs are conducted weekly and have evaluative components also. Semester exams are very tough and the average is very low. The pass percentage varies but is usually 25% of the total marks of the subject.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are huge with the budget varying from 1 crore - 1.5 crore. Weaves is the largest fest with various artists coming from across the world.

reviews.review_title: The overall experience with college is really good and I will definitely recommend it to others.

detailed_review.Placements: I am still pursuing my degree which is WILP B.Sc. in computer and designing programs from BITS, and it has really a great experience till now. As for the package and everything the students get a very good and satisfactory package. Top recruitment companies in BUTS are Accenture, Cognizant, EY, HSBC, Yes Bank, and KPMG. The highest package offered to CS IT students at BITS is 60 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: BITS is a fully residential campus with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including well-equipped laboratories, modern classrooms, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, various sports grounds, and campus-wide internet connectivity. The labs and classrooms are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is really cooperative. They are highly qualified with a large majority holding PhD and are known for their strong industry experience. They have diverse teaching methodologies and focus on keeping the curriculum updated with current industry requirements.
detailed_review.Other: If you are looking for the best college around you then BITS is definitely a good choice.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Ups and downs of BITS through some unknown insights.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, according to the current data, almost 98.57% of students got placed even with the current recession era. The highest salary package offered is 84 LPA. The average salary package offered is 18.34 LPA, and the lowest salary package is not mentioned to us. Top recruiting companies like Google, Amazon, and Nvidia visit the college for placements. The internship is compulsory in our college, and our college itself provides us with it through a scheme called practice school.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi facility in our hostel is not good. The land cables work better than the Wi-Fi. Classrooms are neat and tidy. Hostels are clean, but there is a dumping ground near, which sometimes ends with a bad odour. The mess food is better than most of the colleges, and the canteen is affordable. Sports facilities are quite good and almost every sports facility is available. We all get medical insurance.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite helpful. They set up a Chembur consultation hour which helps us to get a one-on-one interaction with them. The course curriculum is based on Massachusetts University as it is one of the leading universities of the world. Questions are logically based instead of rote learning. Exams are quite difficult, which makes us more competitive.
detailed_review.Other: BITS is a recognised institute all over the country, just in comparison with the IIT. I chose this course because of the exposure I would get in this college. The best thing is the alumni network and the helpful seniors. I feel the fee is quite high, and if BITS can be made a little bit more affordable then it would be better. It regularly organises fests like technical fests and cultural fests which are quite large-scale and fun, Almost hundreds of other college members come to our campus in fests. We get a scholarship both on merit and merit-based.

reviews.review_title: Worth it to take admission here.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students are placed through the campus recruitment process. The top recruiting company from my course is many product-based companies. The highest package from my course is 1 CR. The lowest package is 7 LPA, and the average package is 15 LPA. Almost 60% of the students got internships from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of this college are awesome. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college campus, classrooms, library, and labs. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is top-notch. Medical facilities are also available 24/7, and sports and games are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers are helpful and knowledgeable; they also help those students who are not able to grasp the concepts they are taught in the classroom. Teaching quality is top-notch. The course designed by BITS Pilani is relevant and industry-ready. The semester exams are good if you understand the concepts clearly.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am keenly interested in software systems. The best thing about my course is we can learn along with the course. The only thing about my course that needs to be improved is the scheduled classes. Events, fests, and the campus are of the best quality, no doubt.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: One of the best engineering colleges in India.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements were amazing. The minimum package for my batch was 12 lakhs rupees, which was given to a student in the Chemical branch. The highest package this year was 40 lakhs rupees, which was given to a Computer Science student. Top companies were JP Morgan and Texas Instruments.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course and hostel are absolutely amazing, other than one big downside, which is the food. The food is horrendous, and you eat it just for the sake of staying alive. The paid canteens are good, but the mess is bad. All classrooms are air-conditioned, with Wi-Fi throughout the campus. The library has a wide range of books to cover every genre. Sports and games are widely encouraged, and there are multiple football grounds, as well as a gym and badminton/tennis courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is excellent. All of them are professors who have decades of experience and are really warm and welcoming toward new students. The exams are pretty difficult because BITS works on a relative grading score, i.e., your marks are compared with others', and then you are given a ranking rather than having a fixed-point system where if you get a certain number of marks, you will be given a certain grade. The pass percentage is very high, around 80-90%.

reviews.review_title: BITS Pilani - It's Magic.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good. The average CTC was around 17 LPA (including all branches). Companies like Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Intel, Nvidia, AMD, Samsung, Nutanix, etc., do recruit here. The practice school makes placements better and helps students become industry-ready.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have great infrastructure at BITS Goa. The Goa campus is really beautiful, full of greenery, and Goa itself is also a very beautiful state. The campus is very clean, with almost no littering on the roads. Spread over 180 acres, it’s smaller than Pilani and Hyderabad, but you still have to walk a lot. Generally, first-year students are given double-occupancy rooms. Each room is equipped with a separate bed, table, chair, fan, windows, almirah, and whiteboards. Each hostel has a common room, a place where you can relax in AC, watch TV, play table tennis, chess, carrom, or foosball. Recently, washing machines have also been installed in each hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here at the Goa campus are extremely qualified. Classes are full of demonstrations. There is no compulsion to attend classes, but it is recommended to attend them, especially if you are a dualite. CGPA matters in almost every aspect, whether it’s getting a dual, practice school, scholarship, etc. When it comes to the curriculum, first-year courses may not be that relevant, but in the end, they will surely help you in one way or another.
detailed_review.Other: The college is great, and people are great. And yes, BITS Pilani—it's magic.

reviews.review_title: Best academics as well as fest culture with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements:
This year the highest package for CSE was 62 LPA, with an average around 30 LPA.
Also, companies like Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Goldman Sachs recruit every year.
Mercedes recruits every year. 
But for core branches, the ROI (return on investment) is not that great.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
We have washing machines.
Clean bathrooms with hot water facilities 24x7, with proper purified drinking water. 
The mess provides very good quality food. The draw back being you have to follow same mess time table (weekly) for a month or two but overall experience being awesome.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Highly qualified teachers are there. 
Relatively tougher academics but the teachers do make efforts in the lectures to show all the demonstrations. Maybe the first-year courses offered are not so relevant but the further courses offered are relevant. 
Also having a good academic culture.
detailed_review.Other:
Engineering in bits pilani should be one of the best experience anyone can have as a student; it offers you. 
A very strong academic background, confidence, overall exposure and lots of fun festivals as well.

reviews.review_title: An Overview: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani, KK Birla Goa campus

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, about 92% of students were placed, even though there was a recession in the market. The average package for my course is around 25LPA. Top recruiting companies were Oracle, Google, Amazon,... Most of the students got internship opportunities from all ranges of companies, ranging from Google to TCS. It all depends on CGPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in my department are top-class .  The quality of food is mostly good, but then if you choose a mess, it is comparatively better than a d mess. So, as the college gives us the option to choose the one we want, we can choose the best mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were helpful and they are well qualified and knowledgeable; their teaching quality was pretty good. The first-year curriculum is a bit boring and seems irrelevant because they make you study most of the subjects starting from CS to Biology. I would prefer it being more specific for each course starting from the first year. Semester exams are pretty difficult.

reviews.review_title: Our college provides a vibrant life for students and very good career opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: In the 2023 batch, around 92% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 65 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 24 LPA. In CS, top recruiting companies are Amazon, Microsoft, Oracle, and Deloitte. Internships are purely based on the CGPA obtained and students receive the stipend after it. These internships are paid but we receive more stipends than we paid for in the first place so it is worth it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good. As it is a private college, they collect a good amount of fees to maintain hostels. Wi-Fi is provided to every student with a limit of 10 GB per day. LAN is provided in every room. Classrooms have air conditioners. They are good. The mess is good. The menu keeps changing frequently. Sports facilities are very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members are helpful. They solve doubts properly. They explain all concepts in detail and give tips on how to study and perform well in exams. They provide many life lessons to balance fun and academics. The course is very relevant and industry-compatible. The semester exams are easy to pass. Almost every student passes exams without much difficulty if they attend the classes.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd is very good as everyone is here because of merit. There is no management quota and reservations. The crowd is not diluted as all are deserving candidates. For economically weaker students, there are scholarships based on academic performance in our college. The campus is well-connected with an airport, railway stations, and the main city. We have many buses and autos. The cars for airports are easily accessible.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied by its performance in placements, good campus life, and personality development!

detailed_review.Placements: According to recent statistics, the placement scenario is quite impressive. Most of the students in the passing-out batch got a pre-placement offer during their Practice School 2. About % of students have been placed. The top recruiting companies for the ongoing year were Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Visa, Adobe, and Cisco. The highest package was around 60 Lacs while the lowest package was around 8 Lacs. The median package was about 30 Lacs. Our college offers internships in the 2nd and 3rd years which are called Practice School 1 and 2 respectively. Every student gets exposure to work and opportunities to do projects through these internships. Top roles offered in CSE were SDE, Software Engineer, Data Scientist, and full-stack developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are pretty good and well-maintained. BITS Wi-Fi also works efficiently. Classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The library is a very nice place to study at during summers as hostel rooms essentially do not have air-conditioning. Food in the mess is vegetarian with non-veg available on Sundays.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors at BITS are well qualified and knowledgeable, most of them known to be doing or have done research work in their field. Students can also consult with them or ask doubts at their chambers. The course curriculum is relevant and updated. These courses make students industry-ready. Semester exams are very competitive due to the relatively grading system.

reviews.review_title: A really good place to develop your personality as a whole.

detailed_review.Placements: My course is M.Sc. Chemistry and the course major students go into non-tech and consulting roles and a few go into research and Ph.D. in Chemistry. Placement packages range from 10 to 50 LPA and the average package is 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Jio, Deloitte, PWC, JP Morgan and KPMG. In SI, around 250 students from a batch of 1100 got internships. In my course, the top roles (if you proceed to go for core) offered are that of Chemical researcher, Synthesis and Lab specials.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are well furnished having fully functional AC, efficient lighting and seating places. Labs in the first year are somewhat renovated but the research labs are very advanced and innovative. Wi-Fi works good, just some productive services like Netflix and WhatsApp video calls are banned. The Library is very spacious and has separate places and tables for studying and books. It also has a relaxing space to sit and has facilities like coffee, tea and snacks from vending machines which can be consumed in the sitting area only, otherwise fine is imposed.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are very qualified and have a diverse teaching methodology. They teach the whole syllabus in a systematic manner and follow the course handouts given initially. Sometimes the classes can be a bit difficult to understand due to increased level of difficulty and then people start getting bored and skipping classes. The semester exams are on the tougher side always and you have to think deeply or memorize in order to solve them. It's not a piece of cake anymore.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Chemistry as I have an interest in the subject since JEE time and wanted to learn and explore it in this college. The best things here include faculty members having expertise and great research experience in their respective fields and we get to learn a lot through them. The things which could be improved are the quiz and assessment timings and adding practices to maintain attendance in the classes. This college is the best place if you want to have a huge exposure to an intellectual peer group, all possible extra curriculars ranging from singing to drama to dance to managing events are provided here. All of them are adequately active and contribute and collaborate together for the functioning of fests. The connectivity is very good in the campus, all the places are within a 10 minutes walk and surroundings have a plethora of greenery and trees.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
reviews.review_title: About moderate good placement season in 2023.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently, the placement scenarios are not revealed, but top companies like Microsoft, Sprinklr, JPMC, Nomura, etc., offer multiple roles such as SDE, consultant, and analyst. Banks like Deutsche Bank recruit financial analysts. While the lowest salary goes to 6 LPA, and the highest to 50 LPA, you can expect an average of 15 LPA. I secured an internship at MultiGraphics Group from my branch, and many students get such kind of internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, classroom labs, and library are of high standards, probably among the best compared to other institutions in our country. The quality of food is decent and manageable. Facilities such as sports and medical services are also very good and comfortable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are qualified and knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is really good. The coursework is really relevant according to the market standards, making the students industry-ready. However, the exams are very difficult, with a pass percentage of only 20% of the total course.
detailed_review.Other: All the events are absolutely good.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with placements and teachers, a really good building and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good with approximately 96 percent of the students getting placed. Google, Microsoft, and Amazon like big companies come to recruit in the placements drive. There is PS provided which is unpaid. After second year, PS is provided to all the students which is very beneficial.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is very big having a lot of greenery. Wi-Fi is available all the time. There is a library and classrooms as well. There are many facilities like sports, games and medical facilities. Overall, it is a great college. There is a canteen in the campus and the food is really yummy.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very good, helpful and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is great, it makes the students industry ready. There are certain subjects which are difficult, you need to study them well to gain good CGPA which really matters a lot. The course is really good in our college.
detailed_review.Other: Due to the increasing demand of this course, I chose CSE. Top fest are organized. There are scholarships provided for the students. The college had a good crowd and the campus is full of trees.

reviews.review_title: Amazing infrastructure, but placements are not that good because of the recession.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60% of students were placed. The highest package was 60 LPA. The average can be around 10 LPA. Amazon was a top recruiting company. 80–90% of students get internships, and many of them get jobs at top companies like Google, Amazon, etc. Full stack developer, data scientist, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is amazing. The first-year hostels are very good and have good Wi-Fi. The library is also there, which is open until 2 a.m. Mess food is better than expected—not bad at all. There is a student activity center where all sports are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and have very in-depth knowledge of the subjects they are teaching. It is very relevant. Semester exams are difficult, and the competition is also very high. For the first year, everyone gets to study the same subjects, but from the next year on, subjects change.
detailed_review.Other: I had an interest in computer science, so I joined it. Campus life is amazing, and festivals are also very good.

reviews.review_title: Good campus with high vibes, but worthy of it.

detailed_review.Placements: The students placed it on my computer. The science branch is very high compared to all other branches of our campus, and we also get a good number of internships every year. The top companies that come for placements for our branch students are Google and Microsoft; they take around 3 students every year, and the packages offered by them are really good. We also get internship chances in those companies because the roles offered by them are backed-developed or software-developed. The highest package is 60 LPA, and the lowest is around 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course, the availability of Wi-Fi and WLAN services, and the maintenance of the library, classroom, and auditorium are up to mark. The management takes a good interest in maintaining them, but coming to the hostel, the only thing that disappoints many students is that there is no AC in the rooms, and the AC in the common rooms is being installed this year itself. All other facilities in the hostel, like drinking water, Wi-Fi, etc., are very good and perfect for students' comfort.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers on our campus are equally educated when compared to any other top IIT or NIT faculty. All the lectures and tutorial instructors hold a Ph.D. degree, and they are good and friendly with the students and available every time to clear their doubts and help them in their academics. They also allow students in their fourth year to do research projects under their supervision, and the semester exams are not that difficult, and the pass percentage would be 4.5 CGPA, and the student can get a pass percentage very easily.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about my course is the placements are high when compared with all other courses of this campus and there is nothing that needs to improve in my course, but I need the frequency of the tests conducted should be reduced a little bit and coming to the events and fests they are many numbers of events and fests conducted every year and the food stalls, DJ nights, proshows, and many more are done during this time, and scholarships are also provided to the students every year to help them financially. There are two types of merit and merit cum need scholarships provided, and the connectivity is also good. We can SEE a cab or 5 buses are there every day from campus to the city but cab charges more since it's outskirts of the city.

reviews.review_title: BITS Hyderabad is magic.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of placements received by the students is almost around 80 percent, with the highest package offered being 60 LPA, an average package of 15 LPA, and an opening package of 10 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Intel, Qualcomm, and Google. The roles offered in my course are software development, and almost 100 percent of students got internships at our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course is perfect for all students, and it's easy for any type of student to undertake. The campus is fully set up with Wi-Fi routers everywhere, and classrooms are equipped with good Wi-Fi and projectors for students' learning processes. The library is very huge and contains a large number of books. The hostels on the campus are very peaceful and have all the facilities for the students' betterment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified and have good teaching skills; they have graduated; almost everyone holds a Ph.D. from IIT, NIT, or BITS; they interact in a kind and friendly way with students; and they are available to them anytime when they need guidance or help in their academics. The course curriculum is good and comfortable, with a limited number of exams and easy-to-score marks, and the pass percentage is 4.5 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: The course I choose is CSE, and this is the better option that I have after completing my 12th standard. I would suggest removing the class-existing tests that we have from our course curriculum, and the frequency of exams is better now. If it were reduced a little bit, the best course curriculum scholarships are provided highly in our college; there are 40, 80, and 100 percent scholarships based on your performance in the college, and the connectivity with the city is very low, and extracurricular activities are really great and encouraged by the management.

reviews.review_title: BITS Hyderabad: A campus with good campus life and flexibilities.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from chemical branch according to the information that I have, around 80 percent of students are placed and the average package offered was around 10 Lacs per annum. When it comes to recruiting companies, there are many like Divi Laboratory, Dr Reddy laboratory, Cipla, etc. Coming to the internships, not only our branch but every branch students gets good internships; almost everyone gets internship and the highest role offered is manager of production department in Cipla.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The complete infrastructure of the college is simply awesome: classrooms, library and auditoriums. Everything is well designed and maintained by the college management, and coming to the hostels, they will be inside the campus itself which is also well maintained by the college management itself and they have all the facilities that a student needs to live.
detailed_review.Faculty: The lecturers here are very friendly and highly educated; they often interact with the students and help them in their studies. The quality of education taught by them is good and the course curriculum is well designed and makes students comfortable to study without any trouble and they can almost become industry-ready. Coming to the semester exams, they are not that difficult and a student can comfortably score a minimum of 6 CGPA without any preparation and the pass percentage is 4.5 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: The course I chose was easier. The best part is that there is no need to work hard compared to other courses and the reason why I chose this was that this is the best college I got compared to other options I had after completing my 12th class, attending events and participating in extracurricular activities. Hyderabad would be top among any other colleges in Hyderabad because it has many fests around 2-3 every semester and students are left free to do any extracurricular activities that they want to do or play anytime .

Girls hostel, however, has a separate mess of its own, situated within the boundary of the hostel. It is mandatory for the students staying in the hostel to have their food in the hostel messes. The messes attached to hostels are fully managed by the students.

highlights.summary:
IIT Indore or IITI, was established in 2009 and was founded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. The college is an institute of national importance. Located in Simrol, Indore, MP, IIT Indore is one of the eight new IITs initiated by Government of India. IITI is a Public Technical Institute and has secured the 12th rank in the NIRF 2025 Rankings under the 'Engineering' category, and #27 under the 'Overall' category. Further, IIT Indore is ranked #556 in the 'World University' category by the QS Rankings 2026.
IIT Indore has signed several MoUs at the national and international levels. The MoUs at the national level are signed with organisations such as ICAR, IIT Bhilai,CIAE, AIIMS Bhopal, NHAI, IIIT Allahabad etc. MOUs at the International level are signed with the National Taiwan University, ICAT, CNU, UoA, etc.
IIT Indore offers full-time BTech, MTech, MS, and PhD programmes in various streams such as CS, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Space Sciences, Biotech, and others. Other IITI courses include a BTech + MTech dual degree programme in a range of specialisations for students to choose from. IIT Indore admissions are merit based with the college accepting scores of national-level entrance exams such as JEE Advanced. Furthermore, IIT Indore admission process involves JoSAA counselling to grant admissions to students.
According to the latest placement report available on the official website of the institute BTech batch, 89.76% of the students got placed. Furthermore, the highest and average package offered during IIT Indore BTech placements 2023 stood at INR 68 LPA and INR 25.45 LPA, respectively. IIT Indore offers a wide range of courses at the UG, PG, and doctoral levels through its departments, including the Department of Civil Engineering, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, and the Department of Metallurgical Engineering & Materials Science Engineering, among others.
At the UG level, IIT Indore offers the BTech programme in the following branches: Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, etc.
The BTech programme offered by IIT Indore is very popular among students. Among the various specialisations offered in the BTech programme, Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) is one of the most preferred specialisations among students. The IIT Indore BTech programme helps students build a strong foundation in Computer Science and Engineering and prepares them for a career in Software Development, Data Science, and Artificial Intelligence. The excellent placement record of the BTech CSE programme also makes it popular.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Indore - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Roles offered are software engineer, software developer, tester, mechanical engineer, civil engineer, and many core jobs. Top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Capgemini, Accenture, IBM, Wipro, etc. More than 90% of students get placed here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus, in hostels as well as classrooms. The library is fully equipped with a vast collection of books, and a system is also provided. Medical facilities are available here. A dietitian, physician, and gynaecologist are also present here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here are advanced because it is an IIT. Here, PhD students are very helpful to freshers and graduates. Semester exams are generally very strict here. The course curriculum is very relevant and future-based. Teaching quality is flawless. It is the best recommended college.
detailed_review.Other: It has every club, like sports clubs, dance clubs, fashion clubs, and NSS clubs. It is the best decision to join IIT.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Space Sciences and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and facilities with the most professional lecturers.

detailed_review.Placements: We are the first batch in our course. We are offered roles such as propulsion systems manager, satellite data analyst, etc., of positions given to us by the space companies. We are also offered government jobs under DRDO and ISRO, which are central government jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are perfect. Food is the best here. Sports and games are amazing. Wi-Fi is not so good at our hostel. It is one of the drawbacks of my college. We have amazing labs at our college. We often visit KV to conduct our experiments.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are pretty tough. You need to be well prepared for the exams. I feel that the course curriculum feels more relevant from the 2nd year. I can't guarantee you that the college will make my batch of students industry-ready. Maybe we should opt for higher studies for better placements.
detailed_review.Other: Fluxus is the best event conducted in our college once a year. I wish we had more understanding and depth in our course.

reviews.review_title: College has a good environment. Placements, infrastructure, and facilities are good.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch is the first chemical engineering batch (2023-27) in IIT Indore, so now I passed 2nd year so companies will start to come in July for internships. Many companies come on campus for placements like Google, Microsoft, EXL, Deloitte, TVS, Bharat Petroleum, Analog Devices, HP, GAIL, and many more companies to see more companies. You can visit on training and placements cell of IIT Indore website.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are separate labs and equipment established according to the course requirements with proper Wi-Fi availability. There are good classrooms in size and proper wooden benches. There are separate hostels for 1st year and 2nd year with double sharing rooms and 3rd, 4th year live in the same hostel. Good Wi-Fi is available in hostel room, and every day clean every unit properly. Hostels are best.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. You can share your personal or academic issues with them they understand and are mostly professors have Ph.D. scholars from foreign universities. But they are newly joined but good teachers. Course curriculum is relevant because course is designed according to the requirements of the chemical engineering sector. Pass percentage is almost 100%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it matched with my JEE rank. Interesting thing is that chemical engineering is mostly physical and chemistry relations. Events are good. Campus has around 3000 students and is good. But campus is beautiful in the rainy season. The campus has excellent infrastructure.

reviews.review_title: This is the only IIT college where placement and infrastructure are both very good.

detailed_review.Placements: In IIT Indore, 95% of students got placed. In my electrical branch, more than 50% of students got placed with a 2-digit LPA package. The highest package was nearly 50 LPA from my branch last year. Top companies are Microsoft, Google, LinkedIn, Goldman Sachs, etc. For electrical and electronics, top companies are NVIDIA, AMD, Snapdragon, Qualcomm, etc. These companies give more than 30 LPA. More than 70% of students got internships from college, and after doing their internships, PPOs are also offered. Top roles we get include chip research, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of IIT Indore is one of the best in India. Hostel of this college looks like a hotel. There is a common room for every 5 students. Every student of this college gets single from the first year. Although from this year, first-year students have to share a single room with one partner due to an increase in branches in B.Tech. Everything is here when it comes to the facility.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are too helpful. In IIT Indore, all professors are well-qualified with an IIT degree. And they wrote many research papers which published in foreign universities like MIT, Oxford, etc. Course is not so relevant. In Civil, metallurgy branch has some subjects that are outdated. Due to many clubs where students personality enhances, students become industry-ready. Semester exams are difficult. 80% of students pass every semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I got into counselling. The best thing is in my course on embedded system thoughts, which the industry needs, and chip design companies are a basic requirement. I would say colleges have to improve internship facilities among core branches, students as electrical, civil, metallurgy, etc. There is a FLUXUS annual tech fest organized every year, which is the biggest fest in central India.

reviews.review_title: I'm satisfied with my college because of good education.

detailed_review.Placements: This is a first-time batch, so we don't know the placement statistics. No recruitment has been done in our college yet, so we can't tell you. Students have got internships in the USA, China, and many other off-campus locations. Research internships are mainly provided by professors.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are proper labs and smart boards which help in better education. Wi-Fi is available, classrooms are high-tech as an IIT. Slides are shared well enough. Hostel is double sharing and the quality is very good two proper beds. Sports facilities have improved.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is very well improved and they are passionate about their work. Course curriculum is industry-relevant. They showcase the top-quality curriculum of IITs. Semester exams are prepared as per students' level.

reviews.review_title: All about Masters at IIT Indore.

detailed_review.Placements: In M.Sc. Biotechnology, there are very few placements for students. The average is 4-6 LPA, which is very low according to IIT. Approximately 40-50% of students get placed in companies. Most students prefer Ph.D. due to the low amount offered by companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are all very good. Each classroom and lab is air-conditioned. The hostel facility is very nice. The washrooms and rooms are clean. Campus life is very good. The mess provides good quality food. The sports complex has a badminton court, swimming pool, and gym facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very approachable. Their teaching style is good. All faculty members have ample knowledge in their field as well as in other fields. Exams are based on the portions taught in class. The exam level is moderate to difficult. There is relatively fair marking for results.
detailed_review.Other: The fest, sports, and other facilities are good. Everything is great except for placements. Practical knowledge is far better here.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 92 percent of students got placed. The highest is 60 LPA, the average is 25 LPA, and the lowest is around 8 LPA. Amazon, Oracle, Microsoft, BHEL, Cisco, and Accenture visited. We get internships during our third year. Almost 80 percent get internships. The above-mentioned companies take us as interns. Roles offered are mostly VLSI- and software-based.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi is a little bad. Other than that, all is good. There are double-sharing rooms; 3rd and 4th years get single-sharing rooms. The library is closed on holidays, but the self-study center is open 24/7. Food is not bad, but don't expect too much. You will live in a unit, 4 BHK. There are washrooms in each unit too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are good, but you have to do your own stuff. The course curriculum teaches a lot of relevant stuff. Semester exams are quite difficult, but as it is relative grading, you don't have to worry much. The pass percentage is very high. You get to go on industrial trips too.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to get into a circuital branch. As this college is a top IIT, I thought this was better. There will be one or another event happening all the time.

reviews.review_title: The campus of IIT Indore .

detailed_review.Placements: We are the first batch of chemical engineering at IIT INDORE, so there are no placements right now as we are studying in 3rd semester of B.Tech course. We are trying to approach several internships in upcoming 5th semester. We are now focusing on internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are total five to six hostel at IIT INDORE campus which includes namely CVR, VSB DA, HJB etc. There are five practical building and Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. The quality of mess food is quite good and it has its own health center and sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers ( professors) are Ph.D. graduates and very knowledgeable. The teaching quality is very good. And all the teachers are very helpful. The course curriculum includes the core and electives courses. The semester exams are very difficult. The pass percentage is high.
detailed_review.Other: I had got this course because of my JEE Advanced rank but I am getting into it nowadays and bit interested in agricultural field as a chemical engineer.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A students honest review of IIT Indore by Raja Reddy. Mentioning the advantage of IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: As far as my seniors told me, students are eligible for placement in the 8th semester and internships in the 6th semester. Companies that visit every year are Google, Goldman Sachs, and Accenture. They offer roles in Software Development and also in Core Engineering. The highest offer made last year is 68LPA for the ADE profile, and the average package is about 26LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is great and is considered the best of all IITs, with modern infrastructure combined. It has buildings like hostels, mess, lecture halls, and an auditorium, all within walking distance of one another. A beautiful sports complex is under construction, and an Inter IIT event is going to happen this year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good and well experienced. You will always find lecturers available to help you with your studies. The classes and presentations by the lecturers are well structured and very helpful. Most lecturers are experienced and have worked in various colleges, mastering their disciplines. As for academics, it follows the modern academic structure provided by the government.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life has been amazing. Seniors are very helpful and respectful. The combination of academic life and sports will keep you fit and allow you to interact with many people, increasing your communication skills. The campus is beautiful, and you can truly enjoy your time here. Fests, including music and dance events, are organized, with famous singers often invited, and summits have been held for the past two years during my time here. I have chosen the CSE branch, and all the branches are good. There are also various clubs to encourage self growth and competition.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the overall quality of the college .

detailed_review.Placements: Less than 40% of students were being placed. The average package was 50,000. PW Coaching Center and many more approached our college for the job of teaching after a Masters. No one got the internship opportunity. The top role, or the only role we were offered, is the teaching role.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Full marks on infrastructure and facilities with high-class labs and classrooms are there. All the extra facilities provided are up to par. Hostels are clean and the hostel staff is really helpful. We do have good-quality food in canteens and mess. Do get regular mess food checked.
.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty do not give their best but do make efforts to provide us with a with a good education. We need a better education course system as most of the courses in our subject need a lot of time to be completed so we need to have a lot of time to grab the things. For that, we need a much more organised syllabus.

reviews.review_title: A well defined review of IIT Indore.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of the students enrolled got a good placement. The highest package was around 67 LPA, the lowest was around 6-7 LPA and the average is around 18–19 LPA for the entire B.Tech. Top recruiters included Oracle DeShaw, Nvidia, Google, Quadeye, Goldman Sachs, AMD, Texas Instruments, Salesforce, etc. Internships were also provided to a lot of students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are in top condition at IIT Indore. Labs are well maintained and funded as well. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, provided by the institute. Classrooms are equipped with digital screens and AC's are seated, which is also very comfortable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in my department are very helpful. They all have completed their education from top institutes and are also doing well in their fields of research. The curriculum adheres to standards and is somewhat relevant. Semester exams are a little difficult but a week before preparing can help in facing the exams.

reviews.review_title: IIT INDORE : Best Campus Life With Greater Opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost every year, 90% of students get placed, and from CSE branch, 100%. The highest package at my college is 68 LPA and going on. The lowest package is 8 lpa, and the average package, including all domains, is 20 lpa. All branch students get placement with a decent package. Top recruiting companies include Google, Nvidia, Amazon, Walmart, Bhel, PW, and many more. Almost 50–60% of students got internships for SDE roles in Google, Bhel, and PW. The roles are offered for SDE, technical roles, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are well-equipped labs in buildings with free Wi-Fi access, big LED screens, and modern teaching classrooms with good-quality sound speakers. The infrastructure of every building is modern and beautiful. The Wi-Fi service is available in every hostel, lab, classroom, and auditorium. The hostel facilities are good too. We will find two student occupancy rooms, four rooms, two toilets, two washrooms, one kitchen, one living room, one balcony, and two sets of very high-quality chairs. The room contains a study table, chair, and B.Ed. almirah (you have to buy your own mattress). The hostel common area contains one big LED TV, a table tennis kit, a carrom, a badminton court, and a free-to-use sports kit. There is one health center too for our good health, and the health center fee is included in our fee receipt. The mess food is very good and a better-cost return meal. There are many canteens, shops, and other shops that need our help. There is no need to go outside the campus. The sports facility is too good to stay healthy and strong. There are two football grounds, one cricket ground, two basketball courts, two volleyball courts, one swimming pool, and many table tennis courts. Many tournaments happen for your entertainment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff is very helpful for our academic journey. The professors are highly educated and kind. The teaching quality is good and classrooms contain digital equipment like LED screens, speakers and comfortable chairs. The course curriculum is good enough to train us for future jobs, including many projects. The difficulty level of exams is very easy, but it is difficult to score high marks. Pass percentage depends on other student's marks too, so no absolute marking works here, only relative marking.
detailed_review.Other: The B.Tech course is designed well to make students skilled and ready for industry-level. We will be given many projects to improve our skills. There is central India's big teach fest, FLUXUS, celebrated in March. The campus contains 3,000 to 4,000 students. The campus is surrounded by high-level security. You will be easily allowed to go around the campus even at night for girls too. There are too many scholarships provided to you to make your life very good. The bank offers loans too; a Canara Bank branch is located here on campus.

reviews.review_title: The real truth of IIT Indore.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, almost every top college faced a dip in their placements. The placement rate for the Mechanical Engineering department is around 70%, which is very low compared to last year's placement rate of 88%, highest package is around 50 LPA, and the lowest is around 12 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Amazon, DE Shaw, PSUs, etc. Internship opportunities are good for CSE and EE branches, while those for other core branches are less. The top roles are SDE and other technical roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the best here at IIT Indore because it's a 2nd-generation IIT, and the hostels are just awesome. Currently, students get double occupancy rooms in their first year, and they get single occupancy from their second year onward. Mess food is okay or leans more towards the good side; sometimes, one may miss Mumbai food and sports facilities are good here, with a cricket ground, football ground, badminton court, squash court, volleyball court, swimming pool, and a well-equipped gym.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors at IIT Indore are good, and most of the professors are Masters in their field from top foreign universities. The teaching method is a little old, but since 2023, courses are aligned with the new education policy, so you will be getting more practical knowledge and will be industry-ready. Semester exams are of moderate level; you get good marks if you study smartly. Passing criteria are different for different courses; sometimes it may be relative grading, and sometimes it may be absolute.
detailed_review.Other: There are numerous events held throughout the year, but some major ones are FLUXUS, the cultural and technical event, E-Summit, MUN, TEDx, and the sports event Lakshya. IIT Indore is going to host the Inter-IIT competition in 2024.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and research facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 96.88 percent of students placed last year. The highest offer made last year was 45 LPA, and the average package is 25.70 LPA. The top recruiters are Accenture, Goldman Sachs, and Google. Almost 50 percent of students got internships. The recruiters are NVIDIA, Texas Instruments, and Google. The roles offered are SDE and design engineers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are fully digitalized classrooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus with 20 Mbps of speed. The labs are equipped with all the latest equipment, but many times some of them are faculty. The library is very good, with almost 45,000+ books and 3000+ e-journals.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified, but many of them lack teaching skills, especially in the math faculty. Many times, students have to rely on YouTube to prepare for exams. The course structure is very relevant to current industry trends. The semester exams are tough. The passing percentage is relatively high.

reviews.review_title: IIT Indore is good and I'm satisfied with my college placements and really good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course last year, the average package was about 12–14 LPA. The highest package was 74 LPA and the lowest was 6 LPA, and in my course, 18 LPA was the average package. Companies like Flipkart, Google, Axela, etc. are recruiting. Roles like software engineer, data analyst, etc. were offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms are more than expected, and the library is very good. Especially in my department, we had many labs and faculty members provided projects to the students. Hostel facilities are okay because the rooms are too small for two students. Hostel food is moderate. The menu is good but the taste is moderate and for medical facilities, we had a health center too where students would get free treatment. Sports facilities are also awesome but cricket grounds have not been made till now; it's been 4+ months.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and also helpful. The teaching quality was average. Course curriculum is not relevant because I don't think engineers need to study courses like bioscience and environment studies. More subjects, like economics and entrepreneurship, should be there. Semester exams are not too difficult but the course curriculum is very lengthy, as we had 10–12 course subjects. Pass percentage is about 4.5–5+.
detailed_review.Other: I'm interested in this course by my 7th or 8th grade. The best thing about my course is that it's a real-world-based course. Events, fests and campus crowd connectivity are very good. Reliance scholarships are also available at our college and more scholarships are also available. Central India's biggest fest was held at IIT Indore, which is called Fluxus. Also, we had almost every club regarding each department.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science
reviews.review_title: Why you should choose IIT Indore!

detailed_review.Placements: This year, in the 2024 passing batch, the placements were not that good. Nearly 65% of students from our branch got placed. The average package was 15 LPA, which is less compared to previous years. The lowest was 8-9 LPA, and the highest was 35 LPA. The top recruiters this year were Jio, ZS, Razorpay, Deloitte, and Walmart. The internship scenario is bad this year; only a few students from our branch got internships. The top roles offered were SDE, Analyst, Consultant, and core positions.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus and infrastructure are top-notch. Classrooms are well-equipped with ACs and other facilities. The Wi-Fi is not super fast, but you can easily handle all necessary tasks. Labs have all the equipment required in fully working condition, and lab assistants are there to help us get familiar with lab equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful and very well qualified; most of them hold degrees from prestigious institutions all over the world. They are more than happy if you want to join them for some work. Talking about the curriculum, it is challenging but could be managed if done wisely. Marks are well distributed among midsems, endsems, and quizzes, giving multiple scoring opportunities. The semester exams are tough but can be passed if prepared smartly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good learning facilities.

detailed_review.Placements:
95 percent of our course will be placed. The highest is 60 LPA, and the average is 32 LPA. The least is 4 LPA. Most roles offered in my course were based on AI, ML, web development, or CP. 
I don't know the percentage of students, but most of the students will be getting internships at the end of their 3rd year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is 24-hour Wi-Fi for students and professors on campus, and the labs and library are the best. Every facility is given to its best level. Food would be average. Medical facilities are available to students. Sports and games are welcome by all.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really qualified, and they teach in an appropriate way. Semester exams are the same as in every engineering college, which are moderate. The course curriculum makes every student ready in their own domain. Every branch has its own better way of learning.
detailed_review.Other: CSE is the core course in the present generation. I don't think there is something about this course that I wish to be better at. Our college's events and festivals provide ample opportunities for interaction and enjoyment of college life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review about IIT INDORE.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of students were placed in our course. Not sure but 50 LPA is the highest package, and 12 LPA is the lowest package, and the average is 28 LPA. Companies like Flipkart, Google, TCS come for placement. 1.5 LPA internship in Google is the highest internship from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Among all IIT's we have the best infrastructure. But food is not good. We have an 81-inch television in the waiting hall. Double occupancy was about too bad, but understanding was important between roommates. And the quality of facilities in our hostel is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers who are teaching here are very knowledgeable. Faculty all are from IIT's who did PhD's in IIT's. Semester exams in our college are very difficult with strict invigilation. The passing percentage is about 95%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science
reviews.review_title: Life in an IIT by an average student.

detailed_review.Placements: In our course, approximately 80% of the students got placed with an average CTC of 10 LPA. The highest package was around 18 Lacs per annum and average was around 10 LPA with the lowest package being around 5 to 6 LPA. Many PSUs and tech companies visit for recruitments. Students getting internship opportunities are less in this branch compared to the other branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the soul of this college. The hostels are good and cleaned properly. The medical facilities along with the and sports facilities also good. Wi-Fi is provided across the campus. Classrooms and the library are equipped with modern day technology. Quality of food in the mess is sometimes moderate and sometimes good or average, but it is never bad. Sports facilities are still progressing but they are moderate.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well educated as they all have done their Ph.Ds from IITs. They are a little old fashioned and are very strict. Course curriculum is relevant and makes the students industry ready. Semesters are a bit difficult and the students need to work hard. Many student get a back (fail) in the exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Most people are classified as both core and non-core. The average package of the CSE branch is around 30 lakh per year. And that is the highest among all the average packages. There are also opportunities for internships at companies like Amazon.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent over here. Everyone has access to Wi-Fi almost everywhere. The labs are very well equipped. There are 2 large seminar halls with smart boards two relatively small seminar halls with smart boards and many other classrooms. A great library is there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and very qualified to teach; after all, they are all professors. But the teacher-to-student ratio is very high. The course curriculum is not so difficult except for math, which is easy to pass. And the grading is relative.

admission.title: IIT Indore Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Indore offers UG, PG, and Doctoral level courses, namely BTech , MTech , MSc, and PhD through three departments of the institute:

Admissions at IIT Indore are based on national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, IIT JAM, UGC NET, and CSIR NET. Candidates who meet the initial cutoff must appear counselling and personal interview rounds for final seat allocation.

Students may look below for a breakdown on the IIT Indore admission process for BTech course:

1. Appear for JEE Mains

Interested students must appear for the JEE Mains exam. Candidates can register on the official website of JEE Main via NTA. Students can check the past trend of IIT Indore BTech cutoff to get an idea about the score they must secured to get a seat.

2. Take JEE Advanced

The next step is to appear for the JEE Advanced exam . Admission to the BTech course offered at any IIT require students to clear both JEE Mains and Advanced . Students must secure a good rank in the exam.

3. Apply via JoSAA

Once the results are out, students need to register on the JoSAA portal through which seat allocation will be done. Students need to fill in their preferences of BTech branch.

4. Receive Admission Offer

Those who make it to the final list and receive the admission offer need to report for document verification . For seat confirmation, one must pay the specified fees within the stipulated time.

Campus facilities: IITI has various campus facilities which include Cafe, Atm, Bank, laundary, salon, etc.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The library has a collection of over 29,000+ books, which includes, in addition to text books and reference books, a fine collection of books on literature and English language and a select collection of books on sports, biographies, and general interest titles. The magazines and newspaper section includes popular magazines and newspapers both in English and Hindi. The library provides its users access to more than 6000 e-journals through individual as well as fulltext database such as ACM digital libray, Elsevier Science Direct, Springer link, IEEE XPlore, JSTOR.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: The Institute has well maintained, spacious and hygienic dining halls both for Veg and Non. Veg food. Students are provided four meals a day: breakfast, lunch, evening snacks and dinner. Mess Menu is regularly updated and changed as per students' demand.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: Presently around 600 students are residing in the hostel of IIT Indore. The rooms are spacious and large and looks out to the nearby mountains, RO system installed in every room to provide safe water.  The hostel has wireless internet connectivity and many other recreational facilities.

NIT Rourkela, also National Institute of Technology is famous. This institution is funded by the GOI. The management of the university tackles by the Board of Governors of the National Institute of Technology (Rourkela) Society, and is registered through the Societies Act. NIT Rourkela is approved by NAAC with a grade A, located in Rourkela, Orissa. The National Institute of Technology Rourkela is accredited by the NBA and is ranked 78 in QS Southern Asia University Rankings 2025. Courses in NIT Rourkela include BTech and MBA as the flagship courses. NIT Rourkela is ranked 13 by NIRF 2025 under the Engineering category.
Courses in NIT Rourkela are offered at the UG, PG, Doctoral, PhD, and various other levels to students. These courses are offered across Engineering, Management, and various other streams. National Institute of Technology Rourkela course admissions are conducted on the basis of merit and entrance. NITRKL offers placement assistance to students. The university is visited by top companies such as Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Wipro, Deloitte, and others.
National Institute of Technology Rourkela is to produce quality Engineers and Scientists at the Post-Graduate and Graduate levels in various branches of Science and Engineering. The university has a residential campus and offers accommodation to the faculty, staff, and several students through the NIT Rourkela guest house.
