reviews.course: M.Tech. in Electronic Systems and Communication
reviews.review_title: NIT Rourkela is an awesome college.

detailed_review.Placements: Now let's talk about placements. This college’s placements are nice. Around 74% to 82% of students get placed in our course. The highest salary package in our college is 64 LPA, the average salary package is 18 LPA, and the lowest salary package is 9 LPA. Companies like Aditya Birla, Tata, Cipla, and PhonePe recruit students from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available in our hostel include Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. Fully air-conditioned classrooms are available in our college. A central library is also available on our campus, and books can be issued by students. The quality of food in the mess is average. There are three canteens available on our campus, and the fast food is good. We have a small ground to play different sports like volleyball, football, and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. All of them are PhD holders. The courses are relevant to industry needs. Besides, one has to prepare himself/herself too. Each semester has two exams, a midterm and an end-of-term exam. One needs to have at least 35% in order to pass the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's a good college as it's one of the top most colleges in India. The college life is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80 to 90 percent of students got placed. The highest package is around 80 lakh. Last year it was 1.2 crore. The lowest is around 5 lakh, and the average is around 12 to 15 lakhs. Top recruiting companies are Wells Fargo, Visa, JSW, Accenture, and many more. Around 60 to 70 percent of students got internships, and companies include Visa, Accenture, and many more. The role offered is SWE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Rooms are not so high-end, but it's okay for our branch. There is Wi-Fi in classrooms, and labs are also good with around 80 computers in each lab. The library is good. It remains open from 9 AM to 9 PM. You will get Wi-Fi, books, e-books, and many more options. In the hostel, rooms are of decent size, and bathrooms are also in nice condition. Daily maintenance happens. Wi-Fi is available in every room. Food quality is also okay not very good, but satisfactory. There is a dispenser inside the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified, but the curriculum is very old and not suited to modern days. It does not make a student industry-ready. Exams are quite difficult, especially the end-of-semester exams, because the syllabus is very wide, and they ask mid-semester portions. The pass percentage is 35 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I got as per my score, which is good according to current days, because the industry is growing. Industry-ready elements should be included in the course, and practical aspects should be increased. Campus life is very good. Many great fests are organised on campus every year, and students enjoy them a lot.

reviews.review_title: Good college, the best NIT in India.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement season starts from the end of the 6th semester and continues till the end of the 8th semester. Many of the students who get an on-campus internship offer get the pre-placement offer after their internships. Companies like Google, Texas Instruments, Oracle, Tata, Accenture, Fractal, PWC, ZS, etc. Come to our campus. The highest package is about 98 LPA, while the average is 12 LPA- 14 LPA across all the branches. More than 90 percent of the students sitting for the placements get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a good central library in our college. All the classrooms in the lecture halls have a blackboard and a smart board along with a projector. There are 2 stadiums inside the campus, a gymnasium in every hostel, a swimming pool, basketball and tennis courts, and indoor sports in every hostel. There are over 50 clubs on campus for different things like coding, poetry, dramatics, etc. The hostel facility is okay. The boys' hostel is bigger than the girls' hostel. The food served is manageable.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty in our college is very well qualified. Most of them hold a Ph.D. from some prestigious universities abroad. We have 2 exams per semester. Midterms for 30 marks for each subject and end-terms for 50 marks. The remaining 20 marks out of 100 marks are internal and are given based on class performance and class tests. Each semester, we have 5 theory subjects and 3 practical labs. We have viva and practical exams for our practical subjects, and the professors also take regular class tests to assess our performance.

reviews.course: M.Tech. (Research) in Earth and Atmospheric Sciences
reviews.review_title: Very unique course and this is the best place.

detailed_review.Placements: We have organised a placement cell in our college. They shall assist us in all possible ways. Lots of emails and messages shall be sent to students to be prepared for the upcoming campus placements of various companies. Many companies provide internships to deserving candidates. L&T, IBM, TCS, Amazon, Flipkart, Deloitte, Practo, Microsoft, and various companies that provide internships with a stipend of at least Rs. 5000 per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is so elegant, so beautiful, just looking like a wow. Everything is there, for example, the gym, swimming pool, labs, Wi-Fi, hostel, and mess. Labs are well-equipped. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are many grounds for different sports. Hostels are very good. Food is outstanding.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is short and crisp. It depends on the branch that we opt for. Every semester, there is an internal followed by a main examination. Practical as well as theoretical to check the deep knowledge of students. Our faculty members are top-class faculty you can ever imagine. The way they teach is practically apart from a theoretical base. These make a student think of themselves as scientists, being multi-talented is much needed.

reviews.review_title: This is a very unique course; you will enjoy this college

detailed_review.Placements: Many companies come for engineering students. For post-graduate students, companies like Byjus, Aakash, and FIITJEE visit. Summer internships are compulsory for students in my college. I got a chance to do it at NCRA (TIFR Pune). Every year, 50 percent of students opt for placement and 25 percent are placed. Usually, a written round is followed by an interview for placement. Our college makes us practice for these in an online mode.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are well-equipped with instruments. All sorts of competitions happen, and workshops on robotics, AutoCAD, etc., also take place. The hostel rooms are small, and we have double-sharing rooms, as well as triple and single-sharing rooms. Hostel is compulsory for everyone. The library is accessible throughout the day. Other facilities include a medical store, hospital, swimming pool, gym, student activity center, data center, etc. We have a lot of fests all throughout the year.
detailed_review.Faculty: The courses here are well-structured and research-oriented. The faculty members are really good and helpful. Even the Ph.D. scholars interact with us frequently. Many students get placed in different companies from here. For engineering students, industrial visits occur very often. Examinations are regularly conducted under strict administration.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Come join this amazing college.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Rourkela guys are more benefited with placements. There are more than 300 companies offering jobs in our college. The main companies for the electronics branch are Texas Instruments, which offers about 35 LPA. The second most important company is Qualcomm, and it offers 28 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Coming to classroom facilities, there are two lecture halls. Every classroom has 2 air conditioners. Room is allotted to two people. There is a facility that you can select your roommate. In the hostel room, you will be given a table and a chair and two charging points. Coming to the mess, the food quality is good but bad in taste. Fee for room is 5000 per semester and 20000 for mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: NIT Rourkela has a 1:15 faculty-to-student ratio. For every department, one faculty advisor is appointed. After every semester, we need to give feedback on professors of the completed semester. We also need to give a review to the faculty advisor. As we know, in every college, electrical department professors are a bit strict; the same repeats in our college. In the curriculum, the electronics department has digital electronics, analog electronics, and so on. Up to 3rd semester, everyone will have mathematics, and the syllabus for every department is the same. In the first year, all departments have the same subjects.
detailed_review.Other: The part of the engineering college is the fests. In NIT Rourkela, there are mainly four fests: Innovision, technical fest, Virridhi, sports fest, Cosmo, cultural fest, Nitrutsav

reviews.review_title: Very good college, top NIT college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement of my college is very good. The college offers an average package of 12-13 LPA and a median package of 11 LPA. The highest package of my college is 84 LPA. The placement percentage is about 90 percent, but this year, due to the recession, the percentage is quite low. The top tech companies visit my college, like Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and Barclays.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is good. There are many facilities like a gym, reading room, night and day canteen, book shop, badminton court, sports, everything. But the mess food is quite disappointing for me. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. There are many cafeterias, restaurants, and malls inside the campus. There are many grounds for different sports. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. The library is good, and it is open 24 hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about the course, it is quite interesting. The exams are held every 2 months, one is a mid-semester exam, and the other is an end-of-semester exam. The faculty-to-student ratio is 10 students per faculty. The faculty members have vast experience in their field, and they are well educated and trained. You can easily go to their office and interact with them, or you can call or text them.

reviews.review_title: NIT Rourkela College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: In my M.Sc. Batch, everyone who applied got placed, but many students prefer to go for PhDs. A 2-month internship is mandatory, so all students get internships in companies or IITs. There are things to be considered before you take this course in college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course gets a lot of support from the available facilities. We have a central library, Wi-Fi, and digital classrooms, which really help. The hostels are quite good, and the food, whether from the mess or the canteen, tastes nice. Plus, there is a multi-sports complex too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty, staff, and teachers play a very important role in helping students learn. They are not just helpful but very supportive, and they try their best to provide a good education. Their teaching style prepares students well for industry needs. Overall, the campus experience was good and nice.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely best college in Odisha.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are outstanding. 90% students are placed through the campus interview. Most students choose to be professors in colleges like any engineering colleges in Odisha or other states. Ambani is like Amazon Samsung Flipkart etc. Visited the campus during the campus interview. The average salary given was 6LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure are world class. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. This is the best engineering college in Odisha. Classroom setup having digital equipment like projectors and smartboards in the classes. Lab surfaces and having all the equipment used in industries. Library is good all types of books are available in the library. There are many grounds for sports like cricket ground volleyball court badminton court basketball court etc. Postal Sir good. Mostly there are two rooms and all types of facilities like seats and a geyser are available in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teacher board is highly qualified and experienced. Most of the faculty members are from the IIT. Teachers taught us in very unique concepts like they cleared doubts through the discussions in the class. Two semesters per year are contracted by the college. Semester questions are sometimes hard and sometimes of a moderate level.

reviews.review_title: Shubham Anand Shiksha review.

detailed_review.Placements: Every year more than 90 percent of students got placed in top companies of India. My college offered to them was 12 LPA to 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies in India hired my college students. The percentage of students got internships from my course in companies like Amazon and Ola was more than 60 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities available in my department were so good. Infrastructure of college was average. But classroom and library were available for all students. Wi-Fi was not present in this college. The quality and facility in my hostel canteen were so superb. Sports and games were also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my course were very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They had great teaching qualities. This course curriculum was relevant, and students were industry-ready. Semester exam in my course was little difficult to pass. But pass percentage was more than 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to gain knowledge from my college. There was nothing to improve in my course. Scholarship was also available for all students.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely the best college with a tag as NITian, good placement and a bright future in every field.

detailed_review.Placements: Well, I'm from the mining department, and to be honest, among all NITs and IITs, NIT Rourkela offered the best facility and placement for mining engineering, due to the available mines in Odisha. 98% of our seniors got placed in various companies like Coal India, Hindustan Petroleum and other mining industries. Many also learn coding and finance to get a placement in the desired companies. The highest was 45 LPA, and the lowest was 5 LPA, with an average of 11 LPA. NIT Rourkela offered an outstanding base for mining engineering. Roles like mining designer, etc., are also offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Literally, you will get everything in the hostel, from free Wi-Fi to a gym, everything is available. Facilities like a central library, swimming pool, gym in both campus and hostel, computer labs, free Wi-Fi, an outstanding building with stunning classrooms, smart boards, and AC. Study room, TV room, dining room, game arena, TT court, badminton court, basketball court, hockey court, chess, and Uno, everything is easily accessible and for everyone to use. A temple, hospital, free checkup, sports complex, many canteens and a food court are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: As the 2nd best NIT, I can confirm that the curriculum, strict courses, and teachers are all qualified and help you to your best. Teachers also focus on the mental health of the students. Each students get assigned a faculty advisor for their helpful needs. The study here is so peaceful and really good. Although semester exams are too strict and hard, the attendance policy is 85% compulsory.
detailed_review.Other: Well, with my JEE marks, I was assigned this branch, though it was not my dream one, but still it's so good with a helpful senior, nice teacher and freedom in this course. I wish to learn more from my branch. The fests and events here are literally the best among all. The biggest fests of East India are organised by NIT Rourkela too. The campus is vibrant and beautiful. The crowd is organised and don't stand out a lot. You can get a lot of scholarships due to the big name of NIT Rourkela. Every facility, like tech, dance, music, design, and sports, is present.

reviews.review_title: Review of Electrical Engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80% students got placed. The highest package was 62.44 Lacs per annum, the lowest package was not available, while the average package was 14.10 Lacs per annum. Top recruiting companies are. Texas Instruments, Bharat Petroleum, JSW, ExxonMobil. Amazon, etc. Almost every eligible student received internship opportunities. Top roles offered are hardware engineers, analogue and digital design engineers and power system engineers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi available in the classroom, but we can access the internet using the LAN cable provided to us in our rooms. There are air-conditioned classrooms with smart boards, and the labs are equipped with decent equipment. There is a central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. Hostels are safe and offer accommodation with amenities like a common room. The quality of food is decent. There are options for vegetarian and non-vegetarian people. They serve four times a day. There is a health centre on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are highly qualified. Some of them are from top institutions like IITs. The teaching quality is good, and the teachers are quite knowledgeable and generally helpful. The curriculum is relevant, and it makes a student industry-ready. Thus, the mature exams are moderately difficult, with about 80 to 90% students passing each semester.

reviews.review_title: Review of mechanical engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 85% of students got placed. The highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest package is 3.9 LPA, and the average package is 9.3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata Motors, Mahindra, and BHEL. Top roles offered include Hardware Engineer, Graduate Training Engineer, and roles related to Mechanical Engineering in the manufacturing sector.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in the classrooms. We can access the internet using LAN cables provided in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. There is a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. Hostels are safe and provide comfortable accommodation with amenities like common rooms. The food quality is decent. It has a large variety of options for vegetarians and non-vegetarians. A 24/7 medical facility is available at the nearest health center.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is well-qualified, mostly consisting of Ph.D. holders from top institutions. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. The teaching quality is good. The curriculum is not highly relevant, and the exams are moderately difficult, with a pass percentage around 80 to 90%.

reviews.review_title: Review of the Master of Science in Mathematics at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 60% of the students get placed. The highest package is 14.45 LPA, while the average package is 7.36 LPA, and the lowest package is 5.48 LPA. The majority of the students tend to pursue research careers. Almost all the students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are no Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. But we can access the internet using LAN cables provided in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. There is a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. The hostels are safe. They provide comfortable accommodation with amenities like common rooms. The food is decent and hygienic. They offers a variety of options for both vegetarians and non-vegetarians. The Health Center is open all day, and access to doctors is available throughout the day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-equipped, mostly Ph.D. holders from top institutions like IITs. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. The curriculum is relevant, with high exposure to research and internships. The play is coordinated by Shabina. The exams are moderately difficult, with a pass percentage around 80-90%.

reviews.review_title: Review of Bachelor's of Technology in Chemical Engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage for students in Chemical Engineering is more than 95%. The lowest package is 3.3 LPA, while the average package is 13.0 LPA. The top recruiting companies are ONGC, ExxonMobil, ITC, and Bharat Petroleum. About 90% of students get internships, mostly at IITs, BARC, and BPCL. The top roles offered are generally research roles in the chemical engineering domain.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in the classrooms. But we can access the internet using LAN cables provided in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. The library is well-equipped with over 60,000 books. They are access to online digital resources and journals. The hostels are safe, with comfortable accommodation and amenities like common rooms and sports courts. The food is decent, with a variety of options for vegetarians and non-vegetarians. Medical facilities include a health center with 24/7 doctor availability and pharmacy services.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-qualified, with some holding PhDs from IITs and others from international universities. The teaching quality is good. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. The course is not highly relevant. The semester exams are moderately difficult, with about 80-90% of students passing each semester.

reviews.review_title: Review of the Industrial Design course at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60 to 70% of students got placed. The average package is about 13.98 LPA. The highest package at my college is 62.44 LPA for the whole college. Top recruiting companies are Mahindra, TCS, Wipro, and Rubrik. Intensive opportunities are few for industrial design. Top roles offered are product design, manufacturing design, and ergonomics.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi in the classrooms, but we can access the internet through LAN cables present in our rooms. Classrooms are air-conditioned and have smart boards. There is a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources. Hostels are average, offering comfortable accommodation. Food is decent, with options for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian people. A health center with 24X7 doctor is available, and pharmacy services are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-equipped. Some of them have earned their Ph.D. from top institutions like IITs. Some are also from international universities. Teaching quality is good. Teachers are quite knowledgeable and generally helpful. The curriculum is not highly relevant. Semester exams are moderately difficult with a pass percentage of about 80 to 90%.

reviews.review_title: Review of Integrated M.Sc. Mathematics at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 50% of students got placed. The highest package is 14.45 LPA, the lowest is 5.5 LPA, and the average is 7.36 LPA. Top roles offered are analytics, research, and software development. Most students generally pursue higher studies. A total of 59 jobs are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: While Wi-Fi is not available in the classrooms, we have access to LAN cables in our rooms. There are well-equipped laboratories with all the necessary and latest equipment available. College has a large central library with over 60,000 books and access to digital resources and online journals. Campus has a modern auditorium and seminar hall. Hostels are decent with double occupancy. Mess food is decent and served four times a day. Medical facilities include a health center with 24X7 doctor availability and pharmacy services.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified, mostly holding Ph.D. degrees from top institutions like IITs, and some are from international universities. Teachers are knowledgeable and generally helpful. Teaching quality is decent. The course is relevant. Semester exams are moderately difficult with a pass rate of around 80 to 90%.

reviews.review_title: Good campus life along with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students got placed by the end of the year. The highest package was in the software domain, and in core, Vedanta provided the highest package. Major recruiters are Tata Steel, Vedanta, JSW, Orica, Aditya Birla Group, IMFA, etc. The roles provided are mostly GET and MT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classrooms are fully digitalized, with all types of laboratories ranging from mechanics to software. All the classrooms have Wi-Fi. There is a central library which covers everything one is in need of. Hostel rooms are good, with bed, table, and chair. The quality of food in the mess is good. There is a dispensary where you can get health treatment.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members are highly qualified. They are very supportive and helpful throughout the entire B.Tech. Every batch is assigned a faculty advisor who guides us throughout. The course curriculum is beautifully designed, covering the syllabus of the GATE examination.

reviews.review_title: Review of Biotechnology and Medical Engineering at NIT Rourkela.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75% of the students got placed. The highest package was 15LPA. Lowest package was 3. LPA, an average packages was 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Deloitte and Wipro. In the southwest, Tata Consultancy Services, Aditya Birla Group, Reliance Industries, and many more. About 60% students got an internship. Most of them got internship at Reliance industries, Aditya Birla and research labs. Top roles offered are research associate bioinformatics, Bioprocess engineer and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classroom infrastructure is modern with comfortable seating. Having air ventilation and smart boards. The library has large number of books and extensive number of resources, and also access to online repositories. The college has a central research facility, which supports high-end analytical instruments and interdisciplinary access. Boys' hostels have double occupancy rooms. Each room is equipped with a bed, table, chair, LAN connection, fan, and adequate storage. Hostel provides four times meals a day, including veg and non-veg option. The Medical Center provides free medical care for students. There are regular doctoral visits and 24/7 ambulance facility.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most faculty members hold Ph.D. from prestigious universities like NIT's, IITs and some of them also got Ph.D. from international universities. Teachers are helpful, knowledgeable, and easily appreciable. The teaching is based on theoretical lectures. The curriculum covers biotechnology, medical engineering, molecular Biology, and many more. It does not make student a completely industry-ready one. Semester exams are moderate and almost eighty to ninety percent students pass.

reviews.review_title: College is good in terms of academics and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Your skills matter to get a job. Many companies visit, but they mostly prefer to hire from the higher branches. For the lower branch, there are only a few opportunities. It's not 100% always, but almost 80% get placed every year. In my course, VISA, Natwest, and Cisco are the top recruiters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college and hostel is good. However, the facilities in some hostels, like CVR, are not so good. The food quality of some hostels is below average. Medical facilities are good. There are various kinds of sports facilities, and a new sports complex is also going to be inaugurated.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are really helpful and well-qualified. The course curriculum is relevant, which makes students ready for the industry and corporate environment. The attendance system is very strict. The semester exam is a turning point, as it decides your stay in college, but it's not that difficult.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are the best part of my campus life.

admission.title: NIT Rourkela Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
National Institute of Technology (NIT) Rourkela admissions 2026 are entrance-based various courses. The institute offers various UG, PG and part-time courses. Some other popular courses offered by the Technology Institute are MTech, MBA, MSc, MCA, etc. Moreover, BTech is the flagship course of NIT Rourkela.

NIT Rourkela admissions to the offered programmes are either through entrance examinations (for example, JEE Main/ GATE/ IIT JAM) or based on merit. The NIT Rourkela application process is completed in online mode. Read on to know more about NIT Rourkela course admission 2026 :

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for MBA at NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: NIT Rourkela MBA application window generally opens in the month of Jan. The registrations close by Feb. After the closing of the application portal, the university will further release the list of the shortlisted candidates for GD-PI rounds .

faqs.question: Is NIT Rourkela hard to get?
faqs.answer: NIT Rourkela offers courses in UG, PG and part-level. The Institute offers admission based on valid scores of accepted entrance exams such as JEE Main/ GATE/ IIT JAM or other equivalent. Candidates are required to qualify for the JoSAA counselling and seek final admission based on the qualification of all the selection rounds.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: How much is the cost of MSc course in NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for MSc courses is INR 30,000 and INR 75,000 for the BSc + MSc integrated courses. Apart from this, the total course fee includes other components such as hostel fee, admission fee, caution money and institute emergency fund as well. Candidates can visit the institute's official website for more details as the mentioned fee is as per unofficial sources and can vary.

faqs.question: What is the selection criteria for BTech at NIT Rourkela?
faqs.answer: The selection criteria for B.Tech at NIT Rourkela is entrance based with the institute accepting JEE MAIN scores for the same. The minimum eligibility is passing Class 12 in PCM/PCMB stream with atleast 50% aggregate.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff of NIT Rourkela for 2025 admission?
faqs.answer: For the General AI category, NIT Rourkela JEE Main cutoff 2025 varied from 3122 to 34766 , wherein Computer Science and Engineering was the toughest specialisation. faqs.question: What is the minimum percentage required for BTech at NIT Rourkela?

faqs.question: How to get MSc in NIT Rourkela?

sections.heading: Introduction
text: The National Institute of Technology, Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has a big campus. The National Institute of Technology, Rourkela has classrooms, a library, hostels, and cafeterias. Some of the other campus facilities include:
Check out more details in the below videos:
list: Hostel facilities for boys and girls

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The library has an invaluable resource with over 60,000 volumes, 1400 journals and periodicals, 700 CDs and video cassettes. The library also hosts a digital online library, providing access to over 1200 video courses online and a number of other journals and an online-wiki page hosted on the intranet for the benefit of the students. The online repository hosted by the library also hosts every paper, dissertation, and thesis published by the students and faculty not only making it one of the biggest online resources for both the students and the faculty but also making the publications available throughout the globe. Constitutes robust collections in both print and electronic resources in subjects ranging from engineering to basic sciences to humanities.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description:
There are nine halls of residence, seven for boys and two for the girls with an overall accommodation capacity of over 3000 boarders. The entire campus is connected by a state-of-the-art network with almost 4000 nodes. 
Every hall of residence boasts of a Badminton court and a Volleyball court for its borders.

data.description: The National Institute of Technology, Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has an experienced faculty who are degree, PhD, and diploma holders. National Institute of Technology, Rourkela employs various Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors Grade-II, and various other faculty members. NIT Rourkela also invites faculty for guest lectures. The university holds conferences and workshops for students and teachers.

highlights.summary:
SRM Institute of Science and Technology was formed in 1985. It is located in Kattankulathur, Chennai. In 2025, SRM IST was ranked 11th position under the 'University Category'. Under the 'Engineering' category, it was ranked 14, by NIRF 2025. SRM IST is a top-ranked institute that is part of the SRM Group of Institutions. Internationally, SRM Institute of Science and Technology is ranked 1001-1200 under the 'World University' category by the QS World University Rankings 2026.
SRM University has been approved with an 'A++ Grade' by the NAAC. The university has been accredited by Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, the Computing Accreditation Commission of ABET and NBA, etc. the university is also a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
SRM Kattankulathur courses are given through its different affiliated colleges and constituting departments. The universoty gives UG, PG, PhD, diploma, and other courses to students across Management, Architecture, Engineering, Agriculture, and other streams. The university also offers distance education and online courses to students.
SRM University Kattankulathur is famous for its flagship MBA and BTech courses. Other SRM Institute Chennai courses include BSc, BBA, MSc, MTech, MBBS, etc. The admissions to most of the courses given at the university are based on entrance exam scores. SRM Chennai Kattankulathur admissions to the BTech programme are based on the SRMJEEE UG scores. The university also accepts several national-level entrance exams. Also, the admissions into the different Health Sciences UG, PG, and Post-PG courses is conducted on the basis of the SRMJEEH exam.
SRM University offers placement assistance to students. Over the years, SRMIST Kattankulathur has conducted more than 2,193 recruitment drives, with over 14,030 offers received, including 47+ global job offers. The highest package given during the SRM University Kattankulathur placements in 2025 stood at INR 65 LPA. SRM University Main Campus Kattankulathur has collaborated with more than 60 organisations and companies such as BITS Pilani, Goa, and Toyo University, Japan. SRM University Main Campus Kattankulathur offers different facilities such as a hostel, library, sports facilities, etc.

The most popular courses offered at SRM University are its BTech in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) and MBA programmes. The SRMIST BTech CSE programme is highly in-demand because of its excellent job prospects and high salaries. It is a versatile degree that can lead to a variety of career opportunities. The CSE graduates can find work as Software Engineers, Web Developers, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, etc.
BTech graduates can also start their own businesses or work as freelancers. SRM Chennai Kattankulathur also offers the BTech programme in combination many other major degrees or specialisations, including Aerospace Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, etc. The university provides students with the opportunity to pursue the BTech programme in any of the majors along with a minor, specialisation or both.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
reviews.review_title: About good and enjoyable college.

detailed_review.Placements: From 7th semester, students become eligible for campus placements. Top companies are Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HUL, HCL, and so on. I got an offer in 2 companies, Infosys and Base Automation Technologies. The highest package is 51 LPA, and the average package is 3 LPA to 5 LPA. 90% of people are easily getting placed, and have plans after getting the placements to work.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The main thing I would like to mention here is library, over 4 lakhs books are placed in the library including IAS, IFS, IPS, central and state government aspirants can also use it. The gym is overall good. Campus timing is 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM, depending on the day of the order and departments. Security is very strict here so students can't do any unnecessary activities inside the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty to students ratio is overall good. The relationship between the students and faculty members is very good. My best faculty is Dr. Kirigalan, he is a good professor, and he will always be open to help students after the college time also. The course is well structured. We can expect 7 to 8 subjects for each semester, and everything is easy to understand.
detailed_review.Other: Milan and Aarush are the famous events in our college. Around 20 to 30 festivals will be happening here because all the state students are studying that's the main reason. The facilities and technology provisions in the classrooms are projectors, LED displays like smart television, AC, and so on.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great campus life, Bad ROI.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed is very vague as a lot of students just opt out of placement because of their CGPA and they are not considered for placement. If you are an average student you can get around 6 to 7 LPA if you maintain your CGPA. Companies like Wipro and L&T are the top recruiters. Internship you have to secure at your college gives you almost zero support there.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs and Classrooms are actually pretty good if you opt for CSE as the new building TP 2 is highly advanced. Library is also pretty good with a nighttime study facility. Hostels are expensive and the hostel staff is pretty annoying. You have an appointment at 9 o clock so beware of that.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers try but to be honest, for our course they are bad actually pretty bad. The curriculum is good and you can score decent marks if you just prepare from the resources, as you will find a lot of resources to help you. Semester exams are actually pretty easy but the thing is you have exams throughout the year, so it is pretty exhausting. You have 3 cycle tests for each subject every semester. Then there is the final semester exam which is of only 40 marks. The remaining 60 marks are on internal and cycle tests.
detailed_review.Other: Too much crowd in CSE thats why I chose Electronics and Communication. To be honest this course is very tough but you can manage if you focus on the core subjects. There are a lot of events but if you are coming from North India, you will be a little disappointed as the fests are pretty south dominated. There are a lot of hackathons happening all throughout the year.

reviews.review_title: Vibrant college life at SRM.

The top roles offered are full-stack development and software engineering. The highest annual package is 50 LPA, and the average is 5 LPA- 8 LPA, where the lowest can range from 3 LPA- 4 LPA. It has a huge central library containing all kinds of books where students can go to study and read in their free time. The classrooms are equipped with CCTV, smart boards, and projectors, and all are in very good condition. The hostel rooms are very good, with nice furniture. The food is fine and has a variety, plus there are lots of canteen cafes plus the sports facilities are good too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are highly experienced and knowledgeable in their respective fields, and they are all very helpful. The pass percentage is 99 percent.
detailed_review.Other: It is very costly, but the campus life is very vibrant. There are two major fests happening in a year, and lots of cultural events and road shows. Extracurricular activities are encouraged through various clubs, and students can join them according to their interests. The campus is very crowded, and it has a nice connection with the main city. reviews.review_title: Good placements, solid infrastructure, supportive faculty, and a relevant BCA data science course.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently in SRM IST doing BCA Data Science. Around 80 percent of students in my batch get placed. The highest package is about 8 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is around 4.5 LPA. Top recruiters include Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, Capgemini, and Wipro. About 70 percent of students got internships in companies like Zoho, Virtusa, and HCL. Common roles offered are junior software developer, data analyst, and data support roles. It's a good platform for learning and placements if you are proactive and work on projects and skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: SRM IST has good infrastructure for BCA Data Science. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated, labs are equipped with modern computers and software, and Wi-Fi is reliable across campus. The library has a decent collection of books and digital resources. Hostels are clean with basic amenities, and the mess food is average but edible while the canteen offers a variety of snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports and games facilities like basketball, cricket, and indoor games are decent giving students a good balance of academics and extracurricular activities. SRM has good infrastructure, labs, and faculty.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at SRM IST are generally helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Most are approachable and clarify doubts effectively. The teaching quality is decent though learning depends a lot on the student's effort. The BCA Data Science curriculum is relevant covering programming, data analytics, and the basics of machine learning which helps students gain foundational skills for the industry. Semester exams are moderately challenging, testing both practical and theoretical knowledge. Pass percentages are usually high. Around 85-90 percent but scoring well requires consistent study and attention to assignments and projects.
detailed_review.Other: I am in the BCA Data Science course at SRM IST. I chose this course because I love programming and data analytics, and wanted a career in IT and Data Science. The best things about the course are the practical labs, relevant curriculum, and exposure to coding and analytics projects. I wish there were more industry-oriented workshops and advanced machine learning sessions. The campus has a lively crowd, good connectivity, green surroundings and hosts events and fests regularly. Scholarships and extracurricular activities are available making it a balanced place for learning and overall growth.

The highest package is 77 LPA. The lowest is 4 LPA. The average package is 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course include Amazon, Microsoft, Chubb, and TechMojo. About 97% of students get internships in our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is excellent. It has fully air-conditioned facilities. The campus has full security. No entry is allowed for unknown persons. However, one drawback is that the hostel fees are too expensive. But the hostel infrastructure is excellent. The food in the hostel is hygienic and tasty.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every faculty member at SRM has completed their postgraduation. They are skilled and friendly with students. They motivate students to succeed in life and provide good training. Semester exams are easy, making it simple to pass and get good percentages.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: B.Tech student review of SRM University, Kattankulathur.

detailed_review.Placements: I belong to the B.Tech CSE batch of SRM University. Around 85 to 90 percent of our students got placed. The highest package offered is 52 LPA, and the average package is 7 LPA. Over 900 companies visited our campus. It provides more than 5,500 job offers. It is a great choice for aspiring professionals.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the B.Tech CSE course at SRM University is very good. The department is equipped with computer labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a fully stocked library. It access to numerous technical books and journals. Hostels are spacious and clean.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members for B.Tech CSE at SRM University are highly qualified, experienced, and approachable. Professors are knowledgeable. They always ready to help students with doubts. It makes the learning experience effective. The curriculum is well-maintained. It is updated regularly and designed to equip students with industry-relevant skills.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: Overall, I am satisfied.

detailed_review.Placements: I think pretty much all good performing students get placed in our college who survive without any standing arrears. The highest place was 60 LPA, I guess, and the lowest may be in mass recruiting in TCS or Wipro, maybe 3 LPA, which is expected for below-average students. Those who are placed for 60 LPA are exceptionally good in the area. It depends on the performance of the students, as SRM almost brings 600-700 companies a year. Almost 30% got internships on their own, and the college also provides, but not to this extent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are really good in SRM. Infrastructure-wise, it's a 10/10. They keep on renovating and building new buildings. At least the classroom for CSE is 10/10, as they even provide escalators in the building and fully air-conditioned classrooms. The hostel is also good, and hygiene is properly maintained. Medical facilities are also good as they have a medical college and hospital within the campus, and SRM students get a discount of 50% in the medical college. As I know, many of my friends are into sports; it's not that good, and I am not into any sports, that's why.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are extremely qualified but not that knowledgeable or keen about teaching, I feel personally. You will have to work on yourself to make yourself industry-ready. Semester examinations are really easy, and the pass percentage is really high, so maintaining your CGPA matters the most rather than just passing the exams. Unlike other colleges, SRM has very easy exams.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for this course because I love cybersecurity. Faculty should be improved. Event and fest freedom is the best part of SRM.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Data Science)
reviews.review_title: SRM, ECE vs. Data Science.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 75% of ECE students got placed in 2025. The highest package in ECE is 36.8 LPA, the lowest is 5 LPA, and the average is 8 LPA. Top recruiters are Samsung, Qualcomm, Nokia, Siemens, Bosch, Open-silicon, Altran, Cadence Design Systems, INVECAS, Intel, IBM, Synopsys, Micron Technologies, Amazon, KPIT Technologies India Ltd, Renault Nissan Limited, Denso International Ltd., and software companies in the ECE domain like TCS, Wipro, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. There are different types of hostels you can choose from. Hostel Wi-Fi is good, but you can't play games. Each department has a good and well-equipped lab, and classrooms are good, can sit around 70students. Library is good, you can go to the library if you want to study from 9:00 PM to 12:00 AM. The food in the mess is good and fresh.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is good, friendly, helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable, with over 10 years of experience. The curriculum are tailored by faculty and companies with a tie-up, which makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are not difficult if you study.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is crowded.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college is good, but it's expensive.

detailed_review.Placements: There are a lot of students in CSE, and only skilled people got placed. The percentage is around 25%. The highest package may be 50 LPA, and the lowest can be in thousands. The average is like 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS and Amazon. Mostly 20%-25% of students, and for all good and top companies. Top roles can be a coder and a designer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library is very good. Labs and classrooms are also good, it's better than others. Facility is okay, food is also okay, medical is very high, it's like you have to pay a lot, and sports and games are a good variety of games, and courts are a huge opportunity you can get.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are helpful and qualified. Some are from SRM. Only they got their degree from SRM, so they are like they don't listen to students' issues. Course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are easy. The pass percentage is 50% and if you study 1 day before, you can pass.
detailed_review.Other: I don't know, the best thing is I don't know coding, and I got into a new world. I will try my best to learn this course. Events are good, the South crowd is huge.

admission.title: SRM IST Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: SRM Institute of Science and Technology course admission 2026 is currently open. The admission is entrance-based for most of the courses. It accepts national level entrance exams. Some of the accepted exams are CAT, CMAT, GMAT, etc. the university also conducts its own entrance exams for admission to BTech and MTech. Candidates can fill out the application form online.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in SRM University without SRMJEE?
faqs.answer: SRM University conducts SRM JEE exam for admission to Engineering courses. The university does not accept scores for any other entrance exams. Also, direct admission is not valid either. Candidates are shortlisted for BTech and M.Tech based on their past academic records and scores obtained in the entrance exam. To sit for the respective exams, candidates must apply for the exams priorly and make a preparation strategy to ace the exam.

faqs.question: How much does BTech cost in SRM University?
faqs.answer: SRM Institute of Science and Technology BTech fees has multiple components, like tuition fee, security deposit, & more. The UG level programme are available with the tuition fees of INR 11 lakh to INR 23.8 lakh. The mentioned fee amount is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is however still subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for SRM University?
faqs.answer: SRM Institute of Science and Technology admissions are conducted on the basis of entrance tests. The admission for the flagship programs are held on the basis of SRMJEEE UG exam. Further, SRM MBA admissions are conducted on the basis of SRMJEEM test. The SRMJEEE PG test is conducted for the various SRMIST PG courses. The university also accepts scoring from nationally-held tests like CAT, TANCET, MAT, etc. for admissions.

faqs.question: How can I get into PhD course of SRM IST Kattankulathur?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking PhD admission are required to appear for an entrance test conducted by SRM IST. This test is conducted via CBT mode. This test is followed by a presentation and PI round conducted by the related department. However, those who have qualified for UGC NET (including JRF)/CSIR NET (including JRF)/SLET/GATE or teacher fellowship holders are exempted from writing the deemed university-level entrance exam for admission.

faqs.question: Does SRM Institute of Science and Technology accept CUET?
faqs.answer: No, SRM IST does not accept CUET score for admission to any of its UG & PG courses. The university conducts its in-house entrance exam for BTech and MTech, i.e., SRM JEE. Further, for admission to MBA course, the university accepts scores of national-level entrance exams such as GMAT, CAT, MAT, TANCE, etc. SRM University also offers direct admission to courses such as BA, MSc, etc., based on the merit of last qualifying exams of previous education.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in SRM University using Class 12 board marks?
faqs.answer: Candidates looking for course admissions must meet the eligibility criteria set by the college. For UG courses, candidates must complete Class 12 and for PG courses, students must complete graduation. Candidates must also fill or attach their scorecard at the time of applying for the respective courses. The university provides direct admission to courses such as BA, BCom, MSc, etc., based on merit of Class 12. However, for admission to courses such as BTech, MBA, BSc, etc., candidates have to also qualify for the entrance exam accepted for the particular courses.

faqs.question: How many entrance exam cutoffs will be released for admission to MBBS at SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre?
faqs.answer: SRM Medical College Hospital and Research Centre will release 4-5 rounds of NEET cutoffs for admission to medical courses. The cutoffs will be released on a rolling basis, and the seats will be filled on a first-come, first-served basis. The cutoffs will be based on the following factors: The NEET score of the candidate The category of the candidate The number of seats available in the course Candidates must visit the official website of entrance exam to read clear instructions on how to proceed with the counselling process, once the round is released.

The Institute accepts national-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, TANCET, NATA, SRMJEEE, SRMJEEM etc. for admission to MBA, BArch, BTech, M.Tech and other courses. Offering more than 80 courses and providing an annual intake of 52 K+, SRM IST offers admission based on the counselling through SRMJEEE e-counselling. To conclude, it is not very difficult to seek admission at SRM IST.

The selected candidates are called for personal interview round. To be eligible for the online course, aspirants must hold a valid bachelor's degree with a minimum aggregate. Moreover, the course aspirants with work experience and having qualified in either of the accepted exams are exempted from the university entrance test.

SRM was ranked #102 in Business Today in 2023 and 8 in Outlook-ICARE 2022 as India's top private MBA institutions in South Zone. The universities is ranked at no. 5 under top Business Schools of Eminence by Competition Success. MBA course at SRM is available in multiple specialisations like Business Analytics, Health Care & Hospital Management, etc. for students to get deep knowledge in the area of their interest. After completing the course, SRM conducts the placement drive for the MBA students.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to SRM IST Chennai MBA course?
faqs.answer: Admission to MBA course is based on CAT/SAT/MAT/CMAT/NMAT/TANCET/GMAT score. Candidates who have not qualified any of the accepted entrance exam can appear for SRMJEEM. Further, shortlisted aspirants need to pass personal interview round conducted by the university. Further, shortlisted candidates are called for counselling and document verification. Candidates need to pay the course fee to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: How many seats are there in SRM Institute of Science and Technology for MBA?
faqs.answer: SRM Institute of Science and Technology offers a total of 1980 seats for various MBA specialisations. Check below SRM Institute of Science and Technology MBA seat bifuraction: Institutes Seats SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai - Tiruchirappalli Campus 120 SRM School of Management, SRMIST 660 SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur 1200 NOTE: The seat intake mentioned above is as per an unofficial source. Hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: Does SRM University campus offers the BCA course?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Kattanlkulathur campus of SRMIST offers BCA programme. It is a three-year UG course. For admission to the programme, aspirants should have passed Class 12 or equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate. In addition, aspirant should have studied either of the mandatory subjects - Mathematics/Business Mathematics/Statistics/Allied Mathematics. The seat allotment is carried out based on merit in the last qualifying examination.

faqs.question: What is the tuition fee for BCA at SRM University Chennai?
faqs.answer: SRMIST Chennai fees has tuition fee, hostel fee, security deposit, etc. The total tuition fee ranges between INR 1.3 lakh and INR 3.8 lakh . The fees also includes registration fee of INR 5,000.

faqs.question: How the admission process happens for BCA in SRM Chennai? Is there any entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Check the steps below for SRM Chennai admission process for BC 1: SRMIST BCA Application Process Candidates have to apply online for BCA. The application fee for BCA is INR 1,200. 2: Shortlisting of Students The applications are further scanned by the authorities. 3: Admission Confirmation The selected candidates then have to submit important documents for verification and pay the fee for course admisssion. Course commencement and orientation details are provided to the students by the institute.

faqs.question: Is it compulsory to have Maths to pursue BCA from SRM University Chennai?
faqs.answer: Candidates applying based on their Class 12 scores must have Maths or Business Mathematics/Statistics/Allied Mathematics. However, those who wish to apply on their basis of their Diploma in Engineering don't need the same. Candidates must have passed the qualifying exam with the minimum aggregate, i.e., 50%.

faqs.question: Can I join MBA in SRM without entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Candidates cannot join SRM without entrance exam. The selection for MBA course is based on CAT/MAT/CMAT/NMAT/GMAT/SAT score. Candidates who have not qualified any of the accepted entrance exam can appear for SRMJEEM. Shortlisted aspirants need to pass PI round conducted by the university. Aspirants must meet the eligibility requirement to avoid rejection of application. Candidates must pass bachelor's degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate to apply for the MBA course. sections.heading: Introduction
text: SRM Institute of Science and Technology Chennai campus area is 250 acres . It provides variety of facilities, state-of-the-art labs, Wi-Fi, a knowledge centre, libraries, 4,000 capacity AC auditorium, more than 100 online smart classrooms, boys and girls hostels with multiple premium facilities, and others. The campus of SRM Chennai is green, clean, and energy-efficient. It considers solar energy as one of the major sources of power for the campus. There are other endless facilities of convenience offered at the campus of SRM Chennai such as cafeterias, prayer halls, ATMs, bookstores, dining options, gym, and others. The students are engaged with community radios, student clubs, cultural events, fitness centres, and prayer halls.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The university library is fully air conditioned 15 storey building comprises a rich collection of books covering various branches of Engineering and Technology, Medical and Health Sciences and Science and Humanities. The library has stocked 140518 volumes of books consisting of 61289 titles. The collection also includes 1550 handbooks & 200 encyclopedias. Back volume is about 4105.  8235 above project thesis. 781 standards which include BIS, ISA & IEEE. Around 5938 books CDs, 2710 journal CDs, 25 encyclopedia on CDs, 20 self learning tutorials, 850 video programs are available in the library.Cumulative database of nearly 2.52 lakh records covering the period from 1990 - 1999 are available. The library building is fully air-conditioned and automated. Photocopy facility is available in the library.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: University has 16 canteens and food courts which serves a variety starts from fast food to full-fedged cafeterias spread throughout the campus.Beside this a 24 hour café is also available for the hostellers.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: SRM University has 14 blocks for boys and 7 blocks for girls. All the hostels have hi speed Wi-Fi connectivity and are provided with solar water have heating systems, mineral water supply, water cooler in each floor, generator power supply.Students are offered with healthy and sumptuous food options at highly subsidized rates and can choose to have North Indian or South Indian menu in the dining halls that are co-located. the hostels also offer a multi-cuisine dining facility providing Thai, Chinese and continental food for the benefit of our international students,.Rooms with single cot ,study table & chair, cupboard & common mirror are available. Most hostels have common washrooms, a few blocks are available with attached bath and AC rooms too. Facilities such as gym, prayer halls, games, sports and cultural activities has been facilitated. 3 International hostels with modernized kitchen,library,drinking water, water heater, telephone,power supply, medical care, recreation,stationery shop, laundry point, gym, playground, indoor games, banking facility, a/c dining hall, a/c study hall and one off campus international hostel is also available.

data.description: SRM University Kattankulathur has reputed faculty with over 2,000 members . These include teaching and non-teaching staff. International faculty also visit the campus regularly. This provides students with a wide range of perspectives, and creates a vibrant environment. Most of the teaching staff is qualified and hold PhDs.

highlights.summary:
IIT Dhanbad is also recognised as the Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines Dhanbad) by the masses. The institute was founded in 1926 and one of the third institutes that was converted as IIT. IIT Dhanbad has been ranked 20th in the QS WUR Ranking By Subject, and it is ranked 100th in Southern Asia and 381st in Asia by QS World Ranking 2025. The institute also ranked 15th by NIRF in 2025 for Engineering. Thus, IIT Dhanbad's ranking is famous all over. Ongoing, the institute has been ranked at number 35 in the overall category by the NIRF 2025 and at the rank 48 among the top Management institutes in India by NIRF 2025.
Indian Institiute of Technology Dhanbad provides UG and PG courses in Engineering, Managment, Science, and others. BTech is the popular programme offers at the institute. The institute focuses on strong research in the field of mining, earth sciences, and engineering. Admission to the courses of IIT Dhanbad is completely dependent on the entrance. The institute accepts different entrance exams for the courses; some of the exams are CAT, JEE Main, JEE Advanced, GATE, and others. For IIT Dhanbad admission, complete the eligibility requirements too.
IIT Dhanbad offers scholarships to the deservind candidates. In this academic year, IIT Dhanbad placements for 2025 are still ongoing. As of now, 1,389 students have participated in the recruitment drive. A total of 237 PPOs have been offered to students up till now, out of which 211 have been accepted. The median and the average package recorded during IIT Dhanbad placements 2025 were INR 17.56 LPA and INR 13.38 LPA, respectively. The top international collaborations are the Institute of Geonics, Boise State University, National United University Mioli, Taiwan, Oakland University, Ecole Centrale de Nantes, and others.
