reviews.review_title: Really enjoyable and a great place to study while exploring the campus and curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: I am Paramesh from IIT Dhanbad. Placement statistics at this college are good. It is approximately 92 percent. The highest package offered here is around 60 LPA. The average is approximately 25 LPA. They offer many opportunities here, such as Goldman Sachs, Google, Amazon, and Accenture.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure might look old, but it is strong since it was built in 1926 during the British period. The auditorium has good capacity. Classrooms are equipped with central AC and smart boards. The library is much bigger than expected. They provide an excellent study environment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, guide us, and are available for personal interaction. The curriculum covers all modern technologies relevant at the global level. Examinations are above average. It depends on good time management.
detailed_review.Other: Students are also welcome to join various clubs, cultural events, and tech fests. You may find your seniors strict. But it is better to follow their rules since they may know something you don’t.

reviews.review_title: It is the best college for students' studies.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Dhanbad is situated in Jharkhand, and this university offers the best placement opportunities for students. This university offers many packages. The highest package offered in this university is 80 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 20 LPA. Many well-known tech companies like Infosys, Microsoft, HCL, and TCS visit this university every year, and at least 60 percent is required for placement purposes.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this course is very good for students. Many facilities are provided by this university, such as a 24-hour Wi-Fi facility for students and faculty members. Our university has many big libraries for students where they learn and study together. The university classrooms are very big and fully air-conditioned. This university also has many hostels for students. The food quality is also very good in the canteen and hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of this university are very kind and supportive. They are highly knowledgeable and highly qualified. The course curriculum provided by this university is relevant for students in one semester. It makes students industry-ready. At least 60 percent is required for passing. Many exams are conducted in this university for students, so students perform well in their sessional examinations.
detailed_review.Other: Our university offers scholarship facilities for students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The campus has a classic environment, well-trained faculty, and good placements every year.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 84 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is 58 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 15 LPA. The average package offered is 24 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Google, Amazon, Flipkart, Tata, Microsoft, etc., hire students. Around 60-70 percent of students get internships in companies like Google, Amazon, Microsoft, etc. Roles like data analyst, operating system, ML engineers, and information security-related engineers are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All facilities are good in terms of academics, like labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms, and branchwise departments. The campus environment is very nice, with lots of trees. It has a pollution-free campus, as most vehicles run on electricity. Hostels are also nice. We get both good non-vegetarian and vegetarian food. Sports and games are excellent here. All required courts are available here. We also have a student activity centre where we play indoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-trained. Their tactics in designing exam papers are really awesome. Teaching is also good. They use the digital projector for displaying slides. They also use the smart board to explain. They will also update the course based on time and current situation to make students ready to face the competition in the industrial world with updated skills, somehow we learn them at least by clubs. The pass percentage is about 90-95 percent.
detailed_review.Other: In view of the present and future situation and the job market, in society, software engineers occupy major roles in development, so I chose the Computer Science and Engineering course. I think that some skills should not be taught through clubs, but should be a mandatory skill to learn by everyone through the curriculum. It is better to implement this in the present curriculum (presentation and communication skills). Events, fests and extracurricular activities organised are also good here as they are governed by students and funded by the campus and other local companies.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Honest review of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85 to 90 percent of students get placed almost every year. The highest package is 59 LPA, and the average is 24 LPA. Recruiting companies include Google, Zomato, and Blinkit. 50 out of 140 students got internships last year at companies such as Cisco, Google, and Microsoft. Roles offered include web developer, data scientist, app developer, software engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus Wi‑Fi is available free of cost and for unlimited use. Labs are equipped with computers, although some systems are old. Classrooms are air-conditioned and very spacious. The best thing about our college is its 7‑storey library containing thousands of books, with ample sitting areas and a cafeteria. Hostels are small. The mess/food is the greatest downside. Currently, our sports grounds are under renovation, so sports aren’t active lately.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, with all being Ph.D. holders. Some have advanced qualifications. Teaching quality is satisfactory. The course curriculum makes students industry‑ready. Semester exams are not very difficult, and most students get around 95%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is Computer Science from an IIT, which is the best thing about it. I think they could reduce some theory classes and replace them with practical or lab classes. There are three major events/fests organised at our IIT, not including sports fests and sports meets.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A brief overview of college life at IIT Dhanbad.

detailed_review.Placements: Top companies include Google, Microsoft, Samsung, Uber, and many more that come for internships and placements. The average package for our course is 28–30 LPA. The highest package is nearly 80 LPA. Top roles like Software Engineer are offered. Overall, 75% of students get placed in our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are many hostels on campus for student accommodation. Each hostel provides all basic necessities like 24/7 cold/hot water, Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and a canteen. Hostel food is also nice and hygienic. Labs have advanced computer facilities with Wi-Fi. Classrooms are air-conditioned. We have one of the largest libraries in Asia.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified and experienced. Professors are assigned as mentors to guide students. There are courses that give us experience in different working fields. The difficulty of exams generally varies with the professor. Some exams can be much more difficult than expected.
detailed_review.Other: Our college is the first IIT to provide a no-attendance policy. Students get enough time to build skills and can join various clubs. Various events and fests also occur here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great college with top faculty, strong labs, good facilities, and excellent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: As I know, out of 137 students in CSE, 122 are placed, and the average LPA was 27.5. The highest was 65 LPA, and the lowest was 6 LPA. Top companies like Microsoft, Google, and Amazon, along with other top companies, are coming for recruitment. Top roles like SD and other roles were offered at my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As I was studying at IIT, the food quality was good, but as I was from the South, I did suffer; mostly people from the South will suffer. Wi-Fi is 24/7 available in the hostel, college, and library. Classrooms have digital boards and are provided with projectors, and everything is facilitated with air conditioning.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. As I was studying CSE, the course was a little bit hard to study for the semester, as the exam papers tend to be difficult. When it comes to the pass percentage, almost everyone will pass. It's hard to score the highest marks in a semester, but it's okay to pass the semester.
detailed_review.Other: I’m doing CSE at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, from the 2024-2028 batch. I chose this course because I enjoy teaching and wanted strong career opportunities. The peer group, coding culture, and project exposure are the best parts. A few subjects could be more updated, and the workload can get heavy at times. Campus life is lively with fests like Srijan and Concetto, good connectivity, and plenty of clubs and activities, so overall the experience is positive.

reviews.review_title: Great opportunities, mixed hostel vibes, but worth it for the IIT tag.

detailed_review.Placements: I graduated from the Environmental Engineering batch of 2K21-25, and honestly, placements are pretty solid. Around 85-90% of students in my course got placed. The highest package was 45 LPA, while the average was around 15-18 LPA, depending on the branch. Top recruiters included big names like Google, Microsoft, Schlumberger, Tata Steel, and ONGC. Roles varied from Software Developer, Data Analyst, Mining Engineer, to Petroleum Engineer, so there is something for everyone. The placement cell is quite supportive. Many students convert their internships into PPOs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am part of the 2K21-25 batch, and overall, the infrastructure is decent. Classrooms are well-maintained, Wi-Fi is available but patchy at times, and labs have the necessary equipment, though some need upgrades. The library is huge. Hostel life was manageable. Rooms were okay, but not luxurious. Mess food is hit or miss. Some days are edible, some days are emotional damage. The canteen has better options, and the sports facilities are actually good. Medical facilities are available, but basic. Overall, the infrastructure is good, and it's the IIT guys.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty profs are super helpful and know their stuff. Teaching quality varies, but if you show interest, most teachers respond well. The curriculum is mostly relevant, especially for core subjects. It does help in placements and internships. Exams are conducted on time. The pass percentage is decent. If you study regularly, you're good. No last-minute surprises, but, some papers are tricky. Overall, the academic vibe is serious but not suffocating.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Environmental Engineering because I am genuinely interested in the field, and IIT ISM has a strong reputation for it. Things that could improve are faster curriculum updates. Events like Srijan and Concetto are major highlights. The crowd is competitive but friendly. There's a good mix of extracurriculars, from coding clubs to dance groups. Scholarships are available for eligible students, and the surroundings are peaceful, though not super urban.

reviews.review_title: Decent college, but with some fundamental problems.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements have always been decent at IITISM Dhanbad. The good part about IIT Dhanbad is that even the supposedly "lower' branches also score decent packages like petroleum engineering, mining. Environmental engineering. Petroleum engineering, in particular, has had a decent history of placement since all major oil and petro companies like ONGC come here to recruit. Recently, even bigger companies are taking an interest in recruiting from IITISM, which promises a hopeful placement journey for the future.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our mechanical department is the richest in the entire college. We have a lot of machines and lab equipment. We have the Institute Research Hub (iRh) and the innovation centre i2H and NVCTI. They have world-class infrastructure. However, I have only given three stars for the infrastructure, which is because of the hostel. The food is okay, we get paneer and non-veg 3 times a week, and the taste is okay. The internet speed is only 50 Mbps most of the time, and the rooms are small and don't even have two desks, although two people live in one room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers, almost all of them, are very well qualified with their post-graduation studies done from abroad or top institutions. Now, the helpfulness of the teacher tends to be a hit or a miss, but I have found that the odds of you getting a bad teacher are low-ish, at least for the first year, when we have common courses. The course is relevant, but you will still need to do things on your own to make sure you are not missing out on skills that the industry requires. The academics are a bit on the tougher side.
detailed_review.Other: I took this college since it is near my home and I can often come to meet my family. Mechanical engineering is a decent branch that gives you the option to appear for the IES exam down the road. The hostel rooms need a change. We were allotted Jasper hostel, and the worst problem I face is that there's only one desk space, so if you're using the desk, your roommate has to study on their bed. This year's final year also has double sharing, which is very sad because you'll never get personal space in your uni life here.

reviews.review_title: Extremely happy seeing my dream of becoming an IITan come true.

detailed_review.Placements: The data on the placements here is good compared to the other 2 IITs. Many of our seniors are placed in foreign countries this year, and some also got high packages in India. Placement in the Mechanical department is expected to become low this year, as everywhere.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel is good. We are getting several facilities with computer labs, a Library, and Many lecture halls for studying. The full campus is Wi-Fi covered, and internet LAN cables are also available everywhere.  Inside the hostel, on every floor, a common room is also available for playing games, watching TV, and relaxing.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors here are very good in terms of teaching and providing study material. They are also highly qualified in their subjects and very humble and kind in nature. They are always ready to help and solve doubts. They also help during exam sessions by taking practice question classes.
detailed_review.Other: There is always something happening in college that helps us to get involved and feel a social presence for it.

reviews.review_title: This is the best university in Dhanbad.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT Dhanbad offers the best placement opportunities for students, this university has high placement rates. The highest package of this university is 70 LPA, and the lowest package is 50 LPA. Many companies like TCS, HCL, and Microsoft visit this university every year for placements. At least 70% is required for placement purposes.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this course is very good for the students. There are many facilities available in this university, like all-time Wi-Fi. There is a big library present in this university where students learn together. There is a big hostel with a calm and clean environment for the students. The food quality is also very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of this university is good for the students. They support students in every situation. The teaching quality is also very good. The course curriculum provided by this college is relevant for the students, which makes the students industry-ready. Many exams are organized in this university so they perform well in their sessional examinations.
detailed_review.Other: There are many fests and events organized in IIT Dhanbad for the students. This university also provides scholarship facilities for the students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: This is the best college in Jharkhand.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, IIT Dhanbad saw an overall placement rate of 76.36% for the 2024-25 academic year, with 70% placed and the highest package of 60 LPA and an average package of 13 LPA. The placement scenario varies by department, with Computer Science and Engineering achieving an 86.50% placement rate and Petroleum Engineering achieving a high of 93.33%. Major recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and Tata.

Student amenities include 24/7 healthcare, sports facilities like a swimming pool and gymnasium, and the student canteen offers spacious twin-sharing rooms with high-speed internet. This university is very good in all its facilities. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers of this university are helpful and Ph.D.-qualified, and they teach students in a very effective manner. They make hard concepts very easy. The course curriculum provided by this college is relevant to students, making them industry-ready. This university organizes numerous exams on campus, enabling students to perform well in the final examination. There is a 60% passing criterion.

There are many extracurricular activities organized at this college, like a sports fest, which is organized every year to build the aura of IIT Dhanbad students.

reviews.review_title: Best IIT for opting for core fields.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement of my branch is best among others because this college is mainly known for Mining of petroleum and Metallurgy as well as material engineering. Almost 90% students are placed every year with an average package of 12 LPA that goes to 34 LPA. Companies that come for this branch are mostly PSUs like Bharat Petroleum, ONGC, Indian Oil, and many more. Internships are offered to 80% students. They hire for a System Engineer and a manager role.

The library of this college is very big and has a large number of books. Hostel facilities are average, the canteen and mess food are not good in taste, but you can manage it. Medical and sports facilities are good, and students get opportunities to show their talent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are very well qualified and knowledgeable, as it should be in IITs. Every faculty is supporting students where they need guidance. Curriculum are much relevant to modern technology, and the application of theories is well executed in labs. Semester exams are not easy if you do not study from the start. Those who prepare earlier get passes easily. The numbers would be 90%.

reviews.review_title: My honest review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements used to be top-notch 2-3 years back. But with the increase of seats and slowdown in the mining sector, the job opportunities were not as good as before. Many reputed companies like KPMG, TATA Steel, PWC, Tata Consultant Engineers, Tega Industries, and Aditya Birla recruited through this branch. The maximum pay is 10 LPA, with an average around 4.5  LPA. I got selected for RINL Visakhapatnam for an internship. It was a non-stipend internship. Tata Steel also came for internships, and they eventually offered PPOs to some of the selected ones.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are 6 hostels for males and 2 for females. All the hostels are good, but I love Diamond Hostel because of the heritage it has. The rooms are spacious, and you need to share the room with one person. The hostel fees are included in your semester registration. The course curriculum is pretty good. It is well-structured and helps the students in getting a better understanding of the entire field.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course is basically about mineral processing techniques and the engineering involved in those processes. It is under the Fuel and Mineral Engineering department, which has good lab and research facilities. The faculty members are very qualified in the past, but since the last 2 years, some good professors have left, creating a void.

reviews.review_title: My honest review of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Being an IIT, the college has a full potential for placements. There is a nice exposure to MBA students for working in the core companies. There are many companies to work with. I did my summer internship at Turtle, India, and my winter internship at Coal India Limited. Both online with the HR course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are 6 hostels for males and 2 for females. All hostels are good but I love Diamond Hostel because of the heritage it has. Rooms are spacious and we need to share the room with one person. The hostel fee is included in our semester registration.
detailed_review.Faculty: It is a semester-based university. There is a credit-based education system, and it has a maximum of 10 credits. There are 75 marks for exams and the rest 25 marks are based on classroom performance, attendance, etc. Faculty members were very qualified in the past, but in the last 2 years, some good professors have left creating a void. The course is good but the focus is more on the theoretical aspects rather than practical. We have to take on our own initiative if we want to do something new and convenience the department once. If they are convinced, they will stand behind us to give their full support. The course curriculum is a bit outdated but professors bring lots of new topics for discussion. Pedagogy is also a bit outdated considering the fact that lots of other MBA institutes have innovative styles of teaching. Some courses are offered on a specific campus.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Electronics Engineering (Communication & Signal Processing) (SP)
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Dhanbad (ISM) - Indian Institute of Technology (ISM).

Highly paid companies like Citibank, Barclays, Google, Microsoft, and Amazon are on the list. They will be coming at the beginning to filter out the cream layer. There are companies like ICICI, Wipro, TCS, and Infosys, which come at the end to recruit students in bulk. There are core companies like Tejas Network, Sterlite, Tata Motors, etc visit our college to recruit the core students. Recently, our curriculum was reviewed, and my juniors have a completely new curriculum and courses. All the important and relevant courses are covered in this institute. The facilities in the hostel were good. We are provided with many activities there. There was a big TV room, table tennis, computer room, fine arts room, badminton court, and basketball court in each hostel. The mess food quality was good, and hygiene was well maintained by the college; that's the main thing I like about the hostel.

They are also well-experienced in their fields and give their best to bring the best out of the students. They have also written many research papers and published them in top-class journals. Most of the lecturers also have industry experience. Exams are being conducted with ease and dedication. Labs are well structured and well maintained by the end of the day, and one feels relaxed.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Dhanbad (ISM) - Indian Institute of Technology (ISM).

Top recruiters include companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and many more. 25% of students got internships from my course. Mostly in core companies, and every kind of role is offered.

Various canteens are there in every hostel. Vending machines are also installed. Medical facilities are good. Facilities are also really good for studying. Library is really big.

detailed_review.Other: I didn't choose this course, I got it through counseling. It's good though, really interesting.

reviews.review_title: IIT ISM Dhanbad College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: A high percentage of placements are available in my course. The lowest and highest packages from top companies range from 3 LPA to 16 LPA. Top recruiting companies are interested in this course. The percentage of internships in this course is 80% in top companies like Wipro and Railways.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has the best infrastructure compared to other colleges in the city. Wi-Fi is available all around the campus. Our classrooms are very clean. The library has good books. We have clean washrooms. The hostel does not have good facilities. The food is the worst. Sports are good.

The curriculum contains very old technologies, and the semester exams are not difficult. The situation is such that teachers do not cover the right portions and include different topics in the exams. The checking is not thorough, leading to difficulties for students during exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good placements in 2025.

The course curriculum is very good and makes students industry-ready. The semester exams do not feel so difficult, as the faculty's teaching is good enough to pass. The pass percentage is about 97%.
detailed_review.Other: Different kinds of fests are conducted in our college, like Srijan, the cultural fest, Parakram, the sports fest, Kanan, Concetto, etc. Students from different colleges are invited to participate in the fests conducted by our college. I chose this course because I am interested in developing both hardware and software knowledge.

reviews.review_title: A glimpse of my life at IIT Dhanbad (ISM).

detailed_review.Placements: Placement states are quite good in our college and in my course also which is 76.92% of 48 students which is quite good. The highest package offered for my course is 38 LPA and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 13 LPA, which is decent. Top recruiting companies are Reliance, Sun Petrochemicals, Chevron, etc. Internships are decent but it is hard to get an internship in my field, but some got in non-core. The top roles offered are process engineer, project engineer, product engineer, etc.

Our college library is the world's second-largest technical library. It has 24-hour Wi-Fi and classrooms are quite good. Labs are conducted in a very strict way. All basic needs are available in our college. Ground, medical center and canteen all are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly and teach us well. Their teaching style is a bit different as compared with others. About 14 weeks are allotted for a semester, which is enough to complete the syllabus and study. Some exams are very tough and some are a bit easy according to professors. The pass percentage is almost 90%.
detailed_review.Other: I love civil engineering, so I have opted for this course. There is a scholarship for merit students, i.e., MCM which offers Rs. 10,000 for a student. There are three major fests that happen in a year namely Concetto (tech fest), Srijan (cultural fest), and Parakram (sports fest). Some minor fests namely Turbulence, Khanan, etc., are also organised. The college life is quite good in my college.

reviews.review_title: My college, in my opinion.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of students are placed every year in my college. The highest package is about 20 LPA, and the lowest is about 6 LPA on campus. About 80% of students get internship opportunities, and they work very hard for them, acquiring good knowledge from this.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are quite good in my college, it is a tier 1 college in India. Hostels are quite poor, but students live peacefully here. Wi-Fi facility is also available, and students acquire good knowledge. The medical facilities are also available, which is good. You can go for it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good in my college. They are very supportive and help us both mentally and socially. The course curriculum also supports building a good future for engineers, but the semester exams are difficult. You can study throughout the year for good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I personally chose this college because of my interest. It is a reputed college in India and one of the top ones. It holds 2-3 annual fests, and we enjoy them along with our studies.

admission.title: IIT Dhanbad Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: IIT Dhanbad admissions are entrance-based for all of its offered courses. IIT Dhanbad , popularly known as ISM Dhanbad provides various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses across multiple specialisations. These programmes are offered in Engineering , Science , and Management . To get admission in any course at the institute, students need to register for the course in two stages, first at the official website of the concerned exam and second on the official website of IIT Dhanbad. Interested students can go through the following article to know all about the IIT ISM Dhanbad admissions.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to IIT Dhanbad BTech?
faqs.answer: Below is the IIT Dhanbad BTech admission process: Application: To get admission in IIT Dhanbad BTech course, candidates have to fill the online application form must and check the eligibility criteria of each course before filling the form. Entrance Exam: Candidates seeking admission need to take JEE Main exam and then JEE Advanced. Aspirants need to qualify both the entrance exams to be considered for JoSAA Counselling. Counselling & Seat Allotment: Further, the students who secure the cutoff marks are called for JoSAA Counselling, based on which the seat allotment is carried out.

faqs.question: What is the IIT Dhanbad cutoff for all categories in the JEE Advanced 2025?
faqs.answer: NTA has released round 1 of the JEE Advanced scores for candidates seeking admission to BTech, Integrated BTech and other courses. For IIT Dhanbad, the cutoff ranks in the first round varied between 3348 and 15969 , for General AI category candidates, for admission to different courses and specialisations. The toughest specialisation among the General AI category candidates was B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering . The cutoff range for different category are given in the table below:

faqs.question: Does IIT (ISM) Dhanbad accept JEE Mains?
faqs.answer: Yes, admission to BTech courses at IIT Dhanbad is only through Joint Entrance Examination (JEE). Candidates seeking admission must pass JEE Main, students selected further need to take JEE Advanced. Based on the score secured in JEE Advanced, students are called for JoSAA Counselling. Aspirants are offered seat based on their rank. JoSAA releases a cutoffs round-wise for students. Aspirants securing the cutoff rank or above can take admission by blocking the seat. Aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the BTech course of IIT Dhanbad.

faqs.question: What if I can't get into IIT Dhanbad for BTech?
faqs.answer: Not getting into IIT Dhanbad or any other top IIT should not be considered an end to a student’s career . While IIT Dhanbad average package is INR 20.79 LPA for its 2024 placements batch, can IIT Dhanbad guarantee the same for each and every student of the batch? The answer is no. Vellore Institute of Technology Vellore was established in 1984 in Vellore, Tamil Nadu and is a private research university. reviews.review_title: I am satisfied because of the good infrastructure and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: So, coming to the placements in BCA, the eligible CGPA for placements is above 8. If 9, it is better as about 94 percent of students get placed, as the recruiter company conducts its own exam to get into their company. The package offered ranges from 3-7 LPA for the BCA course. The college will not provide internships. We have to search for internships. The top role offered is developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. In VIT, all students will have the same facilities that will not differ. Our college infrastructure is a very good place to study. It will provide Wi-Fi only in the library. Hostels have their specific range, like single person per room, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 sharing rooms. The hostel fee may vary, and for 7 days, they will provide different kinds of food in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified. They will teach according to students perspective. There are only a few teachers, as they just read the PPT and run away. The BCA subjects are the same as the M.Tech and B.Tech syllabus in VIT. They make us study in depth. BCA students have a low syllabus compared to B.Tech and M.Tech. Exams are moderate because they will ask scenario questions and not direct questions.
detailed_review.Other: I have to finish my studies, and I want to prepare for the government examination, so I chose this course. VIT will conduct many events, and the Reviera is famous for that.

reviews.review_title: Companies hire for R&D roles.

detailed_review.Placements: Major offers for exceptional roles like research and development are provided by companies like Schlumberger, 3M, and GE Appliances, considering the invite card of our college for recruitment drives. Two kinds of packages are offered by a few companies for the top and lower roles. Some other core companies like Hitachi Energy and Intel also participate in the drives.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Leave intimation, on-duty, and other emergencies require the intimation of the parents. Otherwise, we are not allowed anywhere. Transportation modes like the college bus and public transport such as bus, auto, and cab are available frequently. Mini stationery is available for students to purchase randomly needed things to avoid frequent movement outside the institution.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members shine like a star with their phenomenal qualifications and years of experience. Faculty members do not matter about the students' previous image and their background. They are very clear that their profession is to teach the students. Faculty members are busy with everyday portions, and there is no time for them to take leave.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and faculty, but getting a placement is as difficult as JEE.

detailed_review.Placements: Due to the number of students in this college are in large numbers, placement is very competitive and hard to get. Packages vary from 3.2 LPA to 1 crore per annum, but it all depends on your skills, and the average would be around 7 LPA. Almost all the companies visit our college, from mass recruiters to FAANG.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As I am from the main campus, the infrastructure here is top-notch, and the facilities provided are enough for a 4-year comfortable stay. We have multiple messes here, so the taste may vary depending on the caterers, but overall it is fine. Our college has an outdoor stadium and an indoor complex, including 5 gymnasiums in total.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are highly qualified and are really helpful. They guide us through many things to boost our careers, like helping with projects or writing research papers. The course curriculum is up to date with the latest technologies taught in the curriculum, making students learn what is future-proof. The passing percentage is 60 percent, including internals. If internals are not included, then it is 40 percent, including the final exam.
detailed_review.Other: Our college provides scholarships for those who score below 1000 rank in VITEEE and also maintain a CGPA above 8.0. We host one cultural fest and one technical fest each year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied with this college.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% of students who got an opportunity to sit in placements are placed. Placements are decent at VIT Vellore. The package varies from 4 LPA to 1.02 CPA. It depends on the skill set of the student. Top recruiting companies include Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Benz, and many more. VIT lacks internship opportunities. The top role offered in the CSE core is a software engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very well-maintained by the VIT team. Classrooms are very well-maintained with projectors installed in every class. The labs are built with proper equipment and are loaded with ACs. Hostels are well-maintained and well-furnished. The mess food varies from hostel to hostel. VIT has excellent sports facilities, as it contains 3 gyms, 3 basketball courts, and many more facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and well-educated. The course is well-designed by professionals to make a student industry-ready. Exams are not that competitive, but maintaining a CGPA in CSE is quite tough as there's a lot of competition here. VIT conducts 3 exams within a semester. 2 of them are closed-book, and one is an open-book exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at VIT Vellore is full of memories.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a 2026 batch student studying B.Tech CSE–IoT. Last year, almost 99% of students who sat for placements got placed. This year, placements are still ongoing. The highest CTC is 1.0 crore, the lowest is around 3–4 LPA, and the average is 9–10 LPA. Top recruiters include Motorq, PhonePe, PayPal, Amazon, Meesho, RingCentral, Marvel, and Microsoft.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are top-notch. Students need a good rank or a roommate with a good rank to choose better hostel blocks and rooms. Food in Vellore is not bad, and some caterers like SRRC and Darling are very good. For sports and games, there are both outdoor and indoor stadiums inside the hostel area.

admission.overview_text:
VIT Vellor's admission 2026 is based on the entrance exam for the majority of the courses.The institute conducts VITEEE for BTech., VITMEE for MTech and VITREE for PhD admission. For VIT Vellore admissions, candidates need to appear in either of the exams and qualify for the Personal Interview round for the final selection. The admission criteria generally involve an online application, an entrance exam, shortlisting of candidates, counselling and document verification, followed by fee payment to secure a seat. faqs.question: Are admissions to VIT (Vellore) solely based on the VITEEE?
faqs.answer: The institute conducts VITEEE for BTech admission, VITMEE for M.Tech admissions and VITREE for PhD admission. The institute accepts national-level entrance exams like CAT, XAT, MAT, GMAT, CMAT, ATMA, etc., for MBA course. However, admission to a few other courses, including BSc, BSc (Hons), BCA, BCom, MSc, MCA, among others, is based on the aggregate obtained by the candidates in previous qualifying degree/ exam (merit-based). After passing the entrance exam, aspirants are called further rounds of selection. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for counselling and document verification round.

faqs.question: What is the selection criteria for VIT Vellore BDes?
faqs.answer: VIT Vellore offers BDes with a duration of four years. Candidates seeking admission to BDes courses must pass Class 10 and Class 12 from a recognised board. faqs.question: What is the fee for BTech at VIT University?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for VIT Vellore BTech ranges between INR 4.9 lakh and 7.8 lakh . The total course fee, includes a caution deposit of INR 3,000 as well. The fee will vary as per the specialisation selected by the candidates. BTech is available in 24 specialisations, namely Computer Science and Engineering (Bioinformatics), Mechanical Engineering , Information Technology, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, etc. Aspirants are required to pay the course fee after completion of all the selection rounds to confirm their seats. Candidates can pay the registration fee via any of the online payment mode. The application fee is INR 1350.

faqs.question: What is the total fee for VIT Vellore BCom programme?

faqs.question: How much percentage is required to get admission in VIT Vellore?

faqs.question: How can I take admission to VIT Vellore BTech course?
faqs.answer: Admission to VIT BTech course is based on VITEEE score, followed by a counselling round. Vellore Institute of Technology Engineering Entrance Examination is conducted by the Vellore Institute of Technology every year for admission to undergraduate engineering courses (BTech) of participating institutes. Every year, VITEEE is held to get students enrolled in various undergraduate courses. VIT also considers the eligibility of the aspirants for final admission. After completion of the selection rounds, the institute releases a merit list to announce the names of the shortlisted candidates. The shortlisted aspirants are called for counselling and document verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.question: Is it easy to get into VIT Vellore for BTech course?
faqs.answer: Admission to the VIT Vellore B.Tech course is based on the VITEEE score. VIT Engineering Entrance Exam is a computer-based test conducted for a duration of 2 hours and 30 minutes. The VITEEE question paper consists of 125 questions. The questions will be based on Maths, Physics, Chemistry, English and Aptitude. The shortlisted aspirants are called for counselling and document verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

faqs.question: How to get VIT Vellore MBA admission?
faqs.answer: The institute shortlists candidates for MBA course based on national-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, GMAT, CMAT, NMAT or ATMA. The shortlisted aspirants are further required to come for the PI round. Vellore Institute of Technology will also consider the academic performance and work experience of the candidates for final selection. Candidates who have passed regular, full-time UG/ Integrated degree from a recognised institute/ university of at least three years of duration with a minimum of 60% aggregate (50% for SC/ ST candidates and applicants belonging to Jammu & Kashmir and North-Eastern states of Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim and Tripura) can apply for the MBA course. After the completion of the selection rounds, the shortlisted aspirants are called for counselling. Selected aspirants need to pay a fee to confirm their admission. To know more about the admission process for MBA course, click here .

faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for MBA at VIT Business School Vellore?
faqs.answer: VIT Business School admisison for MBA entrance exams like CAT, XAT, MAT. It also considers personal interview and academic merit. Work experience works as an added advantage during the final selection. Candidates are evaluated based on eligibility, entrance exam scores and their performance in PI rounds.

faqs.question: Is MBA available at VIT Vellore?
faqs.answer: Yes, MBA is a two-year course divided into four semesters. Vellore Institute of Technology offers MBA in six specialisations, namely Finance, Marketing, Business Analytics, Human Resource Management, General Management and Production and Operation Management. MBA course is designed with a Curriculum for Applied Learning (CAL) and executes in a trimester pattern with a Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS). Students can avail of credit transfer options to foreign universities and foreign internships as per their choice. Also, the course is accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) and the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programs (ACBSP).

faqs.question: What is the fees for MBA in VIT Vellore?
faqs.answer: VIT Vellore MBA tuition fees, including the first and second year, are INR 7 lakh. Students who are selected in the MBA admission process have to pay the course fees. The admission of the student will stand cancelled if he / she is unable to pay the fee within the specified time. Also, students have to pay the registration fees. VIT MBA registration fee is INR 1,200. Candidates can pay the registration fee via any of the online payment modes. The information is taken from the website of VIT Vellore and is subject to change.

faqs.question: What is the admission criteria for M.Tech at VIT Vellore?
faqs.answer: The VIT Vellore M.Tech admission process is completely entrance-based. Candidates are offered admission based on VITMEE exam, which is conducted at the university-level by VIT. Students need to qualify the exam to proceed to further selection rounds. The shortlisted candidates are offered final admission based on their performance in PI round.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: VIT Vellore is one of the prestigious institution in India that aim to provide quality higher education on par with international standards. It persistently seeks and adopts innovative methods to improve the quality of higher education on a consistent basis. The campus has a cosmopolitan atmosphere with students from all corners of the globe. Experienced and learned teachers are strongly encouraged to nurture the students. The global standards set at VIT in the field of teaching and research spur us on in our relentless pursuit of excellence.

Spread across a vast area of 372 acres, VIT Campus is a state-of-the-art infrastructure for both students and faculty. VIT Vellore campus has fully furnished and well-equipped labs. Moreover, the campus is fortified with plenty of features that support events, an auditorium, plus open spaces, outdoor stages and more. A notable feature of VIT is the well-planned and comprehensive premises provided for both students and faculty. Seven academic blocks in VIT are extremely specialised in their particular field. The layout has been excellently planned to make the optimum utilisation of the 372-acre campus. Read on to learn more about the VIT Vellore campus, hostel, student life, and more.

sections.heading: VIT Vellore Infrastructure Highlights
text: A striking feature of VIT is the well-planned and comprehensive premises provided for both students and faculty. There are seven academic blocks in VIT which are extremely specialised in their particular field, namely- MB , GDN , CDMM , SMV , CBMR , TT , SJT and GANDHI BLOCK . The layout has been excellently planned to make the maximum utilisation of the 372-acre campus. The idea behind these separate blocks is to make every block equipped with the necessary amenities whilst providing the perfect atmosphere for both studies and research.

VIT Vellore is a home away from home; the hostels of VIT are designed to provide comfortable and safe living. The campus has 24 hostels , out of which 18 blocks are designated for boys and the rest are for girls. The block in total caters to over 22,000 residents every year.

paragraphs: Each year, Vellore Institute of Technology offers scholarships in the form of tuition waivers and freeships. While merit scholarships are awarded to class toppers, economically challenged students are provided need-based financial assistance. Furthermore, NRI and foreign students are given scholarships upon presenting meritorious records. Students from rural backgrounds who secure top ranks in VITEEE at the district level (in Tamil Nadu only) are given free education.

Students who wish to pursue MTech are also given scholarships, given that they score well in the GATE exam. In addition, scholarships are given to students who excel in sports and games. Financial assistance is also provided to students who wish to do their project work in partner universities and institutions abroad, under the Semester Abroad Programme (SAP). In order to encourage the students to pursue active research, VIT also awards appropriate research associateships to meritorious and needy students.

reviews.review_title: Insights of NIT Karnataka.

detailed_review.Placements: Nitk mechanical is the best among all NITs in the QRF ranking. It has a placement rate of about 85 percent. Major core companies that came for placements this year were Apple for mechanical with a minor in ECE, L&T, Bajaj, Suzuki, ONGC, and HPCL. IN 2025 the average package for mechanical is 15 LPA. Internship opportunities are abundant across branches with a stipend of roughly  20k  to 1 Lakh per month and many PPOs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mechanical depth of Nitk has one of the best infrastructures among all departments. It has all the research related facilities, specialized labs like CAD/CAM, Internal combustion engines, and advanced research labs in areas such as strength of materials, robotics etc. Hostels have double and triple sharing rooms with 2 common washrooms on each floor. Ethernet facility for the internet.
detailed_review.Faculty: Nitk has very experienced faculty members. Associate professors specializing in areas like advanced manufacturing, composite materials, tribology, machines design. The course curriculum is designed in a way that makes a student industry ready. The first 3 semesters of mechanical are a bit easy. It gets difficult after the 3rd semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am very interested with automobile. NITK has the best mechanical department among all NITs. There are 3 cultural fests that are conducted every year. The main annual fest is Incident which is held in March.

reviews.review_title: The course is very unique and offers good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, HSBC, Wells Fargo, Arcesium, L&T, Amazon, and ExxonMobil were among the firms that visited. IT/Software firms paid an average of 14 LPA, with the maximum compensation being about 50 LPA. Many PSUs paid approximately 16 LPA for core roles. The management was also very supportive in providing placement training.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the hostel, all facilities were provided in the rooms. The rooms were spacious. First- and second-year students shared rooms with 2 or 3 people, and later they got single rooms. All types of sports like basketball, volleyball, cricket, badminton, swimming, and powerlifting were available. There were also many cultural and technical clubs, which won cups and prizes in competitions. The classrooms were spacious, with charging points and Wi-Fi connections throughout the campus. Classrooms had proper smart boards, and some even had ACs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were good. They were highly educated and experienced. They had all completed their post-graduation. The course content was fantastic. Faculty was highly adaptable to the changing environment and incredibly knowledgeable. Some of the work created by NITK academics was used in colleges throughout Karnataka and India. I found a plethora of practical topics here from the outset and learned a lot.

reviews.review_title: Good college, infrastructure, and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: From the 2nd semester, we are eligible to get internships, so along with many students, we can get PPO. The number of companies visited is all there on the NITK website, but placement is good. In my course, the highest package is 10 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA, and the average is 5 LPA-6 LPA. In my course, around 85-90 percent of students get placed. I wanted a job in a pharmaceutical company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are top-notch, and all facilities, like projectors and smart boards, are available. The library is good, and all types of books and magazines are available. Hostels are good. There are 2-seated and 3-seated rooms. There are different grounds for different sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members have good qualifications, but some courses are not relevant to us, so it is very difficult to understand. So we are thinking that the faculty is not good. In my course, two faculty members are good. They always focus on good teaching with industry knowledge, others just come and teach Maths and go.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: For B.Tech and MCA placements are good. MCA students get an average package of 10-12 LPA. Big companies like Amazon, Flipkart, Microsoft, Infosys, Samsung, and many more visit the campus. Around 250 companies come for MCA placements alone. Overall good placement experience here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels have facilities like Wi-Fi, drinking water, light, fans, and beds. The classrooms are air-conditioned, and the central library is well-equipped for borrowing books. The mess food is average, but there are three canteens serving really tasty fast food. There is also a small sports field for volleyball, football, and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers have good experience and qualifications. They mainly support students preparing for placements. Many subjects focus on the financial sector, especially accounting and auditing. Overall, the staff is capable and usually delivers good results.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Surathkal College.

detailed_review.Placements: Roughly 85 percent of students got placed, with about 6% opted for masters programs. The highest salary package reached 64 LPA, while the lowest was 6 LPA. Big names like Amazon, AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Qualcomm, Nvidia, DE Shaw, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley were all on the list of recruiters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Now, our course definitely benefits from some great facilities and infrastructure. The campus had a central library, Wi-Fi access, and digital classrooms, which was nice. The hostel accommodation was quite good, and the meals were pretty tasty, whether you were eating at the mess or the canteen. Don't forget the multi-sports complex!
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers here had solid experience and good qualifications. The ones who got the most support, definitely the students aiming for job placements. The subjects were mostly entered around the financial sector, especially in areas like accounting and auditing. Overall, the staff seems pretty capable and tends to achieve great results.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology, Suratkal

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students are placed in my course in my college. The highest package is 80 LPA offered in my course, the average package is 30 LPA, offered in my course, and the lowest package is 10 LPA offered in my course. 90% of students got internships from my course in my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is provided and very useful for networking. In labs, AC and projectors are provided. Classrooms are good, and AC and projectors are provided for display. The library is good and provides AC and projectors. Hostel is good, with quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good in teaching. They approach students in a friendly manner. They are very knowledgeable, and teaching is good. In the semester, we have two mid exams and a final exam. The pass percentage of exams is 40%, we need to get 40% marks in the final exam only to pass the entire semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Surathkal College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Over 95% of our students land jobs after graduation from our college. This year, the highest salary package from my branch hit around 50 LPA, while the average for core electrical engineering was about 15 LPA. The big names doing the recruiting include Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Nvidia, Tata, TCS, Jio, and a whole bunch more. Its worth noting that nearly all students who applied for internships got one, but those who did not throw their hat in the bring brought the overall internship numbers down a bit.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi was available all across campus, and the hostels have LAN, too. The labs were fully stocked and really good. The library had over 200,000 books on just about every topic you can think of. I would have to say, when it comes to food, I would give it a 2 out of 5. The medical and sports facilities were pretty solid overall. The second year student hostels arena. It was the best, but the others were just fine. The food was decent, too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers had solid qualifications and extensive teaching experience. Our course fits well within our environment. The semester exams were pretty tough, so getting a good grade requires some serious effort. So, overall, the faculty members were good and approachable.

reviews.review_title: NIT Surathkal College review.

detailed_review.Placements: In the mechanical engineering department, it was impressive. Over half, and sometimes even up to 80% of students, land jobs every year. Some of the big players that came looking for fresh talent include GAIL, HPCL, BPCL, BHEL, and MRPL, just to name a few. We had graduates snagging positions at dream companies like Reliance, Tata, Samsung, and Bajaj, too. Internships, companies like Caterpillar, JSW Steel, and Rather Energy were regulars around here. It was a great time to be part of this field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus includes all the essential academic and research buildings, a central library, well equipped labs, and classrooms with Wi-Fi. Students could use residential facilities and dining halls. The hostel accommodation was generally seen as satisfactory. The food in the mess was just average. It was a health center with medical professionals available, in case someone got sick.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching staff was made up of qualified individuals with a solid grasp of their subjects. They get creative with their methods, which keeps students engaged. They often used storytelling and discussions to explain concepts. The curriculum was spot on, and students who were well versed in the material usually ace their exams.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely a good college in order to learn, with better infrastructure and good placements in 2026.

detailed_review.Placements: In civil engineering, we have 70% placed in different companies, and rest are for higher studies like M.Tech, MBA, M.Sc. Our college placement cell, CDC, has been doing great work for past 3-4 years. Highest package is 22 LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Top recruiting company is BPCL. 30% of students got internships, and top roles are associate engineering and supply chain.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure in our college has been developing over last 4 years. We got new hostels this year, and last year they inaugurated a new lecture hall. Wi-Fi is pretty good, and labs are maintained and equipped with the latest machines. Classroom has good ventilation and proper spacing, with a smart board also. We also have 2 libraries, one of which is 24hrs open. Food quality in mess is normal, and canteen has good food also. We have a medical centre, also with all types of doctors available. We have many grounds in college for sports, such as indoor and outdoor as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and qualified. Teaching quality is also modernized, like they teach on a smart board and also on a blackboard. For my branch of civil Engineering, the course curriculum is enough to be qualified as a civil engineer. Semester exams are of a moderate to hard level. Pass percentage is like 90%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the Civil Engineering course from JoSAA counseling through JEE main exam. Best things in civil engineering course are labs and practical training. Everything is fine with my course. Civil Engineering connection is with many other colleges, and they also conduct many events in college just to discuss and prepare necessary improvements for civil Engineering sector.

reviews.review_title: NIT Surathkal College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all of the students who signed up for our course got placed, except a few who wanted to go for higher studies. The highest package is 48 LPA, and the average is around 10 LPA. Moreover, around 80% of students received internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good, with good facilities for sports and academics. LAN ports are available for connection to the public Ethernet, which is unlimited. Various events are well-organized on our campus, and different clubs provide different opportunities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified with great experience. The teaching quality is Excellent. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry ready. Semester exams are neither easy as well as not too difficult. The pass percentage is 50% of the class average marks.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Surathkal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: All I want to say about placements is that mechanical students tend to get selected more into non-core, management, and other sectors than into core mechanical roles. So, yes, the placements look good on paper, but you need to realize there aren't many jobs available, and even if there are, they don't pay well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are pretty decent. The first-year boys' hostel is basic, but after that, the second-year Shivalik hostel is basically a hotel. The third and fourth-year single rooms are excellent. I think you won't be disappointed with them. They are better than most government colleges, though they have some issues too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college offers a basic engineering education. It's the same as every other college, with nothing new an old curriculum that's recycled repeatedly. The teachers try to teach, but their assistants (TAs) often outperform them in teaching quality. It's pretty standard. Like every other college, there's nothing particularly innovative.

reviews.review_title: Great campus life with good placement and private rooms, a place like heaven for engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements here are good. From 2019-2023, there was almost 99% placement in the IT department, and in 2024, about 91% students were placed in the IT department. The highest salary varies from 55 LPA-62 LPA, the average was about 24 LPA, and the median was about 21 LPA. Companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Morgan Stanley, Dell, etc., are major recruiters. Most of the roles offered are developer. Around 30%-40% of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are enough buildings for classrooms. Wi-Fi is available throughout campus through captive portal login. Two libraries with air conditioners are available. There are 3 grounds. Two sports complexes are too good. 12 boys' hostels and 5 girls' hostels are available. Mess food is decent. We get both vegetarian and non-vegetarian mess. 3-night canteens are available, which serve midnight. There is a food court too. We also get a private one. Campus has a good connection to road (NH66), which runs between the campus, splitting it in two. There are guest houses available. Overall, very good infrastructure.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are well-qualified. The teaching is not that good I would say. Curriculum is relevant to the existing trend, and also makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are decent, not too hard or easy. Pass percentage varies from 20% marks to 30% marks. There is a grading system in NIT Surathkal. Semester can be balanced with other activities.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course out of my interest in the IT field. The best thing is that it's a chill branch and provides all the CSE courses for a slightly lower cutoff. Placements are top-notch. Some professors don't take classes properly and don't give deserving marks. This could be improved. Incidentally, our cultural fest is India's second-biggest fest. Engineer is our technical fest. All the fest events are too good to experience. There are also other events. Many scholarships are provided by institutions as well as private organizations. Scope is given for extracurricular activities like dance, music, art, etc.

reviews.review_title: It is a awesome college.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students got placed in my college is approximately 97%. The highest package is 52 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is 15 LPA-18 LPA. The recruiting companies are too good, and they can achieve bigger and bigger choices.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Scenic & well-equipped A 295-acre beachside campus featuring private access, lush green zones, and world-class sports facilities including swimming pool, tennis courts, gyms, and stadium. Everything is good, having this kind of college is okay. Mess food is decent.
detailed_review.Faculty: NITK Surathkal is one of India's premier engineering institutions, particularly strong in core and technical branches due to its excellent faculty, research environment, natural campus, and placement success, if you're up for a slightly high. Faculty of AI isn't that good, most we have to do is self-study.
detailed_review.Other: There are no academic or cultural restrictions.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College has all the required things for students in all terms.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is always above 90% among the eligible students. Top companies like Microsoft, Adobe, and Oracle. It depends on the student's choice and their exploration in getting internships and top roles in any company. Students' abilities can drive them to get internships from outside also.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is a little issue sometimes we get some suffering, but mostly we don't face it. It is not a big thing to be concerned about everywhere it's common. Everything is fine but sometimes there is an issue of food poisoning and all. We have good medical facilities and have an HCC inside the college open 24 hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and very friendly in teaching. Every course is useful for us and makes us better. Pass percentage is above 85%. Students abilities are tested in exams so it is important that every student has to be legit and cross that minimum mark. In many cases, malpractice is the reason for their failures so it's all the students' fault in this type of situation. But some lectures don't give marks though we are eligible sometimes it's really hard.
detailed_review.Other: CSE is always a great course for those who have an interest in coding and that driven me to choose this option. Better ways of teaching the basics more carefully. All the activities are good. But if the budget is more than I guess that you will be more productive and useful for us in all terms.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure with excellent sports facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 70% of the students got placed. The average package is 19 LPA while the highest is 52 LPA. For my course ECE, Qualcomm and Texas Instruments are major recruiters. Hardware engineer and analyst roles are offered. I am not very aware of the internships and all but placement wise it is good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We cannot use Wi-Fi in our hostel but we have LAN facility in our rooms. Hostel facilities are good while mess food is not that good. Sports facilities are amazing, especially cricket. We have cricket kit, nets, etc. There is a health care center within the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly knowledgeable and they teach well. Semester exams can be cleared by studying a night before the exam. As far as I heard from the seniors, the course is relevant and makes students industry-ready. Teachers are friendly and they are keen to share their knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: I heard from a lot of people that NITK is one of the top institutes, and ECE branch at NITK has good demand. Events will depend on the people you have selected in the student council selection. Government gives scholarships to people whose income is below 1 lakh.

reviews.review_title: Good faculty members and infrastructure, near to sea, and have beach also.

detailed_review.Placements: In my branch IT, more than 95% of students got placed. We have courses in every domain of IT sector, so students can choose which fits and is good for them.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have few decent hostels and few good hostels. It has very good classrooms and few very good labs, libraries with AC and non-AC rooms, large number of books, and sufficient timings. We have Wi-Fi all over the campus, even on ground also, and in rooms we have Wi-Fi LAN ports also. We have very good labs, high-speed internet everywhere.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have very good and experienced faculty members who are doing some research in their respective fields. They will be available most of the time physically, and we can contact them anytime by mail, etc. Exams are also in a very well-planned manner. Each year, we have very decent faculty members.
detailed_review.Other: We have 2 very big events, engineer and incident. Incident is the second-largest fest in South India. Those 2 will be around 3 and 4 days each.

reviews.review_title: It is best college for engineers.

detailed_review.Placements: Percentage of students placed is 30/43 (70) on campus, around 10 in GATE, and rest in further studies. Top recruiting companies are Vedanta, JSW, Chettinad Cement, Ramco Cement, and Aditya Birla Group. Top roles offered are graduate management trainee, analyst, and design engineer. The highest package is 36 LPA. The lowest package is 6 LPA. The average salary is 13 LPA. Internship is only 1, he is our class average student, and not a topper.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure wise NITK is best. It has good hostels. Nice way to live and enjoy student college life. Wi-Fi connectivity is also good and no issues. Moreover, library has nice way to read and makes it a decent learning environment. Quality of hostels and mess is upto the mark and not an issue at all. We all have to just slightly adjust to the taste of the food and not the quality. Good medical facilities are provided. Sports facilities are good. There is a great culture for students to live and enjoy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors in mining engineering are highly qualified and have more knowledge in practical terms. Thus they always welcome any kind of event conducting or organizing workshops. Course curriculum is slightly older version and thus needs to be modified. Luckily, the course curriculum is now modified by 2025. Semester exams are not that difficult, and a week before the exam is sufficient.
detailed_review.Other: NITK was my choice it was my go to college because I loved the place. I belong to the same place and I love the nature around and so it is upto my expectations. Best thing about my course is my friends, well to be precise the most suitable reason would be the home-like department and the professors who support me. Improvement is just that lab should be maintained a little more upto newer generation. Regarding the connectivity, crowd, campus, surroundings, scholarships, and extracurricular activities, I would just say that its awesome.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best way to live a life and life in NITK.

detailed_review.Placements: We have an electrical and electronics engineering branch in NITK which is one of the first branches in our institute. Around 80% of students get placed on campus every year and this year it is not an exception. The highest package is 44 LPA and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 18 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course include Texas Instruments, ARM, Bajaj, Sony, Samsung, Philips, etc. A majority of students get placed as embedded engineers, graduate engineers, and trainees. Around 30% of students got internships and are majorly in analyst roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, it is very good. We have sophisticated labs, a well-deserved learning environment, and classrooms with AC. Availability of Wi-Fi and classrooms are also present in it. The library is also in good condition with more books. Sports and games are also given good priority and thus are more entertaining.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly responsible, intellectually brilliant, and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant and has no gist in it. Semester exams are difficult and require around a week of preparation for it. The pass percentage is 20%.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to become an electrical engineer from early on and I got 10,000 rank in JEE so I took EEE in NITK. The best thing in the course is that we have more projects that are practically more related. Things which can improve about our course are that labs are way more hectic in a course having 5 to 6 credits. Events are way good. The campus crowd is also nicely populated. Extracurricular activities are always conducted here.

reviews.review_title: You will have a pretty good memories in 4 years. Placement in civil is not appreciable.

detailed_review.Placements: Our placement is yet to begin. As far as we know from our senior batch, the placement percentage of civil is one of the lowest of all the branches. Most roles offered are managerial ones. An average package of 8 LPA is offered, as far as I remember it properly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Most of our civil department labs are good, especially the Hydraulics Laboratory. Our classroom is still old-fashioned. There are old, typical wooden benches. There have been new rooms, but we hardly get to have class in that one. Wi-Fi facilities have been removed recently in hostels, and we are using LAN connections. I have hardly accessed the library, so I can't comment more on that. But we have 2-3 libraries with good facilities and accommodation for students and teachers. Mess food is average in most cases. Medical facilities are good, and they operate fast in emergencies.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers are well-qualified. Some courses I feel like are outdated (like geology lab, drawing) unless you pursue a Ph.D. Some courses are relevant for the coming years. Curriculum doesn't make students industry-ready. Semester exams are good. The pass percentage is above 90% in most of the courses.
detailed_review.Other: I didn't choose this course rather, I got it by chance. The course should be changed a lot to make it even interesting and helpful towards the industry. Events and fests are very good. Extracurricular activities take place frequently. The campus surroundings are very good.

reviews.review_title: It has a world-class infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 100% of students get placed in our course. The package offered in our course ranges from 10-12 LPA mostly. The highest package is 32 LPA in our course. The top recruiting companies that visited our college are Larsen & Toubro, GMR Infrastructure, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely awesome. A Wi-Fi facility is present on the whole campus. A huge library is available in the college for studying. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is good like fresh drinking water, clean washrooms, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their own field of education. The teaching quality of our faculty members is extremely great. The course curriculum is relevant. Students become ready to work in real industry. Semester examinations are a little hard.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: Admission to the courses at the institute is entrance-based. The institute accepts national-level exam scores (for example, JEE Mains/GATE/IIT JAM). Aspirants can fill out the accepted entrance test application. Further, based on exam scores and performance in the round of counselling, seats are allotted to eligible students in NIT Surathkal. faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: Is NIT Surathkal good for BTech?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is a good institute for BTech. In 2022, as per media reports, the institute has recorded a placement rate of 93% for BTech. Moreover, the highest and average package offered in NITK BTech placement 2022 was INR 45.03 LPA and INR 23.03 LPA, respectively. The technology institute is ranked 10 as per the NIRF rankings among the top “Engineering” colleges in India. Check below for more reviews by the prominent students of NIT Surathkal for the BTech course:

faqs.question: What is the admission procedure for the BTech programme at NIT Surathkal?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech programme at NITK Surathkal is done basis of JEE Main score and JoSAA Counselling. If the seats are left vacant after JoSAA counselling, then the seats are filled out through CSAB counselling. Apart from this, applicants must meet the minimum eligibility as well, which is at least 75% in Class 12 or an equivalent examination.

highlights.summary:
Jadavpur University, also kown as JU, is a state-level public university of Kolkata, West Bengal formed in 1955. The university is approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), and is accredited with an 'A+' grade by the NAAC. Jadavpur University is also a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
Jadavpur University Kolkata has been ranked in NIRF 2025 Rankings across multiple categories. It has been ranked 1, 9, and 18 in the 'State Public University', 'University', and 'Overall' categories, respectively. The university has 2 campuses, the Jadavpur campus sprawls over 56 acres, and the Salt Lake campus spawls over 26 acres.
Jadavpur University offers several UG, PG, PhD, certificate, and diploma courses across streams such as management, engineering, science, humanities, commerce, pharmacy, architecture, education, etc. Majority of the courses at Jadavpur University are accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA). The courses are further offered across numerous specialistions in full-time mode.
