reviews.review_title: Excellent academic and corporate grooming.

detailed_review.Placements: At JD Birla Institute, everyone is eligible for a placement, but most of the students pursue an MBA, or they join family businesses, bringing the percentage down around 15-60 percent. The highest package is 9 LPA and the average is 5 LPA-6 LPA. The top recruiting companies include EY, Deloitte, HSBC Bank, and Amazon. In my batch, 100 percent of students got internships at top companies, such as TCS and Exide Industries. Top roles offered are business analyst, financial manager, account manager, HR, marketing, and sales executive.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is well regarded for maintaining a corporate-like environment, which is suitable for management studies. Classrooms are air-conditioned with smart boards. A fully automated library with quite a variety of books. Fully equipped computer lab with the latest software and Wi-Fi on campus. There are no official hostels, most students stay in nearby paying guests. The college has a very hygienic canteen. The college has an in-house infirmary. Sports facilities include a badminton court and a recreational area, including table tennis, football, and carrom board. While the college is very compact in terms of area.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at JD Birla is quite good. The teachers here are highly qualified and have quite a lot of experience in teaching. The college follows the New Education Policy (NEP). It includes subjects like digital marketing, Excel, and business analytics. While in practical exposure, students have a 6-week internship, soft skills sessions, and field visits, making them industry-ready. The exams are moderate the papers are set by Jadavpur University and are evaluated by them. The pass percentage is often near 100 percent. The college also requires 60 percent compulsory attendance.
detailed_review.Other: I chose BBA as it is considered one of the top private management institutes in Kolkata. The best things about my course are corporate grooming and an industry-aligned curriculum. Networking areas of improvement are campus-size-limited extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University has a legacy of more than a century.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in the department are among the best in the state and region after IIT KGP. Usually, the average placement percentage for interested students stays above 85–90%, which is good considering this is a core department. The average package in recent years is around 7–11 LPA and varies greatly depending on peer quality. Core packages include most chemical engineering core companies like Vedanta, pharmaceutical companies, Exide, and others, along with PSUs and various other firms. On average, core packages are around 6–9 LPA. Some companies offer 12+ LPA, and PSU salaries are higher. Non-core packages are around 10–14 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department is well-equipped with all kinds of labs and necessary teaching resources. As I am not very familiar with the facilities offered by IITs and NITs, I would rate mine as 4/5. This department was the first in Asia and receives a lot of funds and grants from alumni and organizations. You will learn a lot if you join JU Chemical. About the hostels, UG1 hostels are well-maintained and good. Wi-Fi is available, and rooms are big enough for 2–3 people. As I am not a hosteller, this is all I can share.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are a mixed bag. Some are fantastic, some are okay, and some are not very good. They are all highly qualified in their fields, with degrees from IITs, foreign universities, and most are Ph.D. holders with published research work. The course curriculum is almost as good as that of the older IITs, and I can vouch for that. You will gain the required knowledge and industry exposure when you actually work in the field. Semester exams can be rated as moderately difficult to difficult in some cases, which is very subjective.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this because it was my best option for my rank (GMR-1379, General) and because I was flexible about the course, it does not bother me. I am genuinely interested in learning chemical engineering. About the fests and campus life, it is probably one of the best in the region and certainly in the state. The culture is very vibrant, and many events take place regularly around the campus. As long as you keep working hard, you can enjoy life here, land a good job, and get into quality research according to your calibre. JU is a very good university.

reviews.review_title: Review of J.D Birla Institute (JDBI).

detailed_review.Placements: I’m just a fresher in my college, so I really don’t know about the placements, but I’ve heard the placements are pretty good and the internship process is very detailed. It’s made compulsory for us to have an internship in the third year of college, and it’s a part of the course itself.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have good classrooms, a canteen, labs, a library, and even the college is undergoing renovation, providing us with greater facilities and a more comfortable infrastructure. We have AC classrooms and comfortable seating arrangements. The canteen food is good, and the library has a vast range of books with borrowing facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is really good in my college, with the detailed academic calendar being provided beforehand, and the faculty is really helpful with everything. What we need, what we want, and our issues are heard here. The semester exams are a mix of everything, being easy to difficult, making it a good exam for all types of students. The exam papers are exactly like what we’re prepared for.

I want to pursue a professional degree and B.Com course here in this college provides flexible timings being a morning batch making it very easy for students like us .

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College with the best return on investment.

detailed_review.Placements: The exact details for placement drive for 2025 batch are yet to be released. For 2024, the median and average were near 20 LPA, with almost every top company coming for on-campus placement. This year (2025), the placement drive has been immensely successful. Placement percentage is over 90%, with the highest package being as high as 1.4 crore offered by Rubrik. Top companies like Google, Oracle, Sprinklr, and DE Shaw offered full-time roles. Many banking companies like Wells Fargo, ICICI Bank, and Deutsche also visit the campus for full-time roles. On-campus internship drive also takes place.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Being a state university, the institute is heavily underfunded. As a result, the infrastructure is not upto the mark in comparison to IITs and NITs. Though a good amount of research does take place. Hostel specifically is not of great quality, but that is justified by its ultra-cheap rent of Rs 30 per month.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified. Some of them have multiple PhDs. Teaching quality is fair enough, though it varies from teacher to teacher. The course curriculum is restructured starting from the 2025-2029 batch to meet the industry standards and make it relevant. The questions in semester exams are easier in comparison to IITs, but are much lengthier. Exams are of 100 marks with a time limit of 3 hours.
detailed_review.Other: Events are great and something or the other is always happening around on the campus with so many clubs and societies. Being a university, Arts and Science faculty students are also present thus diversifying the crowd.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, a great college with the best return on investment, one can get with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90% of the students are placed this year. The highest package is 1.4 crores offered by Rubrik, and several other high packages are offered by companies like DE & Shaw and Google. Internships secured are also good, with a major percentage of the students being placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are well-maintained and have the necessary facilities for the course. From 2025 onwards, a new syllabus is being introduced which removes irrelevant courses in the first year that have been a part of the course for many years, replacing them with necessary subjects.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly qualified, with most of them having high research indices indicating their great knowledge. Most of them have completed their PhDs and postdocs from reputed colleges. The course's new curriculum is highly relevant and makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are not an ordeal if one pays attention to the classes when they are being taught.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a very good college. It is the best state university in India.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very good. Top companies come every year. The highest package offered is 1.5 LPA this year, and the median salary for CSE is near 20 LPA. Companies like Google and Frank come every year and hire like 3 to 4 students from our department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department coordinated well with the students. There is Wi-Fi available. Library is one of the biggest in the whole West Bengal. The campus is very big, and has 6 canteens where food of every range is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very helpful and highly qualified. There are exams occuring throughout the whole semester, so students won't face much difficulty in giving exams at the end. They get prepared after giving the class tests for each subject. The course curriculum is well-received by students.

reviews.review_title: The college has very good infrastructure and resources.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the 2022-2024 batch. 60% of students are placed, and the highest package is Rs. 50,000, and the lowest package is Rs. 10,000. Placements are mostly in the government and private teaching sectors. Around 50% of students get jobs from internships in schools and colleges. The top role offered by our course focuses on good teaching ability.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of our department are very good. The whole department and campus have free Wi-Fi. Classrooms, library, and computer labs are also very modern. Hostel facilities are very good, with rooms for study, food services, and a canteen available. Every sports instrument is available, with a good playground.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our department has very good and helpful teachers. The teaching quality is very scientific. The curriculum is also very good because our curriculum is developed by our own department teacher. Semester exams are very easy, and the passing marks are only 35%.
detailed_review.Other: My Course is M.A. in Education, and it is the best department in the whole of West Bengal. It is a multidisciplinary course, which is why I chose it. Jadavpur University has a very good campus with a good environment, playground, and OAT. The placement percentage is very good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Food Technology and Biochemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University food technology course summary and college life idea.

detailed_review.Placements: About 60% of students got placed in core companies. The highest package is 14 LPA, the lowest package is 2-3 LPA, and the average is about 5-6 LPA offered in our course. Amul, Winkies, and ITC are the top recruiting companies. A solid 80% students got internship opportunities every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi is available on the whole campus. There are a total of 9 canteens, and each hostel has its own separate cooking area. Table tennis, cricket, and football are the most popular sports. The sports culture and fests are the most lovable part of Jadavpur University.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified. They are helpful. Exams are tough, and lab faculty members are above average. Minimum 60% marks are required for passing the semester. Each department has its own different set of subjects with different faculty members and a different environment.
detailed_review.Other: This course is good, especially for those candidates who like Biology. Biology and Chemistry are the main subjects in this course. Maths and Physics are not that applicable.

reviews.review_title: Good college with good faculty, placements, and affordable education.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good. In the previous year, placements were around 88%. The schedule is too hectic, but also very rewarding and good. I recommend students to take admission in the college. Top recruiting companies that hire students from our course are HSBC, HDFC Bank, etc., banking companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is good. Hostels are clean. The menu is good and cheap. It has clean labs, and toilets are provided. Medical facilities are also provided. The library is very big and good. Many books are present in the library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and helpful. Exams are also very practical and useful for placements. The course curriculum is supported in our college. Professors are very professional and helpful towards students, and good. Semester exams are very tough.

reviews.review_title: Awesome placements, top-notch faculty, and the college with the highest ROI.

detailed_review.Placements: 95-97% of students were placed this year. Top private construction and manufacturing companies like L&T, TCE, Reliance, Godrej, ExxonMobil, Airbus, AFCONS, etc., recruit from our department. PSUs like BPCL, IRCON, Bridge & Roof Co., and EIL recruit on campus directly. Coming to non-core, IT companies are very few that recruit from the civil department (like TCS). In fintech and consultancy roles, ICICI Bank, PwC, ZS, and Polestar recruit every year. The average salary is around 8 LPA, and the median is 7.5-8 LPA. This year (24-25), the highest package given by BPCL (PSU) is around 21 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are non-AC, and college infrastructure is decent. Labs are also decent; only the computer lab has AC. Wi-Fi is available throughout the whole campus. A large central library and a departmental library are available. Hostel is so-so, also about mess food. I live outside campus in a PG. I would say the hostel should not be preferred. There is a large playground on the campus, and also an ATMA SBI bank.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified, having Masters and Ph.D. degrees from IITs, IISc, and foreign universities. The curriculum is well designed, equivalent to the GATE and UPSC ESE syllabus. Exams are very difficult to score; even the student with the highest CTC in placement also gets supplementary.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life I have experienced here is the best. There are organized fests like Sankranti (cultural) and Srijan (techno-management). I chose this college for its low fees and high ROI.

reviews.review_title: A college known for its flagship BBA course.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 70% of students who applied for placements got placed. The average package was around 5 LPA. Companies like Deloitte, Godrej, and EY were among the recruiters. Internships are mandatory for 6 weeks during the final semester. The college assists in getting students placed in their internships, however.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards. The library has a respectable selection of materials that can be accessed both online and offline. There is a canteen inside the building providing vegetarian food only. There are a few indoor games as well as a badminton court.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are great and highly knowledgeable. They will assist students with any issues at any time and are very approachable. The curriculum is relevant enough, and exams are of moderate difficulty, but that's a relatively vague term to use, to be honest. The pass percentage is around 80%.

reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University has got tier-1 rank by NAAC.

detailed_review.Placements: At least 95% of students got placed per year in a Bachelor of Engineering course. The highest package is 1.5 crore per year. The lowest package is 5 LPA. The average package is 10 LPA. Companies like Texas Instruments, Wells Fargo, Oracle, CESC, PwC, HSBC, ICICI Bank, etc., visit the college to recruit students every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every department has its own library and Wi-Fi. Each classroom is air-conditioned and contains a projector. Both boys' and girls' hostels (3 each) are available for students coming from far rural areas.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and qualified. Some professors belong to the top 2% of scientists in the world. Their teaching method is beyond raiseable. The course curriculum includes lab and workshop work which help a lot for working in the tech field in the future. Faculty members are very much dedicated to their teaching and care a lot for students.
detailed_review.Other: Only this university in West Bengal provides a bachelor of engineering degree with affordable fees and the highest placement offers, so I chose it. Course curriculum should be more accurate for higher studies entrance examinations like GATE qualifying. There are so many events like cultural (Sanskriti), tech (Srijan), film fest ( Chhayanat), etc.

reviews.review_title: An outstanding course for higher studies.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements generally don’t happen after a Bachelor’s degree. But after a Master’s, several companies come during the final semester. The average placement package lies in the range of 4–6 LPA. Generally, students are recruited into the R&D department. The highest package has even gone up to 12 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms and, most importantly, the labs are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. There is a huge collection of all types of books in both the central and departmental libraries. Hostels are also at their very best. The hostel charge is actually very nominal.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified. They provide valuable insights into the subject in both theory and practical classes. The course structure is well-established and relevant for higher studies. Semester exams are easy to moderate, I would say. The passing percentage is quite high.

reviews.review_title: Amazing return on investment and value for money. Amazing campus life and very good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, the placement record was quite good for the chemical engineering department. The highest salary is 34 LPA this year. Above 90% of students who opted for placements got placed in varying fields, mostly in the core sector. And quite good placements in the IT as well as finance sectors. Overall, chemical engineering department is quite a chill department, where you do get the time to develop quite some other skills like coding and all. Also gives you exposure for higher studies abroad.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite good. Labs are maintained. Wi-Fi works quite well. Classrooms are quite clean. Library here is one of the best places. There are 4 canteens with reasonable rates for food present. Sports and games are quite encouraged too.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are quite helpful, friendly, and highly qualified. They teach the curriculum quite well, and the curriculum is quite relevant for the higher studies exams like GATE and all. The exams are moderate to hard, but nothing out of the curriculum, so studying well can secure you good marks.
detailed_review.Other: Our college is quite the value for money, as the return on investment is amazing. Paying almost 10,000 for the whole 4 years, and passing out with a 10 LPA job is quite worth it. Not to mention the amazing and fun campus life at the college. It's quite fun.

reviews.review_title: My pleasurable experience at Jadavpur, 2021-2025.

detailed_review.Placements: In our batch of 44 students, 15 people appear for placements, and to date, 11 of them have get jobs 73%. The highest package offered is around 14 LPA by PwC, and the average package is around 3-6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Cipla, Zifo, Alteus, Medline, GSK, etc. We have mandatory internships for every student at companies like Cipla, Sun Pharma, Glenmark, etc. The top roles offered include R&D Associate, QA, QC Officer, Assistant Sales Manager, and Product Management, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My department has Wi-Fi, labs with a specific setup for each student, classrooms with projectors, and a library with AC. Hostels also have high-speed Wi-Fi, and the quality of food is good both in the hostel and in the university canteen. The university has a health center, a separate sports board, and a game room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are very humble and knowledgeable. They hold Ph.D. degrees, and some of them have post-doctoral qualifications as well. They teach awesome. The course is industry-focused and also makes students to be clinic-ready. The semester exams are not so difficult, and it is possible to pass with good marks if studied well. The pass percentage is 98%.
detailed_review.Other: I find this course exciting as I have exposure to direct medicine development, formulation, and manufacturing. I wish there are more student-focused teachers than average. Jadavpur University is well known for its culturally rich environment, so events, fests, and crowd are awesome. JU also has a scholarship section dedicated to handling the scholarship applications of students.

reviews.review_title: All you need to know before joining Jadavpur University.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, about 90% of students got placed in Information Technology. The highest package was offered by Pixel Group of 1.4 crores per annum and the lowest was 3 LPA by TCS Ninja. The average package was 19.12 LPA and the median was 13 LPA (due to recession). Top recruiting companies were Google, Well Fargo, De Shaw, Salesforce, and BNY Mellon. About 20-30% of students get internships in companies like Salesforce, BNY Mellon, etc. Software development engineer role is the most common role offered, besides this assistant member of technical staff, offered by Salesforce.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classrooms except 1st year have AC and projectors and have enough space to accommodate students. The infrastructure of our college is decent. We have campus Wi-Fi and high-quality laboratories. We have a central library that contains a lot of books and journals. On the Saltlake campus, we have all single-roomed hostels. There is a mess and a hostel canteen that serves North and South Indian food. Hostel seats are very less so maximum students ahead to stay in PG and flats. There is a hostel, Wi-Fi, volleyball, and badminton court inside the hostel. Hostel infrastructure is decent and has enough space.
detailed_review.Faculty: Maximum teachers are highly qualified in their fields and are very helpful. Their teaching quality is also good. They are highly concentrated in their research fields. Course curriculum is industry-relevant, almost every 5 years the course curriculum is changed and it had provided the college with great results. The semester exams are moderately difficult. The pass percentage is 32%.
detailed_review.Other: The placement of our university is very good. Moreover, there is a great scope for extracurricular activities. The fests are above average in our college. The night life is awesome here due to the excellent location of our college. There should be 6 months internship scope on our curriculum that is not present at the moment I am writing this review.

reviews.review_title: Review of Jadavpur University.

detailed_review.Placements: Packages offered for engineering students are top-notch, but for the B.A. students, packages are not quite sure. Internships are best. As far as I know, the highest package in our university is 10 crore per annum. At least 80% of students will get guaranteed internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For the infrastructure, I would rate 7 out of 10. We do have libraries and Wi-Fi. We even have digital libraries and separate departmental libraries.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are held semester-wise. It makes students ready for exams. After the new NEP policy, it has become tough for students to gain great marks but good enough. The highest pass percentage is 8 CGPA. I would recommend students join this university as it is the best at least in my state. Professors are good, but most of them teach in the vernacular, so it might be tough for non-Bengal students.
detailed_review.Other: Jadavpur University is basically free so students who cannot afford tuition can join this university. Fests are held for a month. We have a lot of fests and extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: Jadavpur University dream of every aspiring engineer.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement offers are quite good in our college. In my department, the placement percentage of students who opt for placement is 100%. The highest package offered in the last year was 26 LPA where as the average package for mechanical engineering was 8.5 LPA. In my course, our top recruiters are Caterpillar, Airbus, Tata Steel, Mahindra & Mahindra, PwC, Zs-Associate, etc. Internship opportunities are less as compared to the placement scenarios. The internship offers have come from Airbus, PwC, Tata Steel, and some others also.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is average. There is a central library which is good in terms of the availability of books and journals. The Wi-Fi is fine but labs are not as good as per the expectations. Hostel rooms are also average. In each room, there are three students. The quality of food in the mess is bad. Hostel facilities are not so good. However, medical facilities are provided by the university. The sports and games are given priority and there are clubs also for the different games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty members are very qualified and knowledgeable. The relationship between teachers and students is quite good at the university. They teach in PPT mode most of the time, and are always available for help to the meritorious students. The course curriculum is also relevant if we talk about core engineering. The syllabus is very vast making the students industry-ready. Semester exams are moderate, and it is sometimes easy depending on the subjects.
detailed_review.Other: The mechanical engineering of Jadavpur University is quite good if you look at the other private colleges status (including CSE and IT branches also). The course is designed in such a way that the students can crack any competitive engineering exams like GATE, IES, etc. If there were some robotics subjects included it would be more better. The fests are very good and campus life is enjoyable. For different curricular activities there are many clubs also.

reviews.review_title: I am dissatisfied with the administration, especially the controller of the examinations office.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed ranges from 12% to 15% since the placement cell of the English Department, in terms of undergraduate courses, is defunct. Course packages are not specific due to the lack of placement opportunities. The top recruiting company for our course is TCS, in the Human Resources department. The top roles and the percentage of students who get assured internships are unclear due to the lack of information regarding the same.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Course facilities and infrastructure include an audio-visual room, internship opportunities under professors (with vague details available), and internship opportunities in the JU PRESS. Our departmental library has an incredible collection of literature across all spheres of English Literary studies. Hostel facilities are more or less abysmal. The quality of food available is borderline poor, as most canteens offer the same dishes every day, and sometimes the food is undercooked. Medical facilities are almost nonexistent, but facilities for disabled persons are being gradually built. Sports and games are mostly available to men.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors of the English Department are extremely accomplished individuals with a diverse array of knowledge in intersectional studies. They are helpful and considerate, although sometimes they tend to ignore major issues in the department. The course curriculum is relevant in terms of academia, especially for those who want to pursue Literature for higher studies. This course has a syllabus different from most college curriculums in India, as it focuses more on intersectionality than on the objective evaluation of a text, which is the rising trend of new criticism across all spheres of academia. Semester exams are extremely difficult, and the pass percentage is 35%.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course because the department is one of the best in the world, and the outlook they have collectively adopted towards literature is unmatched and eternal. Improvement in the course could include better placement opportunities. There are huge events in JU, ranging from cultural events to literary fests to debate competitions. JU tends to excel in most. The campus environment and crowd are very laid-back in a way. The administration is slow in their work and maintenance of university grounds, but the campus environment is charged with freedom and its risks.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Jadavpur University is a state university located in Bengal. It is extremely keen on the betterment of the infrastructure to promote a more conducive academic environment. The campus has hostels, a guest house, a library, a daycare centre, a health centre, JU Employees’ Coop Credit Society Limited and a Computer Aided Design Lab (CAD). The university keeps on working on improving the infrastructure and the major improvements are being done during the 2008-2013 period. Read further to know more about Jadavpur University Infrastructure:

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Campus Highlights 2024
text: Jadavpur University is not only known for its academic excellence but also for its excellent infrastructure facilities. The university is spread across 56 acres of land in West Bengal. The university is well-equipped with all the latest infrastructure facilities, yet it keeps on expanding and improving to provide a comfortable environment to the students. The university has comfortable and spacious classrooms, labs with the latest technologies, a library with a knowledge hub with digital library as well, day care, health care and other such facilities.
Campus Building:

tables.Jadavpur University Campus Highlights: Hostel, Guest House, Library, Day Care Centre, Health Centre

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Hostel & Residential Facilities
text: Jadavpur University has 13 hostels, out of which 4 are for girls and 9 are for boys. In these 16 hostels, there is a provision for accommodating over 1600 students. To increase and improve hostel infrastructure, the university is making efforts for the extension of the existing buildings and the construction of new buildings. The hostel has a mess that is conducted by the students' mess committee under the guidance of the Superintendent of the respective hostel. The main hostel complex is situated outside the hostel. The hostel premises' private canteen is supervised by the Students' committee.
Auditorium:

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Hostel Fee
text: Jadavpur University offers affordable hostel accommodation to its students. The students are required to collect a form from the Information Office and submit it to the Office of the Dean of Students. The payment of two meals provided differs from hostel to hostel.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Hostel Life
text: Jadavpur University offers a safe, comfortable and friendly atmosphere at its hostel premises. The hostels have free wifi for speedy internet and 24*7 security with CCTV surveillance for added safety. Rooms are kept clean and spacious, with 2-3 students sharing a room. Single rooms are available at the Salt Lake Campus Hostel. The university tries its best to ensure that students are living safely and comfortably at the hostel premises.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Academic and Research Facilities
text: Jadavpur University places a lot of focus on research. The university allocates over 35% of the total yearly budget to research. The research is conducted as per global standards. The university allocates 15 lakhs INR of its funds every year to support research activities by students. Twenty-two out of the university’s thirty-six departments have been recognised by, and have been receiving funds from, national and international agencies, primarily because of their research output.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Library
text: Jadavpur University has a Central Library, which is a three-storeyed building on the campus. Although the shelf space and working space of the library is 36,000 sq. ft.,(approx), it is being extended by the new construction of annex building 5,500 sq. ft. (approx.). The library has 7 reading rooms, carrels, and an alcove for bound volumes of journals providing sitting accommodation for 700 readers. There is one more library at Salt Lake, the space of which is 6,500 sq. ft. (approx.).

The University also has a Digital Library, which has The Digital Library possess a Learning Resource Centre (LRC) and a reading room. The Digital Library Management Software Dspace, developed by MIT, USA and Hewlett Packard has been installed in the library. It is open-source software and has been customized to suit our requirements. DSpace accepts all forms of digital materials including text, images, video and audio files.

sections.heading: Jadavpur University Sports Facilities
text: Jadavpur University pays adequate attention to the sports facilities so that students can possess the significant development and promotion of sports culture within the university. The university believes in the idea of "Sports for All", as sports are considered the fundamental right of all which seems to preserve the integrity of sports in the university. The sports board encourages sporting activities as an imperative part of the university community that can generate a feeling of national pride and identity.

Every year about 200-250 students of the university participate in the inter-university sports competition. Such participating events are Aquatics (Swimming & Diving), Rowing, Chess, American Football, Karate, Grappling, Kick Boxing, Football, Volleyball, Basketball, Cricket, Tennis, Table Tennis, Air Rifle Shooting, Squash Rackets, Kho-Kho, Kabadi, Badminton, Ball Badminton, Athletics, Taekwondo, Weight & Powerlifting, Gymnastics, Yoga, Handball, Netball, Wrestling, Archery, Judo etc.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the Jadavpur University Campus
text: Jadavpur University is surrounded by Parks and nature, historical and cultural sites and other attractions. In their free time, if students wish to explore parks and nature, they can explore Rabindra Sarobar Lake, Science City, and Benu Bana Chaya Lake. A few historical and cultural sites that could be explored are St. Paul Cathedral, Tagore House, Howrah Bridge and Victoria Memoria. A few other places that could be explored are Jadavpur Lenin's Statue, Graffiti warehouse, and Nuner Bheri Picnic sport.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
Jadavpur university library system comprises the Central Library, Salt Lake Campus Library, 36 departmental libraries, and also the libraries attached with schools and centres for studies.
The University Central Library is housed in a three-storied building on the campus. Its shelf space and working space total 36,000 sq.ft. and is being extended via a newly constructed annex building. This will add another 5,500 sq.ft. Seven reading rooms, carrels, and an alcove for bound volumes of journals provide sitting accommodation for 700 readers. There is a separate library on the second campus at Salt Lake. The space of the Salt Lake campus Library is 6,800 sq.ft.

The Central Library is home to over 6,46,296 volumes of books on record (including the Salt lake Campus Library and those loaned to departmental libraries), 80,700 bound volumes of journals, 13,000 theses and dissertations, and 37,000 items of non-book materials such as reports pamphlets, maps and micro-forms. 

The library subscribes to about 633 print and 2,794 online journals. The university also has access to an additional 9,082 online journals through the INFLIBNET and the INDEST consortia. In total, the university library provides access to around 12,530 Journals.The library subscribes to 30 databases which include Scopus, Econlit etc. and also about 10,057 E-books.

IIT Patna is ranked 160 by the QS Ranking 2025 under the Asian University Rankings - Southern Asia category and 541-560 by the QS Ranking 2025 under the Asian University Rankings category. Indian Institute of Technology Patna is an esteemed Engineering institute in the country. IIT Patna has secured ranks from various national and international bodies. IIT Patna ranks 36th under the Overall category by NIRF 2025. In addition, it ranks 39th under the Research Institutions category by NIRF 2025 and 19th under the Engineering category. IIT Patna is an Institute of National Importance (INL). IIT Patna is approved by UGC and AICTE. IIT Patna offers UG, PG and PhD courses across 10 departments. Some of the important departments are Computer Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Civil & Environmental Engineering and Humanities & Social Science.
Admission to various courses is done basis entrance exams such as JEE Main, JEE Advanced and IIT JAM, GATE. The average package recorded during the recent placement drive was INR 22.23 LPA. reviews.review_title: IIT Patna M.Tech honest college review.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at the institute are the perfect definition of it. Students generally become eligible for placement from the fourth semester. Around 300 recruiters participate, including top domestic as well as foreign companies. The average package for the M.Tech programme is 16 LPA, and the highest package offered is 1 CPA. The top recruiters in the drive include Microsoft, Oracle, Goldman Sachs, ICICI, Tata, and HCL. Almost 100 percent of students got placed. I plan to work after my graduation.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel rooms are good in all aspects. 24 hour electricity is provided, and an emergency generator facility is available. The hostel is neat and clean. Sweepers come regularly to clean the dirty areas, and rooms are properly cleaned every weekend. The mess maintains good quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified. Most of them did their PhD. from IITs or other reputed colleges in other countries. The first year curriculum is a slight mixture of all subjects and makes students industry ready in other ways. Semester exams are not difficult. The batch size is approximately 150, of which 15 are branch changes.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a really good college with great campus life and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of total registered students get placed in the Metallurgical and Materials Engineering branch. The highest package is 51 LPA, the average is around 15 LPA, and the lowest is 10 LPA. Top companies are Google, Microsoft, and Facebook. Around 60 percent of students get internships. The top roles are software engineer and consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch for Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Patna. There are almost all labs for every subject. The infrastructure for lectures and tutorials are top-notch. Hostel infrastructure is very clean and top-notch, and the mess is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very qualified. All of them have studied at very good universities all over the world. They are very knowledgeable. Teaching quality is also very good. This course is relevant. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are of a good level. The pass percentage is 98 percent.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied (worth it).

detailed_review.Placements: Afaik, placements are pretty good in circuit branches like CSE, AIDS, MNC, etc. Many international offers were also made to many students, and many companies like Goldman Sachs, Maang, etc. Visit regularly. As for core branches, opportunities are fewer compared to CS and all. Many people get placed in PSUs, some get placed in teaching, and others go for higher studies like M.Tech, MBA, etc. The placement percentage in my course, afaik, is 90%. More or less, if you want placement, you will get it, and if not, then you can always go for higher studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are separate buildings/floors for different departments, and they have Wi-Fi in all, afaik. Labs are well-equipped and maintained properly. IIT Patna has a central library, which is very beautiful and the heart of the campus; it is a round-shaped building with many floors and Wi-Fi facility. Classrooms are well-furnished, and Wi-Fi is available. There are many hostels, but the hostel allotted to freshers is CV Raman. It is well-furnished, and Wi-Fi is available. Mess food is decent. There are Nescafes and a food court, along with a sports complex and gymkhana for sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and experienced. In our 1st semester, we have Physics, Maths, CS, and all. Tbh, the course of the first year is not that relevant to our branch because we get common classes in the first year. But from the second year, it would be pretty relevant. Exams are not that difficult if you study. Most of the students pass the exams. Overall, if you study well, you will pass easily.

admission.title: IIT Patna Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: IIT Patna admission 2026 is entrance-based. With large number of applications and limited seats, admissions are compeitive at IIT Patna. The institute offers admission to its flagship BTech programme based on JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced scores. The seats are allotted in BTech course via JoSAA Counselling. IIT Patna also offers BS, MSc, MTech and other courses. While admission to MTech and MSc is subject to GATE and IIT JAM, respectively, the admission process for BS is subject to a valid score in JEE Main, JEE Advanced, followed by JoSAA counselling.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What minimum marks are required in JEE Mains to be eligible for JEE Advanced?
faqs.answer: The minimum marks required in JEE Mains to qualify for JEE Advanced 2026 will be announced with the JEE Main 2026 final result after session 2 exams. Last year's minimum marks in JEE Mains to qualify for JEE Advanced were: 2025: 2024: 2023: Candidates aiming for admission to the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) need to meet these cutoff marks in JEE Mains to be eligible for JEE Advanced 2026.

faqs.question: What is the popular course at IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: The flagship course of IIT Patna is BTech. The four year BTech programme is offered in 11 specialisations. Admission to all BTech courses is subject to a valid score in JEE Main and JEE Advanced exams. Students also need to go through the counselling process conducted by JoSAA for final seat allotment. The eligibility criteria for admission is that students must have cleared their HSC/10+2 with minimum 75% aggregate. The total seat intake is 638.

faqs.question: What are the courses that IIT Patna offers?
faqs.answer: IIT Patna offers BTech, MTech, MSc, and PhD programmes through its 10 departments. IIT Patna offers four-year BTech programmes at the undergraduate level in 11 specialisations. A two-year MTech programme in 15 specialisations and two-year MSc programmes in three specialisations at the postgraduate level. All 10 departments of IIT Patna also offer a three-year PhD programme. The mode of IIT Patna admission is online. Admission to BTech is based on JEE Main and JEE Advanced scores, followed by JoSSA counseling. Admission to MTech and MSc is subject to GATE and IIT JAM, respectively.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for BTech at IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: Candidates must complete Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics with a minimum of 75% aggregate to apply for BTech programme at IIT Patna. Aspirants also need to pass JEE Main followed by JEE Advanced to get a seat in the BTech course.

faqs.question: Can I get admission in MSc programme at IIT Patna without IIT JAM score?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pass IIT JAM with a good rank to get a seat in the MSc programme of IIT Patna. The seats are offered in the MSc programme via CCMN Counselling. The IIT JAM cutoff is quite competitive for MSc admission at IIT Patna. The closing rank was between 575-699 for MSc in 2025.

faqs.question: What is the JEE Advanced cut off for BTech in Civil Engineering at IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: For 2022, cut off was 13741 for General category candidates in All India quota for B.Tech. in Civil Engineering in IIT Patna - Indian Institute of Technology. For female candidates in General category under All India quota,  21802 was the closing rank. B.Tech cut off varies depending on the category and domicile/quota of the applicant.

faqs.question: What is fee for various courses offered at IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: IIT Patna offers various Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD courses in Engineering and Technology, Science, and Humanities and Social Science. Tabulated below is the list of courses along with their total tuition fee: Candidates can click here to know more about the courses offered at IIT Patna.

faqs.question: How can I join IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: BTech and BS courses completely based on JoSAA following an appearance by a candidate for JEE Main and JEE Advanced examination, however for other courses MSc and M.Tech based on GATE, IIT JAM through COAP and CCMN counselling and the seats under PhD course on appearance basis on admission test organized by institute itself. After the test is conducted, IIT Patna publishes a merit list containing the names of students selected for PhD.

faqs.question: What is the last date to fill the choices in JoSAA counselling?
faqs.answer: The dates for JoSAA counselling 2026 choice filling will be announced once the result of JEE Main 2026 is declared. Candidates can fill choices only during the choice filling period. Also, candidates need to lock their choices before the last date.

faqs.question: Can I get IIT Patna BSc without JEE?
faqs.answer: IIT Patna accepts multiple state/national entrance exams other than JEE for admission to BSc courses. NEET, CUET, BITSAT, etc., are other exams accepted by the institute. However, candidates must make sure to first qualify for the BSc eligibility criteria. Qualified candidates just need to apply via the official website of IIT Patna. BSc eligibility criteria: Class 12 in Science Stream with 60% aggregate

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is required for admission to M.Tech at IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: To get admission at IIT Patna, candidate must qualify GATE COAP. IIT Patna GATE COAP cutoff 2024 has been concluded for admission to the MTech courses. In the meantime, students can refer to the table below to check out the GATE COAP 2021 cutoff scores for General AI categories.

faqs.question: Can I study BTech at IIT Patna for free?
faqs.answer: No, there is no provision of a student studying free at IIT Patna as per the official website. However, IIT Patna provides a range of Merit-Cum-Means scholarships to meritorious and needy students. Any UG (BTech) student or MSc student can receive these scholarships. The criteria to receive is that the annual income of a student's parents/ guardian/ family from all sources in the preceding financial year must not be more than INR 4.50 lakh. Category-wise eligibility criteria and the way in which the scholarship is offered is as follows: A few more PG scholarships and UG scholarships offered by the PM are awarded to the students of IIT Patna.

faqs.question: Can I change my BTech branch after admission to IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: In general, students admitted to the particular branch of the undergraduate BTech course must continue studying that branch till completion. However, in special cases the institute may permit a student admitted through JEE to change their branch of study after the first two semesters. Such changes are permitted only for students who have completed all the common credits required in the first two semesters of their studies, in their first attempt, without having had to pass any course requirement in the summer term examination.

faqs.question: What rank is required for BTech CSE at IIT Patna?
faqs.answer: Candidates are offered seat in IIT Patna BTech CSE programme based on their JEE Advanced rank. Looking at the past three-year closing rank, the cutoffs has a declining trend. The closing rank was 2811 in 2023,  3144 in 2024 and 3377 in 2025.

faqs.answer: For 2022, cut off was 13741 for General category candidates in All India quota for B.Tech. in Civil Engineering in IIT Patna - Indian Institute of Technology. For female candidates in General category under All India quota,  21802 was the closing rank. B.Tech cut off varies depending on the category and domicile/quota of the applicant.

faqs.question: Can I get into IIT Patna for M.Tech without GATE?
faqs.answer: Candidates who wish to apply to the M.Tech programme must have a valid GATE score. Students are screened based on their CGPI in BE/BTech and GATE scores during COAP counselling. However, candidates who have completed their BTech from IITs with a CGPA of 8.0 and above can apply without GATE scores. These applications are reviewed by the respective department (s). Hence, the answer to this question is - yes , it is possible to get into IIT Patna without GATE for MTech.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Patna campus has various facilities for its students and people who are part of the system. Spread over 501 acres, IIT Patna's infrastructure includes the following amenities, which help in the overall development of students:
For more information about IIT Patna check out the below videos:
list: Hostels:IIT Patna hostel facility for all students There is one boys’ hostel and one temporary girls’ hostel, with a total capacity to house 1,200 students. Hostels are equipped with a gym, TV room, mess, food joints, and table tennis facilities.

Medical Unit:Thehealthcare facility at the IIT Patna campus is run with the help of Ruban Memorial Hospital. A pharmacist and an assistant are available on a full-time basis; moreover, the medical unit is well equipped to cater to the basic medical needs in case of emergency.

Sophisticated Analytical Instrument Facility (SAIF):Sponsored by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, SAIF was established to provide analytical and data collection facilities to the scientific community using different sophisticated analytical equipment.
Sports Complex:IIT Patna campus has sports facilities like a badminton court, basketball court, cricket ground, football ground, and a volleyball court.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: IIIT Patna digital library is equipped with modern technology of library automation system with Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC) and self check-in and shelf check-out (Drop Box) system using RFID technology. The library provides e-resources (e-books, e-journal, e-databases and Turnitin) facility, newspapers, etc.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: IIT Patna currently has one boys' hostel and one temporary girls' hostel in the campus. It also has necessary arrangements for married research scholars. Presently over 1200 students are residing in the hostels. Regular bus services have been provided from the hostels. The hostel also has a Wi-Fi facility along with gymnasium, TV room and table tennis.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of good placements and faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly, 80 percent of the students in Anna University Chennai got placements in good companies. The highest package is around 30 LPA to 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA to 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are TCS, Wipro, Accenture, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Anna University Chennai is good, and laboratories and libraries are available. They provide separate hostels for both boys and girls with free Wi-Fi. Hostel food is not bad. Average in taste. They give importance to sports as well as studies.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers at Anna University Chennai are well-experienced and qualified. They are always being friendly with students. They teach us lessons crystal clear and always clear the student's doubt regarding lessons without any concern. They conduct an examination every month.

reviews.review_title: I like hostel life more as college is strict.

detailed_review.Placements: The students from 3rd semester were eligible for placements. Companies like Toyota, EY, Micromax, Accenture, KPMG, Delliote, etc., will come to hire the freshers. The highest package offered was around 20 LPA, and the lowest package was around 4 LPA. The percentage of students getting placed was 70-80%. My plans after degree were to work for 5 years in an MNC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our campus was good enough to accommodate 2500 students including two colleges as we had two colleges under the same campus. Blocks were different but common facilities were shared be it library, canteens, sports ground, or the perpetual seminar halls. We had plenty at our campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty student ratio was around 1:15. Faculty members were so supportive of the students, and they would always respond to students immediately. All faculty members were good like Charitra ma'am, Jasmine ma'am, Ranjitha ma'am, Santhosh sir, etc. All the faculty members were the best. There was no faculty whom we didn't like. There will be semester exam after 3 months in the semester. In a semester, there will be 2 internals, 2 small tests which will be considered as assignment, and 1 project for every subject. The courses were good and connected to the industry.
detailed_review.Other: Our events like the tech fest Henosis also held there.

reviews.review_title: The pride in sharing the greatness of Asia's oldest college.

detailed_review.Placements: In our course last year, around 81% of students got placed. The remaining students opt for higher studies abroad. So the remaining students do not apply for placements. The students are being given an enormous number of opportunities for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is the best infrastructure available among the government colleges. The standards and the fees that we pay are very different. Though the fee is low. The infrastructure is very good. The greenery of the trees within the campus gives a good feeling to stay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very much helpful and have a great experience in research as well as in the curriculum. The curriculum is very relevant to the needs of the industry. Semester exams are very easy to crack which makes me give four stars rather than five.

reviews.review_title: My college is a 10 for those who prefer exposure rather than infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: 50% of students got placed in IT companies and manufacturing companies, mechanical sectors as well. Remaining students focused on building their own company, and some of them are getting into higher studies. The highest package known to me was 18LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Companies like TATA, Hyundai, Mahindra, CATERPILLAR, etc. Roles offered are mechanical, automobile, manufacturing, management, data analytics, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is available, but the maintenance is poor. Wi-Fi is available, but it lags sometimes. Medical facilities are good enough, and the food is also good. But there is no proper maintenance of restrooms and infrastructure. The canteen still doesn't have Epay, but it is still in development. Cleanliness is at its worst on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are helpful, joyful, and qualified. Teaching is still like the old school. No advanced methods. It is relevant to what the industry needs, but still holds. 75% is the pass percentage, approximately. The semester exams are difficult but manageable.
detailed_review.Other: This course integrated Mechanics, Management, and Data Analytics, so I ended up here. The building is worse and can be cleaned, painted, or renovated. Events, fests, etc., are excellent. There are several scholarships that one does not need to worry about.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college with nice campus and social life.

detailed_review.Placements: 26 LPA is the highest package and 5.6 LPA is the lowest, and 6 LPA is the average. Associate engineer is the position offered. Caterpillar recruits more freshers here 70% of students are placed/in internships. The exact numbers are not known off-campus students are like 10.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus life is lot enjoyable. There are lot of space to spend time inside campus, like clubs. Architecture classes are quite good. You can have Wi-Fi access on laptops for free. A wide range of sports are available. Two canteens are available. Hostel and mess food is decent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified. Most of them are Ph.D. holders. Every 4 years once they change the syllabus and curriculum. It makes study more informative, but not more practical. Semester exam are sometimes easy and hard based on the selector. 45% is the passing percentage.
detailed_review.Other: Through Tamil Nadu Engineering admission counseling, I got this course. The course is quite tough. There was a choice filling where you could select professors of your choice. But it has been removed now Kurukshetra, the biggest tech fest and lots happening around college every now and then.

reviews.review_title: I highly recommend, it is good.

detailed_review.Placements: In the industrial department, most of students get placed, and some go for higher studies in top institutes, including IIM. Here, they encourage students to contribute to the entrepreneurship sector too. It all depends on our efforts; opportunities exist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi is available for laptops, and the library is really good with sufficient books and infrastructure. Hostel infrastructure is good, but the taste of mess food is a con, especially lunch. It is really a good college for sports, PPL in ball badminton, hockey, and throw ball. Health facilities are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching style is based on real-life applications rather than marks, with interactive classes. The new curriculum makes it even better. Getting marks is easier, but knowledge depends on you. The question paper depends on the professor, and presentation matters. Class notes are key to marks.
detailed_review.Other: There are a lot of extracurricular activities where you can showcase your talent in science, dance, or whatever. You can learn a lot. Clubs guide for higher studies, UPSC, singing, dance, astronomy, robotics, etc. It is a wide exposure college.

reviews.review_title: My experience of M.Sc. electronic media at Anna University.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package is 7 LPA and the highest package is 36 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Cipla, TCS, Infosys, Siemens, Vodafone, Wipro, Flipkart, etc. Statistics show that around 90% of students are placed from this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of Anna University is good. University is well-managed for students. Labs are advanced. Library has more than 1 lakhs books and journals and full campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostel is clean and well-managed. Mess has separate vegetarian and nonvegetarian food. So this is a better option for students who are vegetarian.
detailed_review.Faculty: According to students the teaching is very good. Almost 90% of teachers are Ph.D. scholars. All teachers are very friendly and fully experienced. The mentors are very supportive and available all the time to help. Exams are not too much easy and not too much difficult, so students are passed quite easily.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Quality education with strong placements and affordable fees.

detailed_review.Placements: This college offers 120 seats for Computer Science and Engineering. With quality teaching, it has a 90% placement rate. The average salary package offered ranges from 4 LPA to 10 LPA. All major IT companies recruit from this course, and 95% of students secure internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For my course, they provide good infrastructure with high-speed network in Wi-Fi and data. It provides well-organized labs and wonderful Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan library which has more than 40,000 books. The canteen provides food 3 times a day with good quality and good taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teachers in this course are well qualified and with more than 7 years of experience. Their teaching is proven with the passing percentage. It makes industry-ready students like providing good communication skills and stage performances. Exams are easier in this college as the good teachers, and pass percentage is 93%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it has been a good platform during the quarantine time and good average package. It provides more technical skills like developing company projects, and all special events are conducted at appropriate time.

reviews.review_title: Anna University is well satisfied with placements and exploration.

detailed_review.Placements: High package - 33 L, the lowest package - 3 L, average package - 6 L. Anna University has a robust placement programme, attracting numerous companies across various sectors. Some of the companies are Apian, Microsoft, etc. Nowadays, the internship opportunities seem to decrease in count.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the students of the college are provided with Anna Wi-Fi. The speed of the Wi-Fi is quite enough for academics. There is a health centre inside the campus, which is open to all students, faculty members, etc. There is a huge library inside the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams will be very tough to clear. The pass percentage is 50 percent. The course curriculum is quite relevant to the industry. Most faculty members hold advanced degrees (Masters and Ph.D. from reputed institutions and from abroad). No complaint regarding teaching.
detailed_review.Other: There will be two events held in the even semester. One will be a teach event and the other will be a non-teach event. In the odd semester, there will be no events.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Anna University, Chennai in the year 2025 admission in M.Tech course information.

detailed_review.Placements: In this college, we get the best placement opportunities. Students must score an 8 CGPA to participate in campus placements. In this college, many companies come for internships. The salary package offered is around 4 LPA to 8 LPA. Our college has a partnership with tech companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college provides the best facilities. They use high-quality infrastructure, products, and materials. This college provides facilities like classrooms, labs, benches, a library, fans, bathrooms, computers, etc. Facilities are available. This college has a canteen. Its food is very tasty and clean.
detailed_review.Faculty: This curriculum is relevant and very good. Our teachers are very good. They provide knowledge of the subject. This course is for 1 year. We have 2-semester exams. Exams are very difficult to clear and score marks.

reviews.review_title: Good exposure and campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% are placed and many go for higher studies. The lowest package is 3 Lacs and the highest is 21 Lacs. A student recently got into Apple as well. Most students get placed as Software Development. Students also get mass recruited at the end of the placement season. Companies like Fidelity, Visa, Citi Bank recruit students here often.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department has working labs and classrooms. There is a common library for all students within and outside the nearby campus. You cannot connect to data on your mobile within the department, but they will provide students with Wi-Fi that can be registered with your laptop. The quality of food is subpar in the international hostel. It is very repetitive. Housekeeping is prompt. The medical center closes by 5 pm, so in case of emergency, you have to visit Malar hospital nearby. Sports culture is very strong here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified but lack the ability to teach. The course is slowly being revised and is somewhat relevant, making the students industry-ready through mandatory internship/summer projects. Semester exams are application-oriented. Pass percentage is 45% if you pass in internals.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course because I assumed it has good placement. There are many scholarships that are offered for different sections of society. The campus crowd is mostly Tamilians, with few foreign nationals, NRIs, and other state students. I wish the professors were more approachable.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Vibrant Campus Life at CEG.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently, I am in my third year as far as the placements and internships go our college is very esteemed. Very old college we have a greater army association and alumni connections so it will be very much easier to get connections outside the college through the alumni as far as college placement cell goes. We have many companies visiting yearly for our college for internships and placements and college has done a very good job at bringing those companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Even though our college is 200 years old, all the infrastructure is present and is very much available for students. But, we may not have a mobile network on the college campus. But there is Wi-Fi present all around the campus so it is very much helpful. Labs have very high facilities like the computers software required are very much pre-installed and ready to use. Hostels are affordable and manageable but still a bit of improvement is required.
detailed_review.Faculty: As far as curriculum goes, the curriculum is regulated every four years. It is changed based on industrial requirements and other changes. Faculty members are very friendly, approachable, and very experienced in various fields. Very diverse staff are present in the department and also the exams are conducted twice within the semester which are the internal assessment. Finally, we have an ancient semester totally accounting for the grades of the students.

reviews.course: M.E. in Power Electronics and Drives
reviews.review_title: The college is good, nothing negative as such.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of the students getting placed in our college is 95%, and the college does provide us with internship opportunities. Students also pursue internships on their own as well. The average package being offered was 10 Lacs rupees per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and the infrastructure that is provided to us in our course is that we have access to Wi-Fi 24/7, labs, and also audio-video classrooms. The quality of the facilities that are provided to us in our hostel is really good, and the medical facilities are also really great.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in our college are really very helpful. They have strong domain-related knowledge and also have good teaching skills. The course curriculum is also very relevant to the industry requirement, and the pass percentage of the college is 90%.

reviews.review_title: The best university with many facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Our university is well-known for good placements. Almost 93% of students were placed. The highest salary package offered in our course is 34 LPA, while the lowest salary package ranges from 5 LPA - 9 LPA. Recruiting companies include Wipro, Infosys, Amazon, Google, and others. More than 100 companies collaborated with the university. The percentage of students who got internships is 97%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College facilities were good at our university. The infrastructure is very attractive. Our course provides Wi-Fi and a library that has books on all fields. The food quality in the mess is good. The hostel facilities are also good. Many sports events were conducted.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very supportive, and the courses are to the point. They are helpful in teaching and have more than 20 years of experience. Teachers' knowledge was excellent. The course curriculum was relevant, covering everything from basics to advanced topics. They prepare us for the industry by providing hands-on experience. The semester exams are challenging, and the passing percentage is 93%.

reviews.course: (Discontinued Sep 2021) M.Tech. in Environmental Science and Technology
reviews.review_title: I like mostly college. College infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very good in our colleges. Students got placed in reputed companies with good packages. Students from the 6th semester become eligible for placements. More than 400 companies visit for placements. The highest package is 56 LPA and the average is 5 LPA. Every year more than 90% of students get placed in companies and some do their startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The range and accessibility of books and journals available in the library yes it's available. The facilities and technological provisions within the classrooms. An overview of sports and extracurricular activities offered on campus yes they are offered.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-student ratio may be 20:1. But they are all very helpful whenever there is a need. Data Science faculty members are all very good. They also take extra classes for those who have any queries and solve their queries. There are a total of 3 sessions of exams per semester and the level of difficulty is moderate. Almost 80% of students passed every exam.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: My Life Lessons at College of Engineering Guindy.

detailed_review.Placements: For IT, CSE, nearly everyone will get placed and their average salary is around 12 LPA, with the highest salary being around 36 LPA. For ECE, EEE department core companies will also come, but the salary is not lesser than IT. Their average is around 8 LPA. For civil, mech, and manufacturing, core companies will come and the average is around 7 LPA. Rare departments like printing, mining, some companies will come, some will get placed, and some will do higher studies. Even though they don't get placement, Anna University brand name and life experience will help them grow.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not so good as private colleges. Ambience is good. Some classes don't have smart boards. Wi-Fi facilities are given only for laptops. Lab infrastructure is very good. Hostel facility is okay, but you have a very good life experience there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some faculty members teach extraordinarily. Some faculty members don't have subject knowledge, but this helps us to improve more through self-learning. Without self-learning, you can't get good grades. The question paper is set by any one of the staff members who are handling the subject. Exams are somewhat medium to difficult level. Seniors will guide you more for placement, etc. Seniors also conduct special classes for students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because we can go for both IT and core jobs. Some department staff are not teaching well, and it is tougher if you don't follow self-study. There are many clubs, and it is mandatory to be a part of NSS/YRC/NSO. I am a part of NSS, which is a personality improvement course. You will be able to speak confidently and efficiently. Many clubs are also there. Each club has its significant events. CEG Teach Forum conducts Vyuhaa for freshers and Kurukshetra, an international-level tech event. SAAS CEG conducts AGNI in the odd semester and Techofes in the even semester. Those cultural events are the best part of your life.

reviews.review_title: Review of B.Tech in information technology at Anna University.

detailed_review.Placements: We have higher placement chances in both the core and non-core companies. Our alumni's got placed in various roles such as finance, IT, consultant and so on. And also, they honestly respect and support our start-up ideas patiently without any jealousy. They had given their fullest support.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are 400 computers present in our college laboratories. As programmers were appointed to monitor the computer laboratories, they additionally took care of students while doing programs. Also, technical assistants were appointed in order to monitor machines and equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: During examinations, our teachers gave special attention to the students who scored below average marks and they arranged special coaching for them in their lacking subjects. Also, special rooms were allocated for the students who have medical issues like fever during exams.

reviews.review_title: Overall the best college for M.E in Solar energy.

detailed_review.Placements: Our university placement percentage varies from year to year. About 80-90% of students are placed in a special education. The salary range offered is between 10 LPA - 15 LPA. The salary range offered is between 7 LPA - 6 LPA. Minimum salary is between 4 LPA - 6 LPA. Recruitment for our study can vary from year to year. Some of the top recruitment agencies included Adani green , Waaree energies, Tata power Soler systems, Vikram solar, loom solar, Goldi solar etc. Approximate 70% of the students got internships. Top or startup companies offer internships for students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have everything in our college. Our college and hostel have 24/7 Wi-Fi access. Our classrooms are well equipped and well maintained. Our university has state-of-the-art labs. There are good books in the library. Our college has basic facilities and courts for various sports. We also have a canteen and meeting room.
detailed_review.Faculty: The instructors are highly experienced, offering excellent instruction and live coding in the classroom using projectors. The learning experience is excellent, with instructors solving questions in different ways and properly guiding students. The pass percentage is 86%.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good engineering college.

detailed_review.Placements: Our university provides good placement opportunities. Students have to score above 7 SGPA in all the semesters to get good placements. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj Electricals, Syska, HP, etc. These companies select students based on their interviews. The average salary package offered in our course is 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall environment of our college is very good. All people are very helpful. There are different types of clubs where like dance clubs, music drama, etc. You can join in these clubs. The infrastructure of our college is good. All facilities are available in our college. There is a huge library. It is always full-stocked. The hostel facilities are good. The food served in the mess is tasty. Canteen and grocery stores are available on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is well-designed and provides practical knowledge. Faculty members are average. Some of them are very good. Some are not good. They keep on criticising and de-motivating you. They make you feel bad about yourself. Some of them are very motivating. They help us learn new things. The teaching methodology is good. Exams are organised on time.
detailed_review.Other: All festivals are celebrated in our college. The seniors are very helpful.

reviews.review_title: Review of College of Engineering, Anna University.

detailed_review.Placements: Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Caterpillar, etc. These companies provided jobs to MCA students. In the previous year, the highest salary package offered by Microsoft to MCA students was 22 LPA. The average salary package offered is 4 LPA. Around 50-60% of MCA students got placed in top MNCs. The remaining 3% of students got internships. In the previous year, my friend Ashis got an internship in Mindtree during his 3rd semester. Top roles offered are software engineer trainee, application developer, analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are well-equipped labs and a central library in our college. The central library has more than 1,00,000 books. There is a separate library for each department. Smart classrooms are available in our college. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Hostels have separate vegetarian and non-vegetarian messes and amenities for normal and international students. There are 2 health centers which work 24X7 for any kind of emergencies.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching is very good. Almost 90% of staff members are Ph.D. scholars. Our DSA and network faculty members completed their Ph.D.s from France and London. The course curriculum is constructed based on the course and industrial knowledge. The semester exams for MCA are less complex compared to B.Tech and BE students. The pass percentage is based on the assessment, attendance, and semester exams.
