faqs.question: Can I get B.Tech at College of Engineering Guindy with 75 percentile in JEE?
faqs.answer: With a 75 percentile in JEE Main, admission to College of Engineering Guindy (CEG) is difficult because Tamil Nadu students must rely on TNEA, and there are high cutoffs for popular branches. Cut-off ranks in previous years have exceeded a possible rank of 50,000+, with ranges from 10,000 to 30,000. It is encouraged to raise JEE Main scores, look into universities with lower cutoffs, or take a closer look at CEG's other branches. Since cut-offs change every year, your chances of getting a higher score are increased. For well-informed selections, extensive research and remaining current with entrance requirements are essential.

faqs.question: How do I get a seat at College of Engineering, Anna University?
faqs.answer: College of Engineering, Anna University offers a large diversity of courses to students in various fields. College of Engineering Guindy admissions are held on the basis of both merit and entrance tests. Students seeking course admissions must clear their previous qualifying examination and appear for any of the prescribed entrance exams such as CEETA, GATE, among others. Students can visit the official website to learn more regarding the course-wise eligibility and specialisation details.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for BSc courses at College of Engineering Guindy?
faqs.answer: CEG admits students to its BSc courses based on marks obtained on Higher Secondary Examination (Class 12) from recognised boards. Recognised boards include CBSE, ICSE, West Bengal and any other board subject to verification of the HSC certificate. Thus any candidate who has passed Class 12 and has obtained relevant HSC certificate is eligible to apply for BSc courses at CEG. highlights.summary:
National Institute of Technology Calicut is one of the top-ranked Architecture institutes in India. It was founded in 1961. It is one of the 31 institutions of National Importance. NIT Calicut has been ranked 2 under the 'Architecture and Planning' category and 21 under the 'Engineering' category by NIRF 2025. National Institute of Technology Calicut Campus has been ranked by several international organisations as well.
NIT Calicut has 15 Engineering departments. The courses offered in these department include BTech, MBA, MPlan, MS, BArch, MTech, and PhD. The BTech is one of the most famous courses of the institute. NIT Calicut admission to these courses is based on the entrance exams, such as JEE Main, GATE, CAT, IIT JAM, etc.
National Institute of Technology Calicut Campus covers an area of around 120 hectares. It is a residential campus with all amenities available on and around the campus. There are, at present, 13 hostels on the campus, out of which 10 are for boys and 3 for girls. Mess operated by outsourcing is given in all hostels.

college_info_program.intro:
NIT Calicut offers 11 undergraduate (UG) and 30 postgraduate (PG) programmes. Besides this, all Departments have their research programmes as well leading to PhD Degrees. The flagship course of National Institute Technology Calicut Campus is Bachelor of Technology (BTech), which is given in different specialisations. reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology, Calicut.

detailed_review.Placements: In M.Tech, there are so many courses. I chose Chemical Engineering, and it is beautiful. So many students in M.Tech are in the chemical course. The highest package in my course is 55 LPA, and the average is 15 LPA. So, from this, we can consider that we can easily achieve 20 LPA. So many top companies in India are giving so many job opportunities. Nowadays, I am attending interviews. So many are going to internships for other companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are so many canteens and hostel blocks. We have so many good facilities like canteens, playgrounds, a park, and a medical clinic. We have so many classrooms and labs with well-equipped requirements. In every corner, there are CCTV cameras in case of any further issues. We have a big library, and the hostel's food quality is so good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful, and they are a very professional faculty. Their way of teaching is amazing. If we completely listen to the class, we can easily pass the exam without studying before the exam. That's the capacity of our professors. The course curriculum is relevant to the lab industries in chemistry. Nowadays, so many are joining labs, and they give high packages. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering

There are big library blocks 24/7 available. We have so many labs available for practical experiments to do with students. The hostel food quality is so good. We have a hospital here, and every day, any time we can play games, if we want, we go to classes.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in NIT colleges are very qualified and knowledgeable. They have so many years of experience in teaching. Some teachers completed their degree in my college, and they started teaching professions in my college. They are well-trained professors. This course is on very advanced technology subjects. For our future generation, these subjects are very useful in many software companies like Google, Microsoft, etc. The semester exams are very hard. We have to study every day for one hour to pass the exam.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Calicut - National Institute of Technology.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering

reviews.review_title: NIT Calicut is a heavenly college in god's own country.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in the college is very good. The average package is 9 LPA. The college provides strong support throughout the placement season. However, students are highly advised to work very hard because the competition is tough.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The buildings and infrastructure are well maintained. It has regular maintenance and construction throughout the campus, making living here convenient and worth the money spent. Although the campus is very big. You might need a cycle for comfort.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here is one of the best among any other institute in India. They are all Ph.D. holders from NIT, IIT, IISc, and even some from Ivy League schools. The semester exams are very hard and difficult to score a high GPA, so students must be very careful.
detailed_review.Other: The college curriculum is very hectic, so be prepared to face challenges. Above all, the placement is good but not well guided, so you have to perform and manage things on your own.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Calicut College.

detailed_review.Placements: Every year, more than 75 percent of students find their way into management companies, typically with packages over 8 LPA. A couple of our seniors recently landed some great offers, one hitting 36 LPA. Another senior got a package of 22 LPA in mechanical engineering, while others got 16 LPA and 12 LPA in mechanical and EEE courses, respectively. These were the packages from folks I know.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
When we talk about the college's infrastructure, it covers all the basics clean water supply, spacious science labs, an auditorium for cultural events, and a playground for sports. There was a well-stocked library and tidy classrooms. Students could also benefit from transportation and on-campus housing if they did not have their own rides. The mess was kept 
clean, and while the food was decent, I think adding a few more choices that students like would be a real bonus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty and staff really did a good job here. First-year classes felt quite a bit like high school, which honestly made the transition easier. The yearly tests were not too complicated. The college did a great job recognizing academic achievements, going out of its way to celebrate the top performers.

reviews.review_title: About good campus life and hostel facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students are placed. The highest package is around 18 LPA. The lowest package offered is around 4 LPA. Out of all the companies, around 40% of students are in core companies. Rest of the companies are sales and marketing related. Usually, 3rd year students get internship offers, and 4th year students get placements. Internship offer percentage is less, around 20%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are good with changing room allotments by year. In the first year, rooms are shared by 3 students (earlier 4). Second and third years stay in the Mega hostel with 2 students per room. In the final year, students can choose the campus hostels or the Mega hostel, with a single room provided. Wi-Fi or LAN is provided to all the hostels. Mess food is better than that in many colleges, with multiple mess options available. There is a health center outside the main campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are moderately tough, and most of the grading system is relatively. Everyone has to get a minimum of 40% marks in order to pass. All teachers here are highly qualified. Most professors maintain good teaching quality, though a few lack in this aspect. The old curriculum was followed till 2024. But I think it is completely restructured now for 2024 admissions onwards, and may make the students industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical engineering as I was interested in cars. Even though its not much popular nowadays, it's still one of the core branches and its value will remain as it is for the rest of the time. During my study, the curriculum was not industry-ready. Many lack the awareness of the skills that are needed in the companies. But a lot of changes have been made in the curriculum for the upcoming batches, and I believe this will be beneficial for them. Ragam and Tathva are the 2 fests conducted annually.

reviews.review_title: NIT Calicut Engineering Physics.

detailed_review.Placements: This is primarily a research course. Most people go for a masters degree or a Ph.D. degree. A very few 3 to 4 students out of 39 opt for placements, and they also get placed. Engineering Physics is counted in the circuit branch along with CSE, EEE, and ECE. We are taught electives from the ECE and EEE branches, so we are placed in similar companies and job roles as them.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mess is okay, not so good, and not so bad. Hostels for 1st year are a bit old. The 2nd year, we get new hostels which are way better than the 1st years. These new hostels are inaugurated 3 to 5 years ago. In first year hostels, there is a computer room, a visitor room, a common room which has TT table, Air hockey, Pool, Chess, Carrom, and a TV. We have a wedding machine installed on the ground floor, which has basic snacks and drinks. We have 3 washing machines also.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty are well qualified. All have done their Ph.D. from reputed indian institutes like IITs, IISc, IISER, and reputed foreign institutes as well. The material that they teach us is very good, and their teaching method is also good. In the first year, some courses are irrelevant for us, like Engineering graphics, mechanical workshop, etc. The curriculum after 1st year is very good. The main objective of this course is not to make students industry ready for companies, but to make students capable of getting offers from reputed institutes for Masters and Ph.D.
detailed_review.Other: If you want to build your career in research, but also want there to be more existing options, when I am not interested in research, then this is the best branch and college you should opt for. College culture is very good. We have workshops related to Physics every month, and there are events organized. The Cultural Fest Ragam is the biggest cultural fest of South India. Connectivity is a issue. You will not get Uber and Ola from airport to college. You need to opt for a local taxi that does not charge too much money.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in NIT Calicut?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Calicut does not facilitate direct admission to any of the courses. Admission is entirely based on merit in the national-level exams, including JEE Main,  GATE,  IIT JAM,  CAT,  NIMCET,  UGC NET, etc. Candidates are further required to participate in other selection rounds, such as counselling, written exam, and interview as well, as per the applied course selection criteria.

faqs.question: What are the courses that NIT Calicut offers?
faqs.answer: The institute offers two undergraduate courses, five postgraduate courses, and one doctoral course. The offered courses by NIT Calicut are as namely BTech, BArch, MTech, MSc, MBA, MPlan, MCA, and PhD. These courses are available in multiple specialisations, including Chemistry, Computer Science and Engineering , Finance , Human Resources , Information Technology , etc.

faqs.question: Is direct admission available for BTech at NIT Calicut?
faqs.answer: No, admission to NIT Calicut BTech course is entirely based on merit obtained in JEE Main entrance exam. faqs.question: Does NIT Calicut accept CMAT score for MBA?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Calicut does not accept CMAT scores for admission to MBA course. For admission to MBA (Regular) course, candidates must qualify for CAT with a valid score. Candidates have to submit their CAT scores at the time of applying for MBA on the official website of NIT Calicut. However, for aspirants of industry-sponsored MBA courses, candidates are offered admission based on their ranks obtained in the Department-level written test.

faqs.question: How can I get MBA in NIT Calicut?
faqs.answer: Candidates who fulfil the eligibility requirements can apply for MBA admission at NIT Calicut. However, the final selection of candidates is based on their scores valid CAT scores. Apart from the entrance test score, candidates will be selected based on performance in the Group Discussion and Personal Interview rounds, Academic Merit (Class 10, Class 12 & Graduation), and Work Experience (if any) as well. Candidates seeking admission to industry-sponsored MBA courses must appear for a Department-level admission test.

faqs.question: Does NIT Calicut offer MBA?
faqs.answer: Yes, a two-year full-time MBA course is available at NIT Calicut. This course is offered across five specialisations, namely HRM, Operations Management, Finance Management, Marketing Management and Business Analytics and Systems. sections.heading: Introduction
text: The campus of the National Institute of Technology Calicut is located about 22 kilometres to the northeast of Calicut (Kozhikode) city. NIT Calicut covers an area of around 120 hectares . The campus is green, and the ambience is very enjoyable. It is a residential campus, with all amenities available on and around the campus. The students live in hostels on campus. There are, at present, 13 hostels on the campus, out of which 10 are for boys and 3 for girls. Messes operated by outsourcing are available in all hostels.
Check out more details in the below videos:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The central library has the collection of over 1.55 lakhs of books, 193 national and international journals and other resources cater to the knowledge. The central library also houses the NALANDA Digital Library, which has over 4690 online journals, 2117 e-books, 31674 e-databases, 9994 conference proceedings and about 2132 ETDs/ CBTs, etc. NALANDA is one of the earliest digital libraries in the country.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: The institute has different hostels starting from 1st-year students to final year students and for international students also. All the hostels have Common room and Recreational center where newspapers, magazines, TV’s and indoor sports/games facilities are available.Free 24 hour internet and computational facilities are available in almost all hostels.

facilities.name: Shuttle Service
facilities.description: The institute provides transportation services for the campus community in the morning and evening shifts. The bus service also provides in the afternoon time from the east campus towards the hostel area.

data.description: NIT Calicut has a rich faculty community with technical and scientific expertise. The faculty members consist of PhD holders involved completely in teaching and research. Currently, at NIT Calicut, there are 312 faculty members, spread over the cadres of Professor (HAG), Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor. The faculty members are highly qualified and are very helpful to students, be it academic or any other.

highlights.summary:
Siksha O Anusandhan University, formerly known as SOA University is a private deemed university founded in 2007 and is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. SOA University is accredited by the NBA (National Board of Accreditation), NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories), NABH (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals), ICAR (Indian Council of Agriculture Research), ABET (Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology), and NAAC (National Assessment and Accreditation Council) with an A++ grade. It is approved by the AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education), UGC (University Grants Commission) and SIRO (Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation). SOA University Bhubaneswar has been ranked the 15th best university in the country by the NIRF Ranking 2025.
SOA offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Engineering, Medical, Management, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Nursing, Law and Research Programs. Siksha O Anusandhan is a leading institute which focuses on preparing the future generation with quality teaching and innovative research. SOA University has top-class infrastructure and it has been ranked 3rd nationally for the Swachh Campus. SOA University placements are splendid where renowned companies such as Amazon, Dell, HP Inc, Deloitte, Hyundai and others. SOA University admission is based on merit and entrance exams. The university accepts various national-level entrance exam such as NEET, JEE Main, CAT, XAT, etc. It focuses on fostering the culture of academic excellence and embracing technologies. reviews.review_title: Review of what a good experience was in my college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Most students got their jobs in their final year. Those who were not able to get jobs through college placement took jobs outside. The highest package was 16 LPA, and the lowest package was 3.4 LPA. The top recruiting companies were HCL, TCS, Swiggy, Zomato, Wipro, etc. An internship is not mandatory for all students who are interested, they can do it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, there were so many different types of courses available. Different courses had different blocks. Fully Wi-Fi available inside the college campus. Classrooms were smart rooms, and a big central library was also available on campus. In the hostel, they provided Wi-Fi, a gym, four times a day food, power backup, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were very helpful, well-qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality was also good. The course curriculum was relevant. It prepared students for the industry. Very easy to pass the semester exam if you read before the exam. Almost all students passed in the Semester exam.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it was relevant to my field.

reviews.review_title: Review of my college opinion and my experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Most of the students in our branch get jobs from good companies. Students who do not get placed get jobs from outside. The highest package offered is 10 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3.6 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course include Wipro, HCL, TCS, Swiggy, and Zomato. An internship is not mandatory for all students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college campus is so big and has full Wi-Fi. Classrooms are fully AC with smart rooms. One central library is also inside the campus. Inside the hostel, full Wi-Fi is available. Both indoor and outdoor sports facilities are available on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is also good. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are very easy to pass if we read before exams. Most of the students pass in exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is relevant to me and I am interested in it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: See in Odisha, and in terms of a private college, ITER is actually good and if you give.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, some of my seniors said Flipkart and some other companies hire with a nice package. 28 LPA and 32 LPA packages are offered. And the thing is, many companies are coming for hiring, like JP Morgan, TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Capgemini, Flipkart, and Google. The ratio of this year was good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Nice building and hostel are well-maintained, both with AC and non-AC. Food is good, lunch, dinner, breakfast and snacks. All the rooms get cleaned daily. Staff are good, no disturbance. We have 2,3,4 sharing rooms and all the washrooms on all floors, and they are cleaned too.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are good, and they make everything easy to understand. All the teachers are well qualified with a Doctorate, and they are really cool and very good. Able to make us understand things as simply as we want. Overall, all staff and teachers are good.
detailed_review.Other: You may not get a high campus life like other colleges, but in the curriculum and in other aspects, this college is good.

reviews.review_title: My college experience and my opinion.

detailed_review.Placements: In our batch, out of 120 students, 90 to 95 are getting jobs. Most of the students are getting jobs in good companies like Accenture, Wipro, Zomato, TCS, Swiggy, etc. The highest package offered by Accenture is 9 LPA, and the lowest package offered by Wipro is 3 LPA. For our course, the college is not offering any internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college campus is too big. Inside the campus, they provide all kinds of facilities like a big central library, gym, food court, and both indoor and outdoor games. The college campus is a full Wi-Fi campus with smart classrooms. Hostels are inside the college and they provide a Wi-Fi facility inside the hostels. They provide typical North Indian food in the hostel, and the food quality is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers have good quality teaching skills, and some teachers help students related to placement. Those who are weak in communication and academic performance get guidance. The teachers prepare students before placement for all companies. The semester exams are not very difficult to pass; most regular students pass the semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because I have an interest in technical courses. In my course, they teach the subjects that I am interested in.

reviews.review_title: Strong academics, but a few areas can be improved.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage is generally high because most students get absorbed into reputed hospitals. The highest package for neurosurgery specialists is usually very good. The lowest and average vary depending on whether the student chooses a private hospital, academic positions, or fellowships. Top recruiting options include multispecialty hospitals, medical colleges, and neurosurgery centers. A decent percentage of students also secure internships, observerships, or fellowships in renowned hospitals and institutes, which helps build strong clinical exposure. The top roles offered are Neurosurgery Specialist, Senior Resident, Consultant Neurosurgeon, and Fellowship Trainee in subspecialties.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are generally helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable in their subjects. Most of them explain concepts clearly. The teaching quality is overall good. The curriculum is relevant and covers important industry-oriented topics, which helps students become well-prepared for future opportunities. Semester exams are moderately difficult, but if you attend classes and study regularly, they are manageable. The pass percentage is decent, and most students clear the exams without major issues. So overall the academic experience is good.
detailed_review.Other: Strong academics and supportive faculty with good clinical exposure. Excellent facilities and hands-on training make it an overall good experience. Quality teaching and solid clinical opportunities in neurosurgery.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is good. You can take admission and have a good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is good. If you are a good student doing amazing in academics with extracurricular knowledge and coding knowledge you will surely get a better placement. Our average placement is 5 to 6 LPA but in 2025 batch we got 10 to 12LPA. Many companies like Infosys Flipkart Amazon TCS etc. B.Tech CSE core is in much demand but if you can take AI ML it will be better. Last year 80 to 90 percent got placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus is a little big not that big do not expect that much. Classrooms are not that modern but always clean. Wi-Fi everywhere. Central library is good and it has many facilities. The key building is cafeteria which has 2 cafes 1 salon and a big restaurant and on the ground floor there are many stores like Maggi and more. Labs are clean not that messy and bad looking.
detailed_review.Faculty: Curriculum is good and has developed a modern syllabus. B.Tech in AI ML got Python and Java both languages. Students can get a great idea from this syllabus. Teaching is good but the number of faculty is not that good at teaching although every teacher has graduated from many great colleges.
detailed_review.Other: Do not expect any big fest. The best course to pick is in CSE core. I wish they did more fests events and concerts. Crowd is good as they have alternative time classes. You can get 20+ clubs or societies.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: SOA ITER overview.

detailed_review.Placements: Decent placements. Packages amount ranges between 4 LPA-45 LPA, with an average of around 7 LPA. Top recruiters include names like Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Accenture, etc. Top roles offered are software engineer, data scientist, DevOps engineer, AI/ML engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is quite well-equipped with various facilities for both academics and beyond, such as sports and research purposes. The campus size is quite vast, and the academic buildings are very well-equipped with air conditioning and other required facilities for learning. The quality of the mess food is decent. Medical facilities are top-tier since there is a collaboration with SUM hospital.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very well qualified, eager to help, and the quality of teaching is very good. The course curriculum is relevant with cutting-edge courses available for AI and Data Science. The course makes the students industry-ready and beyond. The semesters are moderately difficult with a decent pass percentage.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience so far has been good for learning and growth.

detailed_review.Placements: From what I've seen with my seniors, the placement record is strong, and the university brings in a lot of well-known companies for recruitment every year. Placement cell is also quite active. Companies like TCS, Cognizant, etc., come here for the B.Tech course. To my knowledge, the highest package offered in B.Tech is 30-40 LPA, and the average is 8 -10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is pretty good, the classrooms are well-maintained with ACs and digital boards, and the labs have all the equipment you need for assignments. The Wi-Fi is decent enough to get work done. Hostels are fine, pretty much what you'd expect. The mess food can be a bit boring, to be fair, but the canteens have great options, so it's not a big deal. There are also libraries and many sports grounds for various games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers I've had are mostly great, they actually know their stuff and are pretty helpful about helping you out if you're stuck on something. The syllabus feels up-to-date and prepares you for what companies are looking for. The Exams are challenging but fair, you can't pass by memorising everything. Basically, if you show up to class and study a bit, you'll do fine.
detailed_review.Other: I have taken B.Tech in the year 2024, so far it is good, there is so much more to explore. Campus is good with good students and facilities. They are helpful.

reviews.review_title: Good college in Odisha, ITER.

detailed_review.Placements: If someone is pursuing BCA, they become eligible for campus placements in their final year. For B.Tech students, eligibility starts from the 3rd year. The highest package is 4.5 LPA. Each year, over 2000 companies visit and offer comfortable packages to deserving candidates. Around 80-90% of students secure placements with decent salary packages. I plan to pursue MCA after completing my BCA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are really nice. The food is nice. Whenever I had any problems, I just filled out a form, and within 24 hours, the issue was fixed. Although the hostels are quite expensive compared to other colleges, they provide flexibility and comfort. The central library offers all kinds of books. Book lovers would really feel like they are in heaven there. Each classroom has projectors for digital education. Students involved in clubs and social groups may find it difficult to manage everything, but it is manageable if one tries.
detailed_review.Faculty: The quality of teachers and their knowledge is very important in the IT sector. To be honest, our college provides the best in class. The faculty-to-student ratio is quite impressive, as SOA has more than 500 faculty members. There are only two exams. They are mid-semester exams and end-of-semester exams. The mid-semester exams are usually tougher than the end-of-semester exams. Around 20% of students fail to clear each exam. The course curriculum is a little old, but it is being updated as of 2024.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Well-rounded experience with strong academics and vibrant campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Our B.Tech CSE batch of 2025 achieved nearly 80% placements. The highest package offered is 30 LPA, the lowest is 3.5 LPA, and the average range is 6.5 LPA - 8 LPA. faqs.question: Is SOA University hard to get?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is hard to get admission at SOA University. faqs.question: How is admission determined for the BTech programme at SOA University?

Amrita School of Engineering, Coimbatore is a part of the Amrita group of Institutions. Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a parent establishment that has 19 constituent Schools and 9 campuses. Similarly, several other schools deliver programmes in different disciplines. Deemed to be a university, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is accredited by NAAC with a grade of A++ and is approved by AICTE. Amrita Coimbatore admissions are conducted on the basis of the Amrita Entrance Examination – Engineering (AEEE).
Amrita School of Engineering, Coimbatore, on the other hand, has 8 Departments and offers 31 courses. The Institute has a student strength of 3500 with a faculty strength of 600 along with the staff members. The institute offers more than 50 courses under UG, PG, and doctoral level. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Where learning meets passion.

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students are placed, Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Fidelity, IBM, Top roles offered are Software Engineer, Software Developed, The highest was 48LPA, the lowest is 3LPA, average is 15LPA, 60% got internship and the companies are Fidelity, Scale.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities available are Wi-Fi, labs, a water dispenser, library, study room. The quality of the rooms in the hostel is somewhere between average and high quality and some food is very delicious, while some is average. They also provide a cafeteria they have doctors available 24/7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers have completed their Ph.D. programme and are well knowledgeable. They actually maintain a well planned course curriculum and it makes each student get better and trains them well for their placements. The semester exams are quite challenging but if you prepare well you can ace it.
detailed_review.Other: The course I have chosen was CSE and it is a core subject as it helps in placement for all top IT companies. More practical training should be improved. The campus is always crowded and many technical events have been conducted.

reviews.review_title: Review of M.Tech in Biomedical Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Medtronic, Abbott, Cyrix Healthcare, and Boston Scientific are the formal recruiters for the Department of Biomedical Engineering. Peculiarly for the crucial roles like biomedical engineer, Field service engineer, etc. The salary packages range above 3,20,600 LPA as the minimum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The innovative laboratories with all the special healthcare set up are built with all such necessary biomedical devices. Students never tense about anything on campus, because there are some primary responsibilities in all the zones. Everything was followed by us under certain rules of management.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are purely professional in the field of biomedical and engineering, and completed a Ph.D. or other equivalent degree. All the teachers had significant experience in relevant biomedical industries, and the teachers composed the complex concepts into much simpler means.

reviews.review_title: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeeth review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in our course was good. The highest package offered in our course was 24 LPA. The average package was around 7 LPA. Top Recruiting companies were JSW, Tata, Mahindra, Jindal, etc. Around 50 percent of students got internship offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility, modern classroom, and labs were well equipped with instruments and machinery. The quality of hostel was very good. Canteen and mess food was awesome in taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful, qualified and knowledgeable in their respective domains. The Teaching quality of our faculty members was good. Course curriculum was relevant. Students become industry ready. Semester exam in college was moderate. Around 95 percent of students passed.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence  and Data Science (Quantum Technologies)
reviews.review_title: Real truth of Amrita Coimbatore college, you can join this college or not? Is food nice or not?

detailed_review.Placements: I am the first batch in quantum technology in Amrita, so I can't tell the percentage of students placed as of now, but the dean of AI of our college predicts it to be more than 80 percent. Generally, Amrita has only 1 passed-out batch, so as per internal and dean talk, the highest was around 30 LPA. Many got good out-of-campus placements, and many were placed in good colleges for higher studies. Amrita is poor at bringing top companies for placements, but the quality of students was good, as I have seen them getting high placements in off-campus. Many got data security roles, HR, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: To be fair, I consider infrastructure to be worth the money in college. We are getting good 24/7 Wi-Fi, classrooms with smart boards, personal desktops, and charging ports. Many say hostel food was not nice in Amrita, but for me, it's somewhat good compared to other colleges, I think. They may repeat the same menu across a week, but the quality of food is okay to eat. In the canteen, we can get non-veg, so it's also somewhat good, not perfect.
detailed_review.Faculty: The quality of faculty in the 1st year was average to good because they are assistant professors working in college, and on the side, they are working on their own projects and doing Ph.D.s. The syllabus was good, but we don't have high importance on the final semester. It's all in our group projects, interaction with all, assignments, and daily exams. So, that makes us industry-ready. No semester importance, just projects and their reviews, making us hands-on with hardware and software to apply to real-world problems.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of the future scope of quantum. No extracurricular activities, as there is much pressure in academics. So forget about your extracurriculars when you join this college.

reviews.review_title: Completely satisfied with faculty and campus life, good infrastruce.

detailed_review.Placements: In my previous batch of students, among 120 members, the majority of those who opted for placement are placed. The highest package is 14 LPA, and the lowest is 4 LPA. The top company is Caterpillar. Various kinds of internships are provided, which are useful for students in Amrita.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good Wi-Fi, proper conditions in labs, efficient library, food quality is average, and good facilities for sports and games. Food can be improved a bit, but that is secondary. You can really focus well on sports if you are interested. Multiple options like basketball, football, badminton, and powerlifting are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty here are highly qualified and help you in every aspect. Our course curriculum is relevant to IIT's curriculum. Difficulty is easy to average, but attention in classes is mandatory. Mid-semester exams are very important since they carry high weightage of marks, along with internals.
detailed_review.Other: I personally like mechanical engineering, the best thing is practical work. Better information can be provided in depth.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amrita Vishwa Vidhyapeetham where academic excellence and career opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Amrita Vishwa Vidhyapeetham Coimbatore offers great academic industry exposure, 75% minimum placements for the students. Average package is 9 LPA, and the highest is 56 LPA. 60% of students got internships from IBM. Top companies are Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and Wipro.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good, and Wi-Fi will be 24X7 overall the campus. Classrooms and labs are very good compared to normal hostels. International hostels will be better, they differ in the AC/non-AC, whether it depends on the students' comfort.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my college are very helpful and qualified with minimum experience of 15 years and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is nice. Course curriculum is relevant to students. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are moderate to write. Pass percentage will be more than 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I would recommend others to take admission in Amrita Vishwa Vidhyapeetham as it offers a strong academic foundation, great infrastructure, and a supportive environment for overall growth including all events, fest, connectivity, campus surroundings, scholarship, extracurricular activities, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amrita School of Engineering, Coimbatore review.

detailed_review.Placements: I am part of the electronics and communication batch at Amrita School of Engineering, Coimbatore. Out of 260+ students, around 180 are placed in top companies, while others get mass recruitment opportunities and wait for offers. The highest package is 24 LPA, the lowest is 3.5 LPA, and average is 6 LPA to 7 LPA. Top recruiters included Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, Intel, Cisco, TCS, and Infosys. About 60% secured internships at reputed firms like Qualcomm, Bosch, and TI. Roles offered range from VLSI and embedded engineer to software developer and network engineer, providing strong opportunities in both core and IT domains.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Electronics and communication department at Amrita Coimbatore has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms with Wi-Fi, and access to a vast library and digital resources. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms, study space, and 24X7 Wi-Fi. The mess provides nutritious food with both South and North Indian options, though taste can vary. Medical facilities include a dedicated health center with ambulance support. Campus has excellent sports infrastructure, including indoor and outdoor courts, gym facilities, and grounds for cricket and football, ensuring overall development. The environment is safe, disciplined, and supportive for both academics and personal growth.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members in the electronics and communication department at Amrita Coimbatore are highly qualified, approachable, and supportive, with many holding PhDs and industry exposure. The curriculum is regularly updated with electives, labs, and projects that align well with current industry needs, especially in VLSI, embedded systems, and communication. Teaching quality is good, with a focus on both fundamentals and practical learning. Semester exams are moderately difficult, designed to test understanding rather than written learning. The pass percentage is usually high (above 90%), as students receive sufficient guidance, assignments, and remedial sessions to ensure strong academic performance.
detailed_review.Other: I graduated in 2025 from the department of ECE. Events happen in my college but are mostly traditional.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good college for studying and has an environment-friendly.

detailed_review.Placements: According to the placement record, 92% of students get placed. The highest package offered is around 56 LPA, and the lowest is around 2 LPA. Companies like Microsoft, Google, Amazon, etc., visit for recruitment. I am not sure about the internships, but according to seniors' experiences, they get internships too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All facilities such as Wi-Fi, labs, and library are good and well-maintained. The hostel rooms are good, but the mess food is not very good, it is average and sometimes not good at all. The canteen is well-managed and good. There are a few big grounds and many small grounds for playing. Overall, facilities are good except for the food in the mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, and a few are not, but most are knowledgeable. The course and curriculum are good. There are many things built into the course that make learning efficient. First-year semester exams are somewhat easy, while going it may get difficult. To pass exams, we need at least to get 40 marks out of 100.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I studied here between 2021-2025 and I had an amazing life here.

detailed_review.Placements: About more than 90% of students got placed, with an average salary in computer science department of 7 LPA-9 LPA, whereas another department has an average of 4 LPA-5 LPA. They also provide us with both internships and internships with FTE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I'm a CSE student. Mostly we carry our laptops to classrooms for daily activities. Only on exam days, they provide us with their systems to avoid malpractice. When coming to hostel infrastructure, old hostels aren't that great but tight now new ones are building and they look amazing.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are always friendly and helpful except for one or two, which usually happens everywhere. They train us not only for academics but also for the industry where we will go work. Semester exams are difficult for real. We should understand the concepts well to crack them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's a good college with advanced courses.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is good. The students sit on campus for companies, like Amazon, TCS, Zoho, etc., which are big achievement companies visit our college. Every year, almost 95% of students get placed in companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel provides a home away from home to the students, keeping in view the same philosophy. The college provides a secure, comfortable, and healthy environment for all the students. The food in the mess is so good every week. They prepare hygienic food. The rooms are so good for studying and staying.
detailed_review.Faculty: Saying for the faculty, they are basically good and well-educated. The exams can be slightly complicated for the student to write. The course that I have taken is so good, from which, I learned many skills and I developed them by myself. The pass percentage of the college is about 45%, depending on the subject. If any student gets an arrear, he/she has to pay Rs. 700 for all UG programs.
detailed_review.Other: Education, skill projects, and extracurricular activities, which are most verified by the college.

reviews.review_title: Faculty members are very strict and we do not have free time to enjoy.

detailed_review.Placements: 89% of students get placed. The highest package is 59 LPA in ECE and the lowest package is 7 LPA. The top recruiting company for our course is Bosch. 50% of students got internships at Amazon.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amrita has the best working labs to work live. Classrooms are so good and hostels are also very good. It also has 24x7 electricity. It has 3 canteens and they also provide both non-veg and veg food. It has the best infrastructure. We have the best hostels compared to some IITs and NITs with 24x7 Wi-Fi. We have the main canteen and the MBA canteen. The canteen offers different kinds of food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly and very caring. We also have HODs of our branch. They used to guide us every minute without wasting our time and their time. We have the best lab teachers to teach.
detailed_review.Other: Our college organises some fests.

reviews.review_title: Review of Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are not that good for CHE and in our college. They are pretty average. The college has a lot of connections, so internships are pretty good. Top recruiters are Amazon, Hyundai, Bosch, etc. 50-70% of placements are done. The average salary is low.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are bad. There are 4 people in 1 room. It is also not a sufficient amount of space to keep all your things. They provide you with 2 tables for 4 of you. The mess food is really bad and sometimes, it is impossible to eat. Wi-Fi is provided 24/7 throughout the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is good and prepares students for industries. Most of the teachers are friendly and good at teaching. But some teachers are not that good at teaching. If we complain, the entire class has to suffer.
detailed_review.Other: There are not many events on the campus that are enjoyable. Just a planned college life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amazing faculty members and infrastructure. Diverse and friendly student community.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package offered is 56.95 LPA, and the average package is around 9.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, cognizant, Wipro, Amazon, and IBM. Various on-campus and off-campus internships are offered in the 3rd year. Amazon is one of the top companies offering internships to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Multiple labs designed for different courses and very well-maintained. Campus infrastructure is beautiful. Amrita clinic offered medical assistance on campus. There are 3 canteens situated in the three main academic blocks serving delicious meals. Amrita Wi-Fi connects all the labs, academic blocks, and hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are Ph.D. holders. They are friendly, patience, and understanding. The course curriculum is designed very similarly to the IITs giving equal importance to our culture by including subjects like Indian heritage and yoga. Semester exam papers are moderate to difficult. CIR courses are also given importance right from the 2nd year to make the students industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: Apart from academics, here at Amrita, all the events, fests, and extracurricular are given equal importance. Campus crowd is mixed with people from all over India. This makes it the right place for networking and socializing.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I recommend to visit our college to see the environment of it.

detailed_review.Placements: Regarding placement statistics, university has demonstrated strong performance across its various programs. For instance, the MBA program for 2022-2024 batch reported an average salary package offered was 8.33 LPA. The median salary package was 7.60 LPA, with 115 recruiters participating and 40 new recruiters joining the placement process.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has the best Wi-Fi facility in every classroom and hostel. We are lagging behind some labs, but we have the best computers, EEE, and ECS, as well as some important labs. Our classrooms and library are very good. Our hostel has good facilities, and the food is also very healthy, with only vegetables in the mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: The university boasts highly qualified and experienced faculty members, many of them hold advanced degrees from prestigious institutions such as the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) and the Indian Institute of Science (IISc).
detailed_review.Other: Students often choose courses at Amrita University due to its strong academic reputation, industry-aligned curriculum, and excellent placement opportunities. This university emphasis on research, practical learning, and holistic development attracts students aiming for comprehensive education.

reviews.course: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
reviews.review_title: Amrita's B.Tech AI course: A gateway to top placements and cutting edge roles.

detailed_review.Placements: In our AI department, about 90% of the students get placed. The highest salary package offered is 48 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4.8 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 8.5-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Intel, etc., visit our college for placements. Around 75% or more students got internships whereas the rest did their own projects or prepared for higher studies. The top roles offered in our course are data scientist, machine learning engineer, AI engineer, data analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My department has the best infrastructure. We have a full Wi-Fi class with a big-screen monitor for lectures and 72 systems for daily work. The college library is the best library I have visited. It has all types of books and e-book access for students. My first-year hostel, Kashyapa Bhavanam, is brand new and very good. The quality of hostel food is more than average. The canteen has some good food. Sports are also given equal importance as studies in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: All my lecturers are from NIT and IIT. They are very good. The course curriculum is set by our dean Mr K. P. Soman. He is one of the best and among the top 2% of AI scientists in the world. My course does not have mid-semester or end-semester examinations. However, we have daily assessments and end-semester projects, which help in our future as we get hands-on experience by doing a project and publishing research papers.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall best among others.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly 70% of students got placed in Amrita with good salary. The highest salary package offered is nearly 53 LPA. The average salary package offered is 6 LPA given by Amrita. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, Infosys, etc. The internship that students get is nearly 60%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is quite good and has a wide area filled with trees. We also have labs and grounds. Wi-Fi service is available everywhere on campus. I won't recommend it higher but it is quite good. Classrooms consist of 70 members and it has Wi-Fi facilities and charging points also.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well trained and they are mostly Ph.D staff. Their teaching is very experienced. They may not be more interactive but they are good at teaching. The exams conducted here are a bit tough compared to the other colleges. But the CGPA is based on relative grading so no worries.
detailed_review.Other: Events are conducted here very frequently and we can enjoy those events very well. Participants are first-year students so we can enjoy it here.

reviews.review_title: I had a good experience here. It has good placements, infrastructure, and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95% of students have secured placements with a salary package that ranges from 6-24 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 8-9 LPA. Prominent companies like Caterpillar, L&T, Bosch, and other leading firms visit the college for placements. Roles like design engineer, production engineer, quality analyst, and research and development engineer are offered to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college offers a comprehensive infrastructure to support the B. Tech Mechanical Engineering program. It is equipped with over 20 state-of-the-art laboratories and workshops. The campus is spread over 400 acres of land. It includes well-designed academic buildings, a central library with vast books, and a good dispensary.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is designed to be industry relevant aiming to equip students with the necessary skills and knowledge for the engineering sector. It includes a blend of theoretical and practical learning experiences. Exams are moderately difficult and the pass percentage is around 50%.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because I like machines. The best thing about our course is machines can do anything which humans cannot do. Events organised are regular and average, and not that good like other colleges.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amrita is a life-changing campus.

detailed_review.Placements: 95 percent of students placed last. 52 LPA has the highest. Coming to the lowest, 7 LPA. It depends on the year because last year was with recession, so it got low. Many MNCs came, not specified, and NH to placement. Most of our faculty members have seen what's happening with placements; they will help us to build our resume.

reviews.review_title: Affordable and superb infrastructure college.

detailed_review.Placements: A total of 48 students got placed in 2025, and the highest is about 18.56 LPA in Optum, and the lowest is in TCS Ninja with 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies include TCS, Optum, HCL, Accenture, Visa, IDFC, HSBC, etc. Around 40 percent of students got their internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-class. Although the area is not that big because of the Delhi location, the overall infrastructure is the best. Jamia has its sports complex where Ranji matches are also held, and all facilities are available. Hostel charges are about Rs. 40,000 per year, including mess and accommodation.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, very helpful, and well-qualified with superb minds. Their technique for teaching is excellent, and they make students industry-ready. However, exams are not that hard. We can easily pass with 2-3 days of study before the exam, and around 70 percent of students pass without any backlog.

reviews.review_title: Jamia Millia Islamia review

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in our course was not good in any college because it is an academic course, not a vocational course. The career options after this are assistant professor, teacher, or translator. Some companies like BPO/Customer Care recruit us with a salary of 3–4 LPA. Students also got internships in various institutes.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central library was present. Classrooms were integrated with digital TV. The quality of the hostel was extremely good, but the hostel capacity was very less, so most students could not get hostel accommodation.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality of our faculty members was good. The course curriculum was relevant, and students gained deep knowledge about their subject. The semester examination was a little tough. Almost 90–95 percent of students passed.

reviews.review_title: It offers what a tier-3 college can provide and is good in terms of ROI.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, nearly 50% of students secure campus placements, with an overall placement rate of over 80%, including off-campus placements. The highest package is 24 LPA from Landmark Group UAE, followed by 18 LPA from Splash and 11 LPA from ICICI Bank. Most offers range between 5-8 LPA, primarily for marketing, sales, and HR roles, along with positions in operations, project management, consultancy, and analysis. The lowest package is 5 LPA. It is advisable to seek internships independently, as those offered by the college are not very relevant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The basic facilities such as smart boards, microphones and speakers, drinking water, and a girls' common room are available. The departmental library is well-equipped with resources and study materials. There are numerous canteens on campus that offer good food at reasonable prices. The campus is green and beautiful. Talking about the hostel, it has 3-seater rooms, a common room, a reading hall, clean drinking water, and average mess food available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of professors are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is revised and updated, but the B-school environment is lacking. The atmosphere is not as competitive as that of a B-school. Semester exams are not very difficult, with easy questions, some practical questions, and case studies included. The pass percentage is 40%.
