reviews.review_title: Review of Jamia Millia Islamia.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in our course is not quite good, but it has a good curriculum and alumni network as compared to other colleges. The package offered in our course is around 4-5 LPA. Some translating firms hire us. Around 70 percent of students get internship offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good. A central library is present. The hostel quality and our faculty members are good. All essential facilities are available. Food and canteen food are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality of our faculty members are excellent. The course curriculum is relevant. The college prepares students to be industry ready. Semester examinations depend on the students' preparation.

reviews.review_title: Best college for mass communication.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 85 per cent of students were placed in our course. The highest package offered in our course was 12 LPA. The average package was around 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies were TV9, Times Now, India Today, etc. Almost all the students got an internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central Library was present. The quality of the hostel was awesome, but it's rare to get a hostel. A medical facility was available in the college. A sports and games complex was available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors of our course were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They teach unbiased journalism and are free to speak without any fear. The course curriculum was relevant. Students were working in Big Media House, like Aaj Tak. The semester examination was a little tough.

reviews.review_title: An Engineering student perspective about JMI.

detailed_review.Placements:
Around 75% of students from CSE got placed in the companies. The highest package is 18 LPA on-campus, and the average package is 5.5 LPA. The lowest package is 3.2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Accenture, Optum, HSBC, and TCS. JMI does not provide that much of on-campus internship opportunities but you can apply off-campus. Some big companies that offer on-campus internship opportunity for CSE are 
Accenture and Optum with a stipend of Rs. 10,000 and Rs. 40,000 respectively.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of the college are not up to mark as the building of the college is not upgraded. Even some classroom projectors does not work properly. Talking about library, it is quite good. I didn't opt for a hostel so I can't tell you about the hostel food but canteen food is a major problem especially when you are vegetarian there are less varieties in canteen and even that are not so good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in JMI are well-qualified and experienced in the research sector. Course curriculum is less relevant as the latest topics are not included in the curriculum. Some changes are introduced but still, some more changes can be done. Semester exams are not that hard. Pass percentage is 40%.

reviews.review_title: It's a beautiful campus and a well-reputed university, and the teaching staff is great.

detailed_review.Placements: From the 7th semester, students are eligible for campus placement. Companies visited are Optum, Accenture, HSBC, Zenon, Zia Semiconductor, RSM, Axiom, ZS, HLS, and CDOT. The highest package is 40 LPA, which was given by Microsoft in 2018, and the highest package currently is 25 LPA on campus. The average package is 8 LPA currently in the CSE branch. 70 percent are placed right now in batch 2025. I want to do a job after my degree.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel accommodation began by December, while I secured a seat in August itself. So it got a little difficult for me. The room is nice, spacious with a 3 seater, food was okay, we used to get veg and non-veg both. The quality was not great but decent. Seats are very much limited, this is one issue. The hostel is 1.5 km away from the college. Hostel fee is INR 48,000 per year. They need improvement in terms of class infrastructure, smart boards and projects are needed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty teach us each and every concept, engage us, and classes are very interactive. And reading books like the original is one thing, they prefer us to read originals.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the quality of the course.

detailed_review.Placements: For M.Sc. In the Virology course, there is no placement, not a single company related to our field comes for placement. You have to find a PI for your dissertation. Sometimes the faculty also helps with this. Our faculty members also offer dissertations, but they encourage students to apply outside the university.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, a water purifier, and a projector. To conduct experiments, all necessary facilities are available in our lab, including RT-PCR, qPCR, BSL-2, a cell culture room, and a Virus culture lab. Our university has a central library near my department, where you can issue any two books for 14 days. The central canteen has good quality food at a cheap rate, and many other shops are also there. Cricket ground and other sports grounds are working, you can use it, many tournaments are organized from time to time.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very polite and helpful. If you need any help, you can ask in the classroom or personally. They are very knowledgeable. Before joining here, they did a doctorate in foreign countries. The M.Sc. Virology course syllabus is the best, it includes every topic needed for current research and also history. If you focus on the lecture and read at home, you can easily score well in exams. In this course, you have to give two sessional exams, each worth 20 marks, and a final exam of 60 marks. 40 percent marks are needed in every exam to pass.
detailed_review.Other: The university and departments organize many events, but the best event is the annual university event. My department organized an international symposium last year. AAJMI, NSP, and many scholarship opportunities are available for students. Our class has paid Rs. 90000 for each year, but now you have to pay only Rs. 55000 per year.

reviews.review_title: JMI: A central university in New Delhi.

detailed_review.Placements: My branch was introduced in the batch of 2024. So, as of now, it has no placement data, but it's an outcome-based combination of both electrical and computer engineering. Students will be going through placement in both branches, particularly in fields where knowledge from both fields is required. So, for the basic idea, electrical engineering graduates acquire from an average of 7 LPA to 20 LPA. The highest in computer engineering offered 6 LPA to 20 LPA, with 75% of students placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms have AC for 2nd year students onwards, and the seats are good. Sometimes issues are faced that are resolved within a few days. Wi-Fi is available. FET library is working from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays. The central library in a block remains open from 9:00 AM-2:AM, except national holidays.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are actually helpful. A few teachers are quite strict, but they help you pass exams. Marking is normal, not that strict. The course curriculum is 50% relevant. Labs make it relevant. They make students industry-ready. Semester exams are not very tough. If you keep studying and keep track of what's going on in class, along with proper assignments, you will come up with a good CGPA, and the passing criteria varies from subject to subject 33% to 40%.

reviews.review_title: Very good faculty and very nice experience.

detailed_review.Placements: The Electrical and Computing branch started with my batch in 2024. It is a self-financed course but falls under the Electrical Engineering department. In 2024, around 37 to 43 students are placed. The highest package is about 18.56 LPA, the lowest is 3.46 LPA, and the average is 7.5 LPA. Around 60% of students are placed. Top companies include TCS, Accenture, Siemens, HCL, Optum, Zia Semiconductor, L&T, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are six boys' hostels named F.R.K, A.P.J, B.R.A, A.M.K, Kelat, and S.R.K (Alma Iqbal is not available right now). The hostels and mess are very affordable, with hygienic and nutritious food. The engineering department has one big building with different sections for different departments. The library has AC and Wi-Fi connection.
detailed_review.Faculty: The Electrical Engineering department has very good and experienced professors. Our branch is self-financed, so the study covers both electrical core and software, benefiting from both the Computer and Electrical departments. Around 70% of students pass the exams because the exams are not very hard. There is one end semester and two midterm exams.

reviews.review_title: Good faculty, but 2024 was not a good year for engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package in 2024–25 in Electrical Engineering is 18.56 LPA in Optum. The lowest is 3.46 LPA in TCS Ninja, with an average of 7 LPA. Around 40 students are placed in 2024–25. Top companies like TCS, JSW, Optum, Zia Semiconductor, L&T, etc., visit the campus. Around 25–30 students get internships on campus, and around 80% of students get internships off campus. So overall, it is not a good year for Electrical Engineering in terms of placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All five departments, Computer, Electronic, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil, have a common building. There is one separate building for the library and reading room, fully air-conditioned with centralized Wi-Fi. Electrical Engineering classes have no AC. In Jamia, there are 7 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic and very affordable. Hostel costs around Rs. 40,000 per year for mess and accommodation.
detailed_review.Faculty: Electrical Engineering has very experienced and knowledgeable professors. One professor, Ahteshamul Haq, is named among the top 2% of scientists in the world, and others are also very experienced. They help us anytime we need. The department conducts two session tests and one end-of-semester exam. Exams are easy.

reviews.review_title: Overall, everything is okay.

detailed_review.Placements: Students are not placed in this course because this field is for civil service and so many. No package offers in this course, maybe offered but I have no idea. I have no idea about this, or maybe randomly internships are offered with government political.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Department is also good. Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are not too much good. Library is excellent. The food quality is not too much good in mess. Canteen food is good. Medical facilities are free which is good. Sports and games are also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and more educated from outside of India. They are qualified and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is good. It depends on your semester exam, how much hard work you put into the semester exam. Internal exams are difficult. Pass percentage SCGPA is 4.5.
detailed_review.Other: It's best for me because of the civil service to choose an optional subject. Everything is organized on time.

reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied with placement but very good faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: There are a total of 5 departments in engineering, but civil is in the last position for things like placement and student priority. A total of 30 students were placed in 2024-25 in civil companies like L&T, Ambuja Cements, J.K. Laxmi, etc. All are in field jobs with an average salary of 5 LPA, the highest is 9 LPA, and the lowest is 2.9 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The quality of mess food is good, especially in A.P.J. hostel and F.R.K. hostel. There are 3 girls' hostels and 6 or 7 boys' hostels, and there are many canteens in Jamia with affordable prices. Sports facilities are available, as well as a clinic. The engineering department has one building, and there is another building for the reading room and library.
detailed_review.Faculty: The civil engineering department has the most senior professors, and they are very knowledgeable and experienced faculty. They are strict teachers, but they help students with academic studies, and the difficulty level of exams is very low, allowing around 80% of students to pass.

reviews.review_title: 2022 is the best year for electrical engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, electrical placements are not good. Around 40 students are placed out of 78 students, and these 40 students are placed in Optum, TCS, Zia Semiconductor, JSW, L&T, etc. The lowest package is 3.45 LPA in TCS Ninja, and the average package in electrical engineering in 2024-25 is 7 LPA, while the highest is 18.56 LPA in Optum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall campus is good. The buildings are good, and the dentistry building is very nice, well-maintained, and well-designed. The engineering department has a personal library and reading room, and all 5 departments of engineering have a common building. There are a total of 6 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic, and the food is decent at a reasonable price. Jamia has a sports complex and a free clinic for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable. They teach us very well. However, some teachers are lazy and don't teach us with their hearts. In the engineering departments, all 5 departments take 2 sessional tests and 1 end-of-semester exam. We can easily pass the exams by studying before them, and approximately 70 students pass their exams.

reviews.review_title: Development extension - Professional course.

detailed_review.Placements: Only 30% of students got placed in that year. The highest package was 5 LPA, and the lowest was 2 LPA. Mostly students got placed in NGOs such as Bachpan Bachao Andolan, Kailash Satyarthi Children Foundation, and Hope Ngo. All the students of 2nd year were placed in NGOs for the internships. The top roles offered were assistant project officer and HR Recruiter.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the students had access to Wi-Fi and library. Library at Jamia was very good, and the classrooms of the department were average. The hostel was very good. The quality of food was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were very helpful and knowledgeable. Teachers taught very well according to the curriculum. The course curriculum was good but not so good. Somehow, students face difficulties in getting placed and being industry-ready. The semester exams were easy, and mostly every student pass the exams. Faculty members were good. Some teachers taught very well, and some were average.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it was similar to social work, and also they placed students in various NGOs for field work. I want they could let the students choose a dissertation for masters.

reviews.review_title: Before taking Admission in JMI s B.Tech course, go through this review.

detailed_review.Placements: In electrical engineering, about 80% get campus placement, and among them, most are recruited by mass recruiters. The packages are not that high, but the ROI return on investment is high as the fee for the whole 8 semesters is about only 80k Rs hostel excluded, and the average package in electrical engineering is 4 to 5LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facility is top notch. Being a non vegetarian, it is heaven to be in a muslim university hostel, as the non veg foods are delicious, the menu is also mouth watering, and on festive occasions, they give special foods, and also the Hostel Annual functions are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, most are PhDs, and even some are IIT students. One of the teachers has been the NITs dean. The course is also relevant, workshops and labs are truly making students industry ready. I have not given any exams yet, but heard from seniors that exams are also tactically good for students growth.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as I wanted to study in Jamia Millia Islamia, as I have studied 9 to 12 in Jamias school.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It provided the best placements in 2022. It is the best college for engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024 and 25, the lowest students got placed from the electronics department in campus placements. Only 45-50% of students get placed, and 2 students are placed in the Optum company with a package of 18.56 LPA. Other students got placed in companies like TCS, Accenture, etc. 1 student got an internship in Accenture, and after the 7th semester, he got a PPO by Accenture.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The engineering department is very good. Five departments have only one building, one separate library, and a reading building with AC and Wi-Fi connection. There are hostels like FRK, SRK, Kelat, A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, Allma Iqbal, Dr BR Ambedkar, and 3 girls' hostels. Jamia has a big sports complex and Ansari Medical Services.
detailed_review.Faculty: All five departments, including electronic and communication, take two sessional tests of 15 marks and one end-semester exam of 45 marks. Exams are easy. Electronics faculty members are very good. They give good marks. They teach us very well. There are knowledgeable and experienced faculty members. Approximately 70-80% of students pass exams.

reviews.review_title: Best department of JMI B.Tech.

detailed_review.Placements: About 65% of students were placed in 2025 in computer engineering at companies like Optum, HSBC, Accenture, RSM USI, TCS Digital, TCS Ninja, etc. The average is 9 LPA, and the highest is 52 LPA (off-campus), and on campus, the highest is 18.59 LPA in Optum, and the lowest is 3.45 LPA in TCS Ninja.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The engineering department has its own building, library, and reading room with centralized Wi-Fi and AC. Labs are good. We have an Apple lab and many other labs, and computer science is the best department in all of engineering and technology. There are 6 boys' hostels in which 3 students live in a room. A total of 1500+ seats are available, along with 3 girls' hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: The computer engineering department has the most facilities and experienced faculty who are knowledgeable about current market demands. The semester exam consists of 2 midterms, which are 15 marks each, while all departments have different patterns and 1 end-of-semester exam worth 25 marks.

reviews.review_title: Best placement in 2022, and the worst in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025 electrical engineering, placement is the worst like only 38 students placed out of 76 students. Recruiting companies are Siemens, Accenture, Optum, TCS, Zia Semiconductor, L&T, Reliance Industries, JSW, etc. All these companies take 3 to 4 students only. Average package this year is 7 LPA, the highest is 18.56 LPA which is by Optum, and the lowest is 3.45 LPA by TCS Ninja.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is pretty good and greenish all over the campus. Buildings are good department. Lab has less facilities but okay. Mess food is average. Engineering has a separate library and reading room, which have Wi-Fi and AC. There are total 6 boys hostels and 3 girls hostels. Sports complex is available and timing is from Monday to Friday 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of electrical engineering are good, very experienced, and knowledgeable. But they are lazy, not all professors but some are lazy and arrogant. Department takes 2 mid-term exams of 30-30 marks each, and 1 end semester which has 45 marks but we can easily pass the exam by studying just before the exam.

reviews.review_title: Best affordable college and best central government university.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package of Electrical Engineering is very less, about 6 LPA, and the highest is 18.56 LPA, which is offered by Optum to only 2 students. A total of 38 students are placed this year out of 70 students. Companies like TCS, Siemens, Accenture, Optum, etc., are the main recruiters for Jamia Engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very good. The Engineering Department has one big building in which all departments are together, and Engineering has a separate library and reading room for students, and also has a canteen. Jamia has Wi-Fi connection all over the library, reading room, and hostels. The hostel facilities are very good, with 6 boys' hostels: f. r. k hostel, a. m. k hostel, alama iqbal hostel, kelat hostel, a. p. j hostel, and s. r. k hostel. The mess is hygienic and very affordable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty of Electrical Engineering is very knowledgeable and experienced, but they are very lazy and not focusing on students' studies. However, they all are Ph.D. holders and very knowledgeable professors. Two MS term tests and one end semester exam are taken by the Engineering Department, which is easy to pass.

admission.title: Jamia Millia Islamia Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
JMI admission 2026 will be as per the score of the entrance exam. The university has made its prospectus available in March along with the admission schedule for courses with national-level and university-level entrance exams. JMI, New Delhi provides more than 220 courses both in regular and self-financed modes. The university also offers distance learning courses at UG, PG, and diploma levels.

JMI admissions 2026 are majorly on the basis of CUET and JMI entrance. Applicants who want to get a seat to one of the programmes have to take part in the process of admission through the steps provided below:

1. Eligibility:

Applicants have to go to the official website.

2. Apply Online:

Candidates must apply through the application form on the official website of the institute.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA at Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Total tuition fee for MBA at Jamia Millia Islamia ranges between INR 38,500 - INR 3 lakh. The range indicates that fee across all MBA specialisations is different. In addition to tuition fee, students are also required to pay application form charges which is INR 700 for course. The afore mentioned tution fee, however, is sourced from various sources on internet. For exact fee and specialisation-wise fee break-up for different MBA specialisations, students can reach out to the admission office or check out the JMI Official Prospectus 2023-24.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for Jamia Milia Islamia BTech CSE?
faqs.answer: Jamia Milia Islamia BTech in CSE is one of the popular programmes among students. Candidates seeking admission must fulfil the eligibility and selection requirements. The aspirants who are Class 12 with PCM with 55% / 3-4 year Diploma with 55% aggregate can apply. At the time of admission or form filling, aspirants must hold the relevant documents for verification purposes.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: How can I get into JMI for BA or BA (Hons)?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to Jamia Millia Islamia for BA must have passed Class 12 or SSC with a minimum aggregate ranging from 40-50%. The passing percentage is different for different specialisations offered in the BA programme. Admission to Jamia Millia Islamia for BA and BA (Hons) is subject to either CUET (conducted by NTA) or JMI entrance exam. Till 2021, admission was subject to the JMI entrance exam across all specialisations. However, starting 2022, admission to a few BA (Hons) specialisations is CUET-based and for the rest, it is university-level entrance-based. Interested candidates can apply online for all courses on the official website of JMI or CUET.

faqs.answer: NIT Manipur JEE Main cutoff 2024 has been released for admission to the BTech courses. faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MA at Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia offers a two-year MA programme, admission to which is offered based on the entrance conducted by the university, i.e. JMI Entrance Eest. More details for Jamia Millia Islamia fee for MA along with its eligibility, selection criteria and seat intake are as follows: MA Specialisation Eligibility Criteria English BA/ BA (Hons)/ BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCom/ BCom (Hons) or a bachelor’s degree with at least 50% aggregate in the subject concerned Hindi BA/ BA (Hons)/ BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCom/ BCom (Hons) or a bachelor’s degree with at least 50% aggregate in the subject concerned Mass Media (Hindi) - self-financed UG degree in any discipline with a minimum 50% aggregate or equivalent CGPA History BA/ BA (Hons)/ BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCom/ BCom (Hons) or a bachelor’s degree with at least 50% aggregate in the subject concerned Islamic Studies BA/ BA (Hons)/ BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCom/ BCom (Hons) or a bachelor’s degree with at least 50% aggregate in the subject concerned Economics BA/ BA (Hons)/ BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCom/ BCom (Hons) or a bachelor’s degree with at least 55% aggregate in the subject concerned Political Science BA/ BA (Hons)/ BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCom/ BCom (Hons) or a bachelor’s degree with at least 50% aggregate in the subject concerned Sociology UG degree in any discipline with a minimum 50% aggregate or equivalent CGPA Politics, International & Area Studies UG degree in any discipline with a minimum 50% aggregate or equivalent CGPA Mass Communication UG degree in any discipline with a minimum 50% aggregate or equivalent CGPA In addition to the above 10 MA specialisations, the university also offers MA across 25 specialisations, namely, Arabic, Persian, Sanskrit, HRM, and Geography, among others.

faqs.answer: Jamia Milia Islamia BSc cutoff list is prepared based on CUET UG scores. Candidates seeking admission to the aforementioned course, must have a valid scores in CUET UG scores in order to be eligible for further rounds. faqs.question: Does Jamia Millia Islamia accept CUET score?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jamia Millia Islamia accepts CUET scores for UG courses such as BA, BSc and BVoc. Jamia Millia Islamia admission is based on entrance exam score. The university released its prospectus for admissions in March with the schedule for admission to courses accepting national-level and university-level entrance exams. JMI, New Delhi offers over 220 courses in both regular and self-financed modes. The university also provides distance learning courses at undergraduate (UG), postgraduate (PG), and Diploma levels.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia admission to UG and PG courses is entrance exams based. The university accepts JMI entrance exam, CUET and JEE Main for admission. Further, to be eligible for admission, students also need to pass Class 12 with 50% for admission to UG courses and a graduation degree with 50-55% aggregate for admission to PG courses.

faqs.question: What is the reservation percentage for Muslim candidates at JMI?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia offers seat reservations in almost all the courses based on the category of the students. Candidates seeking JMI admission under the reserved category can apply for reservation under one category only and are required to fulfil the prescribed eligibility conditions of the course. More details regarding JMI reservation criteria are enlisted below: More details on the reservation criteria and relaxation offered to students across course eligibility are available in the official 2023 prospectus of JMI .

faqs.question: Can I get into JMI with 50 percentile?
faqs.answer: As per the JMI cutoff 2024 for the Round 13 seat allotment, candidates won't be able to get into JMI with 50 percentile for M.Sc in Biotechnology , which is the only course available for the General AI category candidates.

faqs.question: Can I get into JMI for BA without CUET?
faqs.answer: As per the CUET UG website, students seeking admission to BA at Jamia Millia must appear for and qualify CUET exam. However, since some universities are also considering other components while giving admission to CUET-UG based courses, it could be a possibility of getting into JMI without CUET. But, this being said there is no official information on whether the university will only consider CUET UG scores or other components as well for admission, it is tough to give the right answer. Students are therefore advised to reach out to the admission office for more details.

faqs.question: I've scored less than 60% in 12th boards, can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: To get admission at Jamia Millia Islamia in BA course, the score needed is between 45% to 50% based on different specialisations. Interested students need to visit official website of JMI and check admission details and eligibity criteria of course they want to apply.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BA (Hons) at JMI?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to Jamia Millia Islamia for BA must have passed Class 12 or SSC with a minimum aggregate ranging from 40-50%. The passing percentage is different for different specialisations offered in the BA programme. With an annual intake of over 900 students for BA and BA (Hons) programmes (including all the specialisations), admission to Jamia Millia Islamia for BA and BA (Hons) is subject to either CUET (conducted by NTA) or JMI entrance exam. faqs.question: Is MA available at Jamia Millia Islamia?
faqs.answer: Yes, MA course is available at Jamia Millia Islamia. The institute offers MA courses at the PG level. Candidate must meet the eligibility criteria to enroll for MA course admission set by the college. Aspirants must pass Any UG degree with at least 50%-55% aggregate. JMI admission process is JMI Entrance Exam.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jamia Millia Islamia for MA?
faqs.answer: Jamia Millia Islamia offers a two-year MA programme to the stduents across more than 30 specialisations. It is a two-year programme spread over four semesters, admission to which is based on a candidate’s performance in JMI Entrance Exam. sections.heading: Introduction
text: Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI) is one of the premier educational institutions, offering a holistic learning experience blended with vibrant campus life. Jamia Millia Islamia strives to build a modern learning system with a vision to promote the sustainable development of society and betterment for all. It caters to the needs of lakhs of students by being a hub of knowledge, offering a variety of UG, PG, Diploma and Doctoral programs, and fostering intellectual curiosity and innovation in their lives. The University also offers top-notch infrastructure facilities encompassing a vast library, hostels, games & sports facilities, and its affiliated schools. To learn more about the JMI infrastructure details, read the article below:

sections.heading: Jamia Millia Islamia Campus Highlights 2024
text: Jamia Millia Islamia is accredited as the NAAC A++ central university and ranked in the 3rd position under top universities by the NIRF Ranking Report 2024. It is a Delhi-based institution working as a comprehensive research-intensive central (Public) University. It was established in Aligarh by nationalist leaders and students of Aligarh Muslim University in 1920, and relocated to Delhi in 1925. Funded by national and international agencies, it is furnished through cutting-edge research programs, infrastructure facilities and academic collaboration, which help it achieve academic excellence all over the world.

highlights.summary:
IIT Gandhinagar was founded in 2008 and it is ranked 25 th in NIRF 2025 in the Engineering category. Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar IIT Gandhinagar has got e-Masters degree programme in Energy Policy and Regulation that is offered over 2 years. The institute has also initiated application to batch 2 e- Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation and there is no GATE requirement to be admitted. The qualification criterion of the candidates is that he must have either a Bachelor or a Master degree in any of the related fields like Engineering, Economics, Law, Commerce, Management, or Finance. Moreover, IIT Gandhinagar e-Masters in Energy Policy and Regulation accept at least 60 percent marks or 6.0 CGPA. Applicants are required to submit their application in the official site to IITGN e-Masters programme. Though a fee of INR 1000 is required to be paid by the candidates.
IIT Gandhinagar is a government institute, which was founded in 2008. The best companies like Accenture, Cred, D E Shaw, Oracle, Salesforce, and many more visit the institute. reviews.review_title: Green and clean with a good friend and a bright future.

detailed_review.Placements: In my college 60 percent of students get placed, and remanig student mostly prefer to go for higher study or to do strat up. The top companies that come every year are Google, ITC, Amazon, Microsoft, Zomato and many more. These companies mostly come for sd role. There are many more companies for other branches also. The highest package offered is 40 LPA and the lowest package offered is 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the second generation of IITs, IIT Gandhinagar boasts the most beautiful campus and infrastructure. We have free Wi-Fi everywhere on campus and staff to clean the hostel and rooms every day. Good quality mess food. indoor sports complex open for everyone.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty for everything, and they are good in nature and giving score. The courses provided in the curriculum are beneficial for academic internship as well as industrial placement. Exams are easy or based on the professor. We have relatively easy grading, so its easy to pass and score well in the exam as well as from your peers.

reviews.review_title: Good Infrastructure, placement and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: AI branch at IIT Gandhinagar is still very new and our batch is only the third one, so there isn’t any past placement data only for AI. But IITGN overall has pretty strong placement record with around 85–90 percent and avg package near 18–20 LPA, so it gives some idea what to expect. Many big companies like Amazon, Google, Morgan Stanley, Flipkart and more visit every year. AI students will also likely get roles in software, data Science, ML and research since related branches already getting these type of opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure level is at its peak and design is unique. Facilities provided are Wi-Fi, Labs, Library, Mini Library, Washing Machines, Laundry, Smart, Stationary Shop, Gym, swimming, Hockey, Football, Badminton, Volleyball, Basketball, Fruit shop, Amul shop, General store, Cafes. Hostels are the best.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and qualified, almost all of them are from top universities of world. Teaching quality is superb and course curriculum is relevant. It make us ready for the current industrial technology. Semester exams are moderate to difficult.

reviews.review_title: My honest review about my college.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch had almost 25 students, out of which only 11 got placed in companies such as HCL, Tech Mahindra, etc. Packages ranged from 4.5 LPA to 12 LPA. Some mid-sized companies also came for campus recruitment and selected approximately 40% of students who appeared for interviews. The packages they offered ranged from 3 to 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire curriculum took 18 months to complete. Some aspects covered in the curriculum represented the views on India’s water security. It included the development of learning materials related to the sea security of India. Marine engineering students received special benefits from the course. No, I didn’t opt for the hostel. The hostel fee was Rs. 10,000 per year. The infrastructure was good. Free electricity, free water including hot water, a free table and chair, free Wi-Fi, and free parking for cars and bikes were provided. A guard was present, and reading room facilities were available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were very active and helpful. They even shared their contact numbers to assist us. They did not skip any topic and made sure that everyone understood the concepts clearly. Teachers only came to the university on weekends since we were from distance education. The best part was that the teachers informed us in advance if they were not going to be present. There were 19 subjects taught by my college, each with the best faculty for both theoretical and clinical knowledge. All 19 subjects were divided into 4 professional levels and taught by 4 types of faculty, i.e., Professors, Associate Professors, Assistant Professors, and Lecturers.

reviews.review_title: Overall, it is the best college for a PhD in Chemistry course.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of the students qualified in the last batch. The highest salary package offered is 35 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 9 LPA. The average salary package offered is 17 LPA. Top companies like Tata Chemical, Ranbaxy, Sun Pharmaceutical, etc., visit the college to hire students. More than 60% of the students secured internships in industry. Both education and technical training are available. Higher-level roles like research scientist, patent scientist, etc., are offered here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Gandhinagar is located in one of the best locations in India. It has exclusive campuses with a library, exclusive hotels with multiple daily outlets, and two agglomerations. It has a sports stadium with impressive sports facilities, an Olympic-size swimming pool, badminton courts, basketball courts, etc. It also has two cricket and football pitches.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful but their teaching is not at all good. Students are not happy with teachers. Some teachers take 3-4 days leave in a week. Otherwise, the college is good. Semester exams are a little tough and the pass percentage is 57%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Integrated Circuit Design and Technology
reviews.review_title: Placement, campus life, research and growth - IIT Gandhinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, IIT Gandhinagar placement has seen a recession. About 164 students have registered for the placements, of whom 125 students successfully secured a job. The average package was Rs 18.20 LPA overall. The average package of BTech CSE students was around 22.73 LPA, while MTech CSE students secured an average package of 21.05 LPA. Still, it is better than last year, in which 398 students registered, of whom 163 were placed, making an average package of 19.60 LPA. This year, one of the 4th year electrical engineering students got an offer of 48 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One of the best thing I liked the most about IIT Gandhinagar is its sports facilities. If you are a sportsperson, you should definitely opt this. It has a sports complex which has indoor playing facilities for volleyball, badminton, basketball, and table tennis. Also, 2 indoor swimming pools are also available 24/7 except for Monday, which is the cleaning day. The Gym here is very large and fits with AC. Talking of outdoor games: it has 2 big grounds for cricket with big lights, which are typically in stadiums; it also has a big ground for football around which an athletic track was drawn. Net practice for cricket and tennis is also available. Coming to the hostel: All room have AC, which is centrally controlled. One downside for freshmen is that you have to adjust in a 4 sharing, which is built for 3. 4th year students get a single sharing room. All the bathrooms are properly cleaned every day. It has support for both cold and hot water to bathe with. The lights are automated. Each floor in the hostel have a fridge, one water cooler, one microwave and an induction cooker. They also provide laundry facilities twice a week. Mess food are nearly nice for veggies ( as Gujaratis prefer veg more) and you have to pay an amount of $60 for eating nonveg (but egg are free). Inside the campus canteens, Amul shop, general grocery, stationary and sports shops are available. library is best as long as you not opt for story books. All classrooms are connected with ac, 2/3 projectors. Labs are very well maintained and have great facilities. You can go anytime and 3d print a part you want to. Inter-Hotel movement is allowed and there is also no restriction for going out of campus in the night. The college provide bus facility to go out of campus to nearby by market. The unlimited wi-fi is available all places on campus, giving an average speed of 700mbps mbps on the phone and 250mbps mbps on the laptop. Of course you can connect laptop with ethernet to get higher speed. We have a students lounge inside the campus which has games like football, chess, etc. The unique thing I discovered here is the skywalk. Most of the hostels and mess are connected with an overhead bridge.
detailed_review.Faculty: I am joined in the ICDT branch. Of course, after the breakthrough in AI, it will flourish in the future. Also, there is going to be new industries setting up in Gujarat. The curriculum includes VLSE Design, Microelectronics, Physics of Transistors, Asynchronous Circuit Design, Analog CMOS IC Design, IC Design Lab, Nanoscale Device Engineering, Microfabrication and Semiconductor Process, Machine Learning, Memory Device Technologies and Applications.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course because it is already available in IITH and gained a much more demand in 2-3 years. I also think that similar will happen hear also. The course does not contain more electronics topics, it mighty added for the future batch. Coming to event IIT Gandhinagar is not performing that much good. The Ganesh Chaturthi was held in a smaller way. Not much decoration and not much sounds and stuff like that. I thought that there will be garba nights during Navratri but as soon as holiday announced most of the students gone home. Our cultural fest is going to be held in march or so. Other clubs are also organize their fest from November onwards. But you get lot of extracurricular activities to do. Too much project to keep you engaged. You will be making car models, prepare the design of your own product and making that and lot more. This provides a great platform to show your design and innovative skill.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college infrastructure is very good. I am disappointed by the overall placement.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has a good placement ratio. This year, its placement was 76.02%, with the college average package being 19.02 LPA. Note the difference in college average package and branch average package; both are different. From my course, 98.9% was placement ratio, and internships are available in Samsung, Microsoft, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have good speed of Wi-Fi around 100 MB/s, with fully furnished labs. The classroom and library are amazing. The library also has a kids' zone and full ACs. It's like a wow! It has a very wide collection of books and resources and even contains CDs. We have various shops inside the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have a different curriculum from all the IITs, which makes our IIT unique. Teachers are very knowledgeable, and if you go to them, they are always ready to help. The curriculum will guarantee you will be industry-ready. The semester exams are at a moderate level, and the pass percentage varies with each subject.

reviews.review_title: Excellent infrastructure and faculty members. Research culture is groundbreaking.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in mechanical engineering are decent. Around 75-80% of students got placed last year in various departments including automobile, manufacturing, and consulting. The median salary package offered is around 17.5 LPA - 18 LPA. Many students get internships in their 5th semester at different companies such as TCS, Wipro, Siemens, L&T, Infosys, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college offers a range of facilities designed to support students in their research and learning. Some of them are well-furnished and fully air-conditioned classrooms along with Wi-Fi, advanced teaching aids, smartboards, and multimedia systems to enhance the learning experience. The library is the core of our college with a vast number of academic-related books, along with a good collection of comics, journals, mythology, self-improvement, and biography books. The main library is accessible for 17 hours a day, and you can also book study rooms in the library to study with your friends. All the hostel rooms are fully air-conditioned and interconnected with common rooms in each hostel. In rooms, you will get a bed, a study table, a chair with a night light just above the table, and a spacious almirah. Apart from that, our college has come up with the new emerging idea of an open culture to encourage learning and demolish the boundaries between opposite genders. As a result, you can go to opposite-gender hostel rooms without any restrictions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very helpful and well-qualified. Their teaching style has a remarkable impact on students. The course is very relevant and focuses not only on theoretical study but also on practical learning, encouraging students to learn and implement what they have learned. Semester exams reflect what we have learned in the lectures, although exams are not that difficult. The relative grading policy makes it more challenging and encourages continuous learning.

reviews.review_title: IIT Gandhinagar short review.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement here is decent. Not very big companies tend to come here for placements. The main reason for that might be the fact that the computer science branch has been recently introduced here, but definitely it will significantly improve over time as more cs branches such as AI have been introduced here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
It has the best hostel facilities. If you opt for the newly built hostels, they will provide you with triple, double, and single(mostly in final and pre-final year). Each floor has a kitchen with an induction microwave and a fridge. Bathrooms are like for 5-7 people. There is a bathroom mostly all the hostels have bathroom of both ends of the corridor except for the old hostels, which only have 2 bathrooms on each floor, but they are big ones. 
Coming towards the labs for my course, they are also good. They almost have all the machinery which is also accessible to all the students. So far as projects are concerned, they tend to reimburse the material that has been consumed in that.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams here are quite tough as the professor here tries to check your understanding of the topic; therefore, if your basic understanding of the topic is not clear, you will not be able to score well in exams. We follow a 2-examination system followed by multiple quizzes during the semester. Also, there are some assignments which are also part of grading. Grading is totally dependent on the professor, and no one can comment on that. Mostly, the professor follows relative grading compared to absolute grading.
detailed_review.Other: There is very less crowd and campus life here because the intake here is very low. The last year intake was just 400 in BTech and the total strength of students would just be around 2500, which is just 2 years of strength of some bigger IITs. Due to which there is not very diverse culture here. But as the new hostels are being made, intake would also increase.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Gandhinagar: Pros and cons.

detailed_review.Placements: I am enrolled in B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering and the placements were quite good. Almost all the students who were interested in placements got placed. The average package was around 25 LPA for CSE. The top recruiting companies that visited our campus were Graviton, Texas Instruments, Zomato, etc. Talking about internships, around 70% of the CSE students got summer internships in various companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of IIT Gandhinagar is very good and world-class. The hostel and academic buildings have outstanding architecture. High-speed wifi is available all the time. The library is also there where students can go and study; almost all varieties of books are available there. Computer labs are also available for students to use every time.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are highly qualified and have quite vast knowledge of their subjects. Students are encouraged to take research projects under the professors, which is quite helpful for the students who want to make their career in academia. The course curriculum is very relevant and latest. There are two exams per semester, i.e., midterm and endterm exams.
detailed_review.Other: The institute offers great facilities for sport. Students are encouraged to take one sport along with their studies.

reviews.review_title: Best IIT campus in India.

detailed_review.Placements: There is campus placement at the college. There are so many companies that select students on the basis of written and oral interviews. There is a 6 lacs per year average package at the college. Students who are in the final semester can take part in the placement process. Students get an internship opportunity based on their academic score and performance. Teachers also recommend students for the internship opportunity. There is some internship opportunity, which is to consider students for foreign study and research.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the room, there is one cupboard, one bed mattress and a set of tables and chairs. The process of hostel registration is the same as the admission process. In the morning, there is breakfast; in the afternoon, they provide lunch; in the evening, snacks with tea or coffee; and in the night, they serve dinner.
detailed_review.Faculty: In IIT Gandhinagar, the course curriculum is based on semester-wise exams. All of the faculty are well qualified and well versed in their field. Every faculty member is very helpful and you can interact one-on-one with them after the class. I have completed my graduation in the mathematics and IITs are also providing a Masters degree in mathematics, so we chose M.Sc. Mathematics. There were semester-wise exams and in every semester we had a mid-semester exam and an end-semester exam. Apart from this, there were quizzes every 15-20 days.
detailed_review.Other: In the college, there are different kinds of festivals, like the annual fest, Blithchron and the technical fest, Amalthea. There are different kinds of sports events, like CCL and Hall Bol. There are so many sports events in the Hall Bol tournament.

reviews.review_title: Review of B.Tech in Electronics from the IIT, Gandhinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: All the students of this branch of engineering were getting placements opportunities at the IITGN. The average package offered at this college was 4–7 LPA. The top recruiting companies were TCS, Philips, Infosys, Wipro, Tata Motors, etc. Most of the students were also getting internship opportunities at this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college had very good infrastructure for our course. The college had labs for our course with all the required equipment. Wi-Fi, library, sports, canteen, etc. facilities were also available on the college campus for the students. The hostel facility was also available for the students. The food in the hostel mess was good to eat. The quality of the rooms in the hostel was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college had highly qualified and knowledgeable teachers for our course. All the teachers were giving proper practical and theoretical knowledge to the students. The course curriculum of the IITGN was relevant and made the students industry-ready. Exams were not that easy to pass at this college.

reviews.review_title: Great exposure with next level learnings.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are excellent and the college has maintained a record of 100% placement results. The average package offered was somewhere around 19 Lacs. The top recruiters were IT companies like Infosys, Oracle, Accenture, Rakuten, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good with the Wi-Fi available across the campus. The laboratories are very advanced and the campus has different laboratories as per various discipline options available. The library is well stocked with the latest resources along with the classrooms being modern.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very well-experienced and qualified. They are enriched with good industry exposure and are scholars from good Universities. The curriculum is nicely crafted wherein it is made to be rigorous and industry-oriented and focuses on both theoretical and practical aspects.

reviews.review_title: A college with good qualities.

detailed_review.Placements: If I am supposed to talk about the placements given by this institute, I can say that it is very average, not all the students are placed well, only about thirty to forty percent of students got placed every year, which is not bad at all. The average package of the students is about 10 lacs per year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If I talk about the infrastructure of the institution, I can say that buildings were creatively made, they were restricted for outsiders to enter the institute, and there were playing areas, libraries, and cultural activities areas over there. The best part of the hostel is the cleanliness maintained by staff, and it serves good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: If I am supposed to say something about the faculty, the best part of this institute is that the faculty members who are working here are really well qualified. Well-knowledgeable and head students and motivate the students in each and every step of their lives in those four years. The curriculum is well maintained to cover the syllabus in a semester.

reviews.review_title: Perfect infrastructure and facilities .

detailed_review.Placements: Companies like Amazon, Adani, Adobe, Amul, Bank of America, Byju's, Google, etc. are our past recruiters. Students were also offered international internships at RMIT University, University of Washington, etc. More of the placement and internship information is available on CDS IIT Gandhinagar website.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college's infrastructure is undoubtedly exceptional. Since it is a 2nd-generation IIT, it is well built with all the facilities provided. The hostels as well as the academic area have comprehensive infrastructure. The food and medical services are of high quality.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors here are friendly and helpful. Their high qualifications and knowledge contribute to their quality behavior. As far as I have known, the course curriculum does make the students industry-ready. The difficulty of exams depends on professors; they cannot explicitly say if they are difficult or easy; it varies according to different courses .

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the college facilities and decent placements great for research oriented students.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost everyone who applied for the placements got placed; the highest was around 60 LPA and the median would be around 14–15 LPA. Regarding internships, around 40% of students got internships. The internship recruiters were Atlassian, DE Shaw, Oracle, JSW, Puma, and Barclays. While some of these companies also came for placements, some other companies like Zomato, Nike, etc. also came for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This is the best part of IIT GN. The hostel rooms are very well maintained, and we have AC's that work at night for a peaceful sleep. Good Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are available. Mess food is pretty decent. The sports complex is really the highlight of the campus. It's really well-equipped. There are two libraries: one in the academic area and one in the student hostel area.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really good over here; they are always ready to collaborate with you if you are willing to work on a project. The course curriculum is dynamic in most of the courses and most of the courses are selected by the students themselves. Passing exams is easier but for scoring a good grade, consistency is important.

reviews.review_title: Good campus infrastructure and amenities along with academics, staff and very good faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80–85% of students get placed during the placement season. The highest package offered is 72 lacs per annum, with the average package being 27–30 lacs per annum. The lowest package varies each time from 9–10 lacs. The top recruiting companies are Google, DE Shaw, Barclays and other government-sector companies. Internships are offered mainly in the 3rd year of B.Tech. In my course, the main scope is a research area pursuing a Ph.D. in a particular field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Gandhinagar has one of the best infrastructure in India, having separate academic building which includes library, separate hostel area with many outlets of daily routine, two messes (5-star rating by Fssai) and sports area which includes a magnificent sports complex with an Olympic-size swimming pool, badminton courts, indoor basketball court, etc. And two cricket and football grounds.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members on campus hold Ph.D. degrees in their respective fields, which means they are highly qualified to seek help. The course curriculum is designed with a student mindset in mind, and recently it has been reframed with an industrial and academic aspect. There are two exams in each semester: midsems and endsems, which are quite difficult, according to many students.
detailed_review.Other: Apart from academics, there are two big college fests: Amalthea (the teaching fest) and Blithchron (the cultural fest), which happen in November and March, respectively. Also, there is a sports fest open to the entire college community named Hallabol. If we talk about the location of the campus,  that is somewhat of an issue because it is located outside the city, and the only way to connect is by Uber, Ola or bus service from the college. The campus is located on the banks of the Sabarmati River and has a very beautiful scenic view in the evening and early morning. There are many cultural clubs, like Stepup (a dance club), Sargam (a music club) and many more. There is a very unique feature of hostels: they are co-ed, which means inter-hotel movements are allowed at night as well.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and campus life, along with academics and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 95% of registered students get placed in my course. The average package is 14 LPA for MSE students. Most of the students go for higher education in this branch. Some of the institutions where the students of my branch are selected for higher studies are CALTECH, Clemson University, Illinois University, Colorado State University, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Each and every class and lab is equipped with a Wi-Fi router. Every department has its own building where all the labs and offices of professors of that course are present. There is a separate building for the library, which will be open until 2 a.m. There is also a mini-library in the hostel area, which will be open 24/7. Each and every room in the hostel is equipped with a Wi-Fi router and an air conditioner. The hostels and mess are of top quality. We also have a separate region dedicated to sports. We have an Olympic-size swimming pool, indoor courts made of synthetic material for all sports, and also an athletic track, football field, and cricket field. The sports facilities are also top-notch.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They will always be there for the students to solve doubts and help them regarding their careers. The course curriculum is relevant and also has many lab components, which make the students industry-ready. The difficulty of semester exams differs from professor to professor, but they will mostly be easy. And almost all the students pass. A very small percentage of students fail, and that too in at most 1 or 2 courses.
detailed_review.Other: We have an annual tech festival named Amalthea and an annual cultural festival named BLITHCHRON. We also have summer and winter vacations, which are held at the start of summer and winter.

reviews.review_title: Short Glimpse At IIT Gandhinagar.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 60% of students were placed in my course (Chemical Engineering), the highest salary so far was offered 52 LPA by Zomato, the average salary was around 12 LPA, and the lowest salary was around 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Barclay, DE Shaw, media, Oracle, etc. Top roles offered in our course are manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our campus is very nice. All the electricity comes from the solar panel. Currently, the solar panel capacity is 500kwp, 120kwp for hostels, and 190kwp of solar carport. We can see some buildings will have sharp edges which is unique. Also, the mess and canteen facilities are also quite good. There will be a spicy meal counter and a normal meal counter in the mess. The sports complex on our campus is equipped with a wide range of facilities. It offers a diverse array of sports, including squash.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are very friendly to teach the course. The course curriculum will be applicable mostly in our daily life. The content covered in the class will be very much less, only the fundamentals part will teach in the class. From the exam point of view there will be some easy to moderate questions and there will be very challenging and confusing questions that are difficult to approach. The pass percentage is nearly 30%.
detailed_review.Other: With the JEE rank that I got, I have chosen this chemical engineering branch. The best thing about my branch is it is very much hill branch compared to other branches. Also, we can do simultaneous coding, which would be helpful from the computing point of view. One of the events which was organized by our institute is Blitchron. It is a 2 cultural fest. The campus crowd is nearly 2000. In our B. Tech 22 branch, the strength was only 280 students. It is very much less compared to other IITs.

reviews.review_title: A new-generation IIT having excellent Campus Infrastructure named IIT Gandhinagar .

detailed_review.Placements: Placement for Mechanical Engineering is around 90%, and the average package is about 21 Lacs. Top recruiting companies are Amul, Puma, IBM, Amazon, Cognizant, Deloitte, Adobe etc. The highest package is around 76 Lacs and the lowest is 10 Lacs. Around 80-85% students got internship from mechanical engineering in various recruiters are University of Buffalo, Hiyoshi International, University of Wasington, Larson and Tourbo ltd, Texas A&M University etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities at IITGN are designed to provide students with a comfortable and conducive living environment. The institute boasts 12 centrally air-conditioned and furnished hostels, accommodation over 2600 students. Each hostel has a unique name, such Aibaan, Beauki, Chimair, Duven, Emit, Firpeal, Griwiksh, Hiqom, Ijoka, Jurqia, Kyzeel and Lekhaag. IITGN takes pride in being India's first 5-star campus in food safety and healthy eating, offering nutritious and hygienically prepared meals in a hostel mess. All the sports facilities are available. A medical center is also there which includes the qualified doctors and physio.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are well qualified and helpful to resolve all your doubt and able to create a friendly environment with student. Course curriculum is structured in a way that student can relate with real-life problems and involves industry based projects. Yes, course curriculum makes the students industry ready. The exams difficult level is moderate to high. The pass percentage depends from course to course and professor to professor. But generally it is 40%.
detailed_review.Other: At IITGN, many cultural activities happen. IITGN's annual cult fest, Blithchrone, makes the students feel a different level of enjoyment and entertainment. The yearly teach-summit named Amelthia that make students to feel the teach stardom that an IIT brings in students. Then there comes Hallabol that is 11 to 12 days of sports event, where 6-7 member student teams participate in 6-7 games like seven-stone, gully cricket, footvolly etc. Another event named Ted-x that includes with ted-talks of popular people.

reviews.review_title: Good opportunity for internship.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is quite good with around ninety percent of the students getting placed. The highest package that was offered was around twenty-five Lacs per annum an the average of our batch was around twelve Lacs per annum and companies like Tata Motors came.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels have central Air conditioning and also in the classroom and the hostel offers single and double sharing options and in both, you have attached the washrooms facility. There is medical support and a sports complex and a few recreational areas are also there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is up-to-date date and is designed keeping in mind the industry relevancy. The semester are challenging but the passing percent range is around 80 to 85 percent. The faculty members are very knowledgeable and have few industry collaborations.

college_info.college_name: IIT Gandhinagar Course Admissions 2025: Cutoff, Dates, Eligibility, Registration, Fees & Selection Criteria

faqs.question: How can I join IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: IIT Gandhinagar admission process is entirely based on the selection of candidates via popular entrance exams such as JEE Advanced and GATE, etc., for courses such as BTech and MTech, respectively. Further, IIT Gandhinagar conducts an institute-level test for the selection MA and PhD courses. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria as per the course requirements and then qualify for the respective entrance exam in order to secure a seat at IIT Gandhinagar. Later on, the final seat allotment is done through counselling process.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: How can I apply to IIT Gandhinagar for BTech?
faqs.answer: Students seeking admission to IIT Gandhinagar for BTech are required to apply for both JEE Main and JEE Advanced.

faqs.question: Are GATE 2024 dates out for IIT Gandhinagar admission to M.Tech?
faqs.answer: Yes, GATE 2023 exam dates have been announced. IISc Bangalore will conduct the GATE exam on February 3, 4, 10, and 11. The GATE application form will release on Aug 24 on the official website.. The organising institute for GATE is IISc Bangalore. The exam will be conducted online  for 29 papers. Students will be required to solve 65 questions in 180 minutes .

faqs.question: What is the JEE Advanced cut off for BTech in Civil Engineering at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: For 2023, cut off was 11422 for General category candidates in the All India quota for BTech in Civil Engineering at IIT Gandhinagar - Indian Institute of Technology. For female candidates in the General category under All India quota, 17696 was the closing rank. BTech cut off varies depending on the category and domicile/quota of the applicant.

faqs.question: What has been the trend for cut off in BTech in Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Gandhinagar in last few years?
faqs.answer: The cutoff trend for B.Tech at IIT Gandhinagar - Indian Institute of Technology has been increasing in the recent years. In 2024, the closing rank for B.Tech. under general category for all India quota was 1708 . In 2023, it increased to 1544 from 1352 in 2022. Likewise, the cut off ranks have changed for diffecrent categories as mentioned below: This trend is likely to continue in the coming years, as the demand for engineering education in India continues to grow. Similar cut off trend can be seen for female candidates under all categories however the ranks are slightly different.

faqs.question: What is the JEE Advanced cut off for BTech in Computer Science and Engineering in IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: As per JoSAA Closing ranks IIT Gandhinagar cutoff was 1576 for General category candidates in All India quota for BTech in Computer Science and Engineering. For female candidates in general category under All India quota, 4592 was the closing rank. B.Tech cut off varies depending on the category and domicile/quota of the applicant. IIT Gandhinagar admissions 2024 are based on JEE Main 2024 ranks followed by JEE Advanced ranks and further followed by JoSAA Counselling. Candidates seeking admission to IIT Gandhinagar BTech  course must appear for JEE Main and JEE Advanced in order to be eligible for further admission process.

faqs.question: Can I get admission for BTech in IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: The cut off rank in JEE Advanced Round 6 for BTech in Computer Science and Engineering is 1555 which is very close to this range. This was for General category under All India quota. Unless the candidate belongs to some other category or domicile, one can not afford to score less than this. With this rank, there is a probability of getting admission however since, the cut offs keep changing from round to round, better ranks definitely increases your chances of getting admission at IIT Gandhinagar - Indian Institute of Technology.

faqs.question: Can I get into IIT Gandhinagar for M.Tech without GATE?
faqs.answer: Yes, non-GATE candidates must appear for the institute level entrance test. However, all candidates are required to appear for the PI round for final selection. In addition to this, BTech graduates from the IITs with CGPA/ CPI of 8.0 or above (on a scale of 10) are eligible to get admission to M.Tech at IIT Gandhinagar without GATE. Other than GATE or the criteria state above, candidates are required to be a pass in BE/ BTech/ MSc or equivalent in appropriate branches with a minimum of 55% aggregate or 5.5 on a 10-point scale (50% aggregate for SC /ST).

faqs.question: How can I apply for M.Tech at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: All applications for IIT Gandhinagar MTech course must be submitted  online. Candidates willing to apply for more than one specialisation must submit separate application forms for each specialisation. After the successful submission of the application form, students will receive an application number and a link to download the application form. Save the application form, fill it and furnish the hard copy of this application form and self-attested copies of all the relevant documents during the interview. Incomplete applications are subject to rejection. The application fee is  INR 850 for and INR 1700 for other category students. Students applying via GATE must also apply for the GATE exam. Below are the steps of application:- Go to the official website of GATE and register. Fill the application form with relevant personal, educational, and other details in the empty fields. Upload the required documents in the right size and format. Pay the GATE application fee through a convenient online payment mode. Accept the declaration and click on the 'Submit' button to complete the application process.

faqs.question: What all M.Tech specialisations are available at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: Check out all the specialisations available under M.Tech at IIT Gandhinagar in the below table: IIT Gandhinagar M.Tech Specialisations Biological Engineering Chemical Engineering Civil Engineering Computer Science and Engineering Electrical Engineering Materials Engineering Mechanical Engineering Earth System Sciences

faqs.question: Is there an interview round for M.Tech admission at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: Yes, Indian Institute of Technology, Gandhinagar conducts a Personal Interview round for both GATE and non-GATE applicants. Those who have not written GATE exam are required to appear for the institute-level entrance test. In order to apply, all applications must fill the form online . Candidates willing to apply for more than one specialisation must submit separate application forms for each specialisation. After the successful submission of the application form, students will receive an application number and a link to download the application form.

faqs.question: How can I get admission at IIT Gandhinagar for MSc?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to IIT Gandhinagar for the MSc programme must meet the basic eligibility for the course which is a UG degree in any stream. Further, they need to apply for IIT-JAM by visiting the official website of its conducting body. Candidates seeking admission must have a valid score in IIT JAM exam, followed by CCMN counselling.

faqs.question: What is the selection criteria for MSc offered at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to IIT Gandhinagar for MSc are shortlisted based on their IIT JAM score followed by CCMN counselling. Additionally, they must also fulfil the miimum eligibility criteria set by the institute for admission. The same is as follows:

faqs.question: What is the application fee for MSc at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pay an application fee (non-refundable) in the online mode only for MSc admission at IIT Gandhinagar. However, they are required to furnish a hard copy of the application form along with a photograph and all the necessary documents in original (testimonials, certificates, publications, work experience, and research/professional experience) at the interview time. Incomplete applications get rejected. Application fees for SC/ST/PwD candidates is INR 150 and for all the other category candidates, the same is INR 300. The details of the IIT-JAM application fee specific to gender/category are given below: Category IIT JAM Application Fee for One Test Paper  (in INR) IIT JAM Application Fee for Two Test Papers  (in INR) Female (All Categories)/ SC/ ST/ PwD 900 INR 1,250 All Others 1,800 INR 2,500
