sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Gandhinagar infrastructure features world-class classrooms, research centers, a library, hostels, an auditorium, etc. It has all the modern infrastructure to support the academic and research needs of the students. Spread over 399 acres of land, the IIT-G campus is on the banks of the Sabarmati River. It provides various facilities to its postgraduate and undergraduate students, such as a central dining facility, student housing, a sports/gym facility, and recreation spaces . The campus also houses a research park , which consists of a common facility center and an incubation center, supplemented with spaces for social activities, restaurants, gyms, etc. It also has four lecture halls with a capacity of 150 students each. The institute also has two auditoriums, one with a capacity of 325.

sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Campus Highlights
text: The IIT Gandhinagar campus is huge and comprises 6 hostel blocks accommodating both UG and PG students, two independent messes for food, modern and well-equipped kitchens, one large cafeteria with multiple food joints, etc. The campus is surrounded by lush green trees to provide an open and healthy environment for the students. The campus has a 100-foot-tall landmark tower , which is one of the distinctive architectural features. It also features dry, wet, and general labs and cubicles for students. Building 7 of the academic campus has 16 classrooms with a capacity of 40 each. The IIT-G campus also features lecture halls (4 in number) with a capacity of 75 each, with facilities for passages, toilets, etc. The institute also promotes physical health among the students; therefore, it also has the infrastructure for recreational activities. It also has both indoor and outdoor sports facilities. IIT Gandhinagar houses a rooftop open-air theatre as well. Some of the key campus highlights of the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar are tabulated below:

tables.IIT Gandhinagar Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Sports Complex, Auditorium, Research centres, Medical services, etc.

sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Hostel Facility
text: The Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar features 12 centrally air-conditioned hostels. All the hostels have basic furniture, such as a study table and chair, a single bed, a wardrobe, etc. The hostels have both single- and double-seater rooms available for students. IIT Gandhinagar offers separate hostel accommodation for boys and girls. IIT Gandhinagar hostels have modern amenities like 24x7 WiFi, LAN connections in every room, sick rooms, 24x7 electricity, common rooms, washrooms, specially designed washrooms for the specially abled, hot water supply, 24x7 security service, drinking water coolers, and elevators. IT-G hostel also has a pantry on each floor, equipped with a refrigerator, microwave oven, and induction stove. On the hostel premises, a general store, grocery store, hair salon, and cafes and eateries are also available to cater to the basic needs of students.

For healthy and hygienic food, the institute has two student messes, which supply food to the entire hostel community and visitors. It is the only institute in the country to be certified by FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India). The 6 hostel blocks of IIT Gandhinagar have a capacity to accommodate 200 students. Every hostel block has a common hostel library and reading space. The institute also has faculty & staff housing. This includes a daycare facility for the faculty and staff members. The day care is operational from Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

IIT Gandhinagar also houses a guest house, including 4 floors and 85 rooms in total. The guest house consists of 60 twin-bedded rooms, 11 double-bedded rooms, 12 suite rooms, and 2 specially abled rooms. Other amenities within the hostel premises are:
Music room & art room
Distributed spaces for students to think and innovate
An open-air theatre

sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Sports Facility
text: IITGN also has the infrastructure for both indoor and outdoor sports. It has a football, hockey, and cricket field; volleyball and basketball courts; a room for table tennis; and a track for jogging. It has a well-equipped gymnasium for encouraging fitness and a healthy lifestyle among the students. For recreational purposes, it has terrace gardens, a riverside promenade, rooftop open-air theatres, jal mandaps, a central vista, and two natural lakes. The institute organises several sports tournaments and events.

facilities.name: Cafeteria

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: The students are accommodated in six different hostels, namely: Aibaan, Beauki, Chimair, Duven, Emiet and Firpeal. Each student is issued basic furniture including chair, study table, cot and mattress at the beginning of the academic year. Students in all hostels have access to a common room, laundry and canteen facilities within their respective hostels. There is a general store within the hostel premises to provide the students with basic necessities like stationary, toiletries and snacks.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very strong placements with a peaceful lifestyle in the mountains of the Himalayas.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95 percent of the total students participating in placements are placed, and it is 100 percent for CSE branch. In CSE, the highest package is 80 LPA, and average was 29 LPA, with the lowest being 6 LPA. Top recruiters were Amazon, Adobe, Infosys, HCL, Microsoft, Mahindra, JP Morgan, Samsung, Tata Motors and TCS. On-campus internship was done by 41% students
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are every possible facilities available in our course, but only thing that may be troublesome for some students is the 4 sharing rooms for 1st year students. Mess food quality also decreased after a couple of months, but is restored upon complaint to the dean's office.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, teachers are very helpful and obviously highly qualified and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is very good because teachers also provided 2nd language tutorials for state board students. Course curriculum is relevant and revised. Yes, it makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams were quite difficult in some courses, depending on the faculty, but as grading is relatively fair, it makes sense.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about this course is placement and the mountains. But it could be better with some more effort from mess workers' side. Events are frequently organised, but they are located in very remote locations, so the crowd is not very large.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and facilities, but they can always be better.

detailed_review.Placements: This year in my branch, everyone got placed. I am not sure about the highest package, as far as I know it's around 90 LPA. The average is 30 LPA. I am quite fascinated by the placement rate. As far as I know, an internship is quite good. I am 1st year student, so I don't know much about it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's a newer IIT that is second-generation III, so the hostels are good. One thing I don't like is that we are four people in a room, which I think is a room for 2 people. The Wi-Fi facility is good. The food can be better, and for sports and games, it's above satisfactory.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are all very qualified and are highly experienced. Every professor had a different style of teaching. I think the course curriculum is very much relevant, and it does make students industry-ready. The semester exams are not as easy as one would expect, the pass percentage varies for each professor. For some, it's relatively, and for some it's absolute.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because from the beginning I wanted to be in tech, that's why you chose Tier-2 IIT CSE above other branches in top IITs. The placement here in CSE is great. I think the mess food can be better.

reviews.review_title: Review of the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi.

detailed_review.Placements: All the IITs are widely known for giving the best placements. Every year, Students of M.Sc. In the applied mathematics at IIT Mandi, one gets an impressive average salary package of 10 LPA. Students work as data scientists, quantitative analysts, statisticians, financial analysts, and software developers in various places, such as finance and IT sectors, government institutes, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We all know that the infrastructure and facilities of any IIT college are top-class. IIT Mandi is no exception. The entire campus of IIT Mandi is divided into two parts - the North Campus and the South Campus. There are around 10 hostels in IIT Mandi. Each room has a bed, study desk, chair, wardrobe, and attached bathroom.
detailed_review.Faculty: As the " Indian Institute of Technology " is a highly reputed institution in India, there is no need to talk about the faculty members of this institution separately. All the professors of IIT Mandi have a minimum of 10 years post-Ph.D. experience. M.Sc. In applied mathematics, there is a programme of two years. Every year, around 95% of students easily pass the examination.

reviews.course: B.Tech.-M.Tech. Integrated Dual Degree in Bio-Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely loving it, it's a different place, good interactions, lovely nature, and best placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Very good placement states most of the big companies like Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, Adobe, Samsung, and Zomato come for both internships and placements as well, and being honest, most of the interns get PPO as well, and later companies also come for placement, so almost everyone gets placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel is good, I mean nice bus, not as good as it could be because of obvious reasons, the physical location of IIT Mandi is in the mountains and there it is not possible to construct such big buildings, but we are provided with common room, pantry room, vending machines shared between hostels nearby, study room, washing machines, and fridge all.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is good here, we are provided with multiple courses and a chance to gain good and greater knowledge in our own domain. We are also free to do some courses in other domains as well, in case someone wants that knowledge. Semester exams are quite average, and more than 95% pass the exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose bioengineering because I have interest in pursuing higher studies in this domain only. No such major improvements as of now. College has events like Rann-neeti, Exodia, Expect, and a small fest celebration. All festivals are celebrated.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's the most beautiful college with such a beautiful environment, It's lovely.

It's a very good opportunity to be part of such a college, as there's less competition or fewer students vying for a role, leading to more opportunities.

We have common room, study room, Wi-Fi, vending machine, pantry room, and laundry room. We also have table, chair, and almirah in hostel. Its a good experience to live on such a beautiful campus.

detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for the IIT tag.

reviews.review_title: Heaven in mountains - IIT Mandi.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classes are in very good condition, and the cleanliness is top-tier. For summer, there is air conditioning, and for winter, there are heaters. The Wi-Fi is also good. The mess food is good, and sports facilities are very good. All the grounds are well-maintained.

My course is already good, and I don't have any complaints about it. Events and fests are amazing. Expect, Exodia, and Ranneeti are the top fests at my college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Mandi has excellent placement, infrastructure, faculty and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch contains 568 students. There are 80 students in my course which is CSE. In this year, almost 60 to 70 percent of students were placed in placements. All buildings of IIT Mandi are new. Classrooms have AC facility, charging points at every bench, a study environment, and are in excellent condition. A central library is present there which contains over 50,000 books. Hostel facility is also excellent in IIT Mandi. There are available indoor games (table tennis, etc.), washing machines, Wi-Fi, theater, geysers, water coolers, iron, security, and much more facilities for students. The health center of IIT Mandi has good connections with excellent doctors. All types of medical issues can be solved there and only 1500 rupees per year are paid for all medical facilities. Mess food is good. Canteen food is highly expensive. All sports facilities are available there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Course curriculum at IIT Mandi is well-structured and focuses on practical application. The curriculum is relevant to industry and practical learning. The faculty of IIT Mandi is highly qualified and expert in their own field. All teachers are helpful, supportive, and encourage students to grow and excel in their life. Teaching quality is good. College takes two exams in one semester. One is mid-semester and another is the final which is the end-semester exam. The level of both exams is easy to moderate. Almost 100 percent of students pass these exams.

reviews.review_title: IIT Mandi genuine review about all things.

detailed_review.Placements: By May 11, 2024, almost 80% of Computer Science students have been placed. The highest package offered this year was 7.4 LPA, almost 40 LPA. The lowest package was 3.5 LPA. The average salary is near 9-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies are BNY Mellon, Samsung Delhi, Nucleus Software, MAQ Software, BPCL, C-Dot, etc. The roles offered were software development, management, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities offered include Wi-Fi in every academic block and library, high-class labs for all domains, and fully digital classrooms. The libraries are outstanding with a comprehensive collection of books, and the infrastructure is excellent. The hostels are also new, with amenities such as study chairs, almirahs for each member in the room, a common fridge, electric iron, water cooler and purifier, and common study rooms on each floor.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, highly qualified, and knowledgeable, they are open-minded and always go beyond the curriculum to explore new things. The curriculum covers all domains like management, AI, robotics, software development, and data science, the semester exams are relatively easy; just one day is enough for above 50% of the students to score well.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course based on the recommendation of one of my seniors, best things about the course are zero ragging, supportive seniors, and open-minded faculty members. The college has a strict 80% attendance policy, which prevents students from exploring courses on their own, all institute seminars are compulsory to attend, even if the topic is not relevant to you. This should be looked into. The annual and technical fests are Ranneeti, Exodia, Frosthack, etc. There are many student-run clubs like music, dance, programming, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Extremely good college for exposure and serenity.

faqs.question: Does IIT Mandi offer integrated BTech-MTech programme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the institute offers a four-year integrated BTech-MTech course. The dual degree course is offered in only one specialisation, i.e., Bioengineering. Admission to this course is also done through JEE Advanced score, followed by JoSAA counselling. There are a total of 28 seats available for this course at IIT Mandi.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for B.Tech offered at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: IIT Mandi BTech admission is entirely entrance-based. Aspirants need to appear for the JEE Main exam, secure a valid rank and become eligible for JEE Advanced exam . Candidates who secure a valid rank in JEE Advanced need to participate in JoSAA Counselling for seat allotment. Additionally, rank and cut-off of JEE Advanced score decide the admission status of a student.

faqs.question: What is the fees for B.Tech course at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for BTech is INR 8 lakh . T his information is from official sanctioning body and can change. In addition, the total course fee will be higher as it will include other components such as admission fee, caution money deposit, hostel charges (if applicable), etc., as well. You also have to pay for hostel fee and one-time payable charges of INR 22,000 .

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for M.Tech at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: For admission to IIT Mandi MTech, you need Bachelor's degree in Engineering/ Technology or MSc or MCA with at least 60% aggregate in the relevant discipline from a recognised university. In addition, applicants with BE/ AMIE exam scores can also apply.

faqs.question: How to get admission in M.Tech at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: Aspirants with a valid bachelor’s degree in the relevant specialisation are eligible to apply for the PG course. Admission to M.Tech at IIT Mandi is based on merit in GATE followed by COAP counselling . Candidates with a score equal to more than the cutoff become eligible to participate in the counselling round. In addition, IIT graduates with an 8.0 CGPA or above are exempted from the GATE score requirement and can apply directly.

faqs.question: What is the opening and closing rank for Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Bioengineering at IIT Mandi - Indian Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Opening and Closing rank depends on the category and quota of candidates. For general category under All India, opening rank was 13364 and closing rank was 15216. Cut off are different when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even domicile of home state. In All India, opening and closing rank for female candidates was 20984 and 22169. Admission to Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Bioengineering in IIT Mandi - Indian Institute of Technology is based on the scores obtained in the entrance exam JEE. Applicants are advised to confirm what category are they applying while checking for cut offs.

faqs.question: How to get a seat in MSc at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: Aspirants must meet the eligibility conditions as prescribed by the institute and qualifying exam conducting body. IIT Mandi shortlists students for MSc based on their scores in the IIT JAM entrance exam. Further, the shortlisted candidates are called for CCMN Counselling . At the time of counselling, seat allotment is carried out on the basis of exam score, seat intake, reservation policy, and cut-off.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MSc at IIT Mandi?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for two-year course is INR 20,000 and the hostel fee (excluding meal plan) is INR 88,000. Total course fee will include other components such as admission fee, caution deposit, etc. as well. This fee is as per the first year/semester fees. Thus, the actual fee may vary. Aspirants can further visit the IIT-Mandi official website (iitmandi.ac.in) for more information around the fee structure.

data.title: IIT Mandi Placements Report 2025
summary: The highest and average package offered during IIT Mandi MBA placements 2025 stood at INR 39 LPA and INR 16 LPA . Analytics was the top recruiting domain during the placement drive 2025.

The placement process at IIT Mandi includes a comprehensive pre-placement training and skill development program for the students. The final placements at IIT Mandi are a result of very systematic interaction with the industry and continuous career counseling of the students.

During IIT Mandi placements 2024, a total of 192 recruiters visited the campus and placed 72.39% of the BTech Class 2024 in new-age job roles. The average package for BTech CSE was INR 26.55 LPA. The overall package offered to BTech students was INR 22.38 LPA. The median package stood at INR 18.5 LPA. Microsoft, Infosys, Amazon, HCL, etc. were the top recruiters.

highlights.summary:
India Institute of Technology Jodhpur was founded in 2008 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development along with others IITs. The institute was located in Jodhpur, Rajasthan. The institute is committed to technological thought and action to benefit the economic development. IITJ is ranked 27 among the top Engineering colleges in India by NIRF 2025. Additionally, it has been ranked 66 in the overall category by NIRF ranking 2025.
IIT Jodhpur offers UG, PG, diploma and PhD courses through 10 departments and 3 schools of study. BTech and MBA are the popular programmes offered at the institute. IIT Jodhpur admisison is based on merit and entrance exams. The institute accepts national entrance exams such as JEE Main, GATE, CAT, and others.
IIT Jodhpur has sprwaling campus which is spread across 852 acres of area. The institute provides various facilities, including well-endowed labs, library, computer centres, etc. The facility of the IIT Jodhpur hostel is offered separately to boys and girls. During, IIT Jodhpur placements, the highest package offered is INR 25.11 LPA. The institute appoints well-trained and expert faculty members with year of experience. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the course.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 70 percent of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 80 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. Google, Microsoft, and Amazon are top recruitment companies. Approximately 50 percent of students got internships in FAANG, MAANG, TCS, and Rubix. Software engineer and data scientist are roles offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good enough, but the range is less than expected. Classrooms are very good and large enough to accommodate all students. The library is also decent, and there is a wide variety of books in it. Good sports complex, but one bad thing, which is not appealing to me, is that there is a sudden thunderstorm that happens in the spring season.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is good. Teachers are good and supportive. They provide help when needed, but there is an issue with late email responses. The course is also good, it makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are moderate to hard, and the passing criteria is 33 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it has a good placement and the campus is also good. The campus structure might get better as there are a lot of stands, which cause disruption in the wind. Events, fests, and connectivity are also some.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Indian Institute of Technology Jodhpur.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost everyone gets placed, both circuital and non-circuital guys. The highest package, I guess, was 60 LPA (in hand). All renowned companies come here for placements. I don't have data about internships, but 5-6 people get internships at Google every year (3rd year students) and GSoC as well. SDE, SSE, AIML engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi can be a bit slow, but it's fine, sometimes very bad. The Physics and Chemistry lab is good and spacious. Classrooms are air-conditioned with appropriate lighting. The library is not sufficient for the number of students that exist on the campus, but its air conditioning and books are available, as well as computers if needed, and switchboards are available as well. Food in the mess differs, sometimes it's fabulous, sometimes it's very bad. The canteen is good and affordable. There is a PHC on campus, pretty far from hostels, but you can call an ambulance during emergencies, free service, free meds and blood tests.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are awesome and really good, some are not. Teaching quality differs. Most professors come here for their research work. Sem exams aren't difficult if studied properly. The pass percentage is mostly 30 per cent, but there's a relatively grading, so it might differ.

reviews.review_title: Being a student of M.Tech.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement services were done at minimal charges. Most of the students from our branch got placed in core companies with minimum and moderate packages. Only 3 to 5% of students from our branch got hired with maximum salary package of above 5 LPA, and below 7.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As my college was far away from my home, I used to travel in the college bus, because they charged high for hostel accommodation. Usually, they set some procedure to collect exam fee, only after all the fees were paid. So students face a hectic situation while during payment of examination fee.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors were not only testing the academic understanding of the students but also often testing the students' external skills and knowledge by conducting creative examinations, games, and simpler learning. Professor's activities were more beneficial for the improvement of our knowledge.

reviews.review_title: They create a system that avoids heatwaves from entering the campus, which I like very much.

detailed_review.Placements: I think almost 100% placements are there. If you work hard, you can get placed. Last year top placement was 53 LPA and hired by  Google. Median package is 15 LPA - 17 LPA. Top companies here are Google, HPCL, and Goldman Sachs. So, top companies come here, and you can get placed easily.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has very good infrastructure. It has 5G+ Wi-Fis. There is 100 MB speed. Canteen food is excellent, and they include some Jodhpur stuff there, and that's fantastic. Sports facility is good. Library is okay. Sports facility is good, and they encourage every student to play some stuff.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. They teach advanced stuff. If I have any doubt, they always respond and are very helpful with placements kind of stuff. They are very good person, very humble, and have good behaviour. If you call them, they respond as well.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for this college specifically, and Jodhpur is nearby. Fests are also held.

reviews.review_title: My wonderful journey in an amazing college.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 30% of students got placed from my course. The highest package is 62 LPA, and the lowest package is 13 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are Tata Motors, Mahindra, Google, and Microsoft. Maybe 67% of students got internships in Unlox and other companies. Machine learning is the top role offered in my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has Wi-Fi for every student with an unlimited network. The Wi-Fi works anywhere on the whole campus. The labs are pretty hygienic, and safety protocols are followed by management. The classrooms are very spacious and ideal for students. The library is also very huge and here we can get many types of books and magazines. The quality of food is very good and healthy. There is also a primary health centre available for all students for medical issues. All types of sports games and grounds are here for students, including indoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are highly talented and very famous lecturers. They are professional in their role. They are also very kind. We can contact them via email for our doubts, and they give their personal timings for our doubts. The course curriculum makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are not too tough nor too easy. The pass percentage is very high, i.e., more than 97%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as my option due to my JEE Advanced rank. The cutoff for this college in this course matched my rank, so I came here with some interest based on other reviews. The course is not bad, it's very good. Ignus fest is the very famous fest here, loved by many, hated by none.

reviews.review_title: Partially satisfied with the college due to very high strictness.

detailed_review.Placements: 96% of students got placed. The highest package is 61 LPA. The average is 10 LPA. The lowest is 2 LPA in the CSE department. Google, Amazon, and many Japanese companies have a strong relation with our college. 60% of students got placed at Nvidia and Microsoft.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We got a single loving room with highly satisfying facilities. We got a good mess. There are two messes. One for veg and one for non-veg mess which provides better satisfaction to people who don't eat non-veg. The Wi-Fi facilities here aren't so great. There is very slow speed internet.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not helpful. Their accent is weird and I don't even understand what they teach which came to be a major reason for my skipping classes frequently. However, they have great qualifications. The subjects are very weird. I don't think they will help. It makes us industry-ready. Semester exams are moderately tough.

reviews.review_title: IIT Jodhpur college review.

detailed_review.Placements: The college itself really does provide solid knowledge, and students were landing jobs in this course. The salary packages here were quite varied. The highest can go beyond 18LPA, while the lowest starts at around 3LPA. There were some top notch recruiting companies specifically looking for graduates from this course, and over 70% of students were getting internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The colleges infrastructure is made up of the most basic services like a supply of clean water, large laboratories for science, an auditorium and playground for cultural and sports activities, a well stocked library, and well maintained classrooms and canteen. Students can also take advantage of transportation and on campus housing if they do not have their own vehicles. The mess is clean, and if we talk about the food menu, it is quite good, but if more items of students choice are introduced, it will surely be beneficial.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty and staff here may not always excel, but they do their job well. First year teaching was very similar to high school, which made the change quite easy. The yearly tests were not too hard. The college also recognised academic successes and took special care to award the highest achievers.

reviews.review_title: World class infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students got placed from our course in my batch. The highest package offered in our course is 14 LPA. The average package is around 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Accenture, Goldman Sachs, ICICI Prudential, etc. Top roles offered are research, data analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. Wi-Fi-enabled campus. Labs are well-equipped with advanced instruments and modern machinery. The hostel is also pretty good. Multiple sports complexes and a food court are present.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective domains. The teaching quality of our faculty members is extremely good. The course curriculum is relevant. It provides industry exposure. The semester examinations are of a moderate level.

reviews.review_title: Good campus and study, but more industry exposure is needed in the course.

Exams are not very hard if you study regularly. Notes and help are also given. Around 90% students pass. Teaching quality is mostly good.

Course curriculum is made according to what industry requires today. It makes the student industry-ready. Semester exams are offline and of medium difficulty.

reviews.review_title: Reviiew of IIT Jodhpur - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Ripik technology, Uber, TATA consultancy, Oracle, Adobe, Qualcomm, Wizards India LLP, Sony group corporation, the world wants, trilogy innovation, and many more companies visit our college to recruit students. You will get a stipend from 5000-200000 per month, depending on company to company and type of internship. In my course, students of the final semester are eligible for placement. Mostly, coaching institutes hire from an M.Sc. Physics with an average package of 10-12 LPA. Not a lot of students go for placements but mostly they opt for higher studies, and a good number of students get Ph.D. in foreign universities.

Various hands-on courses were compulsory, which provided good experience and learning. The hostel life was awesome due to friends. Talking about the facilities, we had a Hostel Management Committee that took care of all our hostel problems, and the mess food was also appreciable for the cost that we were charged. We pay around 60,000.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of student ratio was good. We had a lot of in-person interaction with the faculty members. Even the faculty was very helpful and friendly. Some people were exceptional, but overall, they were good. A lot of good faculty members were there, but also some people couldn't satisfy students with their teaching methods. There were two minor exams in between and one major exam. Marking was done considering all three of them. Which made scoring good marks easy.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at IIT Jodhpur: A comfortable and fun experience at college.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now, more than 60% of students got placed. Around 10% of students are preparing for further higher studies. The average package is around 16 LPA. Companies like Google, Samsung, BNY Mellon, Zomato, etc., come to IIT Jodhpur for placements. The lowest package is around 6 LPA. The highest package is 56 LPA in our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are separate departments for almost all branches. We have ACs in academic buildings, hostels, mess, labs, etc. It makes us survive in the heat of Rajasthan. The infrastructure of IIT Jodhpur is pretty new and hence has a good quality. A physical health centre is present inside the campus. The mess quality is satisfactory and considered better than most of the IITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is fixed for each programme you enrol in. Minor changes are made based on students' requirements. The curriculum mainly focuses on motivating students to go for research and higher studies. However, it prepares us to solve real-world application-based problems. The difficulty level of exams is medium to hard.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is less crowded than tier 1 IITs which is a good thing. You pretty much know everyone which is a good thing for creating a bond with people. Connectivity with the city is bad considering how far it is from the main city. I chose this college because the course I was taking was of my interest. Many fests are seen in this college which creates a good environment for developing extracurricular activities.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for various courses offered at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: IIT Jodhpur admission 2024 is entrance based. IITJ offers UG, PG, PhD, and PG Diploma programmes in various disciplines through its 10 departments. Tabulated below is the list of some of the popular IITJ courses, IIT Jodhpur eligibility and IITJ selection criteria: Courses Eligibility & Selection Criteria BTech Eligibility: Class 12 pass with 75% aggregate in PCM Selection: JEE Main + JEE Advanced + JoSAA Counselling MBA Eligibility: Candidates with a Bachelor’s degree (three-year) or equivalent from a recognised university with 60% Selection: CAT / GATE + PI MSc Eligibility: Bachelor’s degree in relevant specialisation Selection: IIT-JAM + CCMN counselling MTech Eligibility: BTech degree with 60% aggregate Selection: GATE + COAP Counselling

faqs.question: Can I apply for branch change in IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, the branch can be changed at the end of the second semester. But, the student must meet the required criteria- a CGPA greater than or equal to 8.0 and 7.0 for SC, ST and PD applicants.  They must have completed all prescribed course credits for the first two semesters.

faqs.question: What minimum marks are required in JEE Mains to be eligible for JEE Advanced?
faqs.answer: The minimum marks required in JEE Mains to qualify for JEE Advanced 2026 will be announced with the JEE Main 2026 final result after session 2 exams. Last year's minimum marks in JEE Mains to qualify for JEE Advanced were: 2025: 2024: 2023: Candidates aiming for admission to the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) need to meet these cutoff marks in JEE Mains to be eligible for JEE Advanced 2026.

faqs.question: Is IIT Jodhpur good for BTech?
faqs.answer: The institute is ranked 30 among the top colleges of India under the “Engineering” category by NIRF in 2022 rankings. faqs.question: How to apply for BTech at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Admission to the course is entrance-based. Aspirants are required to take JEE Main and JEE Advanced. The selected students based on merit in JEE Advanced further have to participate in JoSAA rounds of counselling. The seat allotment process is then carried out as per performance in counselling and other selection rounds.

faqs.question: How can I get into IIT Jodhpur for BTech?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech programme at IIT Jodhpur is based on performance in the all-India level Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Main), followed by JEE Advanced. Based on JEE Advanced score, candidates need to take part in JoSAA counselling. Candidates can apply on the JEE official website (nta.ac.in). Candidates who secure a rank more than or equal to the IITJ BTech cutoff become eligible for admission.

faqs.question: Is it worth doing MTech from IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: IITJ is ranked 30 among top Engineering institutes as per the NIRF 2022 rankings. The institute has a good placements record. The median package offered to MTech CSE and M.Tech AI students were INR 14 LPA and INR 14.5 LPA, respectively. Some of the top companies that participated in the IIT Jodhpur placements drive were Accenture, Adobe, Amazon, IBM, TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, etc.

faqs.question: Is any financial assistance given to M.Tech programme students at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: Candidates with a BE, BTech, BS, or BDes degree and a GATE or GPAT qualification are eligible for financial aid worth INR 12,400 per month. Even if they do not pass the GATE exam, IIT BTech graduates with a CGPA of 8 or higher are eligible for assistantships. Sponsored category students cannot get an IITJ assistantship, nevertheless. This data is as per past years' records and hence may vary.

faqs.question: How to get admission in a M.Tech course at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: The selection is based on GATE scores followed by COAP Counselling. Candidates shortlisted are invited for written exam or interview round for final selections. Aspirants shall complete the GATE application process (gate.iitk.ac.in) within the due date to be eligible for admission as there is no other provision for admission. With a valid COAP score, students may have to apply on IITJ website as well.

faqs.question: Is it necessary to participate in COAP counselling for M.Tech at IIT Jodhpur?
faqs.answer: The Common Offer Acceptance Portal (COAP) is a registration portal. Candidates who pass GATE exam are required to apply on COAP portal for counselling. Only the students who register successfully on the portal become eligible for admission in an M.Tech course of IIT Jodhpur.

faqs.question: Can I do MBA in IIT Jodhpur without CAT?
faqs.answer: Admission to MBA course at IIT Jodhpur is entirely entrance-based. To get admission to MBA and MBA Technology at IIT Jodhpur, candidates must apply with a valid CAT percentile. However, the institute also provides admission to Non-CAT qualifiers. For admission to MBA in FinTech and Cyber Security, aspirants are selected based on a valid GATE score. The online application form can be filled out by visiting the institute's official website. The seat allotment is further carried out as per the candidate's overall performance in the entrance test and interview round.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Jodhpur infrastructure features a state-of-the-art permanent campus comprising cutting-edge research labs, smart classrooms, a library, a health centre, etc. The institute also provides hostel accommodation to the students. It has all the modern amenities available to cater to students' academic and research needs. Read further to know in detail about the campus infrastructure:

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Campus Highlights
text: Spread over 852 acres of land, IIT Jodhpur's infrastructure offers both residential and academic facilities. Interestingly, it is the first institute in India to install NVIDIA DGX A100 supercomputers at its Central Computing Facility, enhancing AI and Data Science research and education. Located on the campus, IIT Jodhpur has an ISO-certified healthcare centre, which has OPD and ambulance services . The health centre has a constituted medical board of doctors from the Government Medical College and AIIMS. The institute has modern laboratories, which support research and development. The infrastructure of the institute incorporates eco-friendly architecture and smart technologies . A few highlights of the IIT Jodhpur are given in the table below:
Campus Building:

tables.IIT Jodhpur Campus Highlights: Classrooms, laboratories, Smart Technologies, Sports Facilities, Library, Hostels with Mess, Cafeteria and more

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Jodhpur has well-maintained classrooms and labs. The classrooms are equipped with projectors and green boards . The infrastructure is built in a way to promote interaction and growth in all aspects.

In order to promote entrepreneurship among students, IIT Jodhpur has its Incubation Cell - Technology and Innovation and Start-Up Centre (TISC) . It has certain incubation projects that are supported by the Ministry of MSME and the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. Facilities such as AI, IoT, surgical robotics, and virtual reality. The institute has seven platforms, supported by the Department of Science and Technology.
IIT Jodhpur is planning to set up its own Tech Park , which will be spread over 100 acres of land and will have the capacity to host 30 companies at once.

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: IIT Jodhpur is a fully residential campus. There are separate hostel buildings for boys and girls. It offers single-occupancy air-conditioned and semi-furnished rooms, subject to availability. Basic amenities such as a table, chair, bed, almirah and internet connection are available. Additionally, each hostel building has a TV room, reading room , etc. Also, it has space for playing indoor games like carom, table tennis, chess, and badminton .

Each hostel has a dining hall accommodating a large number of students and offering vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. A gymnasium is also available for fitness, and a medical room. Students have access to 24/7 water facilities, RO purified drinking water, geysers and daily cleaning services . Overall, the hostels offers a very calm, peaceful, safe and comfortable atmosphere to the residents.

sections.heading: IIT Jodhpur Library
text: The library located in the clock tower building serves as a central point for knowledge creation. The name of the library is S R Ranganathan Learning Hub . The library has wheelchair accessible entrances and parking.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements here are well organized. Nearly 85% of students are eligible for placements, and 90% of them are already placed. The highest package this year is 1.25 crore, which is the highest package our college has ever seen. Most students from our branch get internships in consultancy and management.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms in our branch department are very good and spacious. Wi-Fi is available in each classroom. Labs are well-maintained. The college library consists of more than 10 lakh books, which are open to everyone, and more than 10,000 e-books are also available. The hostels are good. The mess food is satisfactory. There is a food street as a canteen where we can get a variety of foods.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors in our college are mostly members of high-level national and international organizations. Their teaching skills are very effective. They provide practical knowledge through labs and industrial visits. Exams are of a difficult to moderate level, where we can easily score around 60% marks. The passing percentage in our college is 70%.
detailed_review.Other: During JoSAA counseling, I got this course. The best thing about this course is that I gain practical knowledge about our surroundings. Some areas for improvement include updating the syllabus according to growing technology. Events and fests are one of the best aspects of our college. Scholarships are given to eligible students. The campus surroundings are really peaceful and calm. Extracurricular activities are mostly conducted by various clubs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placement.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Warangal is the top 1 NIT college in our ECE course, which has demand with other courses. 86% of students were placed in our course. The highest package is 77 LPA, the average package is 22 LPA, and the lowest package is 9 LPA. Amazon, Microsoft, and PhonePe are the top recruiting companies that visited, and 80% of students got internships from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The NIT Warangal infrastructure is excellent, clean, and neat. The facilities are available 24/7 with a high-speed network. Classrooms are clean and neat, with one lab for each subject. The quality of food is good and hygienic, and they keep a variety of food daily. Sports and games are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, everyone did their PG. Teachers are highly qualified and have good teaching skills. Faculty members are friendly with students, and they explain concepts very well to help them understand. This course curriculum is relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. It is a little bit tough to get a good percentage, but easy to pass.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Warangal is one of the best NITs in India. It offers many courses in engineering. 75 percent of students got placed. The highest package offered is 70 LPA. The lowest package is 20 LPA. The average package is 30 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Flipkart, Amazon, Google, etc. 50 percent of students got internships in start-ups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Some hostels are good, but we are not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room, not even the iron. The weather is too hot, and we are not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. The library is good with all types of books. Technology-based books are also available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.
detailed_review.Faculty: Academics here are rigorous and well-structured. Professors are highly qualified. Many professors are PhD holders from IITs, IISc, and foreign universities. They encourage research-based learning rather than just written memorization. Semester exams are not that difficult.

reviews.review_title: NIT Warangal is a good college.

detailed_review.Placements: After completing the 4th semester, students are eligible for internships, and mainly companies as I know are Oracle, ITC, TCS, Amazon, and Google, with the highest till I know being 88 LPA, a good percentage of people get placement here, and companies visit for internship, as I know ITC is said by our seniors, and I am not completely aware of what others would be there, as I am still searching on it, in the 7th–8th semester, there should be a project made by all students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are not that good as washrooms are not cleaned every day, which makes it difficult, and the mess is average, though the food kept on special dinner is best, there is a big library through which we can access our books of any kind, many clubs are there which makes it better, Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security, classrooms are spacious and digitally updated, and there are gym facilities in each hostel which can be accessed by all students with hostel timings.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is good and the main reason for choosing it is that it is different from software and a new path which many people might not choose, Chemical Engineering is a good course for challenges in the real world, faculty are friendly and many are good, they readily solve doubts if any, and there are mid-semester exams, end-semester exams, and teacher assessment (minor), which total makes 100 marks in each subject.

reviews.review_title: Good college, good vibes in the college.

detailed_review.Placements: Students are eligible for placement after the 7th semester. In mechanical, I can say mostly all PSU come for recruitment, which includes HPCL, BPCL, ONGC, etc., and also some private core companies came. The highest package is around 28.6 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA, with an average of 14 LPA. I want to go for UPSC after graduation.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a huge central library in the college which consists of almost every book possible. There are whiteboards and projectors in mostly every classroom. There are various societies and clubs. In the first year, there is a hostel named 1.8 K Ultra Mega Hostel, and the hostel room is not that big but fine for 2 persons. Quality of food is good; there is breakfast, lunch, and dinner there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-students ratio is fine because in our batch the whole department is distributed in 2 sections, and in both sections faculty members are the same but classrooms are different. Mostly all the professors are Ph.D. holders from respective IITs or NITs. There is very rare interaction of teachers and students after the classroom. Including mid-semester and end-semester exams, there are minor tests which are of 15 marks in each subject.

reviews.review_title: Good college for Mechanical Engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Internships are there. A lot of companies are tied up with NITW, and Siemens Research Center is inside the campus. Many clubs exist, and students are motivated to do projects and help get patents if needed. National Institute of Technology Warangal is famous for its placement percentage in core and tech side. Everything in detail can be found on the NITW main site, like placement percentage branch-wise and average package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel costs are affordable. There is an ethernet connection, electricity, fan, and cool mineral water in every hostel. The campus is very good. A big library is available for students for free. Good sports facilities and grounds are there. Gym is available for everyone. Many events and festivals are celebrated well. There are lots of clubs students can join to explore and learn. Gym is available. There are also coffee shops in campus, a food street where you can have food or buy necessary items, and a book stall inside campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: NIT Warangal is famous for Mechanical Engineering among NITs. There are sufficient faculty for learning and helping in academics. There are workshops and industry visits for students. Faculty are always helpful, friendly, and professional. They are highly experienced. There is no faculty that is disliked; everyone is good. Exams are 70 marks: 30 marks mid-term, 40 marks end-sem, and other 30 marks are under professors’ control, which may include assignments or special tests.

reviews.review_title: Good college and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: From 5th semester the students are getting PPO its obvious because of NIRF of NITW and top placements are here only. 80 percent of students were placed if we skip the biotech branch because they all go for higher studies. The highest package was 88LPA last year the minimum package was 6LPA and the average package offered is about 13LPA. Sprinkler Phonepay Oracle Google Microsoft Zomato and Uber were the top companies that offer internship with a stipend around 1.8LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Some hostels were good but we were not allowed to use any electrical appliance in the room not even the iron also the weather was too hot and we were not allowed to bring a table fan. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Library was good all types of books and technology based books are available. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are enough faculty members but still some courses are taken by non professionals who do not even know about the subject and they do not have interest in that subject. Some faculty are good but some of them are like eclipse to our future. They will give you a bad grade if they have some personal issues with you. My course curriculum includes all the knowledge that a engineering student should learn. All the courses are practical based weightage that can be divided into each semester. We have too many exams 2 minor exams 1 mid exam and end of semester exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Definitely you can join this college.

detailed_review.Placements: The National Institute of Technology is known for its placements. It has excellent placement records. Students get internships from the 3rd year, and they also get pre-placement offers, and 4th year students get excellent placements. The companies that visited are Google, Facebook, Amazon, Deloitte, Flipkart, etc. The highest package of NITW is 88 LPA. The average package in the Computer Science and Engineering branch is 30 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NITW is known for its 1.8k hostel. It’s Asia’s largest hostel. The hostel facilities are very wonderful. They provide beds, fans, and lights. The mess quality is also good, but it can be improved. The mess menu should be diversified and should satisfy both North Indian and South Indian students. The vast library possesses excellent books which give students immense knowledge. There are also excellent sports facilities. There is a huge stadium. Students can also enjoy playing different games like tennis, badminton, cricket, kabaddi, etc. We also enjoy the nightlife by having different items. We have Madras filter coffee, Domino’s inside the campus itself.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members of the institute are wonderful. The faculty-to-student ratio is 1:80. The professors along with assistant and visiting professors are also highly qualified. The course curriculum is very relevant to the present changing technologies in the world. The course curriculum gets updated frequently according to changing technologies and new innovations in the technical field. The course curriculum provides us with vast knowledge. There are three types of exams in a semester, namely minor, mid, and end-semester exams.

reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Warangal - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 85% of students get selected in campus placements at this NIT. Many companies collaborate with the institute, and there is a strong alumni network. Students can check the NITW website or Instagram page for detailed placement information. So, the overall placement process is nice here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure covers all the basic needs: clean water, spacious Science labs, an auditorium for events, a playground for sports, and a well-stocked library. The classrooms are tidy, and there is transportation and on-campus housing for students who need it. The mess is clean and the food is decent, though a few more options would be nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of our teachers are highly experienced and qualified, and they truly focus on helping students land great placements. The coursework is really geared towards the financial sector, with a special emphasis on subjects like accounting and auditing. Simply put, the staff is talented and usually gets excellent results from the students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Warangal College.

detailed_review.Placements: If you are in ECE, you are in luck. They have some great core placement opportunities, especially if you keep your CGPA decent over the years. A good mixture of companies shows up every year, offering a variety of roles. If you are somewhat competent, you are likely to land a good placement. ECE students seem to have an edge when it comes to software and management roles too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: On the downside, there are not really enough instructors, and the classrooms are well, they are pretty basic. The canteen menu is kind of limited too mostly just samosas and tea. The campus feels more like a place for cramming for exams rather than a real learning environment. There's no medical facility around. The hostel accommodation is not the best, but they offer some comfort. The mess serves hygienic food, and the water supply is pretty well maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are really supportive, focusing on helping students individually. I have noticed a few instructors who clean towards being a bit strict and, well, a little old school. Sometimes that can lead to issues like gender bias or discipline trouble.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT, Warangal is the best NIT in India.

detailed_review.Placements:
NIT Warangal is one of the best NIT in India. It offers many courses in Engineering. 
75% of students got placed. Highest package is of 70 LPA. The lowest package is of 20 LPA. Average package is of 30 LPA. Top Recruiting companies are Flipkart, Amazon, Google etc. 
50% of students got internships in start ups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are big enough. Classrooms are chilled with AC and fans. Library is also big enough. Hostel food contains variety of food daily. Canteen is also available. Medical service is for 24/7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are so interactive with students. They teach in a good manner. Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable. Time table is so flexible to the students. There are some extra curricular activities for students. Here the fests are so special to the students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because of it has flexibility towards software and hardware. But in future, India is looking for the establishment of Semiconductor and Battery industries. So there is need of Engineers (core). There are number of clubs related to dance, sports, finance and many more.

reviews.review_title: College is a paved path, if you want a good placement, you have to run fast.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of students got placed from our seniors. Out of 9, 7 got placed in good companies, one with the highest package of 25 LPA, and the lowest package is 12 LPA. 100% of students got internships, but some didn’t sit for placements as they went for higher studies and startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All over, the college is good, having a lush green campus and a nature-friendly environment,  Wi-Fi is available in the college, and in the hostel, we have LAN ports. Hostel rooms are good, with single and double occupancy. Mess food is good, it might vary from person to person, but for me, it's good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and other staff are well-trained and talented, all have great knowledge in their respective fields, and they are supportive and helpful. Labs are conducted by Ph.D. scholars under the guidance of the respective faculty, so the lab is full of knowledge. Each week, we have 2–3 labs, and all are equipped with best-in-class machines.
detailed_review.Other: College is good, and college life is also good. Some might not like the food, but the rest of everything is good.

reviews.review_title: NIT Warangal College review.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80 percent of students from the PED branch in the 2019-21 batch landed jobs. The highest package is 15 LPA which was pretty impressive. On the flip side, the lowest came in at around 4.5 LPA with an average sitting at about 5 LPA. When it comes to companies hiring, we've got some big names in the mix like GE, Intel, Qualcomm, and Microsoft. Speaking of Microsoft. Around 30 percent of my batch snagged internships along with opportunities at Dell and GE. Pretty cool.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has solid infrastructure with helpful amenities which is especially great for Science students. We have well-equipped labs and a decent library. For those traveling from afar, the hostel provides enough room. The mess is clean and while the food menu is alright. It would not hurt to add a few more options that students actually enjoy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some instructors are not always punctual. They know their material. The teaching itself is average and as expected the semester exams are not too tough with about a 90 percent passing rate. It is a pretty good academic experience.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the hostel maintenance and the mess food maintenance.

detailed_review.Placements: I think the placement criteria depend on the CGPA, the skills, communication skills, and confidence of the student. So, the ones with skills, good CGPA, and confidence will get the placement, and the ones who do not will not get it.  It's not in our hands, but the companies that come here are not that bad.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Coming to the hostel, it is a nightmare. Really. The cleaning and hygiene are not up to the mark. The food in the mess, we shouldn't really talk about this. I mean, they are providing the same food every week without any change in the menu, and moreover, they don't taste good. They taste land. We really can't continue eating this food. And moreover, we have to pay each and every time to eat non-veg. It was not informed while paying the mess fee that we would be provided only with veg food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty, I think, should improve their teaching skills. Not everything can be understood by just scrolling through the slides of a PowerPoint presentation, reading it, and feeling like explaining everything and assuming we understand everything. They also need to pay attention to every student.
detailed_review.Other: Everything is not that bad, but I can't say it is really up to the mark.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members and placement.

detailed_review.Placements: All students are placed. The highest package is 18 LPA, average package is 12 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Micron and ICICI Bank. The roles offered by companies are software developer, data scientist, tutor, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every room. The infrastructure includes well-built labs, classrooms have good equipments such as projectors and computers. Quality of food available in mess and canteen is decent. Dispensary is available free of cost for students. There are basketball and football grounds.
detailed_review.Faculty: The academics here are rigorous and well-structured. Professors are highly qualified, many with PhDs from IITs/IISc and foreign universities. They encourage research-based learning rather than just written memorization. Semester exams are not that difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of placement and college. There should be more abstract Maths.

reviews.review_title: NIT Warangal College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Warangal really stands out as one of the top engineering colleges when it comes to placements, boasting an impressive average package of about 88 LPA. Now, if you were looking specifically at the B.Tech CSE branch, the average package there was around 26 LPA. Its pretty cool because major companies like Goldman Sachs, Microsoft, Samsung, TCS, and Infosys actively recruit from our college. Uber even offered internships with a sweet stipend of 1LPA. Overall, the placement percentage was quite promising, too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi across the whole campus, as well as LAN in the hostels, was available. The labs were fully equipped and excellent. The library had more than 200,000 books of all kinds. I would rate the food 2 out of 5. Medical and sports facilities were good. The hostels for second year students were not great, but the others were fine. The food was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers have good qualifications and a long teaching career. Our course was suitable for our environment. Our schools semester exams were very hard, and to get a good grade, we had to work significantly. Overall, the faculty members are good and approachable.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology, Warangal.

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students were placed in my course at my college. The highest package is 80 LPA offered in my course, the average package is 30 LPA offered in my course and the lowest package is 10 LPA offered in my course. 90% of students got an internship from my course in my college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good, and infrastructure is good. Provide Wi-Fi, which is very useful for networking. In labs, provide the AC and projector. Classrooms are good, and we provide the AC and a projector for display. The library is good and provides AC and a projector. Hostel is good for the quality of food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good at teaching. They are approaching students with friendliness. They are very knowledgeable. Teaching is good. In semester, they have conducted two mid exams and a final exam. The pass percentage of exams is 40%. We have got 40% of marks in final exam, so we will pass the entire semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of National Institute of Technology Warangal.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Warangal is the top 1 NIT college in our ECE course, which has demand with other courses. 86% of students were placed in our course. The highest package is 77 LPA, the average package is 22 LPA, and the lowest package is 9 LPA. Amazon, Microsoft, and PhonePe are the top recruiting companies that visited, and 80% of students got internships from our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The NIT Warangal infrastructure is excellent, clean, and neat. The facilities are available 24/7 with a speedy network. Classrooms are clean and neat, with one lab for each subject. The quality of food is good and hygienic, and they keep a variety of food daily. Sports and games are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, everyone did their PG. Teachers are highly qualified and have good teaching skills. Faculty members are friendly with students, and they explain concepts very well to help them understand. This course curriculum is relevant, it makes the students industry-ready. It is a little bit tough to get a good percentage, but easy to pass.

reviews.review_title: Prefer this college if you are interested in placements and college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students are placed. 95 to 96% from CSE, 94% from EEE, and 79.4% from civil (batch 2020-2024), with an overall the highest package of 64 LPA and 34.10 LPA from civil engineering. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP Labs, Genpact, Godrej (core), L&T (core), and Zomato (health pure).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in every department with proper safety. Classrooms are like school only (this is the worst part), library is very good, around 10cr budget is for the library only. If we talk about the hostel, some hostels are good, like 1.8k, Bhabha hall of residence, Gokhale hall of residence, and best one (well structured) is Azad Hall and Bose Hall, but the rooms are for single occupancy, and they give us double occupancy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the professors are very helpful and qualified from IITS, and they have a vast knowledge about the subject, but they don't know how to teach. Some professors didn't even care if students were getting their point or not. Curriculum is relevant, but we have to do a mandatory internship in core. This one is bad for those who have no interest in the core and are opting for tech placements.

reviews.review_title: College is good only in terms of image, but actual scenarios are the worst.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85%- 90% of students are placed by the completion of 4th year. The highest package for the core role in mechanical is about 28 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Bajaj, Exonmobil, Tata Motors, etc. About 10% of the students secure internships at top companies on campus. Roles offered are core mechanical roles of design, modeling, and simulations, and other roles offered are of management.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the college buildings are equipped with Wi-Fi, there are no AC in classrooms, but labs are available. In the library space, there is PC and AC for students to study. Hostel infrastructure and facilities for the living area are very poor. No options for a canteen kind of monopoly are there. Sports and games are few, and on practical notes, accessible only to a few.
detailed_review.Faculty: Very few professors are well known about their subject, others are just being egoistic by nature and difficult to communicate with. The course curriculum is not relevant and doesn't help with any practical industry knowledge. Semester exams are not so difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course because I have an interest in power generation devices, which are very important for human logistics. The academic curriculum is followed in the same old style, which is not modified for the current world. Events and fests are decent. College is very focused on academics and restricts students based on grades for extracurricular activities.

faqs.question: How can I get MBA at NIT Warangal?
faqs.answer: Students are given admission in the MBA courses at NIT Warangal through Common Admission Test (CAT). Aspirants can apply for MBA with a valid MAT scores. A merit list is prepared based on the CAT Percentile of the candidates. NIT Warangal MBA admission is done through a merit list of entrance tests. Based on CAT scores, candidates are then called for the Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD & PI) round for final admission.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

If you qualify under the General AI quota, the maximum required JEE Main cutoff rank for B.Tech admission was 60255 in 2025.Those who have a lower cutoff than the one specified can get a seat in NIT Warangal BTech. For CSE, ECE, etc., the cutoff ranks tend to be lower showing high competition for admission in the engineering aspirants.

For female candidates in general category under All India quota 5932 was the closing rank BTech cut off varies depending on the category and domicile/quota of the applicant.

faqs.question: How to get admission to the NIT Warangal MTech course?
faqs.answer: To apply for the NIT Warangal MTech course, candidates must apply for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering also known as GATE . NIT Warangal admits students on the basis of candidates' performance in the GATE entrance test. The final selection is based on CCMT counselling process. The counselling body releases a cutoff list for each counselling round. Students with a score equal to or more than cutoff marks become eligible for seat allotment. The application form GATE can be filled out through its official website. Following which, aspirants also have to apply for the counselling.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for MTech at NIT Warangal?
faqs.answer: NIT Warangal MTech total tuition fee is INR 1.4 lakh for the two-year programme. The total course fee is inclusive of other components as well such as hostel fee, mess fee, security charges, and more. Candidates have to pay the tuition fee semesterly/annually. While charges like security fee is only one-time chargeable. The tuition fee mentioned here is as per the official website/sanctioning body. It is subject to changes and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: Is MCA at NIT Warangal 2 years or 3 years?
faqs.answer: NIT Warangal offers a two-year full-time MCA course at the postgraduate level. However, a few National Institutes of Technology (NITs) also offers MCA course for a duration of three years. NIT Warangal admission to this course is based on candidates' performance in the National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET).

faqs.question: How to get MCA Seat in NIT Warangal?
faqs.answer: To apply for the National Institute of Technology Warangal MCA course, candidates need to apply for the National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET). Eligible students are then required to appear for the NIMCET entrance exam. Besides, aspirants must also pass a three-year bachelor's degree with a minimum of 60% aggregate to apply for MCA programme.

faqs.question: Does NIT Warangal accept NIMCET score for MCA admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Warangal offers MCA specialisation based on NIMCET scores. NIMCET is a Common Entrance National Level Test, conducted by any of the NITs, for admission in to their MCA programme. The MCA programme is offered by NITs at Agartala, Allahabad, Bhopal, Jamshedpur, Kurukshetra, Patna, Raipur, Surathkal, Tiruchirappalli, Warangal and IIIT at Bhopal . The admission into the MCA programme for the year 2024-25 in above 10 NITs and 01 IIIT is based on the Rank obtained in NIMCET-2024 only.
