reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty and decent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60 to 70 percent of students from my course got placed by the end of the placement season. Placement opportunities are decent, especially for students who are consistent with coding, projects and internships. The highest package is around 12 to 14 LPA, the lowest package is 3LPA and the average package  is 5 to 6LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities on campus are decent and sufficient for a student. The campus has Wi-Fi, well maintained computer labs, smart classrooms and a good well maintained library. Hostel facilities are average with basic amenities and cleanliness is maintained. The mess food is average and repetitive but the canteens provide additional options. Basic medical facilities for both indoor and outdoor activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is mostly qualified, experienced and supportive and many teachers are knowledgeable in their subjects. Teaching quality is generally good, with a mix of theory and practical examinations. The curriculum is relevant and covers core subjects like programming, data structures and operating systems which help build a strong foundation, but students need to do additional self learning to be fully industry ready. Semester exams are of moderate difficulty and students who attend classes regularly can pass exams without trouble.
detailed_review.Other: Studying at Thapar is quite expensive. Placement is better than tier 3 colleges so I preferred this college and you get a good amount of exposure in college. I chose this course due to my interest in coding and technology and its strong career scope. The course offers good core subjects and learning opportunities through practical subjects. The campus has active student life with technical events.

reviews.review_title: It is the drastic mistake of my life.

detailed_review.Placements: There are around 75 students, out of which 6 to 7 are placed and 93% are unplaced. Later, some students are able to get placed on their own or through referrals. Students study biotech for 4 years, and the college does not provide even a single core company. We are eligible for very few companies (10 out of 100), mostly in sales or pure technical coding roles. Finance and consulting companies are there, but hardly 1 or 2.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is excellent in terms of hostels and classrooms. But average in terms of labs. As many core experiments are done in groups of 10 people, giving little hands-on experience. Hostel facilities are high class with good food. Classrooms are also good and air-conditioned.
detailed_review.Faculty: I will be blunt and honest with this. Except for 2 or 3 professors, no one is there to help in terms of placement, career, or curriculum. I remember one of my professors telling me to drop the semester as I was short in attendance due to a major surgery. My fault was only requesting him to allow me to sit in the exam and manage my attendance. At the same time, he allowed fest students, but I, with all medical reports, was not allowed, so I had to go to the dean for the same.
detailed_review.Other: If you are getting a CS-related or circuital branch. They have lots of money to spend, or just need a degree with an extravagant college life, you are at the right place. For branches like Biotech, your college life is like a ship destined to nowhere, filled with disappointment, and you will end up wasting four crucial years of your life.

reviews.review_title: Extremely good infrastructure, nice faculty, but the fees are a bit high.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70 per cent of the students in my college were placed. Top recruiters are Nvidia and BAINS. About 40 per cent of the students got an internship in the 5th semester in companies like BAINS, BCG, etc. Top roles offered in my course are A. E. [Assistant Engineer] in PSPSCL.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Superb hostels, nice bathrooms, Wi-Fi speed is mid but manageable. Labs have top-quality, up-to-date machines and instruments. Lecture halls are very good and in nice condition. Roads and stadiums are very good. Overall, nice infrastructure as well as 24th NIRF rank.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are very knowledgeable and well-qualified to teach, as expected of a reputable college. Very nice and friendly lab technician. Overall, the course curriculum is very thorough, and the individual collaborated to fit the course in line with the objective of placements.
detailed_review.Other: I want to get a position of A. E. in CEA [Central Electricity Board]. Things I would like to improve would be to lower the feels a bit. Events are very nice, there are a ton of societies that conduct their events very nicely.

reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure with AC campus but the mess food is average.

detailed_review.Placements: About 85% of students definitely get placed in the main courses of computer engineering and computer science. Some students even get very high starting packages as well. Top roles offered are usually SDE, product managers, data analysts, and web developers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs and classroom are good. The library has a vast collection of books and reference material with large sitting areas. But the baggage area outside is quite small in comparison. The sports centre is great, and has good quality equipment. The food in hostels is not that great though.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the old teachers have great teaching experience but are quite strict. The course curriculum is very much based on exams only. There are ofcourse, courses available to make the students industry-ready. Semester exams are relatively difficult to get an A grade but you can pass the exams with some light study with cramming stuff.

reviews.review_title: This college is something great that everyone should experience. The infrastructure is top-notch.

detailed_review.Placements: I have chosen Computer Science engineering, the top branch. Highest package was 55 LPA, and top companies come to recruit. As heard from seniors, competition is quite tough, we need to be perfectionists in our fields, with overall development.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi in the whole building. Library is great, very beautifully made, and the labs are well maintained with all equipments. We have all medical facilities, and mess food is all delicious with hygiene maintained. We have all the games from table tennis to swimming. Infrastructure is good, very clean and maintained,
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is great. Semesters exams are quite difficult, they give practical knowledge too. I believe working hard and smart is the main task.
detailed_review.Other: Events are top-notch. Crowd from different places. Many activities, good placement.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology)
reviews.review_title: Decent faculty, placements, great infrastructure, and enjoyable campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: No students have been placed yet in my course, as the first batch of it is still to pass out. Otherwise, VLSI domain companies come to college often and hire for design engineer roles. People also get roles like testing engineer, basic engineer, etc. Salaries vary for top companies, ranging from 16 to 18LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are great here, in fact, one of the best compared to other colleges. Fully air conditioned classrooms, the biggest library in India, and Wi-Fi connectivity are available in every block. Hostels are no less, they provide the best facilities here. The mess food is reasonable, medical is a call away, you can use the gym, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are good. They have knowledge and are well qualified, but some of them lack teaching qualities. Course curriculum is absolutely industry relevant, and it will help for sure. Semester exams are decent, you can study 1 to 2 hours per day and get very good marks. The pass percent is 35%.

reviews.review_title: The best college in India.

detailed_review.Placements: I am going to pass out in 2028. I study AIML here, with a batch of 120 students. 90% of students get placed. The highest package can go up to 3 crore per annum, and the lowest is 4 LPA to 5 LPA. Nvidia, Google, Apple, Microsoft, and various other companies come here. I'm still in 2nd year, so students are looking for an internship for this summer. Most everyone does one. Top roles offered in my branch are data scientist, ML engineering, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is great. The library is very beautiful and big. Wi-Fi is great. It's available everywhere. Labs have very good infrastructure. Hostels are also great. But the food in the mess is not that great. Medical facilities are also great. You can get an emergency ambulance whenever needed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are great. They help a lot with projects. But it's all on you if you approach them or not. The course curriculum is very relevant. If you study everything in detail, you will be industry-ready. Semester exams are medium to hard.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is great, but not good value for money.

detailed_review.Placements: I have not come to the placements year yet, but I have heard a lot about the placements that the seniors get amazing jobs from Many international companies like Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Instagram, and Facebook. In my course, especially the roles and the job placements are really good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Great infrastructure here. Wi-Fi, very cool buildings. Classrooms are almost the latest, and now the remaining blocks are also getting renovated. It would be a great course to join, a great college, and teachers. I haven't been to a hostel, but they are dope.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified but not that helpful. The semesters are normal, not that difficult. If you try too hard, you will get great marks. If you don't study, it will be very tough for you to catch up with the remaining students, as competition is high.
detailed_review.Other: This was very interesting before I entered college.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: High fees but nice faculty, good placements, good infrastructure and facilities, and scholarships.

detailed_review.Placements: More than half of the students enrolled in the course are placed. Top recruiting companies include Wipro, IBM, Samsung, DE Shaw & Co, Oracle, Microsoft, Siemens, and many more. Highest Package was 39 LPA, lowest package was 16 LPA, and the average was around 19 LPA. Many students received a stipend above Rs. 25,000, with the number generally increasing across groups, and the maximum stipend offered went as high as Rs. 1.5 Lacs in some cases.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: World-class research facilities, antenna research lab, done and intelligent sensors lab, MEMS research lab, optical fibre communication research lab, smart autonomous electric vehicle lab, Thapsat research lab, wireless communication lab. Good classrooms with mostly air-conditioned, free wi-fi around the academic area and in hostels. Very big and spacious five-storied air-conditioned Nalanda Central Library with modern technology. There are 16 hostels, most of which are conditioned. Mess, laundry, cleaning services, gym, and night canteen are also available in hostels. Mess food is quite good. There is a fully functional health centre with a full-time doctor on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are professional, qualified, and helpful. Course curriculum sometimes doesn't feel very relevant to modern needs, but overall, students get industry-ready. Semester exams are moderate to difficult. Labs and hands-on experience provide a great opportunity for the students to gain deep insight into the course.
detailed_review.Other: College events happen all year. Scholarships are also provided to top-performing candidates. Campus surroundings are lush and green. One can reach the campus via bus, train, and car.

reviews.review_title: Thapar provides many opportunities, a great infrastructure, and good faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: Companies that visit Thapar are Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Adobe, Infosys, TCS, Deloitte, IBM, JP Morgan Chase, L&T, Cisco, Samsung, Reliance, Zomato, and Edelweiss. The highest package is 45 LPA. The average package is 15 LPA. The lowest package is 8 LPA for COE. Placement percentage is 70%. The internship percentage is 40% on campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Thapar has very good Wi-Fi connectivity throughout the campus, even within hostels. Labs are great with modern infrastructure. Hostels are nice with AC, joint washrooms, and great mess food. Thapar has the most beautiful and large library with all types of books for any field (B.Tech, law, civil services, etc. Thapar has a free health care centre with good doctors for any issue. Ambulance services are also available 24x7. It has a very nice sports culture with many sports and coaches for every sport, like basketball, cricket, football, badminton, table tennis, lawn tennis, swimming, yoga, chess, athletics, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Thapar follows the modern curriculum and makes changes in its syllabus according to the current needs. Semester exams are not too hard if we study a week before, then we may get above 8 CGPA. The pass percentage is quite high. Professors are highly qualified, but some PhD teachers are unable to explain well (at the end, we will be studying from the PPTs provided), and no matter how good our professor is.
detailed_review.Other: I chose computer engineering because it is one of the oldest branches at Thapar with good placements. I feel there is a lot of student intake in computer engineering, around 1000, which is really too much, making it competitive as well as reducing the average package. There are a lot of fests and many good singers come here. Many students are working on their skills. Thapar provides scholarships based on our CGPA (above 9.3 for CoE)and in our branch.

reviews.review_title: One of the better choices around 90-96%.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement for computer branches are quite better as compared to core branches. According to statistics released this year, the placement percentage is around 80-85% for all branches under computer domain and significant companies with packages greater than 20 LPA also visit the campus. The huge number of students on campus makes the placement scene very competitive.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Apart from small, a few ifs and but's here and there, the facilities on campus are nice. There are many places to hangout, and AC is installed in 90% of the classes and hostels to assist in scorching heat of Patiala. The library being the main attraction, provides more than enough books for every category.
detailed_review.Faculty: Despite paying huge lump sums of money, the faculty members on the campus are just like any other college faculty you have heard about, at least in the 1st year. For more detailed faculty about branches, there are varying opinions but as far as I have heard the computer faculty members are pretty chill.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Expensive but provides facilities for it. Amazing infrastructure, average placements and teachers.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course computer science engineering in first year around 450 students are placed. (According to 24-25 batch) the highest salary is 52 LPA, median salary is 5.94 LPA, and average salary is 18 LPA packages. 818 students got internships, 462 students got placements (for entire computer engineering, not only computer science). Companies are Goldman Sachs, Google, Microsoft, Amex, Expedia, Texas Instruments, Apple, Infosys, and TCS. Roles offered are SDE, analyst, consulting, and data analysis.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are top notch, massive sitting space, well air conditioned, working Wi-Fi throughout campus, and well-maintained massive library with all types of books with discussion areas. Strict rules for the library not allowing eating stuff with a library card for entry. Infrastructure of library is fabulous allowing a very calm and peaceful space for working. Hostel facilities depend on hostel with mess for each hostel providing quality food. Rooms with and without non-AC. A canteen for evening snacks within the mess itself. Chess, table tennis, and carrom facilities are also provided in the hostels. Well-maintained rooms with different types of sharing (2S, 3S, 4S)depending on hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the teachers are very well educated and know what they are teaching with a deep knowledge of their course. Not satisfied with the teaching methods of few teachers and did not understand much in their class so I had to refer to other sources. Course curriculum for first year includes all subjects, and the following years include a well-managed course that helps in grabbing a high paying job. The curriculum is a bit tough, and the exams are held with percentile (relatively grading) format. Due to the large number of kids enrolled, passing and failing students vary a lot majority getting above 7.5 CGPA average.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this computer science course because of the emerging opportunities in future and my interest in the field. I would want better faculty for certain subjects even though they are helpful but they fail to make the concepts clear. Events are really great and happen throughout the year some or the other. Sports and extracurricular facilities are really well managed with coaches for each sport. Scholarships upto 1 crore or more are provided to children depending on performance. Our campus has eating dining places and shopping as well.

reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure like foreign universities.

detailed_review.Placements: All students in our course were placed during the campus placement drive. The highest package offered in our course was 48 LPA. The average package was around 6 LPA - 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies were AMD, Engineers India, Tata Technologies, Apple, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely attractive to us. Sports facilities were also available. Medical facility was present.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective domains of study. The relationship between students and teachers was really good. The teaching quality of our faculty members was extremely good. Course curriculum was relevant. Semester examination was moderate.
detailed_review.Other: Various kinds of events were regularly organised like Formula Racing, robotics competition, etc.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure with a guaranteed fun college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are not bad. The average package is around 15 LPA, and with the right guidance and skills, campus placement isn't hard to get. Under the mentorship of good faculty, you can get good referrals and recommendations, which make placements much easier.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mess services are great as they are catered by Sodexo, and hostels are fairly maintained. The rooms are neither too tight nor too big but the right size. They are cleaned regularly by the staff, and the food in the mess is hygienic with no compromises in taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Good curriculum so that students can have balanced workloads and not compromise their college life. Due to adequate time given before and after the exams, the child doesn't feel super pressurized but is content with the time in hand and with the ease of studying.

reviews.review_title: It is the best university for pursuing graduation.

detailed_review.Placements: Thapar University is accredited with an A+ grade by NAAC. It is well-known for its placement record, quality of education, and discipline. In the final year of their courses, students are eligible for on-campus placements. Companies such as TCS, Deloitte, Capgemini, and many others visit the campus for recruitment. Approximately 95% of students secure on-campus placements. The faculty in the placements cell is exceptional; they support students in maximizing their opportunities. The highest package offered is 45 LPA, while the lowest is 2.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is one of the best things it's pretty filled with beautiful buildings, comfortable classes fully air-conditioned, greenery all around the sports complex running lanes during winter and autumn the weather is so pleasant here. The annual cultural fest named Saturnalia happens along with a sports fest called URJA. Campus life is great. It has the biggest college library in India. Mess food is average in taste and the hostel is quite good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly supportive and knowledgeable. Many teachers are Ph.D. holders. They are friendly. They help students as much as they can. Semester exams of all courses are conducted inside the campus but that doesn't mean you can pass the exams without study.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I know that Thapar's standards have fallen from what it was before lockdown.

detailed_review.Placements: Currently, around 20% of students get summer internships, which is great. According to me, 10% of students get placed, even in the 3rd year, which is great. Considering the market condition, for a private college to maintain its standard and get more placements and interns than the previous year is great.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For my course specifically, I think every aspect of the course is up to date. The hostel is the best in India, and the classroom just feels like a foreign University. If any students come to Thapar, it would be a dream come true for him, so yes, it's great considering everything.
detailed_review.Faculty: I can't say for faculty as they are textbook-oriented teachers, so I don't consider them great, but they are qualified enough and knowledgeable. As a 3rd year student, I have published 2 research papers, so you can see how good they are. Semester exams are very difficult to get through. The pass percentage is 33%, and the course is industry-relevant.
detailed_review.Other: I just want to say, if you want to enjoy college life and events, no college can beat Thapar. In that, you get so many events in a year, you will miss some of them because you won't get time to attend, and you will know every other day is some fest is going on.

reviews.review_title: It provides good placements in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: It provides nice placements. The average package offered is 12 LPA, and the highest package is 53 LPA. The lowest package is 8 LPA. For sure, good companies like JP Morgan, Accenture, Deloitte, and Bain & Company visit the college to recruit students. 90% of students get placed here. 10% of students opt for higher studies. I suggest students join this college. It has good placement states.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has a good Infrastructure. There is a good and massive library. It provides nice hostels with all facilities. It has nice classrooms, and all are air-conditioned. It has a good culture and a decent crowd. It has a very nice auditorium and a nice park.
detailed_review.Faculty: It has a nice course curriculum. Professors are helpful. They provide many nice projects. It also has many summer projects.
detailed_review.Other: It organises many great fests. A technical fest is organised here. Hackathons are conducted. Almost every weekend, there are events. There are many workshops. It has a good social culture. Industrial visits are conducted. Regular ELC is conducted.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college campus is big. Placements are good if you maintain good CGPA.

detailed_review.Placements: The number of students in my course is 250 which is 8-9% of total students in my college. The highest package for my college is 20 LPA, and the average salary is 8 LPA. Top recruiting company is JP Morgan. Almost 70% of students get internships in my course and from tech companies like Microsoft.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and AC are available in every class in my college. Lab is well maintained with all components needed for projects and experiments. The hostels have a lot of choices like 4 seaters, 3 seaters, 2 seaters, and 1 seater for students to choose from. The mess food here is maintained by Sodexo which is a France company providing good and clean food. The medical facility here is good with an ambulance available 24X7. We have a sports event here once every year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching is quite good with a maintained 75% attendance. My course includes both balanced electrical and computer courses which are asked during interviews and making the students ready for industry and jobs. The exams are quite hard with PYQs available on Thapar site for students to solve. Teachers are always available to help students regarding their doubts about their respective subjects except at night.
detailed_review.Other: I chose electrical and computer science because I wanted to pursue computer science. This is the best branch I was getting with my percentile in JEE. The events are very frequent and fun. Big events like SAT occur every year in which big singers and artists come to my college.

reviews.review_title: Best university in Punjab.

detailed_review.Placements: Thapar University is one of the best private universities in Punjab. It is known for its decent placement record and education. At the end of 4th semester, students are eligible for internships. There are a lot of internship opportunities for those students who have skills and interests. In the final year of your course, you are eligible for placements in on-campus drive. Many companies visited colleges like Accenture, Deloitte, Amazon, and many more. Approximately 98% of students get placed in on-campus placement drives. The highest package is 65 LPA, and the lowest salary is 3 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is amazing and very modern. The building is very well built with facilities such as numerous labs with computers with required specifications as per the courses. It has 24X7 Wi-Fi facilities with good internet speed connection. We have a cafeteria on the campus. We have a big playground area. Indoor sports facilities and many more are there. Sports facilities are also good with there being a football field, track, cricket ground, badminton court, and many more. Hostels are also very modern with air-conditioning and private catering along with a dispensary.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and experienced in their field. Many of them are Ph.D. holders. Faculty members vary from department to department. Interaction between students and teachers is too friendly and students can ask their doubts in teachers cabins. Faculty members are very highly supportive in nature and they help students as far as they can. Thapar is an institute but nowadays Thapar has become a deemed university so exams for all courses are conducted on the campus. Semester exams are neither tough nor easy. You can see teachers' notes and give all the college exams you can pass.
detailed_review.Other: College conducts many fests and the biggest fest named Saturnalia takes place in November.

reviews.review_title: Stunned by the quality of this college and college life, highly recommend 10/10.

detailed_review.Placements: In the previous batch, almost 90% of the batch got placed with good offers, and mainly SDE roles were provided to students. Some of the top companies are Apple, Brain, BlackRock, Deloitte, and others. Instead of hiring in mass, they hire less with good packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I have to say we have one of the best architectures in Thapar University. The hostels are top-tier, and classrooms are very well maintained. Apart from these two, the campus seems calm and composed throughout the year, alongside hosting different fests throughout the year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and qualified, providing a good knowledge practically too. The semester exams are a bit tough, so we have to study more than last minute. The curriculum seems updated with the latest market requirements, and none of the outdated material is taught.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is happening throughout the year, providing the biggest techno-cultural fests, sports fests, food fests, film fests, and many others, with a decent crowd and many societies for a person to be involved in and grow naturally.

admission.title: Thapar University Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
Thapar University admissions 2026 are merit and entrance-based. The university offers a number of courses at the UG, PG, and Doctorate levels, such as- BTech, PhD, MBA, etc. The application process is conducted striclty in the online mode. For admission in the BTech course candidates must appear for the JEE Mains exam and for MBA they must appear for CAT/XAT/NMAT or the TMAT entrance exam. Thapar University accepts Class 12 scores for merit based admission. The duration of most UG courses extend up to three or four hears while PG courses have a duration of two years. PhD programmes vary in duration, mostly extending to five years.

Read on to know more about Thapar University admission process, fees, eligibility etc.

faqs.question: Can I take direct admission in Thapar University, Punjab?
faqs.answer: Thapar University admission to most of the undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral courses is based on candidates' performance in several national-level entrance exams. For TIET BTech admission, candidates must have class 12 and a valid JEE Main score. Apart from J EE M ain , TIET also accepts CAT / XAT / CMAT / MAT / GMAT / GRE / Thapar Entrance Test for MBA and GATE for ME/ M.Tech admission.

faqs.question: Is Thapar University entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: Thapar University does not hold its own BTech entrance exam; it's done through JEE Main, which is moderate to tough. MBA requires CAT, NMAT, or XAT, competitive exams. M.Tech GATE is challenging but can be cracked if one prepares for it.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Thapar University?
faqs.answer: TIET admission process includes the submission of the application form, entrance test, release of merit list, counselling process and final fee payment process. The step-by-step application process: 1- Thapar University Application Process Visit the official website of the University and fill application form. The TIET application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates have to register through the official website of TIET to apply for any of the programmes. Below-mentioned steps by TIET application process: Visit the website. Click on “Admission” and register. Fill out the application form by required details. Upload a scanned photo and documents Pay the application fee online via debit/ credit card or net banking. Documents required at the time of admission: 2- Appear for the Entrance Test Students appear for the entrance test i.e. JEE Main/ NEET for Thapar University BTech admission. 3- Declaration of the Merit List The institute release the merit list along with the entrance test score and branch name. 4- Counselling Process & Fee Payment Final step is for counselling after merit list. After counselling students pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What JEE rank is required for Thapar University CSE admission?
faqs.answer: Note: For OBC, EWS and PWD categories, the cutoff ranks were not released.

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility for MCA at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: The minimum eligibility for MCA at Thapar University is passing BCA or its equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 60% (55% for reserved category). Also, Mathematics must be studied at Class 10, Class 12 or graduation level. The selection criteria is merit based with the insitute accepting UG scores for the same.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for MBA at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: The selection process for MBA at Thapar University includes appearing for the entrance exams accepted by the university. Hereafter, clearing the entrance, appear for the Personal Interview and Group Discussion. Further on, the university conducts a counselling session in which seats are allotted to students in their programmes. The selection criteria for the same is entrance based and the minimum eligibility is passing UG with atleast 60% aggregate.

faqs.question: What are the factors responsible for Thapar University BTech Cutoff?
faqs.answer: While preparing cutoffs for the Thapar University BTech course, the authorities will consider examination and admission-related factors. The listed factors will be checked and considered by the authorities while determining the cutoff of the Thapar University BTech course: previous years' cutoff trends, difficulty level of the exam, total number of qualified candidates, total number of candidates applying for a specific course or institute, number of seats available for admission, etc. After checking all of these factors, the authorities will prepare the Thapar University JEE Mains/ NEET cutoff.

faqs.question: Can I get Thapar University without JEE?
faqs.answer: No, JEE Main is mandatory for BTech admission in Thapar University. The candidate should have a valid score in JEE Main and attend counseling to get a seat. But for other UG and PG courses such as MSc, MA, and MCA, admissions are made on a merit basis, i.e., JEE is not mandatory.

faqs.question: Are admissions at Thapar University merit or entrance based?
faqs.answer: Admissions at Thapar University are both merit and entrance based. The selection criteria varies depending on the programme chosen. Certain courses like BTech are entrance based with the university accepting JEE MAIN scores for the same while certain courses like MSc, MCA etc. are merit based. The university accepts Class 12 scores for merit based admissions. Ensure that the minimum eligibility requirement is met and check the selection criteria very carefully before applying for admission to the preferred programme.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for Thapar University MBA admission?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers MBA programmes via the LM Thapar School of Management. Admissions are currently open for Thapar University Patiala MBA courses. Candidates seeking admission must apply online before its last date. To be eligible for Thapar University MBA admission, students are required to have a bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum aggregate of 50% or equivalent CGPA or corresponding grade secured from a recognised University/Institute. Candidates with a post-graduation degree in any discipline with a minimum aggregate of 50% are also eligible to apply for MBA admission.

faqs.question: I have scored less than 50% in graduation. What are the college options available for pursuing an MBA?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for MBA admissions in most colleges require a minimum percentage in graduation degree. Most MBA colleges select candidates based on the scores of national or state-level entrance exams. Thapar University MBA course admission requires students to have passed Masters with a minimum aggregate of 50% aggregate to apply. However, selection to the course is entrance-based. Students must secure a valid score in entrance exams such as CAT, SNAP, MAT, etc. and go through the counselling process. Candidates can also pursue MBA at colleges offering Online MBA courses . They can also check out colleges offering Online Executive MBA programmes .

faqs.answer: Thapar University BE/BTech fee range between INR 8.85 Lakh and INR 14.58 lakh. The fee mentioned here is the total tuition fee and is taken from an unofficial source. faqs.question: How can I get admission to BTech at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: Thapar University admission to the BTech course is a two-way process, one is entrance-based and another is merit-based. Interested candidates can apply for TIET BTech admission either way. Thapar University's 50% of seats will be filled on the basis of JEE Main scores and the rest 50% is based on the marks secured in the Class 12 examination. The minimum eligibility criteria is different for both entrance and merit-based admission. TIET is currently accepting applications for the BE/ BTech courses, interested candidates must visit the official website of TIET to apply online.

faqs.question: Is BTech available at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Thapar University offers a list of BE/ BTech courses at the undergraduate level. TIET offers BE/BTech courses in 14 specialisations, including Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering and Biomedical Engineering, among others. Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology also offers lateral admission to a few BE/BTech courses for Diploma holders in the 2nd year (3rd Semester) of the course. TIET lateral admission to the BTech course is based on the merit of marks secured by the candidates in diploma. For more information related to TIET BTech admission criteria, selection process, important dates and fees, click here . Read more about Career Scope of BTech here .

faqs.question: Is Thapar University good for BE/ BTech CSE?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers a four-year full-time BE/BTech course in Computer Science & Engineering at the undergraduate level. TIET offers a BTech CSE programme with a total seat intake of 180 students. The total tuition fee for TIET BTech CSE course is INR 14.58Lacs (As per an unofficial source). Talking about the placement of Thapar University BTech course , the median package offered was INR 8 LPA during TIET placements 2021. Considering the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranking 2023, TIET was ranked 20 in the Engineering category. So, considering all these factors TIET is not a bad option for BTech CSE admission.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admissions to MCA course at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: The basic eligibility requirement to pursue an MCA course at Thapar University is that candidates must complete their bachelor's degree from any stream with a minimum aggregate of 60% (55% for reserved categories). Moreover, candidates should have studied Mathematics in their Class 12 and graduation to pursue MCA at TIET . The selection process is based on merit, which is released by the university after evaluating candidates' academic performance in Class 10,  12, and graduation.

faqs.question: How can I get a seat in BTech course at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: To get a seat in the BTech course at Thapar University, candidates can follow two ways , one is entrance-based and another is merit-based. Interested candidates can apply for TIET BTech admission either way. Thapar University's 50% of seats will be filled based on JEE Main scores and the rest 50% is based on the marks secured in the Class 12 examination. Check out the steps to get a seat in the BTech course at Thapar University below: Step 1 : Visit the official website of TIET (thapar.edu). Step 2 : Click on “ Admission 2025 ” and register. Step 3 : Fill out the application form by entering the required academic and personal details. Step 4 : Upload a scanned photo of the qualifying exam mark sheet and a passport-size photograph. Step 5 : Pay the application fee online via debit/ credit card or net banking.

faqs.question: Does Thapar University accept NEET scores for BTech admission?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers four-year full-time BE/BTech courses at the undergraduate level. Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology admission to all the BE/BTech courses is based on candidates' performance in the JEE Main entrance exam except BTech in Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering. TIET BTech admission to Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering is based on valid NEET 2023 marks, followed by a counselling process. TIET 50% of the seats will be filled basis of NEET scores and the rest 50% of the seats shall be filled on the basis of merit of marks obtained in Class 12 or equivalent examination in aggregate of three subjects, namely, Physics, Chemistry and, Biology.

faqs.question: Is Class 12 marks enough for Thapar University admission?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers four-year BE/BTech courses at the undergraduate level, candidates seeking admission to TIET Patiala must visit the official website of the University to apply online. Yes, TIET considers Class 12 marks for admission to the BE/BTech courses along with valid JEE Main scores. Based on the marks secured in the entrance exam, a merit list is prepared. The merit list prepared by the University for BTech admission also includes the marks secured in Physics, Chemistry and Maths during the Class 12 examination.

admission_eligibility.title: Thapar University Eligibility & Selection 2026
admission_eligibility.intro_text: Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology offers BE/ BTech at the UG level, ME/ MTech, MBA, MCA, MA, and MSc at the PG level and PhD courses at the doctoral level. Thapar Institute of Engineering andTechnology, Patiala admission to most of the courses is entrance-based. For TIET BTech admission, candidates must have class 12 and a valid JEE Main score. Apart from JEE Main, it also accepts other national-level entrance exams for admission to MBA, ME/ MTech courses. Given below is the eligibility and selection criteria of Thapar University courses :

faqs.question: Can I take direct admission in Thapar University, Punjab?
faqs.answer: Thapar University admission to most of the undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral courses is based on candidates' performance in several national-level entrance exams. For TIET BTech admission, candidates must have class 12 and a valid JEE Main score. Apart from J EE M ain , TIET also accepts CAT / XAT / CMAT / MAT / GMAT / GRE / Thapar Entrance Test for MBA and GATE for ME/ M.Tech admission. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: Is Thapar University entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: Thapar University does not hold its own BTech entrance exam; it's done through JEE Main, which is moderate to tough. MBA requires CAT, NMAT, or XAT, competitive exams. M.Tech GATE is challenging but can be cracked if one prepares for it. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Thapar University?
faqs.answer: TIET admission process includes the submission of the application form, entrance test, release of merit list, counselling process and final fee payment process. The step-by-step application process: 1- Thapar University Application Process Visit the official website of the University and fill application form. The TIET application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates have to register through the official website of TIET to apply for any of the programmes. Below-mentioned steps by TIET application process: Visit the website. Click on “Admission” and register. Fill out the application form by required details. Upload a scanned photo and documents Pay the application fee online via debit/ credit card or net banking. Documents required at the time of admission: Class 10 and Class 12 report card UG mark sheet (if applicable) PG mark sheet (if applicable) Date of birth certificate Passport-size photograph Transfer certificate Character certificate 2- Appear for the Entrance Test Students appear for the entrance test i.e. JEE Main/ NEET for Thapar University BTech admission. 3- Declaration of the Merit List The institute release the merit list along with the entrance test score and branch name. 4- Counselling Process & Fee Payment Final step is for counselling after merit list. After counselling students pay the admission fee to confirm their seats. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: What JEE rank is required for Thapar University CSE admission?
faqs.answer: Thapar University CSE cutoff 2024 was 54620 for the General AI category students for admission. The first-round cutoff for the same stood at 32664 . So, considering the 2024 JEE Main ranks, students aiming for CSE admission at TIET must target to secure a rank up to 54620 in case they belong to the General category in the AI quota. For other categories and courses, the JEE Main cutoff ranks will be different. Tabulated below is the TIET BE cutoff 2024 for CSE admission for different categories in the AI quota: Category JEE Main Last Round Cutoff 2024 General 54620 SC 294428 ST 357281 Note: For OBC, EWS and PWD categories, the cutoff ranks were not released. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility for MCA at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: The minimum eligibility for MCA at Thapar University is passing BCA or its equivalent with a minimum aggregate of 60% (55% for reserved category). Also, Mathematics must be studied at Class 10, Class 12 or graduation level. The selection criteria is merit based with the insitute accepting UG scores for the same. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: What is the selection process for MBA at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: The selection process for MBA at Thapar University includes appearing for the entrance exams accepted by the university. Hereafter, clearing the entrance, appear for the Personal Interview and Group Discussion. Further on, the university conducts a counselling session in which seats are allotted to students in their programmes. The selection criteria for the same is entrance based and the minimum eligibility is passing UG with atleast 60% aggregate. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: How can I get a seat in BTech course at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: To get a seat in the BTech course at Thapar University, candidates can follow two ways , one is entrance-based and another is merit-based. Interested candidates can apply for TIET BTech admission either way. Thapar University's 50% of seats will be filled based on JEE Main scores and the rest 50% is based on the marks secured in the Class 12 examination. Check out the steps to get a seat in the BTech course at Thapar University below: Step 1 : Visit the official website of TIET (thapar.edu). Step 2 : Click on “ Admission 2025 ” and register. Step 3 : Fill out the application form by entering the required academic and personal details. Step 4 : Upload a scanned photo of the qualifying exam mark sheet and a passport-size photograph. Step 5 : Pay the application fee online via debit/ credit card or net banking. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: Can I get Thapar University without JEE?
faqs.answer: No, JEE Main is mandatory for BTech admission in Thapar University. The candidate should have a valid score in JEE Main and attend counseling to get a seat. But for other UG and PG courses such as MSc, MA, and MCA, admissions are made on a merit basis, i.e., JEE is not mandatory. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: Are admissions at Thapar University merit or entrance based?
faqs.answer: Admissions at Thapar University are both merit and entrance based. The selection criteria varies depending on the programme chosen. Certain courses like BTech are entrance based with the university accepting JEE MAIN scores for the same while certain courses like MSc, MCA etc. are merit based. The university accepts Class 12 scores for merit based admissions. Ensure that the minimum eligibility requirement is met and check the selection criteria very carefully before applying for admission to the preferred programme. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.answer: Thapar University BTech admission is done on entrance score basis. Candidates are selected based on performance in the JEE Main and academic background. Before applying, it is advisable to check out the eligibility requirements. Candidates can follow the steps below to get an understanding of the selection process: Fill out the application form with all the mandatory details. Appear for JEE Main entrance test. Selected candidates must appear for the counselling process Pay the admission fee to confirm the seats Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for Thapar University MBA admission?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers MBA programmes via the LM Thapar School of Management. Admissions are currently open for Thapar University Patiala MBA courses. Candidates seeking admission must apply online before its last date. To be eligible for Thapar University MBA admission, students are required to have a bachelor's degree in any discipline with a minimum aggregate of 50% or equivalent CGPA or corresponding grade secured from a recognised University/Institute. Candidates with a post-graduation degree in any discipline with a minimum aggregate of 50% are also eligible to apply for MBA admission. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: I have scored less than 50% in graduation. What are the college options available for pursuing an MBA?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria for MBA admissions in most colleges require a minimum percentage in graduation degree. Most MBA colleges select candidates based on the scores of national or state-level entrance exams. Thapar University MBA course admission requires students to have passed Masters with a minimum aggregate of 50% aggregate to apply. However, selection to the course is entrance-based. Students must secure a valid score in entrance exams such as CAT, SNAP, MAT, etc. and go through the counselling process. Candidates can also pursue MBA at colleges offering Online MBA courses . They can also check out colleges offering Online Executive MBA programmes . Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.answer: Thapar University BE/BTech fee range between INR 8.85 Lakh and INR 14.58 lakh. The fee mentioned here is the total tuition fee and is taken from an unofficial source. faqs.question: How can I get admission to BTech at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: Thapar University admission to the BTech course is a two-way process, one is entrance-based and another is merit-based. Interested candidates can apply for TIET BTech admission either way. Thapar University's 50% of seats will be filled on the basis of JEE Main scores and the rest 50% is based on the marks secured in the Class 12 examination. The minimum eligibility criteria is different for both entrance and merit-based admission. TIET is currently accepting applications for the BE/ BTech courses, interested candidates must visit the official website of TIET to apply online.

faqs.question: Is BTech available at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Thapar University offers a list of BE/ BTech courses at the undergraduate level. TIET offers BE/BTech courses in 14 specialisations, including Computer Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering and Biomedical Engineering, among others. Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology also offers lateral admission to a few BE/BTech courses for Diploma holders in the 2nd year (3rd Semester) of the course. TIET lateral admission to the BTech course is based on the merit of marks secured by the candidates in diploma. For more information related to TIET BTech admission criteria, selection process, important dates and fees, click here . Read more about Career Scope of BTech here .

faqs.question: Is Thapar University good for BE/ BTech CSE?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers a four-year full-time BE/BTech course in Computer Science & Engineering at the undergraduate level. TIET offers a BTech CSE programme with a total seat intake of 180 students. The total tuition fee for TIET BTech CSE course is INR 14.58Lacs (As per an unofficial source). Talking about the placement of Thapar University BTech course , the median package offered was INR 8 LPA during TIET placements 2021. Considering the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF) ranking 2023, TIET was ranked 20 in the Engineering category. So, considering all these factors TIET is not a bad option for BTech CSE admission.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admissions to MCA course at Thapar University?
faqs.answer: The basic eligibility requirement to pursue an MCA course at Thapar University is that candidates must complete their bachelor's degree from any stream with a minimum aggregate of 60% (55% for reserved categories). Moreover, candidates should have studied Mathematics in their Class 12 and graduation to pursue MCA at TIET . The selection process is based on merit, which is released by the university after evaluating candidates' academic performance in Class 10,  12, and graduation. Not satisfied with answer? faqs.question: Does Thapar University accept NEET scores for BTech admission?
faqs.answer: Thapar University offers four-year full-time BE/BTech courses at the undergraduate level. Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology admission to all the BE/BTech courses is based on candidates' performance in the JEE Main entrance exam except BTech in Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering. sections.heading: Introduction
text: Thapar Institute is one of the oldest and finest educational institutions in the country. The institute was founded in 1956, with a campus spread across 250 acres. The institute has well-equipped classrooms, laboratories, a library, sports facilities and much more. The institute is known for its academic excelence as well as infrastructure facilties. Read further to know more about the TIET Campus infrastructure facilities:

sections.heading: TIET Campus Highlights 2024
text: TIET spans an area of 250 acres and is situated in Patiala, Punjab. The university has hostels, a library, a health centre, and sports facilities. sections.heading: TIET Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (TIET), Patiala, provides comprehensive and student-friendly dormitory and residential services to over 10,000 students in 16 hostels - ten for boys and six for girls. Accommodation options include single, double, triple, and quadruple sharing rooms in both AC and non-AC configurations. Rooms are well-equipped with necessities like mattresses, study tables, and wardrobes, as well as access to utilities like geysers, RO water, and washing machines. Each hostel has reading rooms, indoor games, TV lounges, and gyms, with Vyom Hall standing out for its modern amenities and cutting-edge gym. Mess facilities, managed by Sodexo or the hostel itself, provide regular meals with vegetarian and non-vegetarian alternatives, and most students consider the cuisine to be of reasonable quality. Laundry services are given twice a week, with optional third-party services such as U Clean available. Wi-Fi is available 24/7; however, speeds may vary during peak hours. Security is provided by biometric access, CCTV, and 24-hour caretakers. With plenty of sports and recreational opportunities nearby, as well as common areas and study lounges, TIET's hostel life offers a good mixture of comfort, safety, and community involvement.

sections.heading: TIET Hostel Fee
text: Students can check the hostel fee of Thapar University below. The hostel provides a number of basic as well as additional facilities to the students. The mess fee is charged separately.
Hostel Fee-LMTSM, Dera Bassi, as well as the Mess Fee, are given below to help students have an idea of the hostel fee at the campus.

sections.heading: TIET Library
text: Nava Nalanda Central Library is a five-storeyed iconic library situated in the centre of the campus. The area of the library building is 7182 square metres, along with 2044 square metres of garden area. The garden area is made of a beautiful combination of red stone, marble stone and precisely arranged internal wooden architecture. The library is built in a way that adequate natural light can be enjoyed. Students can sit in the park to relax their minds. The building of the library is aesthetically designed, and has a seating capacity of eight hundred. Each seat has a radiant cooling air handling unit. The library is fully equipped with modern technology such as an RFID-based security System, Self-Check-in, and Self-Return system with minimal human interference. The library also has dedicated group discussion rooms with AC, LED, a Projector, and comfortable seating. The staff of the library is very helpful and friendly, and offers help relating to matters such as arranging inter-library loans and receiving suggestions for new acquisitions. The library focuses on learning and research by prioritising digital collections and providing excellent study environments and facilities. In the recent period library has shifted swiftly and efficiently to a digital/online mode and procured more than 2 lakh e-books.

sections.heading: TIET Sports Facilities
text: Thapar Institute of Engineering & Technology (TIET), Patiala, offers sports facilities to promote the holistic development of students. The institute has well-maintained playgrounds and an international-standard athletic track. To encourage students to take part in different games such as Cricket, Hockey, Football, Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Lawn Tennis and Badminton, the institute has built a synthetic tennis court synthetic Basketball court and a Synthetic Badminton indoor court. The institute also has a gym to promote health and fitness among students. A swimming pool is also maintained with all the modern facilities. Various sporting events such as 'Thaparlympics', 'IGNITE' and URJA are organised every year to increase participation among students.

sections.heading: Places to visit around the TIET Campus
text: Students at Thapar University have a lot of options to visit nearby in their free time. Some of the famous destinations to visit include Qila Mubarak, Moti Bagh Palace, Sheesh Mahal, Lachman Jhula, and Gurudwara Dukhniwaran Sahib. There are many restaurants and shopping complexes nearby, too.

Formerly known as Delhi College of Engineering (DCE), Delhi Technological University (DTU) was established in 1941 yr. Delhi Technological University is ISO-certified & was earlier affiliated with the University of Delhi. Delhi Technological University is one of the best universities offering Engineering courses to students. Delhi Technological University, through 17 departments, offers UG, PG, & various other courses to students. These DTU University Delhi courses are provided across the Engineering, Economics, & various other streams. DTU Rohini is famous for its flagship courses, which are MBA, BDes, & BTech.
