reviews.review_title: It is good not to know about the classes but you will never get bored on campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 80 percent of students from the chemical engineering branch got on campus placement. The highest package offered is 32 LPA and the lowest package offered is 7 LPA. The average package is 10.5LPA. Bharat Petroleum, Reliance. 65 percent student got internships mostly in Infosys. You can use labs whenever you want.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Overall college infrastructure is great but the boys hostel for the first year is very bad. The classroom, library, and labs are all fine but Wi-Fi sports are good. You can play anything medical facilities are not good. The classrooms are crazy washrooms are clean and everything is hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: Do not worry about attendance just make sure you attend labs because you can learn that from anywhere else. You will find something happening in every corner, someone dancing, someone singing, too many monkeys are there but all friendly until you show them food.
detailed_review.Other: You will find every type of crowd here. Most professors will be friends with lab assistants.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: A fun and amazing college for those who work hard.

detailed_review.Placements: The total percentage of students who are placed comes out to be roughly 70%. The highest package goes up to 70 LPA, and the average is around 16 LPA. All the top companies come to the college for recruitment since it is a Tier 1 college. Specifically for my branch, Qualcomm, Texas Instruments, and many more come to the campus. Internships are abundant for tech branches. However, this is not the case for core roles in the same companies that offer placements. Roles like SWE and PCB Designer are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All facilities required for teaching are present in the college. Basic amenities like Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, and a big library are present in the college. The 1st-year hostel is not that good, but hostels change every year, so from the 2nd year, the hostels are amazing. In the case of girls, the hostels are top-notch from the 1st year itself. The sports complex has dedicated places for every major sport. There are plenty of shops like Nescafé, Amul, Mother Dairy, juice shops, small cafe points like Raydee and Hims, and there is also Domino's.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is very old compared to the skills required in the market, but teachers are amazing and very helpful in whatever subjects they teach. The material given is sufficient for skill-building. The semester exams are moderate, with a passing percentage of around 70% in each class.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am interested in Electronics and have been tinkering with Arduino ever since I was a kid. If I improve one thing about my course, it is making the course more catered toward what is required in the industry rather than general knowledge. The number of fests in this college is much more compared to other colleges. The environment is amazing because of good peers, greenery around the campus, and world-class infrastructure.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production and Industrial Engineering
reviews.review_title: Extremely good college with all facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Most of the people prefer core and non-teach jobs, teach jobs are minimal. On-campus placements are somewhat like 50 percent, others get from off-campus. Last year, a student got a teach job of 32 LPA, he had 9+ CGPA. Most of the tech companies don't even allow this branch.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Some labs are very advanced and have almost all facilities and apparatus, but some even lack basic facilities like fans, and some have broken and outdated apparatus. Talking about hostel, they are good enough. Food is not too good, but it is good enough and healthy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very experienced, but some of them are too old for teaching. They often teach by conventional methods, which students feel difficult to understand. Other teachers are very good, they are motivated and also motivate students to learn well. They teach well, provide notes, and assignments too.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are widespread; each semester has almost 3-4 fests with excellent artist lineups. College provides scholarships to poor students. Campus has a large sports complex.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: If you want to secure a good placement, I would consider DTU as it is one of the tier 1 colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: DTU placement is not that good like IITs for the highest packages, but it’s still good. DTU is not able to provide above 1 CPA, but the average and median packages are still good. Out of 10 students, 6 or 7 take above 20 LPA, it also depends upon the branch.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I’m not a hosteler, but what I have listened, 1st-year hostels are so good. Can’t say the same for hostel mess, but for freedom, 1st-year hostels are good. You can go outside college up to 10–11 pm and still enter at 3–4 am. Even if you are not able to get a hostel, you can take a PG too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course instructors are so good. You just have to take mid exams seriously, if you score well in mid semester, you can surely take 8 CGPA easily. The resources are also provided by teachers and seniors. All you have to do is just previous year questions.
detailed_review.Other: From freshers to year-end, there are lots of mini events going on. Not only mini events, the main events are also so good. Both academic and sports fests are also there.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: Strong academics and placements with an active campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from DTU, B.Tech in the Mathematics and Computing branch. In recent batches, the placements were around 80-85%, which is pretty good considering the current scenario. The highest package went above 1 crore (international package), while the average package was around 18-20 lakhs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: DTU provides well-equipped classrooms, which are accompanied by the latest technologies, and we have many labs and all the equipment required. Although the boys' hostel infrastructure may be mediocre and not good at all, it will develop and be taken care of over time. Campus and Wi-Fi, good canteens, sports center, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified, knowledgeable, and some are even supportive to a great extent. The attendance scenario is also good. It is not that strict compared to other colleges. The curriculum, I think, is a bit outdated and needs to be improved, but this issue is prevalent all over India. Semester exams are easy to pass if you study even a day or two before.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing because of my interest in mathematics. This course offers a strong blend of mathematics and computer science. The course also offers strong placements and internships. DTU has an active campus life. There are many fests throughout the year that you will be tired of attending. Many fests such as Engifest, Yuvaan, Sanedo, Diwali Mela, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Faculty is very good and satisfying. Placements, infrastructure, and facilities are good.

detailed_review.Placements: So there are 4 sections in the electronics department and 70 students in each section. According to the current states, almost 70 percent of students got placed with an average package of 15 LPA and 60 LPA, with the highest package. Almost all top MNCs like Google, Microsoft, Qualcomm, etc., come for recruitment, offering roles for tech as well as non-tech in embedded system VLSI design.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is genuinely good, and the ECE department has all kinds of labs like the Samsung lab, electronics workshop, and the instruments are all in working condition. The girls' hostel is too good, but the boys' hostel is kind of average, and the mess is also average, but the canteen is really good, and there are almost all types of sports you can find in the sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are really good at his work, but there are also some teachers who you can say is average but almost all of are very humble and polite and if you only study their notes it will be enough the curriculum is relevant to the course. Don't worry about exams too much, you have to score only 23 out of 60 to pass.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: DTU's review from a student's perspective.

detailed_review.Placements: Typically, 65-80% of students get placed in B.Tech. The placement cell of DTU is very active in terms of training students for the placement season in advance. The highest domestic package went upto 85 LPA, the median (average) package is approximately 15-18 LPA, top tech branches may even have higher, and core branches have a 7-8 LPA average package. Some of the recruiting companies are Amazon, Google, Uber, Microsoft, Adobe, Atlassian, etc. Students from the 2nd year start getting placements, which later convert into PPOs, with a stipend ranging up to 2L. Common roles are software developer, data analyst, product engineer, consulting and business roles, and core engineering roles (depth specific).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the depth is quite decent for core branches. The depth buildings are pretty old, but it doesn't really matter as the labs are well-equipped, and most of them are air-conditioned. But for the top tech branches, the building is recently constructed with all modern amenities. The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled, and it has a well-equipped library with books ranging from core subjects to international novels. Classrooms are also quite big. Hostels are, however, pretty limited in number when compared to the crowd DTU caters to. Also, for 1st year students, the hostel facility is hellish, but the girls' hostel is really good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is generally well-qualified and experienced. However, teaching quality depends on professor to professor, some are quite approachable, and others are strictly available for students. The curriculum has core components in theory, which are essential for building a good foundation, but practical skills are not what the industry demands today. Students will have to make extra efforts to secure a good grade in the subject. The semester exams are of a moderate difficulty level and PyQ-based. The passing criteria are 35 marks out of 100, 10% of students mainly fail in a semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements, infrastructure, and many opportunities to grab.

detailed_review.Placements: Many good companies visit Delhi Technological University. They are offering an average package of around 15 LPA in the ECE branch for B.Tech and around 28–30 LPA average in VLSI for M.Tech from DTU. Nearly 70 percent of students get placed. Top companies include Nvidia, and Texas Instruments.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good in the library for studying. Labs are well-maintained. Classrooms are clean and suitable for studying. The infrastructure is really good. Students can roam around freely.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and very helpful during exam sessions. The course and curriculum are relevant. It covers the basics, but you also need to learn additional skills to become industry-ready. Semester exams are not very difficult to pass.
detailed_review.Other: There are many opportunities to explore. You can pursue anything you are interested in here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production and Industrial Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall good college. If you are from Delhi, you should surely see it.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a fresher this year. Placements so far, I have heard are going better than the last couple of years and previously the average package of my branch was 9.5 LPA with around 50 percent of total students placed, as it is a lower middle sort of branch. Hopefully it gets better by the time of graduation in 2029.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am not a hostler, I am a day scholar but my friends have been living in a hostel and I will say its overall okay to live as students. The food quality of the mess is average, but the variety is quite good and hostellers enjoy true college life by living in the college itself.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of the college is overall nice for freshers mostly Ph.D. scholars teach them. The course curriculum in my branch can be useful for those who want to pursue it further. Here we have midsems and endsems and the difficult level is actually normal and varies according to the subject.

reviews.review_title: DTU is a good alternative if you are not getting any IIT.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement here is amazing with more than 80 percent of the batch getting placed each year. The average package is around 17 to 18 LPA and the highest package offered is 85 LPA. All the major companies recruit from our college such as Google, Amazon, Brain, Flipkart, and many more. There are many tech and non tech jobs offered to students in my course, such as SDE or consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are big and are fully air conditioned. The Wi-Fi in the library works well and the labs are very well maintained, having all the required equipment. The library has more than 1 lakh books and many forums and research papers in it. The hostels are of two types, non AC and AC. The AC ones are actually costlier 72,000 for 10 months but the facilities are good and the non AC cost different depending on the number of roommates.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are highly qualified and they genuinely help students in their studies research and placement. The course curriculum is not relevant for some courses but the placement opportunities are still good as they allow them to sit in all the companies. The semester exams are moderately difficult, just because we have given JEE before it does not seem that tough to us. You can score well by preparing for a week or two before the exams. You have to score 35/100 to pass the exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very nice placements and good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: DTU has mostly all the top companies out there in my domain, Google, Adobe, Microsoft, Apple, etc. Many roles offered are Software Engineer, Quant Engineer, and Back end Engineer. The placement percentage in my college is also great. The placement percentage is around 80 percent for the general students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of the college are on par with all the good universities out there. The food is also very tasty in the mess and the canteen. There are good sports teams out there. Computer labs, on the other hand are not as good because most of the computers there do not work. The Wi-Fi signal is also very low.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really helpful and they are always available to work after the classes as well. The curriculum for our course is also up to date. It really helps with the placements. Further, the semester exams in my college are really well conducted and the pass percentage is 70 percent.

reviews.review_title: Mechanical engineering at DTU is really good or bad.

detailed_review.Placements: DTU is a tier one college so placement offers are of a very high package, especially for tech branches like computer Science, information technology, and software engineering. However, for core branches, the placement package decreases the average mechanical is 10 LPA and almost 200 got placed so it is a high number.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am a day scholar so I can not tell you in detail, but as far as I know for 1 st year, the Delhi home state hostel will not allot to you. You have to buy PG which costs almost 10 k for close distance and the DTU message is average. You get a daily menu and 1st year hostel is not good at all.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our 1 semester faculty are very good. In mechanical engineering, my subjects are engineering physics, math, basic civil engineering, basic electrical engineering and mechanical workshop. All teachers are well educated and experienced all are top people in their field and very friendly. The level of education is very high and the exam level is also up to the mark.
detailed_review.Other: My rank, I chose mechanical engineering and DTU tech branches are way better than core so try to score well in JEE.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: You are surrounded by some of the brightest minds who cleared JEE main with top ranks.

detailed_review.Placements: DTU formerly Delhi College of Engineering, has a legacy that attracts Day 0 companies like Google, Microsoft, and Goldman Sachs. Students often report that simply having the DTU tag on a resume helps in clearing initial screening grounds. The university has a very strong culture of covering internships in PPOs Pre Placement Offers. Top tech firms often hire their 3rd year interns as full-time employees, with a stipend reaching up to 1.5 Lakhs per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Girls hostels are generally rated much higher. The newer hostels like Virangana Lakshmibai/VLB are often compared to 5 star hotels by students, featuring excellent maintenance, lifts, and modern furniture. Boys hostels are a mixed bag. While newer ones like APJ Abdul Kalam are premium and have AC options, 1st year boys are often placed in holder transmit hostels or repurposed staff quarters like Ramanujan, which are functional but can feel cramped and dated.
detailed_review.Faculty: Compared to IIIT Delhi, DTU is a hill.  Attendance rules 75 percent mandatory are strictly mentioned on paper, but the overall environment allows plenty of time for self study and extracurricular activities. 70 percent of students come from outside Delhi, and the crowd is diverse. , Students frequently note a skewed gender ratio of roughly 75 percent male, which is common in many top engineering colleges.

reviews.review_title: I will say you must refer to this university. If you want a better placement in tech and core jobs.

detailed_review.Placements: 70 percent of students from software branch are placed every year. The highest and the lowest packages are 84 LPA and 15 LPA, and average package is around 30 LPA. Top recruitment of students from Software branch is done by Amazon, Oracle, Google, Microsoft etc. 60 percent of students got internships from our course in Microsoft, Apple, Infosys, Wipro, etc. Top roles offered in our course are SDE, full stack developer, app developer, AI-ML engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure provided to us by our department are outstanding but there is a single issue with Wi-Fi sometimes or a weakening of our own mobile network. The quality of the facilities in our hostel is average, as other universities and the food available in mess and canteen is also of average quality only, but medical and sports/games facilities are outstanding as there are huge grounds for each sport including indoor and outdoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified and knowledgeable. They teach us in a very well mannered using projectors and whiteboards. The course curriculum is relevant in many cases and it also makes students industry ready, but according to my experience, there is a major role of our own efforts and practice which helps in achieving the shining outcome. After collecting some information, I can say that odd semester exams are comparatively tougher than even semester exams. The pass percentage of students is 97 percent in our course with grades equal to or more than P.
detailed_review.Other: I will say that all my classmates are really hardworking and passionate about their future roles which motivates me also to give my best efforts. I like tech branch and as per my JEE rank, I am getting Software branch which has excellent record of crazy placement packages. Many passing out seniors are telling one thing, just try to give your best and always focus on your goals. I wish that food quality may get improved in our canteens. Events, fests, campus crowd, campus surroundings, scholarship, extracurricular activities are mind blowing, outstanding.

reviews.review_title: Delhi Technological University and life here.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good with almost 90 percent of students getting placed. Top companies come for placements like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Texas Instruments and others offer huge placements for top students and it can even go up to 80 LPA. Average placements are like 17 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is top notch like a IIT or NIT. We have two open air theatre namely OAT and mini OAT, faculty blocks, Academic Blocks, Hostels, and Sports Complex. We have 9 boys hostels and 3 girls hostels, with two AC hostels for both boys and girls.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are good and well educated. They are mostly Ph.D. holders and have immense knowledge in their fields, although some professors might not be able to teach well but most of the faculty do teach well and respond to our doubts. They are very good and help us at every moment.

reviews.review_title: Infrastructure is so awesome, the area is so big, everything is available and the placement is good.

detailed_review.Placements: My college placement ratio is so good because many companies are already going to explore our college from a 5 LPA package to a 1 crore package. So, a variety of placements is given by our college and the ratio is also good. Placement opinion you also know what the value of DTU is all over India.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I think 1st year hostels are not so good, but after that, 1st year onwards, many hostels are in good conditions and the food is also awesome. You really like the food, because I already joined the mess of DTU, which belongs to 2nd year students, because 1st year food is not so good, but 2nd year is awesome. Hostel infrastructure is really awesome, like APJ, has marbles on it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and exams are also going in a transparent way, but if I have to retake any exam, I have to pay 7500 rupees which is very costly, so this should be a major issue in my college. Instead, the curriculum of DTU is also good. This college provides overall development of students.
detailed_review.Other: Campus and hostel life is so good and the curriculum is also very good. I like my college I know its ranking after IIT but apart from that this college has its own aura.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with this college because of the good placements of DTU in 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: There are a total of 375 students in CSE, and there are 6 sections of CSE, of which 80 students are present in my section. Nearby, 15 percent of students got placed from my course. The lowest package 2025 is 3 LPA-4 LPA, the average package is 18 LPA-25 LPA, and the highest package is 64 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Flipkart, Microsoft, Uber, Ola, etc. Actually, I am in my first year, so generally companies don't trust first-year students. In my class, there is no student who has yet got any internship. I don't know much about top roles as I have completed my first semester.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are quite good in DTU, like the sports complex area, which is well developed, and the presence of a gym. If I talk about Wi-Fi, then I will say that Wi-Fi is present in every class, and class Wi-Fi works super fast, but library Wi-Fi is not that fast and sometimes stops and lags. Hostels are good, but I don't think it matters much because it's all about living. Rooms are not bigger in size. Medical facilities are very poor. My friend got severely ill but was not taken seriously by the medical staff.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not very helpful because whatever they teach goes out of the mind. All we have to do is self-study. Teachers of DTU are quite calm, and they listen to the problems of students. Semester exams are not very difficult, but with the right approach and strategy, it is easy to score more than 9 GPA.
detailed_review.Other: The reason to choose this course is that it is the best investment in life. In fees of 10 lacs of B.Tech, students can get a good average package with the right approach of DSA, Java, C, C++, Python, etc. The things that I wish to improve about the course are that I would like teachers to teach a topic by giving examples of real-life problems, and I think that it is lagging. The first year fest has not been held yet, and my semester 1 is over. The campus crowd is quite large, and connectivity with seniors becomes easy due to the large crowd.

reviews.review_title: In the end, DTU College is chill and provides a better placement ratio with high-quality education.

detailed_review.Placements: Among 70-80 percent of students pass the course, and the highest package is 81 LPA, and the median is 16 LPA. Internship company visits DTU and offers a very good offer to the students. Around 70 percent of students get an internship, and the top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, and Apple.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library and classrooms are well developed, and the Wi-Fi speed is awesome. Hostel food is fresh and tasty, and the labs are good, and the instruments provided by the lab professor are working. Especially, the Physics lab is good with all the instruments. The CW lab contains computers with high-end graphics.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality is good, and teachers are mostly Ph.D. professors. Semester exams are easy to moderate, and mostly the questions come from previous papers. Teachers are helping students by providing PPT and handwritten notes. Teachers take a test in a month for revision.
detailed_review.Other: I chose a software engineer because it is quite easy, and I have an interest in coding. Many fests are organised by the society in the college, such as Engifest, Diwali Mela, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: Chill campus life and great placements.

detailed_review.Placements: I am pursuing B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing Engineering (MnC) from DTU. Since it is one of the tech branches, the placement states are pretty good. All the tech branches here have more or less the same placement states. Talking about my department in particular, the official placement data of the year 2024 placed students 82.89%. The highest package offered was 85.30 LPA. The average package offered was 18.90 LPA while the overall average of the B.Tech course, including all the branches, was 15.45 LPA. Some top recruiters are Microsoft, Atlassian, Sandisk, Accenture, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If I talk about the overall infrastructure of the campus, then it is probably one of the best things here. The classrooms are equipped with all of the facilities, including centralised A/C and projectors. The library is also very well built and provides a very peaceful environment to work. High-speed internet is also available in the library. Although the girls' hostels are newly built and have a well-made modern infrastructure. The boys' hostels, on the other hand, are really very bad and congested. Hostel availability is also very limited here.
detailed_review.Faculty: The quality of faculty varies department to department. My personal experience with faculty members has been pretty decent. The lectures are not that helpful, in the end, we have to study on our own before exams. But the faculty members are not that strict with us and assign very limited work. The labs, although, have been the most painful part of it all. Exams are not that difficult, even if you study well in the last 2 weeks before exams, you are expected to score above average marks. The overall academic life is not that hectic.
detailed_review.Other: One thing that I really liked about this college is the societies here. There are so many societies, and they have so many talented people there who are doing so much with them and achieving so much good. There is a society for almost every interest, and they provide a very useful exposure and learning environment.

reviews.review_title: Review DTU - Delhi Technological University for the 2026 batch.

detailed_review.Placements: 80 percent of students get placed. The highest package is 45 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. The average package is 13 LPA. Texas Instruments company hires students from the college. 45 percent of students get internships. Non-tech, tech, and core companies visit the college to hire students. Many companies that come have a set of criteria for selecting students. CGPA is a very crucial factor, and getting a good CGPA is very important.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has the best library with many books to concentrate on studies. Windows are installed for ventilation. The library is filled with students because of the atmosphere it provides. I love the library a lot. Hostels are great too. Warden is nice. There is also a TV room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. The course curriculum is very beneficial. Semester exams are tough, but can be cracked with one week of preparation. Faculty members are helpful, and they are kind like our parents. Hence, I like the faculty members.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it excites me. DTU fests are the best.

admission.title: DTU Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
DTU admission process 2026 is both entrance-based and merit-based. Candidates must visit the official for application details. The college offers numerous UG, PG and PhD programmes. Some of the courses are MA, BBA and BTech. BTech is the most popular programme at DTU. Admission to BTech is based on JEE Main scores, and the entire process of counselling is conducted by the Joint Admission Committee (JAC).

Delhi Technological University admission to all the remaining courses is based on national/ university-level entrance exams, such as UCEED , GATE , CAT , MAT, and CMAT , among others. However, there are a few MBA specialised courses and BBA, admission to which is offered based on the past qualifying exam (UG level) followed by an interview round at Delhi Technological University, Delhi .

faqs.question: Is DTU as good as an IIT?
faqs.answer: DTU's BTech in Civil Engineering course has been rated 4.2/5 by 95 Shiksha verified students, while the same course at IIT Delhi has been rated 4.6/5 by 41 students at Shiksha. Also, as per the NIRF 2024 Rankings, Delhi Technological University has been ranked 27 under the 'Engineering' category, however, there are many IITs that are ranked before DTU in the same category. But, despite that, DTU competes against the top-notch NITs and second-phase IITs in streams such as Computer Science Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, and Mathematics and Computing. Hence, it is safe to say that DTU is as good as a second-phase IIT or an NIT.

faqs.question: Can I get into DTU without giving JEE?
faqs.answer: No, candidates cannot get admission to DTU without appearing for JEE Main as the DTU BTech counselling is done through JAC Delhi . The basic criteria for admission to BTech is appearing for JEE Mains. To get into DTU, candidates must score decent marks or at least around 220 or above marks in JEE Mains. The only way to get into DTU without appearing for JEE Main is by taking a lateral entry admission to BTech second year. In order to do this, candidates must complete a Polytechnic course of two years and then appear for an entrance exam (not JEE Main but this exam will give you entry in DTU's second year.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: DTU, originally known as Delhi College of Engineering (DCE), is a famous college with top-notch facilities and services located on a vast 164-acre campus. A centre of academic excellence, the library is extensively digitised and offers online access to many databases and periodicals. With facilities including cricket, football, hockey, and tennis fields, basketball courts, and a gymnasium, DTU's expansive Sports Complex is a hive of activity. DTU features a Central Library with a collection of books, periodicals, and research papers in addition to department-specific labs and equipment.

sections.heading: DTU Campus Highlights 2024
text: Delhi Technological University is one of the largest universities in India. The university has a modern infrastructure encompassing libraries, hostels, sports facilities, labs and more. Read more to know about the infrastructure of the university:
Campus View:

sections.heading: DTU Hostel & Residential Facilities
text: DTU offers boys and girls hostel to the students. The hostels at the institute are clean, safe and comfortable. The hostel has a good LAN connection for internet usage. The staff at the hostels are friendly and supportive towards the students. All the necessities such as bed, chair, almirah, 24*7 water and electricity etc are available. The food at the hostel mess is loved by students. The hostel also offers medical facilities at all times apart from the medical treatment and ambulance which is always available. There is a common TV area and sports area as well.

sections.heading: DTU Hostel Fee
text: DTU provides hostels which are not only comfortable and safe but also affordable. The charges for the hostel and mess are to be paid separately. Students can check the hostel and mess fee in the table given below:
*These charges are subject to change from time to time

sections.heading: DTU Hostel Life
text: Amidst the challenges of adjusting to a new routine and environment, DTU hostel life offers opportunities for learning, fun, and making memories that define the college experience. Safety and security are given priority at the DTU hostel and students are exposed to a dynamic environment along with a friendly atmosphere.

sections.heading: DTU Academic and Research Facilities
text: Delhi Technological University is known to be one of the top universities in the country, The university focuses on establishing centres of excellence in emerging areas of science, engineering, technology, management and affiliated areas. The university upholds its golden past and continues to deliver the best in the areas of education, research, innovation, and extension activities. With complete financial, administrative and infrastructural support for its entire fraternity, DTU always strives to add more pages to the book of its glorious history and keeps progressing forward each year by taking inspiration from its past achievements.

sections.heading: DTU Library
text: Delhi Technological University has a Central Library and 15 departmental libraries. These libraries collectively support the teaching, support and extension programme of the institute. All students, faculty members and employees of the college are encouraged to use the library. The library has a huge collection of books on engineering, science and humanities, and also offers various services through different departments. To make DTU library a 21st-century library, and to facilitate the transition of the engineering society to a knowledge base society, the library has adopted modern technologies. The library has been digitalized and is accessible through the intranet and the internet Therefore, along with the traditional library, the institute provides a Virtual Library and a Knowledge Centre.

sections.heading: DTU Sports Facilities
text: The college provides excellent sports facilities to the students to encourage them to participate in sports in/around NCR Delhi, especially engineering colleges. The college has a 400 m track, ground for playing Football, Hockey, and Cricket; two courts for volleyball, two courts for basketball, three courts for tennis and five courts for badminton, table tennis rooms, chess rooms, carrom rooms, and gyms in each hostel of the college campus.

ARENA is a sports festival which is organized to recognise upcoming sportsperson The sports played at the festival include athletics, badminton, table tennis, basketball, carrom, chess, cricket, tennis and volleyball, where a large population of girls and boys participate. Prizes and certificates are awarded to the winners. The sports year also involves the organization of the Inter Hostel Tournaments in various games i.e. badminton, basketball, carrom, chess, cricket, football, table tennis, volleyball and tennis.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the DTU Campus
text: Delhi Technological University is located in North-West Delhi, approximately 32 km from Indira Gandhi International Airport. In their free time, students can explore monuments such as the Red Fort, Hauz Khas, Akshardham, or Lotus Temple. Students can also visit malls in West Delhi for shopping or eating.

highlights.summary:
Chandigarh University is a private university and was established in 2012. It is a renowned university in Punjab and has been recognised by the UGC. In 2019, CU became the youngest university in the country to be assessed and accredited by NAAC and granted an A+ grade in the first cycle itself. The university had also become the only state-private university of Punjab to be accredited by NAAC. It is the only university in Punjab and the region to get accredited by NBA for its Civil, Electrical, Electronics and Communications, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and MBA programmes.
Chandigarh University has been also been recognised by several recognising bodies such as AICTE, BCI, NCHMCT, PCI, NCTE, COA, AIU, and CSI. It is also a member of ICAR, AUAP, IAU, ACU, IEEE, ASME, IUCEE, and ACS. The university has secured a global rank of 575 by the QS World University Rankings 2026. Chandigarh University also ranks as India's No. 1 Private University for 3 years in a row in QS Asia Rankings. In addition to this, the university has ranked 31 and 32 by the NIRF Rankings 2025 in the 'Engineering' and 'Overall' categories, respectively.
Additionally, the university offers ABET-accredited programmes to students. It is the first Private University in India to have the highest number of Engineering programmes accredited by ABET. Chandigarh University courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. The university offers courses in streams such as Engineering, Management, Science, Computer Applications, Design, Commerce, etc. Chandigarh Punjab University, through 18 institutes and various departments, offers courses like BTech, BSc, BBA, BCom, BDes, BCA, MBA, MTech, etc. The university has ranked 7 among the top 10 private institutions in India in the Atal Ranking of Institutions on Innovation Achievements (An Initiative of the Ministry of Education).

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amazing campus, great experience.

detailed_review.Placements: 80 percent of students from Chandigarh University receive placement offers. The package varies from a minimum of 5 LPA  to up to 1.5 crores. Top companies include Microsoft, TCS, Wipro and many more. The top roles offered are sales roles, such as Sales Manager and in the tech field such as SDE etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel service is not good personally, as there are only 4 seater rooms with no AC option. The mess food I do not like at all. The campus is good no doubt and hostels are located inside the campus only. The course structure is also good. It includes appropriate time management.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of Chandigarh University is well educated, selected and provide good quality of education. They are specific about their teaching methods and talking about examination, we have 2 mid semesters and at last final semester exams and labs are included in the daily timetable for practical knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: We have a lot of events, fests, and extracurricular activities here and the University provides scholarships to students.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) in Collaboration with IBM
reviews.review_title: Great placements and excellent academics, highly recommend for engineering students.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently in my final year of B.Tech Computer Science at Chandigarh University. Based on what I've seen from seniors, the placement cell is proactive. Last year around 85 to 90 percent of my seniors got placed. The highest packages are around 18 to 20 LPA with an average of 8 to 10 LPA. Companies like TCS, Infosys, HCL, Cognizant and Accenture visit regularly. Some got placed in startups too. The university provides decent support through mock interviews and resume workshops which helped me prepare well for upcoming placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure here is quite well-maintained and modern. The computer labs where I study have decent systems with the latest software and programming tools. We use them regularly for coding assignments. The classrooms have projectors and audio systems. The library is spacious with good books and computers. Wi-Fi is available throughout campus. Hostel facilities are good with proper rooms and maintenance. The mess food quality is average but the quantity is sufficient. Medical facilities with a health center exist. Classrooms are air conditioned during summers which is comfortable. Our department labs are well equipped for practical sessions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of our faculty are well qualified with PhDs and good industry experience. They are very helpful and approachable. The curriculum is practical and covers web development, databases and algorithms which are relevant to current jobs. Exams require a good understanding of concepts. I see around 70 to 75 percent of students pass per semester. The academic environment is encouraging. Professors emphasize projects and real world applications which will prepare us well for future industry roles. Teaching quality is quite good and faculty are available for doubt clearing.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Chandigarh University because of its growing reputation in Computer Science and good placement track record. The curriculum is updated regularly to match market demands. I wish the university would improve the Wi-Fi connectivity in hostel areas and the canteen can offer more variety in food options. The campus life is vibrant with many events and fests throughout the year. The campus is well located near Chandigarh with easy transport connectivity. Overall, I am having a great time and will definitely recommend it to aspiring engineers.

As the crowd on the campus is diversified.

detailed_review.Other: I chose this because I have an interest in it. The best things were the faculty, campus, and classes. The classes should be AC, and the events and fests were so good!

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Chandigarh University is a good college that builds the future.

detailed_review.Placements: The students are almost placed in my class. The highest package was 13.13 LPA, whereas the lowest package was around 3.5 LPA. Most of the students got internships + FTE roles. Top roles offered in my batch were Analyst, Software Developer, etc. Top recruiting companies included TCS, Capgemini, and Cognizant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facility here is very good, all new built infrastructure which is being renewed almost every 2-3 years. The facility is really good, including the quality of the food inside the hostel mess. The canteens serve good quality food at very reasonable prices.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members here are very good and supportive. They will try to solve all of your doubts. The only thing that is lacking is that they don't change their curriculum regularly based on market needs. They are still using the same pattern as 5 years ago.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are really good here.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements and active campus experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Chandigarh University gives solid placement support. Most of our batch got placed with good average packages and top recruiters like Amazon and Deloitte. Many students also got internships in tech and analyst roles. Good opportunities if you are consistent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course has good Wi-Fi, clean labs, smart classrooms and a stocked library. The hostel is decent with regular cleaning, good food, basic medical help and good sports facilities. Overall the infrastructure supported daily student needs well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is helpful and knowledgeable. The curriculum is industry focused and supports and focused and supports practical learning. Exams are moderate and easy to clear with regular study, and most students pass without issues. Overall everything is decent.
detailed_review.Other: The course felt worth the money because of placement and exposure. I chose it for the practical learning and career opportunities. The best part is the hands on project and supportive faculty. I wish the curriculum update a bit faster. Campus life is lively with good fests, events, sports and a friendly crowd. Connectivity is easy and there are decent scholarships and activities that keep the campus active.

reviews.review_title: All facilities are too good, faculty members are supporting us every time, and it's the best time at

detailed_review.Placements: There is no structural placement for BPT. Not officially published their package. Hospitals are Apollo, Max, and Ivy Hospital. BPT includes clinical training or internship. The top roles are physiotherapist in sports rehabilitation, physiotherapist pr their assistant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is strongly available every time, with high speed. Block libraries are there. Classrooms are very good. Department-wise lab is available. In hostels, there are personal amenities, food, a mess or other food court available. Medical ambulance available with medicine, also with extra. Transport or ATMs are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and kind. Also, PhD teachers are there. Quality in teaching is outstanding. The courses are available for everyfield with adaptable knowledge. Semester exams are often tough, but we also learn something new with questions.
detailed_review.Other: I want to help people through my degree. I am able to help patients without medicine. The best thing about this course is helping patients without medicine. OT sessions are not there. I want to improve in this. Events and festivals are too good, fully crowded, and we are enjoying every curricular activity.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements and course but not satisfied with the hostel food.

detailed_review.Placements: The number of students placed are more than the average but there is one thing that to get a better offer or placement you need to work very hard and had to stand out. The highest offer is of 1.9 CPA and average is about 7-8 LPA. Many companies came like Samsung, Flipkart, Adobe etc. And mainly the roles offered are software developer, tester and trainee.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very decent like there are lifts and coolers in room also Wi-Fi, reading rooms. Also the department block is very neat and clean with projector and all basic amenities. The main issue is with the hostel food which is not good and many times we have to take from outside.
detailed_review.Faculty: To be honest talking about the faculty they are not up-to the mark and they have less knowledge according to the qualifications. Course curriculum is good as it give knowledge about every field. Difficulty of exam is not so much, you can get easily good marks but studying one night ago.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Placement cell and hostel food quality could be improved. The campus life is very cool.

detailed_review.Placements: Talking about the placement, which is very important for students in my course, the placement percentage is very low and the highest package is 50 LPA. The top companies that come are Flipkart, Amazon, etc. There are no specific requirements for internships. They even take an extra amount from students, approximately 10k at my time, and then increase it every year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and department infrastructure is very good. We have ACs in our classroom and basic facilities like Wi-Fi, projectors, etc. Now, talking about the hostel, it has a lift and ACs in the rooms. The disappointing factor is the hostel food, which is not worth a penny, and I myself don't like it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about the faculty, some of them are very helpful, but no matter what, there is biasness with students, which should not be there. The course includes informative subjects that enhance our knowledge, but some subjects feel like a waste of time and there is no need to study that.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The university is true to its promises.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement in my course is quite good compared to other courses offered by the college. Most students get decent offers, and the companies visiting are well-known, like TCS, Amazon, and Samsung. The highest package is 2 crore, and the average is 5–6 LPA. The top roles offered in my course are software engineer and tester.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My department is newly renovated and has good facilities, such as Wi-Fi, decent classrooms, and moderately equipped labs. The hostel is also nice, with lifts, stock shops, a cafeteria if you do not want to mess with food. It also have a good medical facilities, separate reading rooms, and a parlor.
detailed_review.Faculty: This is a controversial topic, as different teachers come every semester, so it is difficult to judge. Most teachers are qualified and knowledgeable. The curriculum is decent, as we learn about different fields and areas of scope. Semester exams are of a moderate level, and the pass percentage is not very high.
detailed_review.Other: You enjoy the crowd and campus life and get good exposure.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Campus life is amazing, but I am dissatisfied with the college.

detailed_review.Placements: The number of students placed from my course is just 2 out of 1500, so the ratio is very low. Sometimes, the college uses a cut-off and does not allow students to sit in placement drives. The highest package is around 1.2 crore, but nobody knows for sure. The lowest is about 1–2 LPA, and the average is 3–4 LPA. Top companies that come include Adobe, Samsung, TCS, and Deloitte. The same situation applies to internships. Students mostly have to look outside for opportunities. Mostly, the roles offered by companies are trainee or web developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in my department are average. In some labs and classrooms, everything works fine, but in others, many things do not work. Hostels require students to adjust to living conditions, and food quality is not very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, but many are less experienced, and concepts are not always clear. The curriculum is very theoretical with little practical exposure, so it does not make students industry-ready. Semester exams are easy to average, but to get good grades, students need to be punctual.

reviews.review_title: It's a private university, but we should aim for a government college.

detailed_review.Placements: The college offers a good number of placement opportunities for postgraduate and undergraduate students. Students become eligible for their placements from the fifth semester (undergraduate) and the third semester (postgraduate). The average package offered is around 6 LPA, and the highest package offered is 10 LPA. Companies that visit the college for placements are Cipla, Microsoft, Unacademy, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My overall campus experience was good. I met a lot of people, and they are kind to me. There is no ragging at all. There is a library in each block across campus, and we can go anywhere we want. There is a good range of books, from journals to academic to fiction. There are sports events going on every semester, from department level to university level. There are many clubs and societies, which are led by students. There is a Wi-Fi facility in each block. There is a huge number of labs and a library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are brilliant and are experts in their field. They make it easy to understand concepts. They are always there to help students in any possible way. In each semester, for theory subjects, there are 60 marks external (end-semester exams) and 40 marks internals. Internals consist of mid-semester tests (held twice every semester), assignments/term papers, presentations, surprise tests, quizzes, and 2 marks for attendance above 90%. For practicals, there are 60 marks of internals, which consist of 9 practicals and 1 project, along with a mid-semester practical conducted once every semester.

reviews.course: B.E. (Hons.) in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) in association with IBM
reviews.review_title: Good college, nice atmosphere.

detailed_review.Placements: If a student works hard enough, they will be able to get into a good company. Microsoft and Google are the few companies that offer a package of 35 LPA, but these packages are for the top 5% of students, I guess. There is this joint placement thing in Chandigarh University, where students from other surrounding universities and colleges also come here for the placements. The courses are pretty good in order to shape the student for the industry.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every department has its own library, and the central library is also available in the university with a good Wi-Fi connection. Classrooms are very well furnished, neat and clean. Projectors and Wi-Fi are also available in the classrooms. The infrastructure of this university is very good, and the university provides all types of facilities, like hostel facilities, medical facilities, and a food court to the students. The university organises lots of sports and extracurricular activities every month for the development of the students. Many social groups and clubs are also there for the welfare of the university and students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is decent. Some teachers are pretty good and have knowledge about the subject while some just teach from the pdf, PPT's they are provided with. There are approximately 32-40 students in a class, and in combined classes, it can go up to 75 students. Some faculty teachers go with a practical approach like doing the tasks assigned in the class while some will go with giving everything for assignments.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the machine learning course because I am interested in it, and also, it's one of the emerging fields in the upcoming years.

reviews.review_title: Review of Chandigarh University (CU).

detailed_review.Placements: In the last semester of the degree, students were eligible for placements. A minimum of 75% was required to sit for them. The company depended on the branch. The average package for the university was 2.5 LPA, though sometimes it was lower.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All types of facilities, such as food, hospital, transportation, and others, were available at this college. All types of books in the library. Many sports and extracurricular activities were conducted by the university for the development of students. Many social groups and clubs available in the university.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were good and very qualified. For the monthly mid-semester exams, students prepared, and it was not too difficult to pass. Students scored around 25 marks. Faculty members were always ready to help students at the university. Their teaching style was fabulous.
detailed_review.Other: I was interested in this course, which is why I chose it. It’s up to you what you want.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: One of the best colleges for getting placements if we work hard from the beginning.

detailed_review.Placements: Students get placed if they study well. Many companies come, but students are not able to clear the cutoff. Around 20 percent of students get placed. People focus more on coding language, but they should also focus on aptitude because that is the core. If we study hard, we will easily crack placements because many companies start recruiting students from the third year itself. One of my batchmates has just grabbed a package of 32 LPA in the third year itself.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is the best. Even celebrities come here to shoot their stuff. Hostel living is good, but the only concern is the mess. Otherwise, everything is alright. The only lack is that they don't have enough sports grounds for students, which should be taken care.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are very useful, but many teachers are so egoistic. It is easy to clear the semester exams because papers are easy. Many teachers help us like our parents. They are very supportive. Teachers over here have good knowledge of their subjects.

admission.title: Chandigarh University (CU) Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
Chandigarh University admission to the UG and PG courses is primarily based on Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test ( CUCET ). While CUCET is primary criteria, students can also submit valid scores of JEE Main, NATA, CAT, MAT, XAT, etc. for both admissions and scholarships to relevant courses. The application process can be completed online and the the admission occur in two phases.

For admission to the following courses, CUCET is compulsory: B.E, MBA, Integrated Law Programmes, PharmD, MPharma, MPT, BPharm, MCA, LLM, etc. Find below all about the process, criteria, and other admission-related details about Chandigarh University .

Check out the video below on CU courses, eligibility, admissions, and more:

faqs.question: Are Chandigarh University admissions open?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University admissions are open . Interested students can apply online at the university's website. Aspirants need to register for CUCET and appear for the same. See below some important updates:

faqs.question: Can I get admission in Chandigarh University without CUCET?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University (CU) admissions are generally based on CUCET scores for most of the courses. Students need to appear for the test or submit scores of any other accepted exams as stated by the university. Hence, in some cases, you may get admission in CU without CUCET . The CUCET test is also a scholarship test and if you want to get the scholarship benefits offered by the university based on CUCET scores, then you will have to appear for the exam.

faqs.question: How can I take admission in Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: The Chandigarh University admission process consists mainly of three steps. Find below the detailed Chandigarh University Application Process:

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission is not valid for any of the UG & PG courses at Chandigarh University. The university conducts CUCET exam to offer admission to eligible candidates. All the aspirants must qualify for this exam with a valid score. The admission process starts with CUCET registrations. Candidates can check out the exam pattern and CUCET syllabus to prepare for the exam, which will help them score well.

faqs.question: Is CUCET compulsory for Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University conducts Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET) for admission to all of its UG and PG courses. This is a common entrance exam that is applicable for admission of candidates in every stream such as Management, Humanities, Science, Commerce, Engineering, etc. To get admission to any of the courses offered at Chandigarh University, students have to apply for this exam on the official website of CUCET and appear for the exam. This exam is conducted in an online mode in two phases. For admission to any of the courses, there are two decisive factors that are considered by the university for admission. These are eligibility criteria and CUCET scores.

faqs.question: What are the steps for Chandigarh University admissions?
faqs.answer: Students can refer the steps given below to complete the Chandigarh University admissions:

faqs.question: Can I get admission in BTech at Chandigarh University through JEE Main?
faqs.answer: No, Chandigarh University does not provide admission to BTech via JEE Main. Admission to BTech are entirely based on CUCET scores. Chandigarh University conducts CUCET in two phases. Candidates must qualify for the exam with a valid score. However, the university considers JEE Main rank for providing scholarships to top rank holders.

faqs.question: What is the qualification for BTech at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: For admission to a four-year BTech course at Chandigarh University, candidates must passed Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects. They also have studied any two of the subjects among Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Computer Science/ Biology with minimum 50-60% aggregate (45% in the case of candidates belonging to SC/ST category). Further, Chandigarh University Eligibility Criteria for BTech CSE are slightly different. Find below the eligibility criteria for other BTech specialisations: Those who qualify for the above eligibility criteria are able to apply for the Chandigarh Univesity BTech course. For detailed Chandigarh University BTech admission process, click here .

faqs.question: How can I get admission to BTech at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University offers a four-year course of BTech. Admission to this course is completely entrance-based. To apply for this course, the general eligibility is to pass Class 12 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects and any two of these subjects: Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Computer Science/ Biology with a minimum 50-60% aggregate (45% in case of candidates belonging to SC/ST category). However, the eligibility criteria slightly vary for some specific specialisations. Once students fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for this course, they can appear for CUCET, which is an in-house entrance exam of Chandigarh University. For those who are seeking to get admission to the Chandigarh University BTech course, it is mandatory for them to qualify for this exam with a valid score.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for BTech in Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: The tuition fee for a four-year BTech course at Chandigarh University ranges between INR 5.1 lakh - INR 12.7 lakh . This fee is inclusive of the fee for all the BTech, BTech (Lateral Entry) B.E. + M.E. (Integrated) specialisations. However, t his information is sourced from official website/sanctioning body and is subject to change. Students are requested to visit the official website to get more details on the Chandigarh University BTech fees. There are other fee components such as Examination and Security deposits of INR 2,000 that also need to be paid at the time of admission.

faqs.question: Is CAT compulsory for MBA admission at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University MBA admissions are only done with a valid score of CUCET. This is a university-level entrance exam, which is commonly conducted for admission to all of its UG and PG courses. There is no way to get admission to MBA course at Chandigarh University without qualifying for CUCET. However, the university also considers the scores of the All-India level entrance exam of Management courses such as CAT, XAT, MAT, etc., to offer scholarships. But there is no clarity that whether the CAT exam is accepted for CU MBA admissions or not. Candidates may get clarity from the official website of Chandigarh University.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to Chandigarh University for MBA course?
faqs.answer: For admission to the Chandigarh University MBA course, students need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. This is a PG-level course, so candidates who are graduated in the respective discipline are the only ones eligible to apply for this course. The university selects students based on their valid scores in CUCET, which is a university-level entrance exam conducted by Chandigarh University for admission to all of its PG courses under various streams. The final selection is based on candidates academic background and performance in the accepted exam.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for CUCET MBA?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission to a two-year MBA course at Chandigarh University via CUCET, aspirants have to fulfil minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. As per the minimum eligibility suggested by the university, students must pass the graduation with a 60% aggregate from a recognised university. Only those, candidates who fulfil the mentioned minimum eligibility criteria will be able to apply for the course and sit in the CUCET entrance exam. In the final admission process, both the eligibility and CUCET scores will be considered for admission to MBA. Click here for the detailed process around Chandigarh University MBA admissions.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to Chandigarh University for BBA course?
faqs.answer: For Chandigarh University BBA admissions, students need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. As it is an undergraduate-level course, students who pass Class 12 with a relevant score will be able to get admission to BBA at Chandigarh University. Admission to this course is entirely entrance-based. Aspirants need to qualify for CUCET, which is a common entrance test conducted by the university itself for admission to all of its UG courses. Candidates who qualify for CUCET and pass the other selection parameters will be able to get admission at Chandigarh University. Click here to know about the Chandigarh University BBA course in detail.

faqs.question: Can I do BBA from Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: To get admission to BBA, Chandigarh University has prescribed minimum eligibility criteria that need to be fulfilled at the time of admission. Those who pass Class 12 in the respective subjects from a recognised university are eligible to apply for this course. The minimum required percentage in the last qualifying exam of Class 12 ranges from 50-60% aggregate. The minimum eligibility may differ from course to course as for admission to BBA (General) course, students should get a minimum of 50% aggregate, while for BBA (Hons) courses, students must get 60% aggregate in their high secondary final examination.

faqs.question: Is it good to pursue BBA from Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University has many collaborations with International universities. The university offers BBA-ITP, where students can study a part of their programme in USA and Australia. Students are also offered a chance to study at Okanagan College, which is located in Canada. Students with a 60% aggregate in Class 12 or 6.5 CGPA and an IELTS score of 6.5 are eligible to study at this university. The following subjects will be the key areas of study for the BBA course: Also, there are many scholarships offered to meritorious students based on CUCET scores as tuition fee waiver.

faqs.question: How can I fill the application form for BBA at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Chandigarh University admissions to BBA course are entrance-based. Those who want to take admission to this course at Chandigarh University must apply via the official website of CUCET and apply for the respective entrance exam in the first place. By fulfilling the application form, candidates need to pay an application amount of INR 1,000. The application form can be filled in both online/ offline modes. However, the application fee is common for both modes. Once their application will be approved, candidates can sit for CUCET. After that, the CUCET scores will be evaluated to offer final admission to BBA course.

faqs.question: What is the fee for BCA at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: The Chandigarh University BCA fee for a three-year course ranges between INR 1.2 lakh - INR 6.1 lakh.  Apart from this, students also need to pay other fees such as Examination Fee & Security Deposit of INR 2000 at the time of admission.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to Chandigarh University for BCA?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission to Chandigarh University BCA course is not possible. Chandigarh University conducts Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET), which is an in-house entrance exam conducted by the university for admission to its various UG courses. It's a national-level entrance test, which is conducted in online mode in different phases.Those who are willing to get admission to BCA at Chandigarh University must appear and qualify for CUCET. It's mandatory for every candidate to submit their valid CUCET score at the time of filling the application form to get admission to BCA.

faqs.question: Does Chandigarh University offer BCA?
faqs.answer: In the field of Computers and IT, Chandigarh University offers a three-year general BCA programme along with a BCA in Augmented Reality & Virtual Reality programme. Students pursuing BCA at CU learn networking, integration, server management, and the use of computers in the business world. They learn software developing, system programming, systems analysis, systems management and project management. Students after completing the course are able to develop and prepare documents, projects, presentations, design websites and demonstrate skills in running software programs.

faqs.question: How to get admission in Chandigarh University for BCA programme?
faqs.answer: Students seeking admission to Chandigarh University for BCA must have completed their Class 12 with 50-55% aggregate in the respective subjects. Admission to this course is entrance-based. The university selects students based on their scores in Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET). This is an in-house common entrance exam of CU. Those who qualify for the respective exam have a high possibility to get admission at Chandigarh University BCA course. The eligible candidates are only selected based on their valid scores in CUCET. The CUCET qulaified candidates are allocated seats via a counselling process.

faqs.question: I want to know about the latest cutoff information for M.Sc. in Medical Lab Sciences at Chandigarh University (CU).
faqs.answer: There is no specific cutoff score to get into the M.Sc. in Medical Lab Sciences at Chandigarh University. However, there is an entrance exam called CUCET that you can take to get scholarships and that is also not mandatory for biotechnology students. To be eligible for the M.Sc. Medical Lab Sciences at Chandigarh University, you must pass out B.Sc. MLT / B.Sc. Microbiology with honors with at least 35% marks in aggregate.

faqs.question: What is the last date for MCA registration in Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Admission to the MCA programme is based on CUCET scores. Candidates can apply in two phases after reviewing the complete registration details. Phase 1 registration was held on April 29, 2024, followed by the Phase 1 entrance exam conducted on April 30, 2024.

faqs.question: Is it possible to take admission to MCA at Chandigarh University without CUCET?
faqs.answer: No, there is no option to take admission to MCA course at Chandigarh University without giving CUCET. Admission to this course is entrance-based. Whoever want to take admission to MCA must appear and qualify for CUCET with a valid score as it's a mandatory step of the selection process. To appear for this exam, students have to visit the official website of CUCET and fill an application form along with paying an examination fee of worth INR 2,000. Click here to know about the in-depth details around CU MCA admissions.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for MCA in at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: For admission to two-year MCA course at Chandigarh University, there is a minimum eligibility that needs to be fulfilled at the time of admission. As per the university's official website, those who are willing to get admission to MCA course at CU must pass graduation either in BCA or any equivalent UG degree in the respective subjects from a recognised university. If students get a UG degree in other streams such as BA/ BCom or BSc, they must have studied Mathematics as one of their main subjects. The required minimum percentage to pass graduation as per the eligibility criteria for MCA ranges between 50-60% aggregate. It may vary as per other MCA specialisations. For detailed process related to Chandigarh University admissions, click here .

faqs.question: What is the fees of MCA at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: The tuition fee for a two-year Chandigarh University MCA course ranges between INR 3 lakh - INR 3.2 lakh. Apart from the fee, there are as Examination and Security deposits of INR 2,000 that also need to be paid at the time of admission.

faqs.question: How is admission to the BPharm programme at Chandigarh University conducted?
faqs.answer: Admission to both the regular and lateral entry BPharm programmes at Chandigarh University is based on the candidate's performance in the CUCET (Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test). Meeting the eligibility criteria is also mandatory.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for lateral entry (BPharm LE) at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: For BPharm lateral entry admission to Chandigarh University, candidates must hold a Diploma in Pharmacy with at least 50% aggregate marks from an institute affiliated with a university or a state Board of Technical Education, approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).

faqs.question: Are admissions to various courses open at Chandigarh University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh University admission is currently ongoing. Candidates can find the application window on the online application portal of the university. The admission portal is conducted in two phases for all the UG and PG courses.

faqs.question: How to apply for Chandigarh University admissions?
faqs.answer: To apply for the various Chandigarh University programmes, students have to visit the CU admission portal. Students have to provide the preferred CUCET slot, personal details & academic qualification, etc. The CUCET application needs to be submitted with application fees of INR 1000.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Located in the city of Mohali, Chandigarh University is a popular private university in Punjab. Chandigarh University’s campus is widespread over 150 acres , which surely covers a large green area. The college’s campus is popular for providing modern amenities with state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. Students can facilitate AC/ Non-AC Hostel rooms, Sports, Transport facilities, Banking services, Medical Facilities, Restaurants, Libraries, Media Centers and many more inside the campus of Chandigarh University. Read on to learn more about the Chandigarh University campus, hostel, student life, and more.

sections.heading: Chandigarh University Hostel
text: Chandigarh University hostels are built inside the vast campus of the university. The hostel premises ensure the safety and comfort of students with its vigilant rules and policies. There are separate hostels available for boys and girls. The university promotes lively hostel life by providing spacious accommodations, entertainment resources, and affordable & savoring food services while ensuring proper cleanliness along with regular sports & cultural activities. sections.heading: Chandigarh University Hostel Facilities
text: Find below the list of facilities available at the Chandigarh University campus:
list: Good Power Supply: The hostel has a 24*7 power supply with a supportive power backup for the smooth functioning of the regular tasks and activities.

Free Wi-Fi Internet Services:Hostels are provided with free Wi-Fi services with good speed. The internet services are easily accessible with login credentials provided to students staying in the hostel rooms.
Well-furnished common rooms:There is a 24*7 well-furnished room available to play indoor board games. The hostel also has a separate TV room for relaxation time in the free hours.

Gymnasium:For fitness freaks, Gym facilities are also provided to students. Many modern equipment and special trainers are provided for the proper guidance. The gym is open at particular times and has enough space to accommodate around 10-25 students.

Well-equipped reading rooms:To study with focus, students get separate reading rooms. These rooms maintain the ambiance of libraries and facilitate resources such as newspapers, magazines, and other reading materials.
Night Canteen & Tuck Shops:To provide groceries and essential items, tuck shops are available inside the hostels. There are canteen also available, which remains open till night.
Salon:For girls' students, a salon is given inside the hostel premises that provides all the essential services.

Visitors and Guest Room:For special visitors from the side of students’ families, separate guest rooms are available with clean and attached bathrooms. To book these rooms, prior notice must be given to authorities.
