reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Here, it's a good campus life with strong academics.

detailed_review.Placements: In B.Tech CSE, around 85% are placed, with the highest package of approximately Rs 66 LPA, average of Rs 22 LPA and the lowest Rs. 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters are Google and DE. Shaw, Pattern, Arista, Accenture, Oracle, Sprinklr, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, etc. Top roles are SDE roles and Data Analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All departments have labs, classes, and seminar halls, with high-speed Wi-Fi. Along with this, there is a well-equipped central library and Auditorium. The hostel offers clean rooms, 24/7 water, electricity, and Wi-Fi. There are 3 messes in the institute, which offer decent food. Along with this, there is medical support and sports facilities like a gym, cricket, football, basketball, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very supportive, qualified, and teach well. Curriculum taught here is industry-relevant with practical labs and projects. Exams are moderate to hard with fair evaluation. For most of the courses, you should score 30% to pass, so most students pass comfortably.
detailed_review.Other: My batch and I chose this course for tech interest and career scope. The best parts of this are coding labs, group projects, placements, and internships. Campus has good fests, active clubs, helpful seniors and professors, scholarships and strong connectivity.

reviews.review_title: Campus life and internships at IIT Ropar

detailed_review.Placements: Since I am in the 3rd year of my degree, I am sharing about the internships at IIT Ropar, in my batch of 70 students, about 5 are selected for software development roles in companies like Microsoft, Arista Networks, and Razorpay. Almost 35 students got internships in mechanical core companies like TATA Steel, Trident, DRDO, etc. Two students got internships in product management roles at OLA, and one got an internship at JPMCt.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college provides Wi-Fi facilities throughout the 500 acres of campus area and also LAN facilities in the hostel rooms. The common rooms in all the hostels provide facilities like gym, television, and sports equipment. Some hostels also have a snooker table in the common area. The library is big and contains books on almost every subject, from novels to course books and research papers. Food available in the canteen is better than what is available at the mess; however, after visiting 3 other IITs, I can assure that our mess food is much better.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at IIT Ropar is highly qualified, and most of them have pursued their PhDs from abroad. 75% attendance is mandatory in almost every course, and the teachers are mostly good except for a few exceptions. There are regular class committee meetings where students can give their feedback to all the professors throughout the duration of the course. The course curriculum is relevant and is regularly updated, which really helped me during my internship drive. The semester exams are not very tough but also not very easy; passing them is really easy with around 30% marks.

reviews.review_title: IIT Ropar College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements had been decent. A lot of students were really keen on applying to certain companies. The reason the pay was not that great was that there seems to be a lack of growth opportunities in the industry. Its frustrating, for sure. On the bright side, our placement cell was pretty proactive. They had a bunch of options for us to consider when applying to different companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and the mess were decent. We had Wi-Fi in the classrooms, and you can easily access the LAN from your room in the hostel. Everything you need was right on campus. The classrooms were spacious and had projectors, which was nice. A big stadium for cricket and football, not to mention an indoor stadium for badminton.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members were good, but you really have to show up to class regularly to succeed. Most students pass, but those who barely attend do not. The curriculum could use a better structure, so students often have to figure things out on their own to be ready for the industry. The semester exams were just right in terms of difficulty, so if you want to pass, you definitely need to prepare.

reviews.review_title: IIT Ropar College Review.

detailed_review.Placements: Every student heads straight for placements. Some actually land foreign Ph.D. positions, which is pretty impressive. Others might choose to stick around in academia.  Most students placements were on campus or off. There were some academic internships out there from companies like Doubtnut and Toppr, which could be a great opportunity. The coaching industry was always on the lookout for students from the M.Sc. Chemistry branch, especially for NEET JEE, and JAM prep. There were plenty of paths to explore.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was practical, with solid facilities for both sports and academics. You can always plug into a LAN port for unlimited public Ethernet. The campus was buzzing with organized events, and the various clubs really enhance diversity and opportunities for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were definitely qualified and offered plenty of assistance. Their teaching methods were top notch, and the training programme was relevant, really gearing students up for the industry. Semester exams sit at a medium difficulty level, but the pass percentage often reflects the class average, which was around 50%.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the placement results.

detailed_review.Placements: As 98% of students from our discipline of Master of Science in Chemistry got placed, with the best package of 18.5 LPA and an average package of 5.8 LPA. Some companies, including Venkatasai Life Sciences, Syngene, Turning, and Innodata, took part in the recruitment process offering expected packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As there is limited access provided to students for using the laboratories, students are asked to pay a breakage fee even if they are not involved in any such incidents. Also, the classrooms are air-ventilated and equipped with water and other teaching facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are known for their solid knowledge and are paid higher salaries. They want to make their classes meaningful and understandable, so they take their own time to complete every topic. To cover the whole portion within time, most tests and exams are avoided.

reviews.review_title: Great college, should definitely consider it.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% happen to get placed. Top recruiting companies for electrical core are Nvidia and Texas. The highest salary is 65 LPA. The lowest salary is 7 LPA, and the average salary is 20 LPA. There are many companies like Nvidia and Texas for core electrical and some people go to non-core like Goldman Sachs. Some go into software development at Google, Flipkart, etc. Top role offered is software engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is great up to date equipments. Hostels are great as the building was made in 2019 itself so its very new. Food quality is average. Sometimes food is bad so we just go to cafeteria to eat. There is no problem in Wi-Fi. Library is open 24X7. Medical facilities and games are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: It's more about the students who come there which makes the college great. Teachers are helpful. Teachers know what to teach students sometimes not directly related but you have to increase your way of thinking by taking difficult courses. Difficult is moderate as if you study for 3-4 days you get a decent CGPA of 8. Pass percentage is 30%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best infrastructure among the IITs with quite good placement ratio and also a good campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 80% of students were placed last year. The highest package is around 40 LPA. The average package is around 16 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata Steel, JSW Paints, JP Morgan, etc. Around 45% of students got internships at Tata Steel and JP Morgan in the role of banking and marketing.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The metallurgical and materials engineering department is in Hargobind Khurana block (SAB). We have hi-tech labs with equipment like SEM, TEM, XRD, other microscopes, and other devices. We have full air conditioning and Wi-Fi network classrooms. We have 4 hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls. We have a sports complex which has cricket, football, hockey, volleyball, tennis, basketball grounds, and gym also.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and kind. They are easily available on week days from 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM in their office. They are qualified from very respected universities like IIT, IISC, MIT, and others. The teaching quality is moderate. The course curriculum is moderately relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are quite tough.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Ropar - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Engineering physics is a great branch that offers a good amount of placement opportunities for students at IIT Ropar. Multiple companies come here for campus placement like Google, Microsoft, IBM, and many more which helps students to get placed easily and be satisfied.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is great, design is inspired by foreign colleges like MIT. The course infrastructure is not that great students deal with multiple issue during their courses and it is difficult to cope up with your batchmates still it is still doable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams can be beneficial. If you study well, you can easily achieve great marks. Faculty members are also excellent, making it easier for students to adjust to college life. It primarily depends on how well the student can adapt to the college environment. Wishing everyone the best!

reviews.review_title: A deep dive into IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students are placed in my course. The highest package, according to me, last year was 61 LPA, and the average package was 19 LPA. The top companies were HCL and Google. 74% of students got internships from my course, and they were good companies. I got to work on a good project under a professor.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Ropar provides good Wi-Fi, good labs, big classrooms, and a small library. Facilities at my hostel are good, but we don't have a balcony, and the room is too small for two students. The mess food is good sometimes and very bad at other times. The sports facilities are also very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. They explain everything clearly to everyone. Teachers are highly qualified and have good knowledge. The teaching quality is also so good. The semester exams in the college are moderate, and the passing percentage is 30%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I did not get a good rank. The campus crowd is not big, but we have a big college.

reviews.review_title: Experience in IIT Ropar (the most progressing IIT).

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students got placed in chemical engineering in 2024. The highest package is 41 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. The average package is 22 LPA. Top companies like Google, Amazon, Oracle, and Tata Steel come to recruit. Approximately 80% of students got internships from IIT Ropar in Microsoft, Google, etc. Top roles like processing, petroleum, chemical, material, energy, and environment are provided.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are seven hostels in IIT Ropar, all having the best Wi-Fi facilities and good infrastructure. We have electrical, mechanical, chemical, CS workshop, and civil labs. We have a full-fledged LHC with six large classrooms. We have a large library containing all sorts of books. Hostels provide good facilities like proper lighting and proper sports facilities. The mess provides tasty food three times a day. Medical facilities are on the top level. We have a large sports complex which includes a football ground, cricket ground, lawn tennis court, volleyball court, basketball court, hockey ground, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are most useful, friendly, qualified, and knowledgeable. They teach tremendously. Their teaching style is awesome. The course curriculum is of utmost relevant for our future aspects. It helps in our overall understanding. Semester exams are not that difficult. They are based on what your professor has taught. The pass percentage generally depends on each course but it is mostly 30%.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen the course because my JEE rank was not sufficient. The best thing about our course is that we do not have to study much. The courses they provide could be better. The fests that took place here are Aditya (the teach fest), Aarohan (the sports fest), Zeitgeist (the cultural fest), etc. For extracurricular activities, there are many societies and clubs for each, like music, dance, robotics, coding, sports, etc. There are many scholarships for students whose family income is less than 1 lakh or between 1 lakh and 5 lakhs.

reviews.review_title: Average placements, but overall life is good at IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: By late December, less than 40% of the overall batch had been placed, with many securing PPOs. In the Civil department, placements are particularly low due to companies often excluding non-circuital students. The highest package offered in Civil is 18 LPA, the lowest is 6 LPA, and the average is around 10 LPA. Top recruiters include BPCL, Trident, and LnT. For internships, only Bechtel visited for Civil Core, hiring 1 student out of 33. However, about 50% of Civil students secured internships, mainly in non-core roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are really good. We have a whole new block for the Civil department, centrally air-conditioned, and have all kinds of equipment in all kinds of labs with all the modern technologies. Now, if we talk about the facilities in my hostel, we are given really beautiful hostels with good-quality furniture. There are issues with Wi-Fi, but everything else is good, whether you talk about the mess and canteen, sports and games, or medical facilities. Medical facilities are also available anytime, which is a good thing.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are qualified and knowledgeable, but some professors are unhelpful and do not create a friendly environment for doubts, occasionally displaying bias in grading. The course curriculum is industry-relevant, supported by industrial visits that aid practical understanding. The difficulty is moderate (6/10), with a 30% pass percentage for most courses, though the outcome can vary depending on the professors.

reviews.review_title: IIT Ropar : Journey to the future.

detailed_review.Placements: In IIT Ropar, approximately 80% of students get placed. The average package of IIT Ropar is 25 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Tata Steel, Amazon, etc. Almost 80 to 85% of students got internships at IIT Ropar. Top roles offered in my course are software development, web development (front end or backend), etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of my college is fantastic. Our hostel and department building have wi-fi, classrooms are fully air conditioned, and we have the facility of a smart board and projectors. The library has AC and wi-fi. It has a variety of books. The campus is well maintained and has greenery all around. The mess food is average but not bad. The medical facility is available 24 hours a day, and there is a fantastic sports complex at IIT Ropar that has grounds for basketball, volleyball, cricket, football, lawn tennis, badminton, athletics, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers are well qualified and knowledgeable. There are very helpful at various steps. The teaching quality is very good because mostly it is practical-based so that it can help us in our future career development. Yes, this course is very useful for the student in the current technological-based era. The semester exam is both moderate and difficult; mid-semester exams are moderate, but end-semester exams are quite difficult. Almost 90 percent of students passed the exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I loved mathematics, and there are many job opportunities in the computer field nowadays. The passed batch of mathematics and computing in 2023 had 28 students; out of them, 24 got placed, 2 went for further studies, and 2 remain unplaced. The campus is far from the city, so it has no disturbance. There are many events, but 4 main events are conducted in our college: Zeitgeist (cultural fest), Advitiya (tech fest), Aarohan (sport fest), and Malhar (literacy fest). The scholarship at IIT Ropar is based on the family income of students.

reviews.review_title: Campus life of IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: Talking about the placement scenario, it is quite good, as our seniors are currently placed in companies like Google, Oracle, Pattern, Flipkart, BPCL, etc. The average package of the college, including all the branches of engineering in our college, is around 35 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is imposing, as we are one of the new-generation IITs. The infrastructure is maintained well by the authorities, and every year, lacs of rupees are spent to renovate the infrastructure. The hostel rooms are also well-maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers and faculty members are highly qualified in their respective domains. Every professor has certain Ph.D. students who work as Teaching Assistants (TA) under the professors. These TAs generally evaluate our quiz papers and exam answer sheets.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great hostel rooms, amazing crowd to hang out with makes my experience worth it.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement record at IIT Ropar is excellent. In the Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) department, over 80 percent of students were placed. The average package offered was 28 LPA and the highest package was between 50 and 60 LPA. Top companies that recruited from IIT Ropar include Oracle, JP Morgan, Google, EBay, Amazon and Arista.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I live in Chenab Hostel, and I think it's quite good. The rooms are spacious enough for two people, and the Wi-Fi is decent. If we need more bandwidth, we can use the LAN. The lecture halls are also pretty good with six of them; the largest holding 180 people. The mess food is decent and much better than what I've heard about other colleges. There is a main canteen with several outlets and a medical office that's always open in case of an emergency.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers do a good job of explaining everything in class. If we attend class and review the class slides, we should be able to get a good grade. The course curriculum includes things like data structures and algorithms, which will help us become industry ready.

reviews.review_title: Good faculty, good placements, and above-average infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75 percent of the students were placed. The highest package was about 65 LPA, the lowest was about 12 LPA, and the average package was about 22 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Texas Instruments, Qualcomm, and Nvidia. The percentage of students who got internships was about 70 percent, with companies like Accenture, Intel, Qualcomm, and Texas Instruments.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms here are good, with air conditioning and comfortable seating. The labs are well-equipped with modern equipment, and the institute has a strong ranking in research. There is Wi-Fi available in classrooms, labs, the library, and all hostels, except for the newly built ones. The library is spacious and has many amazing books to explore and read.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course prepares students to be industry-ready, and besides electrical engineering, they also teach electronics, which helps students enter the electronics industry. The teachers are helpful and qualified. The pass percentage is about 30-35 percent.
detailed_review.Other: Our campus hosts four major fests, including Zeitgeist, which is North India's biggest cultural fest. Extracurricular activities are also available, with several clubs such as tech clubs, literature clubs, and cultural clubs. Various events are held throughout the year, serving as a stress buster for students. Our college also offers many merit scholarships.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience at IIT Ropar.

detailed_review.Placements: The college has excellent placements. The maximum package was great this year despite the recession and the median was also great. This year, I have done a lot of duties and served as the branch representative of my branch. The top recruiting companies are Google, Zomato, Microsoft, De Shaw, Oracle, and Sprinkler.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are fully equipped, classrooms are also very good and a special library is also available 24 hours a day. There was perfectly fine food in the mess and canteen. The sports and games are fully equipped, so everything is perfectly fine. The library has a lot of books in all genres.
detailed_review.Faculty: Very helpful, qualified and knowledgeable teachers are there. The teaching quality is simply excellent; the course curriculum is also very relevant and it is very industry-generic as we are provided with the project. The semester ranges from easy to medium and is not very difficult.
detailed_review.Other: Computer science is a very good branch with great professors and great classmates. The only thing I would like to improve is that I would like to increase the number of projects that make the courses more industry-specific. Other than that, the fest is good and campus connectivity are well connected to Chandigarh.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I have Completed one year of my IIT Journey. It was awesome, made a lot of memories. It was fun.

detailed_review.Placements: Here comes the main part of the story, the last dance of your college life. As I am currently in First Year, I don't have any personal experience of it. But you are ensured to get a job with a good package. All the data of placement of recent years are mentioned on the placement website of IIT Ropar. The name of the Placement Cell of our college is CDPC. FYI, the last year average package of CSE (my branch) was 28 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If you are looking out for this College, then you must have seen the iconic four pillars structure and the Spiral at its Entrance. These are inspired by the Ancient Indus Valley Civilization. The other one is our Super Academics Building (SAB). It's outstanding. We have all types of sports facilities ranging from indoor to outdoor. We have gym facilities and a common room (having TV) at each Hostel. Hostel facilities are also good. Hostel life is the best part of College life.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about Faculty at IIT Ropar, I would say they are quite younger in comparison to other IITs. Being a new-gen IIT, professors are also highly energetic. Theory can be approached very easily. The faculty ratio here is 1:9, i.e., for every student, there is a professor. These numbers are a little higher looking at other institutes' statistics. Classes are more interesting as students can interact with professors freely.

reviews.review_title: Our college provided good placements in 2022.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85% of students got placed with an average salary package of 18 LPA. The highest salary package offered is 50 LPA. The average salary package offered is 13 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Amazon, L&T, Adobe, Microsoft, Flipkart, and Oracle.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a separate block for electrical engineering. We have all equipment in the lab. All labs and classrooms have 24X7 Wi-Fi. The library has 24X7 Wi-Fi. It has only a few seats. The course books are very few. The hostel rooms are very good. Many washrooms are not in good condition. The quality of the food in the mess and canteen is very good. We have 24X7 medical facilities. We do not have an indoor badminton court. We have a cricket ground and a football ground. The campus is small.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. They always motivate us to study. They have very good knowledge of the course. They try to teach all things in-depth. We can understand every concept. The course curriculum is relevant but does not make students industry-ready. Students have to study on their own. Semester exams are very difficult. Our college conducts exams from time to time. The pass percentage is average.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are not much good. The connectivity with the market and railway station is good.

reviews.review_title: Our college provides good education.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are decent. Our college offers core and non-core jobs. Internships are a bit difficult to get in the core field. Our college has a placement cell. It helps students to get placements and internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our department is very well-designed. Our college provides all the required elements in any subject. All hostels are new. They are very good in condition. The hostel provides double seater rooms for 1st and 2nd-year students and one seater room for 3rd-year students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college is famous for its faculty members. They are great. Our professors are more oriented toward students rather than their research. They are friendly and helpful. Our college makes it easy for us to communicate with our professors.
detailed_review.Other: Our college provides great exposure.

reviews.review_title: Our college has good value for money.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students got placed in our college. The highest salary package depends on students. The average salary package offered in our course is 15 LPA. Top roles offered are PM, PA SDE, analyst, etc. It is difficult to get internships because IT companies don't hire interns from the mechanical branch. Our college provides good placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is decent. The library is filled with books. Classrooms and the library are air-conditioned. Labs are very good for research. Hostels are well-built. The hostel rooms are very spacious. Our college provides double seater rooms till the second year. The infrastructure of our college is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and helpful. They are good. The course is the same as IITs. Semester exams are quite difficult. The course structure covers all concepts of the theory. The pass percentage is good. If you study well, you can get a pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd is good.

faqs.question: Which are the various courses offered at IIT Ropar?
faqs.answer: IIT Ropar offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses to students. At the undergraduate level, the Indian Institute of Technology–Ropar offers four to five-year BTech in nine specialisations . In addition to this, it also offers an integrated BTech programme. At the postgraduate level, Ropar IIT offers two to five-year M.Tech in different specialisations and a two-year MSc in various specialisations. The IIT Ropar also offers PhD courses to students.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Nestled in the serene embrace of Punjab’s Rupnagar by the banks of the Satluj River, IIT Ropar has a huge campus spread over 525 acres of lush green land. IIT Ropar infrastructure features academic, residential, sports, training and career development, transportation, and healthcare facilities. The institute's building has three independent blocks connected via skywalks. IIT Ropar provides well-furnished hostels to the students. IIT Ropar housed a library building, a data centre, boys' and girls' hostels and Kendriya Vidyalaya. It has a separate medical centre that has a dedicated team of medical and paramedical staff. Students requiring immediate yet basic medical attention can be directed to the medical centre. Talking about the IIT Ropar central library, it is open 24*7 and has more than 22,000 books (on shelves) and thousands of e-books and journals. For more details, watch the below video:

sections.heading: IIT Ropar Campus Highlights
text: The IIT Ropar campus has all the modern infrastructure to cater to the students' academic and research needs. It has multiple departments, seminar halls, an auditorium, etc. The auditorium has spacious interiors with cutting-edge audiovisual technology and acoustics, which is perfect for hosting seminars, lectures, and cultural events. Besides academic resources, the campus also has a utility block and a student activity centre that provides rooms and equipment for various clubs and related activities. The IIT Ropar campus also has a huge sports complex catering to the holistic development of the students. It has plenty of sports grounds for outdoor games, such as cricket, football, hockey, etc. The institute also has the infrastructure for indoor games. It has state-of-the-art classrooms, equipped with modern teaching equipment to enhance the learning experience. The entire campus is wifi enabled. For the security of the students, IIT Ropar hostels are under 24/7 CCTV surveillance. It has 1 CAD/CAM laboratory with 16 workstations for the students. sections.heading: IIT Ropar Hostel Facility
text: IIT Ropar has eight hostels, six for boys (Satlej, Beas, Sindhu, Mercury, Jupiter, and Neptune) and two for girls (Ravi, Venus) to house approximately 3000 students. IIT Ropar is a residential institute; therefore, all the students are required to reside in the hostels. All the hostel rooms are spacious and have all the basic furniture, such as a study table, chair, cupboard, single bed, etc. The rooms are allocated on a single and double occupancy basis. IIT Ropar hostels consist of dedicated rooms for recreational activities, providing a holistic environment for the students. It also has a common dining area for socialising with friends over food. All the hostels have water coolers and RO systems. Inside the hostel campus, there are four shops to supply the basic needs of the residents. IIT Ropar hostels are managed by a warden who is responsible for the smooth running and for maintaining the rules and regulations of the hostels.

For providing healthy and hygienic food, the institute has a mess facility for the students. The IIT Ropar mess is very spacious with an air-conditioned dining room, a well-equipped kitchen, a cold storage room and a storage room. The mess offers multiple cuisines from different regions of the country to meet the needs of the mixed population residing in IIT Ropar hostels. Some of the other hostel facilities are as follows:

sections.heading: IIT Ropar Library
text: The Nalanda Library of IIT Ropar acts as a knowledge hub for academic and research purposes. It has a vast collection of books, journals, theses, etc. Apart from books of study and reading material prescribed for courses, the library has a collection of research monographs, reports, dictionaries, encyclopaedias, etc. The library facilitates access to over 13,000 electronic journals from 30 publishers through its participation in the One Nation One Subscription (ONOS) initiative by the Government of India. The library is well furnished with comfortable tables and chairs, which are suitable for long working hours. The IIT Ropar library is automated using the Koha Integrated Library Management System. The library is operational all seven days in a week except a few national holidays. All library spaces are open from 08:00 am to 02:00 am , and Stack & Reading Area 2 is open from 02:00 am to 08:00 am .

sections.heading: IIT Ropar Sports Facility
text: The IIT Ropar campus caters to the sports needs of students. It has a cricket ground, football ground, hockey ground, badminton court, basketball court, and tennis court for outdoor activities. The institute also has an indoor facility for table tennis. The institute has a huge sports complex with plenty of sports options to encourage students to participate in indoor and outdoor sports activities. It also organises several sports festivals and events for the students. Sports and recreation activities are also available in the hostel blocks of IIT Ropar. It also has a well-equipped gymnasium to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the IIT RoparCampus
text: The IIT Ropar campus has a picturesque view to enjoy a sunset with friends. Situated on the banks of the river Sutlej, IIT Ropar students have multiple options to explore, such as the Archaeological Museum, Virasat-e-Khalsa museum, the Bhakra Nangal Dam and Naina Devi Temple, among others. These are a few nearby places which students must visit during their free time. Some of the famous eateries include Annapurna Dining Hall, The Pizza Store, The Urban Chinese, Shama Chicken Point, and Guru Nanak Bakery for baked food, which are quite popular among the students. highlights.summary:
KARE is a Deemed to be University, formerly Arulmigu Kalasalingam College of Engineering which was established in 1984. The university is located in Virudhunagar, TN, and was established under the trust ‘Kalasalingam and Anandam Ammal Charities’. Kalasalingam University Madurai is accredited by NBA, ABET, and with A++ Grade by NAAC. It obtained the status of Deemed to be University in 2006. Further, the university is approved by UGC, AICTE, and COA.
Kalasalingam University Madurai through 10 schools of study, offers UG, PG, and PhD courses to students across the Science, Engineering, Technology, and Humanities streams. The deemed-to-be university provides a BTech in Engineering for differently able (hearing and speech impaired) students. Kalasalingam University Tamil Nadu is ranked 30 under the ‘University’ category by NIRF 2024. The university has a panel of guest lecturers to inspire students in their respective careers and to give them tips and invaluable insights in every course. reviews.review_title: The Kalasalingam University is one of the best universities in India.

detailed_review.Placements: 20% of students are placed in my course. The highest package is 10 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA offered in my course, and it will increase every year. Companies like Indian Airlines, Indigo, and International Airlines recruit students from my course. The main roles offered are aeronautical engineer and pilot.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The labs and classroom are similar to cinematic rooms. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. The labs are separate to all the branches. Each branch has three to four labs. There are so many canteens, but there is no variety in food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very helpful in clarifying doubts anytime, not at midnight, I mean, any day and on any topic, they clarify the doubts. The faculty members have also completed their Ph.D. or doctorate. The semester exams are difficult if you do not concentrate on studies, but the education is the best from this university.
detailed_review.Other: I have a passion for airplanes and flights, so I chose this course. The course of Aeronautical Engineering is one of the beautiful things, we get wings to fly, and we can enjoy nature. Sports are important in all events, and cultural fests are going on all the time.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a second-year student, and I don't know that much about placement selection. For placement selection, the CGPA plays an important role. The selectors take two categories, one above 8 CGPA, and below 8 CGPA, they both have separate interviews. The student must learn all the programming languages like C, C+, python, java, etc. For interview purposes, they conduct special classes at Kalasalingam University. Approximately 300+ companies are tied to Kalasalingam University. The average package at Kalasalingam University is 4.5 LPA, and the highest package is 50 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: University is big. It is located in Krishnan Kovil, Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India. The room has 70 seating capabilities, with screens and projectors. Different labs for CSE, ECE, EEE, Bio Tech, Food Tech, etc., are available. The library also has big and different blocks for students in different streams.
detailed_review.Faculty: Total faculty is approximately 250 members including professors and assistant professors. Every professor is qualified and talented. Their teaching skills are very well. They are teaching not only subjects, they teach how to live in our modern society and how to get a job.
detailed_review.Other: The overall review of Kalasalingam Academy of Research and Education University is enriching both academically and personally. Kalasalingam University is not only for education, but it is also for gaining skills and knowledge like leadership, mentorship, programming, etc. The institution is also involved in sports.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Kalasalingam University generally has good placements, with a high percentage of students getting placed in companies like TCS and Wipro.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Kalasalingam University provides decent infrastructure with good labs and classrooms, though the hostel and mess facilities have room for improvement.
detailed_review.Faculty: Kalasalingam University has knowledgeable and helpful faculty, with a curriculum that is relevant to current industry standards. The semester exams are generally considered challenging but fair. The college is often seen as a good value for money, providing a positive balance between academic quality and cost. The campus life is vibrant, with a diverse crowd of students contributing to a lively and engaging environment.
detailed_review.Other: Kalasalingam University is a good value for money, offering a strong curriculum and a vibrant campus life with numerous fests and extracurricular activities. The feels are competitive, the college could improve by providing more industry specific workshops.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Excellent placements with strong career opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has a strong placement record with 90 percent students getting placed every year. The average package offered is 10 LPA with the lowest being 3 LPA and the highest reaching 25 LPA. The placement cell provides good guidance and training helping students secure opportunities in top companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has good lab facilities, classrooms, Wi-Fi in the hostel and recorded lectures on LMS. A central library with core books is available. Hostel food is average but the canteen is better. Medical facilities are good with their own hospital. Sports include a 2 to 3 acre ground, badminton and boxing courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, professors are very supportive and all are Ph.D. holders with strong industrial expertise. The faculty not only guides us academically but also provides practical insights. Our well structured curriculum is highly beneficial for securing placements.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering

The curriculum is well-structured and industry-oriented, making students ready as freshers. The exam level is moderate, not too tough or too easy, ensuring fair assessment.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, supportive faculty & decent placements at Kalasalingam University

detailed_review.Placements: It is a part of the B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering batch of 2021 to 2025 at Kalasalingam University. Placements for our course are fairly strong, with around 80 to 85% of eligible students placed. Companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Deloitte, Amazon, and Capgemini actively recruit from our course. Around 65 to 70% of students also secured internships in reputed organizations, including Amazon, Deloitte, Microsoft, TCS, and a few startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The university has a well developed infrastructure with spacious classrooms, well equipped computer labs, a large central library with digital resources, and 24/7 Wi-Fi access across campus. Our department labs are modern and regularly upgraded with the latest software tools. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms, RO drinking water, power backup, and Wi-Fi.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are well qualified, helpful, and approachable. Many of them held PhDs and industry experience, which added value to our learning. The curriculum is designed to be industry oriented, including programming, AI/ML, and elective subjects aligned with current technologies. Regular workshops, coding contests, and industry interactions are part of the course.
detailed_review.Other: Nothing

summary.college_name: Zakir Husain College of Engineering and Technology

reviews.review_title: Good college with good infrastructure and facilities of AMU.

detailed_review.Placements: In branches like Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, almost 70-80 per cent of students get placed in decent companies at decent packages of 6 to 18 LPA. The average is 7-8 LPA, while the median is also approximately the same, around 8-10 LPA. In other branches like Mechanical, Electrical, and Electronics, the placement ratio is 60-70 per cent, and the average is 6-8 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of the college are good enough. Classrooms also have smart boards. Labs are fully working, and everything needed for experiments or project work is available. Wi-Fi works properly with high speed in hostels, but is a little weak in college. The college has its own book bank where students can take books and read in the reading lawn. Reading rooms are also available in all hostels. Maulana Azad Library is one of the largest libraries in Asia, just 2-3 hundred meters from the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is like that of other Indian engineering colleges. I can say it is good enough and far better than some private and almost every college of AKTU. I learned an interesting thing: if a student focuses on skills along with academics (no matter if average or good), the chances of being placed increase drastically. This year (2025-26), some Electronics and Automobile students are placed for teaching roles, as usual, every year.

reviews.review_title: A good college with decent placements and nominal fees.

detailed_review.Placements: A good percentage of students were placed this year and last year too. The highest package in B.Tech AI was 18 LPA, and the average package was 8 LPA. The top roles in doing B. Tech in artificial intelligence are AI ML engineers or data enthusiasts, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is equipped with full network Wi-Fi coverage, and it is very widespread. The classrooms are equipped with high-quality labs. The hostels are very good and large in size, and are based on an old style. We have various games to play, like table tennis, chess, carrom, hockey, cricket, football, and there is a swimming pool in which we can dive.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They help the students focus on their studies, and they give appropriate answers to students who are confused about the syllabus. Teachers are accessible on WhatsApp, and we can contact them easily and ask any doubts.

reviews.review_title: Great university with job opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 75 to 80% students are placed by our university. One crore is the highest package of our university, and 3 to 4 LPA is minimum package of our university, and 5 to 6 LPA is average package of our university. Almost 80 students are interning at kasimpur thermal power plant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course is best. Infrastructure of our university is excellent with greenery park and hostel facilities are too good, like food servicing, cleanliness, and rooms are with large space and personal cupboards. Provide Wi-Fi with good speed, and medical facilities are free and available quickly for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are well qualified with higher degree like PhD. Every teacher has good knowledge of our subjects. Our teachers are provided with doubt-solving. Our subjects are good for industry without any training. Our semester exam passing percentage is 75 %.
detailed_review.Other: This course has a great opportunity for government jobs. Regular fests are organised by the students.

reviews.review_title: Best college in India for engineering

detailed_review.Placements: About 70% of students got placed. Highest package this year is 1.75cr. Lowest is about 25lakhs. After this course, you will have many jobs like quality manager or a parts designer. There are several companies offering internships in well-reputed companies like Narora Power Plant and thermal power plants.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is very neat and clean. Quality of food is also great with a tasty food. Canteen is also on every hostel. Wi-Fi facilities also provided with a good internet speed for watching online lectures. If one wants to study library is also built.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teacher is highly qualified. Every single subject that is taught to us is very useful. Exams are set tough as the syllabus taught is also great. The papers question help us to get ready for industries and get a good job. Teachers help us in academic as well as other problem.
detailed_review.Other: Placement for this course is good in India as well as outside of India. There is also scope for government jobs. Events are also held at every big festival, and every month a fest is held.

reviews.review_title: A good value-for-money college, best for students from lower backgrounds.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 70% of the students got placed in my course, the highest package is 18 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3 LPA. Top recruitment companies are TCS, Wipro, HCL, and more than 50% of students got internships. One student got an offer of manager in the department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The condition of Wi-Fi is not so good, but classes, reports, and peaceful infrastructure of RS College is not luxurious, but better, with screens on the board, so it is very convenient for the teacher to teach. Hostels are good, but it is not easy to get the hostels, so these are the problems that we face. Overall, medical, sports, and games facilities are great.
detailed_review.Faculty: I don’t think the teachers are that qualified and knowledgeable, their teaching style is good, but I don’t know why I don’t understand anything; I always have to study on my own. I don’t think the course curriculum is very good in the first year with respect to industry, because no college has followed the new education policy. For that, it is very difficult for us to study from the second year and get the same understanding.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because I wasn’t getting Computer Science in any other colleges. The best thing about this course is that the placement percentage is very high. I wish I would have got a better college. If I talk about improvements, it is equal to more placement with higher packages.

reviews.review_title: Their facilities are very good and their placement is also very good for everybody.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are very good for our AMU students. Companies usually offer packages up to 20 LPA, only for diploma students. Many companies visit here for placements, and many students get jobs through this university. Overall, the placement is too good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, and the hostel is good too. There is a canteen and dining hall for you, and there is a sports area also. There is turf for playing cricket and a football area. The dining fees are too low, and the food is very good, they provide healthy food.
detailed_review.Faculty: There is an AMU Entrance Exam. You can give this exam, and if you pass this, you can join the course. The exams are conducted by the university. Polytechnic faculty members are very good. They help every student in any case, and they all provide boats.

reviews.review_title: I must have risen by saying my college is like a normal, average college and eco-friendly.

detailed_review.Placements: 60 to 70% of students get placed in my college. The highest package is 18 LPA, the lowest package is 2 LPA, and the average package is about 9 LPA. TCS, Wipro, and some other famous companies come to our college. The top recruit company is TCS. About 50% students get internships. AI data structure design is the top role offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are average, they are like normal classes. Ice cream on the front of the table, which is in normal structure without AC. Wi-Fi, lab, classrooms, and library all exist in our college, so there is no problem regarding that, but it is not the type of college. The hostel is good, but it is not awarded for everyone because the rooms are limited. The food quality of the mess is great, we get good food that you like very much. There are medical personnel participating.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and qualified, but whatever they taught in our class, I never got it. They are a little bit helpful, but not caring, because they are professors. There is strict attendance in our college. Most teachers are good at their subjects, but some classes are harder to follow. Our semester exams are tough, and they are held at the college examination center. Usually, about 82 to 85 percent of students pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because there is a future in this course, and the best thing about this course is that it is emerging in the market, and I don't think it will end very soon. There is nothing to improve. There are many alumni in different places to go, which is very helpful for us to apply anywhere.

reviews.review_title: Campus chronicles experience.

detailed_review.Placements: 75% of students got placed in computer engineering branch. 16,00,000 LPA is the highest package, 8 LPA is the average package, and 6 LPA is the lowest package. Recruiting companies are Infosys, Samsung, TCS, etc. All the students got internships in British Petroleum and other companies. Software engineer is the role offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the amenities are available for students at the lowest hostel fee. Free Wi-Fi, library book bank, and reading room for studying are available. Food is decent not much delicious. Canteen and sports facilities are available. The medical health centre and JNMC hospital provided free of cost.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are highly qualified and very experienced. Teacher quality is intellectual to each faculty. Curriculum is relevant but for skill purposes, its not relevant. Students can be ready for industrial training. Semester exams are too easy to get good marks.

reviews.review_title: Studying Mechanical Engineering at AMU: An insider's perspective.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75–76% of eligible Mechanical students got campus offers. The highest / the lowest / average package: the highest touched 57 LPA, most offers fell 3–4 LPA (the lowest), with an average of 6.5–7 LPA. Top recruiters are L&T, Cummins, Siemens, Tata Projects, NBTC Kuwait, ONGC, Honda, Yamaha, Accenture, and TCS. Internship percent & companies: Roughly 60–70% secured training in firms like ONGC, BHEL, L&T, Indian Railways, Yamaha, and Honda. Top roles offered are graduate engineer trainee, design/CAD engineer, production & quality engineer, maintenance/plant engineer, and a few technical analyst profiles in IT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Mechanical Engineering Department at ZHCET, AMU offers spacious classrooms with projectors, Wi-Fi, and well-equipped labs for Heat Transfers, Fluid Mechanics, IC Engines, CAD/CAM, and Materials Testing, supported by licensed software like AutoCAD and ANSYS. Students have access to both a departmental library and the Maulana Azad Library with rich e-resources, hostels provide twin-sharing rooms, study furniture, and routine maintenance, the mess serves affordable north-Indian and Mughlai meals, with canteens for snacks, the AMU Health Centre ensures round-the-clock medical support, sports facilities include playgrounds, courts, gymnasium, and indoor arena, creating a balanced environment for academic work, research, recreation, and overall student well-being.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty in Mechanical Engineering at ZHCET, AMU are generally well-qualified (most hold M.Tech or Ph.D.) and approachable, offering guidance in labs, projects, and career planning, teaching quality is moderately good, combining lectures with practical sessions, though some classes still follow traditional methods, the curriculum aligns with core mechanical fundamentals and includes design, thermal, and CAD courses, with moderate exposure to industry software and internships, adequate, but could include more recent trends. Semester exams are of moderate difficult if one follows lectures and lab work regularly. The pass percentage typically stays above 85–90%, making overall academic pressure manageable with consistent study.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because Mechanical Engineering gives a broad technical foundation: design, thermals, manufacturing, and materials, ZHCET has a strong heritage and alumni network. The best aspects are the experienced faculty, well-equipped laboratories, access to Maulana Azad Library, green campus, and diverse peer group, which together make learning engaging, areas for improvement include more exposure to cutting-edge tools (automation, additive manufacturing), stronger industry linkage, structured internships, and updated electives reflecting emerging technologies.

reviews.review_title: This college is best if you want to study with less money and get an average placement.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of students placed in Mechanical Engineering in 2024 is 60%. The highest package is an international package of ₹52 LPA given by a company in Kuwait, and the lowest package is ₹4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are L&T, Siemens Energy, Zia Semiconductor, and Engineers India Limited. 20% of students got internships from Mechanical Engineering in companies like ONGC, Yamaha Motors, and Honda, etc. The top roles offered in my course are design engineer (who works on CAD), production engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In Zakir Hussain College of Engineering and Technology, many facilities are provided by the department. You will get an unlimited Wi-Fi connection. The labs in the department are very good, and the classrooms are also good with ventilation. Here is Asia's biggest university library, named Maulana Azad Library, and a library inside the department is also available. Hostel facilities are also good, the quality of food in the hostel mess is okay but not good. Medical facilities are always available for students, and there are big opportunities for sports and games like volleyball, cricket, football, badminton, skating, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and helpful, with a maximum of them being Ph.D. qualified from many top IITs. They are so knowledgeable, except for some. The curriculum is relevant. It makes the students industry-ready a little bit. The semester examinations in the college are of average difficulty, and 90% of students pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in machines and robotics. In this course, we learn about machines, robotics, and energy plants, etc. The faculty members' teaching style is excellent. Faculty members should adopt modern education like IITs.

reviews.review_title: Supportive faculty and good campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: 35% students were placed in mechanical course. 6 LPA is highest package, 2.5 LPA is lowest, and average is 3.5 LPA. L&T and Siemens are the biggest companies that recruit. Almost all the students got an internship at Aligarh Power Plant. Maintenance Engineer role is offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good amenities provided by hostel, such as Wi-Fi, 2,4, and single seater rooms available in the hostel. Asian, the largest library, Molana Abul Kalam Azad Library. Food is decent, and all the workers are adept at cleaning. Health centre and all sports grounds are available for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, and most of the faculty hold a doctorate from Indian Institute of Technology. Syllabus provided by AICTE. It's relevant for industrial knowledge. Easy to score in semester examination. Previous year questions asked by teachers which is easy to pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I want to become a production engineer. I think college adopts modern education inspired by Gulf countries.

reviews.review_title: The best thing here is hostel life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is Decent. In Tech Courses like Computer Engineering, Computer Engineering (A.I.), and Electronics and Communication Branch. You can expect a good Package of around 8 to 9 LPA if you work hard, then you can exceed 18+ LPA, but in core branches, you get a decent Package of 5 to 6 LPA or maybe 8 LPA. No one knows the Future! Lets Hope for the best!
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One of the best infrastructures in India, a legacy of old structures. Their culture and TEHZEEEBB are still present in the college. Seniors are very supportive. This year, fees are high because of the protests that are going on. Lets hope for the best. Regular B.Tech Courses: It is 29,900/year, excluding mess fees. It includes hostel fees, book fees, and other types of Fees.  Semi Self Finance courses like AI and VLSI. It is 74,900/year for the same Facilities. You will get a college hostel too. For Self Finance, It is 1,00,000/Year. No College Hostel allotment in the Entire Duration of the Course. Mess charge in Nadeem Tarin Hall is 1400/Month, including breakfast.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching facilities are excellent, and labs are fully equipped. You get time to learn new skills. You may get Friday & Saturday off. It depends on your section. You will have more classes on the remaining days, so think twice. In my schedule, I have labs on Friday and Saturday, but the schedule is perfect, only 8 to 10 30 in the Morning.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is 100% affordable, and AMU has old legacy. It has good connectivity worldwide. In arab countries, one of the Famous events in AMU is Sir Syed Day. The best day for the hostelers.

reviews.review_title: Is this college worth it? - Full review inside.

detailed_review.Placements: 30% of students got placements. The highest package is Rs 6 LPA, average package is 3 LPA, and the lowest package is 2 LPA. L&T and Siemens are the top recruiters. All the students get internships every year. Machine design engineering is the best choice and is highly paid by the company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are decent. They provide better facilities like Wi-Fi and rooms. Quality of the food is not so much good. They give us equal veg and non-veg. detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified. Teaching style is not like modern education because AICTE syllabus is followed by the university. It's helpful for industrial training. Semester exams are easy, two mid-semesters taken by college. 95% students score good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in it. More opportunities in government sector as well as gulf countries. I think they should be taught modern education which is helpful for placement. Sir Syed Day celebrated every year to remember Sir Syed Ahmad Khan who was the founder of this university. A lot of scholarships are provided by alumni for poor students.

reviews.review_title: This college is totally worth it.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students get placed, with the highest package reaching 19.36 LPA last year; companies like L&T, Avitron Aerospace, and Wonder Cement visit for placement drives, and about 60 to 70% of students receive internship offers for roles such as production in-charge and site engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In the department, labs are very well-maintained and functional, with Wi-Fi and AC classrooms available, and a separate library is provided. Hostel fees are around 4-5k per year, with very good mess food quality, and the campus boasts grounds for every sport, including a gym, swimming pool, hockey ground, skating club, cricket ground, tennis court, and badminton court.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and well-qualified, with most holding Ph.D.s from top IITs. The course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are pretty hard, and the pass percentage is around 70%; others get backlogs, which they need to clear in the next semester. .
detailed_review.Other: Lots of fests are held in the department and in the hostel as well.

reviews.review_title: It has an excellent library and mess facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 7 students in my batch, including myself. 2 girls got married during course and other 5 are doing PhD somewhere. No highest or the lowest salary packages are offered to students. It's the fellowship of a PhD we are getting from the government of India. All students get placed in the top institutes of India, including IITs. Students are engaged in rigorous research work whole year, and sending material sample for testing in different institutions. So there is no time for internships in all that. One student got an offer letter for a project associate and converted that project into a PhD already.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and the library system are top-notch in AMU. There's enough flexibility for doing lab work in any department. This department also has expensive equipment for labwork. Hostels are decent with decent quality of mess. The main feature is the reasonable cost of mess, i.e., Rs. 1600 per month. Food quality is satisfactory. Students have access of JN Medical College Aligarh free of cost and a separate student health service is operation 24x7. Sports facilities are also quite good. From athletic ground to swimming pool, horse riding, tennis, hockey, cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, etc., all facilities are available for bonafide students of AMU.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are the most positive part of the department. Faculty members are extremely supportive and well-qualified. Teaching quality is top-notch. The course curriculum was recently updated with all the current industrial subjects, such as quantum mechanics and smart intelligent materials. Semester exams are quite engaging with the syllabus taught to us and are pretty balanced. An average student does not feel any difficulty in cracking it. For labs, it's 60% and for theory work, it is 40%.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in biodegradable materials for environmental sustainability, so I chose M.Tech. in Materials Science & Technology. The placement area is the weakest part of the department. It needs an improvement immediately. The campus is vibrant and filled with different people from different parts of the world. Scholarships are available from MHRD, and central scholarships are also there. As the strength is very low, extracurricular activities in the department are rare.

reviews.review_title: Highly Satisfied with the infrastructure of the college and teaching style of the teachers.

detailed_review.Placements: About 50% of students got placed in reputed companies in India and the Gulf as well 30%-40% opted for higher education. The highest package is 9.6 LPA, the average is 3.6 LPA, and the lowest is 1.8 LPA. Among top recruiters are IFFCO Dubai, and Pavna Industries Aligarh. Most of the students completed their internships at Harduaganj Thermal Power Station, Quasmipur, Narora Atomic Power Station, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are equipped with world-class infrastructure with smart boards, Wi-Fi-enabled college, and hostel. Book bank is there in the college along with libraries in hostel and college. Wi-Fi and AC are provided in the libraries with the latest books with no additional fees. The quality of food is excellent compared with other hostels but you may miss the homemade foods. Medical facilities are provided 24/7 and ambulance reaches within minutes just on a single call. We have 3 hospitals and 1 small clinic forever. Indoor games, volleyball, badminton, etc., are provided in the hostel apart from AMU.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the teachers are highly qualified having a minimum of masters as a qualification level they teach every topic with in-depth knowledge. However, the syllabus gets updated from time to time but some teachers may provide old notes. Coming to semester exam if a student is attending classes regularly it is very easy to pass the exams but if absentees is higher he may face multiple backlogs. My batch have 93.75% passing percentage.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Diploma in Mechanical Engineering for my interest and I found it very interesting with the infrastructure of the campus but some of the machines of the laboratories are outdated and not working which I think must be updated to match cutting-edge technology.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of its faculty members and good placements.

detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I wanted to pursue engineering. The best thing about the course is that its practical.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Information Technology
reviews.review_title: It is good for those who don’t want to waste money and time. This college is excellent.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has good infrastructure and games. It is a 100-acre college, also known as the Greenary College. The college is full of green trees and gardens. This college has great nature and trees, and all games are available in the college, so don’t worry about games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are excellent. My course has 3 semesters per year. It is an experiential learning course for four years, which is a very good course. In this college, faculty have good skills; they are from IITs, NITs, and some have PhDs. They help always, not only during college time, but all the time.
detailed_review.Other: Because this course has skill-based learning, I want more practical learning. They give it, but only a small amount of time is allocated for practical learning. Overall, the college is good, but it is too expensive for middle-class people. When it comes to studying, this is a very good one, top 10 college, because they teach skills, not just hard work for semesters. They teach the concepts of subjects. If you are a topper, the college will provide excellent skills.

reviews.review_title: It has good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 50 percent of students get placed. The lowest package offered is 3.6 LPA. The top role offered is a software developer. Some of the students got internship offer letters from ECE. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Cognizant, LTI, and Mindtree.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, library, and auditorium are available. Hostels are good. The library is too good, and helpful books are available. The quality of food available in the canteen is worthless. The cost is high. The quality, quantity, and taste of the bad is too bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are helpful for reaching our goals and creating innovative projects, which are helpful for our growth. The pass percentage of my college is 35 percent. If we study, then only we can pass, or else it is different to gain marks and clear the exam.
detailed_review.Other: I personally chose the ECE course. The best thing about my course is that we will learn software and hardware fields at the same time. But we will not be proficient in both courses. But choosing ECE is the best thing for those who are willing to know about communication and technology.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good campus and with good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: 75-85% were placed in our course. I think the highest package is around 75 LPA, and the lowest is around 4 LPA. Tech Mahindra and Infosys recruit. 80-90 percent of students got internships from our course and in companies like Tech Mahindra, Infosys, and Amazon. The top roles are data analyst and developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have all the top-notch facilities like Wi-Fi, furniture, food tables, classrooms with smart boards and highly qualified professionals. The hostels have very good infrastructure, a good environment and very good food. Also have both AC and non-AC facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are fully helpful and very joyful, we can feel free around them about all the doubts and other queries. This course is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are not that tough. The pass percentage is above 75%.
detailed_review.Other: I will definitely recommend you to join the university for a happy lifestyle and for good placements.

reviews.review_title: Great infrastructure, supportive faculty and strong placement opportunities at KL University.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering batch 2021 to 2025. 85 to 90 percent of students are placed, with packages ranging from 3 LPA to 25+ LPA, and average of around 6 to 7 LPA. Top recruiters included Amazon, Deloitte, TCS, Infosys, Accenture, and many students secured internships in leading IT companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The CSE department has well equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, high speed Wi-Fi, and access to a central digital library with extensive learning resources. Hostels are well maintained with good security, medical facilities, sports infrastructure, and the mess and canteen provide hygienic and decent quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty are well qualified, knowledgeable, and supportive, with a good balance of theory and practical teaching. The curriculum is regularly updated to meet industry requirements and helps students become job ready. Semester exams are moderately difficult, with a pass percentage of around 85 to 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: The course offers good value for money with quality education, strong placement support, and modern infrastructure. The exposure to industry oriented skills justifies the fee structure. The campus has a diverse and active student crowd with regular technical, cultural, and sports events. Connectivity is good, and the campus surroundings are clean and student friendly. I belong to the B.Tech CSE 2021 to 2025 batch and chose this course for its strong industry relevance and career opportunities. While the curriculum is well designed, more hands on projects and startup exposure could further improve the course experience.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement support and decent campus life, but it needs better faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of the students were placed with an average package of 6 LPA, and the highest is around 18 LPA. There is an honors programme that can really boost your chances as it provides project-based learning, makes you industry-ready, and helps you to get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is great, every room has Wi-Fi, and there are many rooms, such as a game room, clubhouse, and study room. It even has a swimming pool, a library is great and really cool, it boosts the study morale, and also there are so many games you can play.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at KL University is decent, with some knowledgeable and supportive teachers, while others rely too much on theory-based teaching, and some are genuinely good, and you can learn a lot, while others are just okayish and not up to mark, especially in terms of language.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE because it was the strongest course here, and I have a very strong interest in coding and have always wanted to become a game developer, and I feel this will help me a lot.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The campus is good and large, but there are strict rules and almost no exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: Students get placement, the highest as we know of this year is 75 LPA, and the average is about 6 LPA-7 LPA. The maximum placement is for the engineering department students. They provide CRT training before the campus placement grounds to make you well aware of the placement environment.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are very good, and the infrastructure is also very good when compared to any other college, but the fuller utilisation of the infrastructure is still needed. There are clubs for exposure, but the clubs do not have a lot of infrastructure. There is Wi-Fi nearly everywhere, but do note that only an Airtel SIM works here, so get your sim card changed.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is good and experienced. They explain every topic very nicely and will solve your doubts with patience, and you will get clarity regarding the topics. The exams here are quite difficult, and they will keep you engaged in a lot of activities as well as assignments till the very last day, so it becomes a burden on us in the end.
detailed_review.Other: Get an Airtel sim as no other sim network works inside the campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am absolutely dissatisfied with the hostel life.

detailed_review.Placements: On Google, there are too many good reviews about placements, but they are somewhat fake. There are not many internship and placement records in the college. The average package offered ranges between 6-7 LPA. The top roles offered are CSE and AI. The top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon and Deloitte.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college hostel and the environment are too good. The hostel life is not that good because it is too strict. The food in the hostel is also not that good, and they will give us good food for 1or 2 days after the admission. Sports facilities are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exam pattern is also good. Teachers are well qualified. They make us industry-ready. The pass percentage is 50 percent. Most of the faculty members are not that good. They speak in Telugu half of the time. Although if students are from North India, they will just continue in their own flow.
detailed_review.Other: There are many good colleges around it. Fests and extracurricular activities conducted are average.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Faculty members and the infrastructure are good. Placements are satisfying.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85 percent of students in my CSE batch got placed. The highest package is 32 LPA, and the average package ranges from 6-7 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Deloitte, and Capgemini, and a few product-based companies like Amazon and PhonePe. Many students also got internships. The major roles offered are software engineer, data analyst, QA engineer, support engineer, and associate developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has good labs, Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Hostel rooms are clean and basic, with decent mess food and medical help. Sports and indoor games facilities are available on campus. The hostel facilities are decent, and rooms are clean. Drinking water and electricity backup are available. The mess food is average but hygienic. The canteen offers better options.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is updated with industry topics like AI, DBMS, and cloud. Exams are moderate, and most students clear them with proper preparation. Most teachers explain concepts clearly and support students during projects and labs.
detailed_review.Other: Considering placements, facilities, and academic support, the course offers good value for money compared to other colleges, so I chose it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college with best placement record.

detailed_review.Placements: College ensures that every student who has enrolled in campus recruitment training gets placed in some of the other companies. 100 percent is the placement rate. faqs.question: What should I do to get a direct admission in K L College of Engineering for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: The university offers direct admission to UG and PG courses based on the marks secured by the candidates in the previous qualifying examination. For B.Tech, the basic eligibility criteria are 10+2 from a recognized board with at least 60% marks in the related subject group. Students with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) are eligible for all B.Tech programs including Bio-Technology, and students with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) are eligible for B.Tech (Bio-Technology) and B.Pharmacy In addition you can contact the college directly for further information

KL College of Engineering average package offered in 2024 stood at INR 11 LPA . The average package offered in 2024 increased by nearly 27% as compared with previous year. The overall highest package offered during MTech placements 2024 was INR 15.5 LPA . KL College of Engineering MTech average and median package offered in 2024 stood at INR 7.47 LPA and INR 6 LPA , respectively.
