highlights.summary:
Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) started offering undergraduate and postgraduate courses in 1997. Initially, Engineering, Management and Computer Applications courses were introduced. KIIT introduced many schools, including the School of Law, Biotechnology, Medical Sciences, Dental Sciences, Nursing, Mass Communication in 2007. Now, the institute is recognised as a private institution, that offers courses at the UG, PG and PhD levels. Locates in Bhubaneshwar, KIIT campus is speread across8,900 acres, with 3K+ faculty and researchers and 15K staff members. It owns accreditations and affiliations from various national and international rewarding bodies. The institute is ranked 1001-1200 by theQS World University Rankings 2026. In the 'Overall' category, KIIT is ranked 28 by NIRF. KIIT is also accredited with A++ Grade by NAAC. As per the Times Higher Education, ‘World University Ranking 2024’ recognises KIIT among the rank-band of 601-800.
KIIT offers 8 scholarships based on various criteria such as merit, economic status, international, PhD students and a few more. The Institute also has scholarships based on government schemes and multiple scholarships offered by the industries.
KIIT Bhubaneshwar also has KIIT Kareer School to provide placement training and student assistance. Around 700+ companies visited the Institute during the campus placement and made 5K+ offers to eligible students.
To know more about KIIT Bhubaneshwar highlights, check out the table given below:

college_info_program.intro:
KIIT's popular courses include MBA, BTech, and MCA. The institute offers 200 courses via its 28 schools that operate on the same campus. Known as one of the top B-schools, KIIT offers UG and PG degrees in business administration, covering multiple specialisations, such as business analytics, operations, and supply chain management. Offered at KIIT for a duration of two years, the minimum eligibility criteria for MBA admission requires candidates to graduate with a minimum aggregate of 50% or equivalent. Along with this, a valid score is also required in any one of the entrance exams, such as KIITEE MGT/CMAT/CAT/MAT/XAT/GMAT/ATMA. KIIT MBA fees are around INR 3.5 Lakh – INR 10.3 Lakh.
KIIT offers 18 specialisations in BTech and MTech through the Schools of Computer Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology. Aspirants must have at least 60% marks with the scores of eligible entrance results of JEE, KIITEE, Odisha CHSE and CBSE 12. The tuition fee of BTech is around INR 3.8 Lakh – 19 Lakh.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, it's a good college.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly, students get placed, as I have heard from my seniors. The average package is okay, with a median of 7 LPA, and the highest goes around 21 LPA. Mostly, students get internships here. Some of the recruiting companies that visit include Accenture, Infosys, JP Morgan, etc. Mostly, the roles offered are SDE, business analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are nice, and we get Wi-Fi in the classrooms too. I personally love the library, it's just perfect. Hostels are great, to be honest, infrastructure-wise, they can be very strict for girls, though. Few have study rooms even. Food is great, there's so much variety, and it keeps changing every once in a while. A few hostels have a badminton and basketball court very close to them, if you are lucky enough.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are really great and will actually make you enjoy learning. The course curriculum is relevant. We also have assigned mentors who are there for the students, they visit hostels often to ask if we are facing any issues. The semester exams are not tough, to be honest, just go through the PYQs, and you will be fine. The paper is standard in my opinion.
detailed_review.Other: The fest here is really fun, it generally happens in mid-February, mostly after mid-semester.

reviews.review_title: It has good infrastructure, faculty, and a good track record for placement.

detailed_review.Placements: The college has good placements. 80 for the MBA RM and 80 for the ABM course. The subjects are designed as per the current market demands. We are having a large, diverse group of students from different parts of the country, as well as international students from Africa. We share good communication with the facilities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college has good infrastructure and is well-furnished. They serve satisfactory food, and the hostel is in a short distance from the college with student-friendly staff. They also have AC premium hostel, which is much expensive than the regular non-AC hostels. The laundry system of the university can be improved as it lacks the quality of washing and its services.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have good and qualified teachers from respected institutes and organisations. They have vast knowledge about the course. But more professors are required because of the student-to-teacher ratio. Some faculty teach more than 2 -3 courses in the same semester. It will be good if this can be improved.
detailed_review.Other: The course is good and valuable as per industry demand.

reviews.review_title: Perfect for a successful future.

detailed_review.Placements: 100 percent of students got placed in our previous batch. The highest package is about 14 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. According to my knowledge, development sectors, CSR, and finance companies are most common. All the students got internships in our course and in different sectors. The top role offered is rural manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is very good and available 24/7, classrooms are well-maintained, and the library is very good. Every book is available for our reference and future goal achievement. Hostels are very good, and the rooms are ventilated, the mess food is very good, and it provides 4 times meals a day. For medical cases, they take students to KIMS.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and friendly, and the teaching quality is very good. The teachers are very helpful and clear, with a friendly behavior. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes the students industry-ready. Semester exams are moderate, and the passing percentage is 60 percent.

reviews.review_title: Excellent experience with KIIT School of Rural Management.

detailed_review.Placements: 100 percent of students got placed. Recruiting companies are AKRSP, Pradan, APCNF, Wassan, Seva Mandir, and Annapurna Finance. Average package offered ranges from 6 LPA to 10 LPA. 100 percent of students got internships in organisations like AKRSP, APCNF, Wassan, and BAIF.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 24/7 Wi-Fi facility. The quality of food provided in the mess is good. The canteen is also available. An AC facility is available in classrooms, hostels, and the library. 24/7 medical facilities are available. Sports events are also organised. Different types of books are available in the library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Well-qualified teachers with Practical experience in different core areas. The course curriculum is designed with relevance to the course and with practical knowledge, with 3 internships provided. 100 percent is the pass percentage. Semester exams can be attempted from regular class knowledge and can write in their own words.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in the development sector. I have chosen the Rural Management course. Here we can learn practical experience from 3 internships provided by the college. Events organised like KIIT fest, freshers, and farewell.

reviews.review_title: Supportive faculty, good academics, and a positive campus atmosphere.

detailed_review.Placements: 100 percent of students got placed. Top recruiters are Jeevika, Pradan, BIAF Seva Mandir, and AKRSP. Top roles are Team Coordinator, Project Manager, Thematic Expert Package, which basically range from 5 LPA to 8.5 LPA. 100 percent of students got internships from the company like Kalamandir, CYSD, and Gramvikash.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department has good classrooms, Wi-Fi, labs, and a library that support learning. Hostel Facilities are good with clean rooms and basic amenities. The mess food is also good and hygienic. Medical facilities, games, and yoga facilities are provided.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful and knowledgeable. They explain the topic in a simple and unique way and are always ready to clear doubts. The teaching quality is good and supportive. The course curriculum is useful for both theory and practical learning. Semester exams are of moderate difficulty.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest and good career scope. The course offers a good mix of theory and practical learning with a supportive teacher. More practical exposure and industry interaction can improve the course. The college has good events, a friendly crowd, easy connectivity, and clean surroundings.

reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the excellent faculty and their mentoring of us for our future growth.

detailed_review.Placements: 99 percent of students are getting placement, the top companies are ITC, Pradhan, Amul, etc. We are coming for recruitment. Mostly, we are getting roles like project manager, Project coordinator, and field assistant roles. 100 percent of students are getting 3 internships from our college, like Jeevika, Jindal, and Techno Serve.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have good infrastructure facilities like smart classrooms, a library, a seminar hall, and an auditorium. We have good quality facilities. We have better mess, and in any emergencies, immediate action is taken by the hostel warden.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty is made up of more experienced people, and they teach us with real-life examples, and we also have practical experiences. These are relevant to our curriculum. It's not as difficult if we attend classes, we can get a better score. A maximum of 75 to 80 percent are getting a score.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I want to explore the development sectors. There is no need to improve, they are providing better activities. We have different club and committee activities every month.

reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, teachers, surroundings, opportunity, and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: There is 100 percent placement. It might sound like a promotion, but KSRM made it real. Top recruiters offering internships are ITC, Jeevika, BAIF, Gram Vikas, and Pradan. The average package is 6 LPA. Roles offered are Project Manager, Thematic Expert, Project Coordinator, and Programme Associate.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled, with smart classes, a seminar hall, an auditorium, and a library, which is open throughout the week. The hostel is well-maintained with basic amenities and security. Mess is of good quality and has a variety of food options. The canteen offers additional options that are inside the campus. 24/7 medical support, sports, games, and activities include gym, swimming, indoor sports, badminton, cricket, and basketball.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is the Alumni of top universities like IRMA, IIT, XIMB, OUAT, and G.B. Pant University with more than 20 years of experience. This course curriculum adds value not only to your professional life but also to your personal life. Support of teachers is not only in class but also out of the class during internship and with career guidance.
detailed_review.Other: Experiential learning makes the course more interesting and engaging. As our university gives us the opportunity to go for three internships, it makes us industry-ready. Fests, tournaments, guest talks, and events make the college life more interesting.

reviews.review_title: Strong learning impact.

detailed_review.Placements: The batch recorded 100 percent placements with packages from 5 LPA to 8 LPA. All students completed internships with Kalamandir, Access, Pradan, Pragatti, AKRSP, Seva Mandir, BAIF, and took up roles like Team Coordinator, Thematic Expert, and Project Manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Life at KSRM features Wi-Fi classrooms and a rich library for smooth learning, safe and pleasant hostels with decent and hygienic food available in the mess and canteen, plus medical care, sports, and yoga facilities for a healthy, balanced campus life.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are friendly, supportive, and highly experienced, making complex topics easy to understand. The curriculum is practical and aligned with real-world needs. With consistent effort, exams feel fair and achievable, and the majority of students clear them smoothly.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for its strong field exposure and practical learning. The best part is real-world engagement. More industry tie-ups could help. Campus life is lively with events, good connectivity, and active extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_title: The programme strengthens the journey from experience to expertise.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students are placed in our course, and top recruiting companies are Pradan, Jeevika, Gram Vikas, ITC CSR, BAIF Development and Research Foundation, and Arnapurna Microfinance. Major roles offered by our course are programme executive, livelihood promotions officer, CSR manager, and relationship manager. The average package offered in our course is 6 LPA-8 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of KSRM provides a comfortable and supportive environment for learning, with well-equipped classrooms and a green, peaceful campus for focus and reflection. Clean living space and a safe environment with basic amenities are available at the hostel to make the day-to-day activities stress-free.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is well structured. A key strength of the programme is 3 internship segments which connect students directly with organisations and communities. These help students build strong grassroots understandings of professional roles.
detailed_review.Other: I joined KSRM with prior experience in the social sector, but the course gave me the opportunity to strengthen my conceptual clarity, refine my managerial skills, and approach social and rural challenges in a more structured and impactful way.

reviews.review_title: The course and college are good.

detailed_review.Placements: In rural management, all students go for 3 internships to different companies all over India, starting from development, agriculture, consultancy, and livelihoods. For final placements, we will go for the project management roles. Different companies like ITC, Pradhan, and Technoserve visit the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is present with good infrastructure, having 24-hour Wi-Fi facility, air-conditioned classrooms, and a vast library where we can go through different career development books. The hostel is maintained clean, provided with good food, and has 24-hour medical facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors present here from the top colleges in India, like Delhi University, IIMs, and IRMA, where their exposure helped us to learn in a meaningful manner. The academics for every semester make us get ready for internships. A 100 percent pass percentage is seen in the semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: The course helps me to work with the ground-level issues, which brings a good experience of connection to a new environment and learning new practices. The events and the extracurricular activities help us to learn management skills and leadership qualities.

reviews.review_title: The 2-year journey here is enriching and fun.

detailed_review.Placements: A 100 percent placement rate is achieved in every batch. The average package offered is 5 LPA, and the highest goes up to 10 LPA. The top recruiting organisations are PRADAN, AKRSP (I), JEEVIKA, Gram Vikas, BAIF, ITC CSR, HDFC Bank, and Annapurna Finance Pvt. Ltd. Major roles offered are evaluation and monitoring, Project Officer, Project Coordinator, and Thematic head.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available 24/7 at the college and hostel. Smart boards and ACs are available in each classroom. The library has a capacity of up to 50 members. Different types of books and magazines are available in the library. The hostel rooms provided are well-maintained, and they are neat and hygienic. Mess food is prepared with care, and the kitchen is always clean.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors had graduated from top colleges like IRMA, XIMB, and IIT. The faculty are really helpful in guiding the students through the mentor-mentee programme. The course is planned for students to do 3 internships, which gives them exposure to the grassroots-level work of the organisations and makes them industry-ready at the end of the course. Semester exams are not textbook-based and are easy, as the student is asked to write the exam in their own words. A 100 percent pass percentage is seen.

reviews.review_title: It's an MBA and management studies development and CSR.

detailed_review.Placements: 98 percent of students get placed. Few students join their family business or start something on their own. The average package is around 6 LPA, and the highest package is 11 LPA. Top recruiting organisations are Pradan, AKRSP, and Jeevika. 100 percent of students get internships from college. Roles offered are Senior Associate and Programme Manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a library, Wi-Fi, conference room, seminar hall, auditorium, open theatre, etc. All the classes are equipped with a smart class. In the hostel, we have a meeting room, a playroom, washing machines, a 24/7 camera, a team of 4-member wardens per hostel, and cleaning staff.
detailed_review.Faculty: If we talk about the course curriculum, then I will say it is an MBA because it is management studies with Development and CSR. Most of the teachers have working experience in multiple industries, so they have good industry connections. The course curriculum is very relevant because it is a study of different thematic areas like Rural Management, which includes topics like Health, Education, Livelihood, Natural Resource Management, Disaster Management, Rural Development, CSR, etc.
detailed_review.Other: If we talk about activities, we have a lot of co-curricular and extracurricular activities going on throughout the session. We also have a lot of events on the campus. I name one that is KIIT Fest. Apart from studies, KIIT has a lot of activities going on in its vast campus. 25 square kilometers (or roughly 6,177 acres), with different theme campuses, each campus is so beautiful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: KIIT is a decent college when it comes to private colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: At the end of the placement season, the majority of the students are placed, but the roles of their jobs are typically non-tech, as for the campus placement, usually tech roles are comparatively less. The non- tech jobs are usually consultancy and marketing. As far as the package is concerned, it ranges from 2.5 LPA-61 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, it stands taller than several other colleges, i.e., tier 1,2, and 3. Hostel facilities are pretty good. When it comes to Wi-Fi speed, it is a little turbulent, while lab facilities are good when it comes to the computer science branch, but for electronics-based branches, things have deteriorated in the last couple of years. A new campus has been constructed with great facilities, be it the canteen, mess, or any aspect you name it.
detailed_review.Faculty: When it comes to faculty, my review will be a little mixed. They are qualified enough, but a chunk of facilities still lacks the qualities of teaching. As far as the course & curriculum are concerned, it has been updated, but not industry-ready. Semester exams are pretty decent, which is worth scoring & regulations towards malpractices have been scrutinized from this year, unlike the previous years, which were a little mild.
detailed_review.Other: My branch has a combination of Computer Science and specialisation, which is decent enough compared to other courses. Labs are pretty hectic as they resemble an ECE-based subject, so that needs to be taken care of for CSE undergrads. Frequent events are organised based on every aspect and interest. Apart from IIT kgp's Kshitij Fest, KIIT Fest is undoubtedly the best on the Eastern side of India. Society is established for every sort of extracurricular activity.

reviews.review_title: Good branch and curriculum. Teachers are helpful and plenty of resources.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package this year was around 30 LPA in ME, and usually JSW, TVS and Maruti Suzuki are the top recruiters. The lowest they offer is around 4 LPA, and the average is somewhere around 8 LPA. Almost all students got internships, and 99 percent got placed. Some went for further studies, and others for GATE, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good libraries and labs are available. Aesthetic places to study and helpful lab assistants. Air-conditioned, Wi-Fi-enabled campuses. My hostel is non-air-conditioned, but some are air-conditioned too. The food is good, with ample choices if you are a non-vegetarian. The wardens are not so great.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are qualified professionals and knowledgeable. The teaching style is great. The curriculum is very good. They always sign MoUs with companies and try to bring industry-relevant subjects and courses. The semester exams are easy, getting an 8 sgpa is not that tough. 99 percent of class passes.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My honest KIIT experience, worth it if you're focused, average placement, good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: As a KIIT student, first of all, I feel it’s an above-average university in India in terms of infrastructure and facilities. The top recruiting company in 2025 was Accenture, which offered around 11 LPA to 285-300 students. There are around 4,000-4,200 students in my batch, with about 50-60 sections. Around 1,000 students got packages of more than 10 LPA. The lowest is around 3-4-5-6 LPA. The average is around 8-8.5 LPA. What I honestly feel is that if someone studies well and maintains a GPA of around 8-9+ while also gaining some industry-level skills to add to their CV, then it’s definitely worth joining KIIT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: KIIT's infrastructure is really good. One issue with the Wi-Fi is that with one’s credentials, only 2 devices can connect. Regarding the quality of food, it’s alright but could be better, it's edible, and the menu changes every week, but the items revolve around the same stuff. Basically, they use some permutations and combinations with the menu. Most of the staff are really cool, but some of the mess staff's attitudes are not good. Regarding medical facilities, we have KIMS, a nice hospital, but it’s very crowded and not that organized. It can be very time-consuming, and there's not a single pull-up bar on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some professors are really helpful, while some are not. Luckily, I got some of the best faculty, and my experience with them was really good. Most of them are from IITs, NITs, and other great universities, and the teaching quality is top-notch, though some are not. Some are very arrogant and can’t explain stuff. They just write stuff on the board. Most of them are nice, however. The course curriculum is relevant, and students are getting industry-ready. Semester exams are easy to moderate; if someone attends 70 percent of classes and studies 1-2 weeks before exams, they will easily get a CGPA of 8.5+.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I love coding. I love the logic behind everything. Fortunately, I got some of the best faculty. Some things I wish would be better are the labs. They are not that good. You have to sit according to your roll numbers. If you are lucky and get a seat in the middle or near the board (instructor), you can follow everything clearly. But if you sit on the end side, you literally can’t see the board. You have to zoom your camera and all. It’s really hard to follow what is being taught.

reviews.review_title: My college review, IT department, for sure we need to improve, but we are doing great, key insights.

detailed_review.Placements: The companies mainly come for placement in the 7 th sem in the 4th year. For the 3rd year, companies start coming after the summer vacation ends at the start of the 5 th sem, in our batch 2027, the 1st company was BNY, Cisco, and Dell. BNY had a 7 CGPA criteria, but the cutoff for Dell was very high, about 9.3 in the IT department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is excellent in our university. From the start of the 5 th semester onwards, the whole school of computer engineering has been shifted to the new campus 25. On campus, 25 majorly 2 and 3rd and 4th year students' classes are held. It is divided into 3 blocks A, B, and C. We have Wi-Fi Labs for our lab classes, and the new library is also present in the C block. The hostel depends on the type of room you want AC or without non AC. Campus 25 has AC premium hostels. Non-AC hostels are kp 6, kp 1.
detailed_review.Faculty: Talking about the curriculum, it is designed to achieve the outcome mentioned in the course objective. It depends on the type of subject you study in your semester, some subjects students enjoy, like DBMS, OS, etc. Other subjects, like ITC for the IT department, it is not a good scoring subject. The end-semester are above average and in the case of DSA and DAA, algorithm-related subjects, the toughness is great, which will make you question whether you really studied anything or not. Majorly all the students who have attended the classes regularly pass the exams.
detailed_review.Other: Talking about the connectivity point, campus 25 is a bit too far from the main campus. But, I am sure that in the near future, necessary arrangements will be made for the students. The network problem is also present in campus 25, which needs to be resolved.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really glad for its first class facilities, infrastructure and greenery campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90 percent students are placed from CSE. The average package offered is 6 LPA, and the highest package offered is 21 LPA. Many companies like Accenture, Infosys, BNY, Meesho, JP Morgan, Philips, Optum, etc., have visited our campus. Almost 50 percent of the students got their internship in the third year itself. Top roles offered are SDE, product manager, business analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are top notch. The environment is a fully greenery campus. We also have high-class classrooms, labs, and high-speed Wi-Fi. The hostel is also very good. We also have IIMS hospital for any kind of medical issue. Sports and games are also really encouraged.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really very helpful and knowledgeable. We are also assigned personal mentors who really help us when we need them. Besides, the course curriculum is really relevant and industry ready. The semester exams are not so hard to pass if you regularly attend classes and study hard. Almost 90 percent students pass their exams.
detailed_review.Other: I am from the Computer Science Engineering batch passing out in 2026. The college society events and especially the fest are really exciting. Besides studies, this college also provides a lot of extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great campus life and placement reality of KIIT University, Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: Although KIIT claims 100 percent placement, many students opt out or join mass recruiting companies, with top recruiters like Amazon, Microsoft, and Flipkart, highest packages around 50–60 LPA mostly off campus, lowest 3–4 LPA, an average of 7–8 LPA, fewer on-campus internships, and common roles such as SDE, web developer, analyst, and consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of KIIT is the best you can get. High-tech classrooms, Wi-Fi and AC in hostels and classrooms, aesthetic libraries are a part of regular life. Research facilities, project opportunities, and exploration in academics have no boundaries for someone who’s eager to learn. Hostels are great, the mess food is above average depending on hostel to hostel. Mess charges are 22.5k per semester, and hostel fee is around 50,000 approximately per semester that includes Wi-Fi, AC, laundry and everything. For medical facilities, we have KIMS which is our own medical college where our checkups are free.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in general and definitely too qualified, as a lot of them are IITians and everyone’s a Ph.D. holder. Teaching quality and marks giving vary from teacher to teacher. The course curriculum is mostly relevant, but a lot of extra subjects are there for no reason, which hinders the actual studies required for placement. Semester exams aren’t that difficult if studied routinely. Everyone passes, and even if they don’t, they are made to appear again to clear backlogs. No year losses.
detailed_review.Other: I am in my 6th Semester B. Tech CSE. Computer Science is a vast subject with a lot of domains. I am getting to know a lot of things on technologies, and given the market, if you have skill in tech you get a nice pay. I wish the course was more placement focused, like AIML, Cybersecurity, Full Stack, SQL, Python, Cloud, which are more industry-based knowledge. We have almost 30 societies, and the fest and extracurricular scene is very strong here. We have crowd from foreign countries as well. The campus surroundings and connectivity are top class.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: KIIT comprehensive review.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90 percent of students get placed. The average package is 6 LPA. The highest package was 52 LPA last year, offered by Yugabyte. A few companies that recruit from campus are Accenture, Cognizant, TCS, Infosys, Deloitte, and Dell. Internships are offered by companies like Dell, JP Morgan, Cisco, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Classrooms, labs, and libraries are well-maintained and great places for studying. Mess food is okayish, canteen food is good, and lots of variety is available. New hostels have games rooms to play TT, chess, carrom, etc. Sports facilities are great here.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is mostly good and helpful. They guide you if they see you're sincere. Semester exams are not that difficult, it is okay. The course curriculum is relevant, a lot of core CSE fundamentals are taught, like OOPJ, can, DBMS, and OS, which are important from a placement perspective.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Balanced choice strong placements modern infrastructure and decent.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements improve provided CGPA is more than 7.5 and attentiveness to aptitude. Many will be placed within IT services with a 5 to 8LPA range but some secure 12 to 20LPA roles, 40 to 50+ LPA are rare. 80 to 85 percent of eligible students receive offers per season. HighRadius Deloitte, Amazon and Yugabyte are some of the top recruiters that came for the placements this year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In CSE we have smart classrooms with air conditioning strong Wi-Fi in labs updated PCs equipped with rides and an extensive digital library. Hostel facilities are clean and offer full day Wi-Fi with quick maintenance and good security.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most professors are pretty qualified and helpful enough although the teaching quality can sometimes vary by course. Mentoring and access to pros are solid. The curriculum is well rounded mix of core CS classes, electives and projects. If you want to prepare for the industry be sure to add some DSA/ dev practice to your plan. The exams are moderate and you will have continuous evaluation too. The passing grade is above 50 percent or grade D.

admission.title: KIIT Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) Bhubaneswar admission 2025 is mainly entrance-based. Also known as KIIT Bhubaneswar, the institution offers over twenty five courses at undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral levels through its 24 schools. The university provides admission to most of the programmes based on KIITEE. KIIT also accepts scores from other examinations for specific programmes. Interested students can go through the following article to learn all about the courses, admission criteria and procedure for KIIT - Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for B.Tech in KIIT Bhubaeswar?
faqs.answer: Course fees in INR along with the application date for various courses at KIIT Bhubaneswar is as follws: B.Tech 3.5 Lakhs (1st Yr Fees) 9 Nov - 24 Jun 2024 MBA 6.15 Lakhs (1st Yr Fees) 19 Mar - 24 Jun 2024 BBA 1.39 Lakhs (1st Yr Fees) 9 Nov - 24 Jun 2024 BCA 1.92 Lakhs (1st Yr Fees) 19 Mar - 24 Jun 2024

faqs.question: How many seats does KIIT offer for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: KIIT offers BTech as one of its popular programmes, offered as 3-5 years of a full-time course, depending on the specialisation opted for. It provides 700+ seats for Computer Engineering and 300+ seats for Mechanical Engineering and Electronics Engineering. Apart from these, the Institute offers 100+ seats in Civil Engineering and Electrical Engineering and 50+ seats in Biotechnology and Chemical Technology.

faqs.question: Can I join KIIT Bhubaeswar without KIITEE for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot join KIIT Bhubaneswar for B.Tech without appearing for KIITEE (Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology Entrance Examination). The eligibility criteria for B.Tech courses at KIIT University require candidates to have a valid rank in KIITEE. Candidates who have passed the 10+2 examination in 2022, 2023, or are appearing in the 10+2 examination in 2024 are eligible to apply for the B.Tech course at KIIT University. In addition you can check the official website.

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by KIIT Bhubaeswar for admission MBA?
faqs.answer: KIIT Bhubaneswar accepts the following entrance exam scores for admission to its MBA program: KIITEE MGT, CMAT, CAT, MAT, XAT, GMAT, and ATMA.

faqs.question: What is the latest cutoff information for admission to MBA at KIIT Bhubaeswar?
faqs.answer: The cutoff for the 2023 MBA course at KIIT School of Management (KSOM) based on CMAT for general category students is 80 percentile. The CAT 2023 results are declared on December 21,  2023. KIIT School of Management Cutoff 2023,  2022,  2021,  2020,  2019 Candidates seeking admission are required to meet the cutoff criteria of the institute. The institute is yet to release the KIIT School of Management CAT cutoff. KSOM cutoff 2023 of the MBA course based on CMAT for general category students is 80 percentile. The CAT 2023 results are declared on December 21,  2023. Students can apply to KSOM with a valid score from the relevant admission year. For example, CAT-2023 or XAT-2024 score can only be used for 2024 MBA Super MBA Admiss ion.

faqs.question: How can candidates join KIIT School of Management, Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology?
faqs.answer: KIIT University offers UG, PG, and Research programs in various disciplines through its different schools. For UG and PG courses admissions at KIIT, candidates are required to appear for the KIITEE examination and participate in the counseling for final seat allotments. KIITEE is conducted by KIIT University for admission to B.Tech, MBA, BBA, BCA, and other UG and PG courses. The minimum eligibility criteria for B.Tech is 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics/ Biology with 60% marks in aggregate. For B.Arch program,  10+2 (60%) with Mathematics as the main subject is mandatory. KIIT conducts KIITEE to offer admission in B.Tech course followed by counselling. B.Arch admission is based on a valid score in NATA . Final admission is confirmed through counselling. KIIT also offers admission to B.Tech+M.Tech (Integrated)/ B.Tech+MBA (Dual Degree) and B.Tech (Lateral Entry) on the basis of performance in KIITEE followed by coiunselling.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for admission to BBA programme at KIIT?
faqs.answer: For admission to the BBA programme at KIIT, candidates must have completed Class 12 in any stream or equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate and having Mathematics/ Business Mathematics/ Economics/ Statistics as one of the subjects in Class 12. Also, the candidates need to qualify, KIITEE entrance.

faqs.question: What is the fees for PG courses at KIIT Bhubaeswar?
faqs.answer: The Kalinga Institute of Industrial Technology (KIIT) in Bhubaneswar, India offers PG courses with tuition fees ranging from INR 3.84 Lakhs to INR 5.95 lakhs. The hostel fee includes: Non-AC two-bedded rooms: INR 38,000 per semester. Three-bedded (non-AC): INR 28,000 per semester. Single-bedded (AC): INR 65,000 per semester. Two-bedded (AC): INR 60,000 per semester.

faqs.question: What are the various courses offered at KIIT?
faqs.answer: KIIT Bhubaneswar offers courses in UG, PG and Diploma levels with specialisations in streams such as Computer Applications, Computer Engineering, Civil Engineering, Architecture and Planning, Design, Law, Management, Rural Management, etc. KIIT offers BTech, BSc, Dual Degrees, PhD, B.Arch, MDes, MBA and many more in full-time mode through various Schools of study.

faqs.question: What are the popular courses in KIIT?
faqs.answer: KIIT offers BTech, MSc and MBA as popular programmes in full-time mode for 2-5 years , depending on the course opted for. Students can opt for the KIIT BTech course with a tuition fee of INR 3.8 Lakh- INR 19 Lakh and seek admission through the eligibility criteria of achieving 60% in 10+2 and qualifying KIITEE, JEE Main, and other suggested exams by the Institute. KIIT offers an MSc with a tuition fee of INR 3.6 Lakh- INR 6 Lakh and an MBA with a tuition fee of INR 3.5 Lakh- INR 10.3 Lakh . The eligibility criteria for MSc covers graduation marks of 50% - 60% along with the scores of KIITEE.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
KIIT central library has successfully built up a comprehensive collection of over 
6,83,616 books covering different branches of knowledge. Besides, there are also more than 1,27,541 books available in electronic form covering varied subjects.The library subscribes to 718 print journals (both Indian and Foreign) specific to the academic and research needs of the academic community of the university. reviews.review_title: It has good infrastructure and a good course curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 35% of students from our course get placed through campus recruitment drives. The highest package offered is 8 LPA, reflecting strong technical roles. The lowest package is 1 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Dell and Coforge, which hire students for technical support roles. Approximately 70 percent of students secure internships. The most common role offered is IT technician.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained infrastructure with Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. It has properly equipped computer labs, and a well-stocked library that supports academic learning. Hostel facilities are good, with clean rooms. It also has decent mess and canteen food. Along with adequate medical support, and access to sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The overall teaching quality is satisfactory. However, a few faculty members lack in-depth subject knowledge. The course curriculum is relevant. It provides a good foundation, but students need to develop additional technical skills on their own to become industry-ready. Semester exams are not very difficult. The pass percentage is generally high.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this because of my interest in the IT field and the career opportunities it offers. The best things of the course are its basic technical foundation, supportive environment, and exposure to practical subjects. The course could be improved by updating the curriculum. The college organizes events and fests often, but sometimes they get cancelled at the last moment.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Average opinion about the college.

detailed_review.Placements: Out of 11 students interested in placements, 3 have been successfully placed through campus placements. The highest package till now is 7.5 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course include BSES, Vanderlande, Schlumberger, Kirloskar Oil Engines, and LiuGong. 50 percent of students got internships through college support in companies like Dixon Technologies Ltd. and Nuremberg Ltd. Top roles offered include graduate engineer trainee and associate sales engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi does not work properly. Labs are well-equipped with all the necessary infrastructure and machines. Classrooms are a bit messy. The library is well-equipped with good infrastructure and books. I found the mess quite hygienic, but the taste of the food is not up to the mark. Sports facilities and grounds are average, with nothing special.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, though the teaching quality is average. The course curriculum is relevant and helps make students industry-ready. Semester exams are easy if you study well and difficult if you do not. All questions are asked from PPTs and topics taught in class, with nothing outside the syllabus. The pass percentage is 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am interested in electrical subjects. The best thing about my course is that it provides detailed knowledge of electrical concepts. I wish the curriculum are more engaging through PPTs, animations, and reduced rote learning. There are many events and fests on campus, such as Amity Youth Fest. The campus crowd is good, and students are helpful, though opinions may vary. Connectivity is good, as the campus is located in a prime area of Noida and is surrounded by many offices.

reviews.review_title: Great campus and teachers but dissatisfied with labs and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package of 3 LPA can be expected. Only one company comes here that offers 8 LPA, but it takes 2 to 3 students only rest all are placed at the above mentioned package. The company comes, and you will give interview and sometimes they are online as well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amity is best in terms of infrastructure, classrooms and library but lab in the pharmacy department definitely needs an upgrade. They are really good in other departments like biotechnology or chemistry, etc. The classroom teaching takes place with a projector and ppts are provided as notes. Hostels are available but the cost is very high and food is not included in the hostel fee and rooms are small as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here have high knowledge and skills. The curriculum is completely as per the pci norms but 2 additional courses, which are foreign language and behaviour skills, are extra. The exam difficulty is average and the passing percentage is 50 percent.
detailed_review.Other: Its a multidimensional course that you can enter into any pharma domain if you have done Masters from pharmaceutics. I will love it if there are more paid internship opportunities and better lab facilities. The event, fest, campus, crowd and connectivity is awesome, which you will surely like.

reviews.review_title: My college's placement section must be improved.

detailed_review.Placements: As a student of the University of Lucknow, I would like to share that my college is better than private institutes. The percentage of students who get placed every year in my course is very high compared to private colleges. The highest package offered is 12 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available in my course are Wi-Fi, classrooms, labs, grounds, washrooms, etc. Facilities are very good according to the fees taken from students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers of my course are very cooperative towards their students. Semester examinations are not that difficult for regular students of my college.

reviews.review_title: Great teaching staff and student diversity.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 30% students got placements in my department, with the highest package being 5 LPA, the lowest being 2 LPA, and the average being 3-4 LPA. The top recruiting companies were Dhanuka, Coromandel, and DeHaat. We got internships from PCF Agritech, Dhanuka, and KrishiJagran. The top roles offered are mainly sales, marketing, and research.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department has 2 labs dedicated for agricultural research. The classrooms are big enough for 50-60 students. We have a big library in our university. We have Wi-Fi facilities seperate for both students and teachers. Hostels are of good quality and the food offered in the canteen is clean and tasty. We do have a medical block and the facilities are pretty average. We have a big sports ground with equipments for various sports and games, and the quality of these equipments are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have very qualified and knowledgeable teachers in our department, and their quality of teaching is great. The course content is also up-to-date and valuable for our careers. The difficulty of the semester exams depends on the subjects, but generally they are not too hard. The pass percentage is 35%.
detailed_review.Other: The facilities in our department specifically could've been improved, like the washrooms and the quality of the labs.

reviews.review_title: Great faculty and labs, but average facilities and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: My course is not the kind where you get placed after B.Sc.. It's a research-oriented field, and from that point of view, our faculty and department provide us with ample backing and opportunities. As our faculty are already researchers themselves, we get the bonus advantage of gaining experience by joining their research projects.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our classrooms can definitely use an upgrade. Some of the chairs in our class are broken. The Wi-Fi does not work all the time. The fans and their switches are a little too messed up. The library is excellent infrastructure-wise, but there are barely any books from my syllabus. The labs are extremely well-maintained and ideal for research. The quality of food, however, could use improvement. Sports and games are all great. Medical facilities are also pretty good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are definitely qualified and knowledgeable in their fields. However, their teaching style can be hard to cope with considering they are researchers. Most of the faculty are open to criticism and willing to work with students to solve any kind of issue. The course curriculum, for the most part, is helpful. However, the course flow could be better. Exams depend on the teachers, they can be pretty hard and expected, as well as predictable and easy, depending on the teacher.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about the course is the faculty and the facilities provided by the department, like the labs. So far, things are pretty fresh. Department-wise, things are great for the most part. However, the events feel very low-key for a university this big. Our university-level freshers are conducted as if it is some coveted secret event, allowing only CRs and Department Mr. and Ms. Freshers to attend. That is incredibly disappointing, to say the least.

highlights.summary:
The IIIT Hyderabad full form stands for International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad and was first founded in 1998 as a not-for-profit public-private partnership (N-PPP). IIIT Hyderabad Gachibowli is the first IIIT set up in the country under the N-PPP model and has since become a well-known higher education institution of National Importance, receiving an ‘A++’ Grade accreditation from the NAAC.
The latest International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad ranking information has been released by the 2025 QS rankings standing at the 601-650 rank (QS WUR Ranking By Subject) (Computer Science and Information Systems). Other important rankings of IIIT Telangana include 89th (Overall category - NIRF 2025), 55th (NIRF 2025- University category), and 38th (NIRF 2025 - Engineering category).
IIIT Hyderabad courses are extended at the UG, PG, and PhD levels with its BTech and MTech courses being the flagship programmes and are majorly preferred by students during the course choice/selections. Students also have options for Dual Degree (BTech & MSc) and Part-Time (PG courses) modes of learning. These courses have been recognised/approved by national bodies such as the UGC and AICTE.
Further, International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT Hyderabad) features over 20 domain and applied research centres. Nine of every 10 International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad alumni work in Product Architecture, ICT Research, Design, or Development at top-notch Information Technology companies worldwide. detailed_review.Placements: IIIT Hyderabad consistently records excellent placements, as 95-99 percent of students get placed each year. detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good and is not short on anything. Keeping in mind the shortage of space in the college, there might be a few luxuries missing. The campus has very small-sized hostels, so they might be congested. We have rooms called workplaces where most students spend their time.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and teaching assistants are very helpful and approachable. There are tests on a regular basis. Tests are kind of a difficult level, and not just that, the previous year or the most probable questions are repeated. Lab subjects also have a rigorous curriculum.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Completely satisfied with studies, but not about entertainment.

detailed_review.Placements: About 97% of students were placed in my course, with the highest being 74 LPA and the lowest being 12 LPA, with an average of 27 LPA. Some of the top companies include Amazon, Qualcomm, and Google. Almost everybody in our course got the internship; it is somewhere around 99%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is a wonderful college when it comes to labs and a library with a very good infrastructure, and there will be 24/7 availability of Wi-Fi. When it comes to the hostel, we were triple sharing, so it will be somewhat uncomfortable. The quality of food will be good, and sports are compulsory on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, and there can be no doubt about teaching, and the courses are definitely relevant, and which also makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are a bit tougher, but most of the students pass the courses; almost 95-98% of students pass the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science + M.S. (by Research) in Computational Natural Science
reviews.review_title: Overall satisfied with faculty and infrastructure. Placements are good.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, i.e, 2025, 100% of registered students are placed. The highest package is 18 LPA, the lowest is 12 LPA, and the average is 15 LPA. Many of the students got PPOs, which are not considered in official placement states. These include companies like Uber, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, and Google.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have CCNSB labs dedicated to CND research. Most of the classrooms have AC, but hostels do not. Wi-Fi is all over the classes and labs. Hostels are provided with LAN support. Food quality is good in all four of the messes available. Recently, 2 of the messes, North mess and South mess, were combined and are called Palash mess. Sports are mandatory for the first 4 semesters for all branches.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable in terms of the lectures they teach. They do respond to our emails. Every Semester has 4 exams in total, quiz-1, mid-sem, quiz-2, and the end-sem. Quizzes carry a lower percentage in total, followed by mid-sems and end-sems. Exams are pretty challenging. Most of the courses are graded relatively, so relative performance over others matters the most.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science + M.S. (by Research) in Computational Natural Science
reviews.review_title: One of the best decisions you can take.

detailed_review.Placements: At least 70% of students got placed. Nearly 40 LPA is the package offered. Many students go abroad to pursue higher studies. Many students got an internship. Some individuals got to CERN too. You can work as a TA to earn money in your third year or above, too. For the CND course, recruiters sometimes have a science background too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available for first-year students, but it is not available or is poor. The bathrooms are clean, but we have to triple share a single room. Mess food is as expected. Nothing out of the ordinary is manageable, but since there are four messes in IIITH. There are options for everyone. Jains included.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers, tho fast-paced, are extremely well qualified and strict about punctuality and attendance. The course curriculum is very much relevant. The exams, on the other hand, are stressful and difficult, keep this in mind. The peers competing with each other for a grade are top-notch and clever. The pass percentage is uncertain and depends on the course, but it shouldn't be that hard if you pay attention in class.

reviews.course: M.S. by Research in IT in Building Science
reviews.review_title: It provided good placements in 2024 as well as 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college offers courses like B.Tech in Computer Science, Master's in Data Science, and MS in Research. Many students from the UG background will get internships in top companies, and it is somewhat difficult in some areas like a master of science in data science. The course structure is not aligned properly, which causes students to face trouble during placements. Furthermore, courses in B.Tech and M.Tech are good. It can be recommended if anyone is interested in technical skills and would like to do hard work to get a good job.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is good. The food facilities are also divided widely with 4 mess partitions. Hygiene is something that is not fully satisfactory, but compared to other institutions, this place is very clean and serves moderately tasty food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Everyone has to prepare their own strategies, even though we have faculty members to ask for help. There are every one who can help us at any time with our academics. Faculty helps us to understand and clear doubts. Exams are not very stressful but require effort. The MSIT course structure is not good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very satisfied because of curriculum, electives, opportunities, clubs, and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 97% students placed in our electronics and communications engineering batch. Highest package is 36 LPA, and lowest package is 12.36 LPA based on 2024-2025 placements. Qualcomm, Nvidia, Texas Instruments, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Uber, Samsung, Amazon, and Oracle are recruiters. At least 40-50 % students got internships during their course. Roles offered are Analog and Digital Design Engineer, RTL and VLSI engineer, machine learning engineer, SDE, SWE, hardware and embedded systems engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Well-equipped and AC classes, and many computer labs. Students can spend considerable time in labs and research centers. Adaptable timetable and many open electives, and only 4-5 hours of academic sessions. Fascinating library sources, 20-hour library. Currently, 2025 has 3 messes, Palash, Yukthar, and Kadamba. Sports there need a requirement that every student must complete 4 sports credits per semester, one credit, and also includes many sports like yoga, martial arts, badminton, basketball, and football. Food quality was very reasonable, price, and flexible meal locations. Medico, Aarogya Center for basic and emergency needs.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Exams are relatively difficult, but not much. Teachers are very well qualified, certified, and fully experienced and knowledgeable. 
Curriculum makes students super freakin perfectly industry-ready.
Pass percentage is above 90% most of the time. Research centers like SERC, CVest, CVit, SPRC, and many more.
detailed_review.Other: Best thing is curriculum and open-ended college sources. Infrastructure and alumni connections need to improve. Many events take place, with almost 50+ events and fests taking place yearly. Many sports tournaments are held, and campus surroundings are very decent, and a nearby stadium is also there. I chose this course because I'm interested in electronics and computer Science. IIITH provides college pay-forward loans for low-income students called alumni fund. Currently, IIITH has helped me a lot and given me an alumni fund. Now I'm paying zero rupees for studying. After getting a job in 3 years' time, I need to pay for that duration.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.S. (by Research) in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has good placements, infrastructure, facilities, and location. There is a hectic schedule.

detailed_review.Placements: As far as I know, placements at IIIT Hyderabad are very good. I have seen my seniors who are currently getting passed out going into good companies like Apple, Rubrik, Allegro, etc. Top recruiting companies are Texas Instruments, Nvidia, Allegro, Qualcomm, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are excellent. We have a library, a reading room, well-maintained workplaces and labs. Free college Wi-Fi is available on campus except in hostels and mess. In hostels, ethernet ports are provided but not Wi-Fi which is also good. The mess food quality is good, and there are various choices among the four different messes for each meal. There are canteens all across the campus which remain open from 10 AM until 2 AM. There is a medical facility inside campus only with basic medicines and an ambulance for an emergency.
detailed_review.Faculty: All professors are from an excellent background and have published good works in their domain. The course curriculum of IIIT Hyderabad is updated to the latest and one year ahead of other colleges. Many courses provide knowledge relevant to the industry, internships, and placements. The toughness of courses and exams depends on the professor teaching that course, and it is the same for the pass percentage. The grading is done relatively among students. There is no fixed pass percentage but we should maintain a minimum of 5.5 CGPA as per college policy.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIITH- the best college.

detailed_review.Placements:
100 percent of students who sat for placements got placed. The highest package was 88 LPA.
Average was 30 LPA.
Minimum was 11 LPA.
Recruiting companies are Google, Apple, Goldman Sachs, and Intel.
Top roles include assistant project manager, etc.
100 percent of students get internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:

Medical facilities like ambulances are always present.
Sports and games are compulsory for all students.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Faculty is the best of the best in their field of expertise.
Teaching quality is top-notch.
The curriculum is always changing to keep up with the world's ever-changing needs.
Students are made more than industry ready.
The semester exams are very hard, and passing is usually 35 to 40 percent.

reviews.course: M.S. by Research in IT in Building Science
reviews.review_title: Great Infrastructure and Facilities

detailed_review.Placements: 90 percent of students get placed in our course. The highest package is 40 Lacs and the lowest is 8 Lacs. Companies like Google, American Express, RedFox, and TCS are top recruiters. 100 percent of students secure internships in roles such as Data Scientist, Software Engineer, and Software Developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college facilities are excellent, with the entire campus covered by Wi-Fi accessible to all students. We have a large library and various labs for different courses. Both boys' and girls' hostels provide LAN connections in the rooms, and study tables are available to facilitate studying.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers in our college are mostly Ph.D. holders in their respective fields. The course curriculum is rigorous and designed to prepare students for high-paying jobs. The difficulty level is moderate, with a pass percentage of 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I wanted to secure a high-paying job and gain practical experience. I believe the course is well-designed and doesn’t need any improvements at the moment. Every year, in February, we have a fest based on various streams.

reviews.course: B.Tech.+ M.S. (by Research) in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience at IIIT Hyderabad.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements at IIIT Hyderabad are excellent, with the highest package of 46 LPA in my course and in B. Teach computer science and engineering is 74 LPA. The average package in my course is 30 LPA. And the percentage of students who got placed in my course is 100 percent. The top recruiting companies are Adobe, Alpha Grep, Amazon, Apple, Deloitte, Bloomberg, Jio, Microsoft, Samsung, Google, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is just awesome with all the requirements. In the central library, all study materials are available for all semesters, and all books are available. Classrooms and labs are equipped with smart boards, and unlimited Wi-Fi facilities are available throughout the campus. There are many grounds for sports like cricket, football, volleyball, and basketball. The quality of the food in the mess is good and hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty were very experienced and very friendly with all students; they taught us in a unique way so we could easily catch it. They are highly qualified to teach us. My course is curriculum relevant and they make us ready to the current industry. For each semester, there are mid-semester, end-semester, quizzes, and lots of assignments will be given. We have to study hard to pass the semester Each semester will include a midterm and an endterm, as well as quizzes and numerous assignments. The pass percentage is 50 percent.
detailed_review.Other: The campus life is great because it has all the required facilities. I have left the top NITs and chosen this college because it has the best placements. There is nothing changing. There are many extracurricular activities like sports, events, festivals, and clubs. Connectivity is also good because transportation is easily available. Scholarships are also available, so we can pay our fee easily.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Exceptional learning place for students.

detailed_review.Placements:
100% of students were placed. The highest package is 70 crores, the lowest is 10 crores, the average is 30 crores, and international offers were also given.
Apple, Google, Traceable AI, Rubrik, Oracle, Goldman Sachs, etc. and many more startups like sprinklr, plivo, come here for placements.
60% is the internship rate.
Software developer, product Engineer, Data scientist are the top roles offered.

detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified researchers. Our college mainly focuses on research development of software or in any Science field. Semester schedule is fully occupied with quizzes, mid exams, end exams, projects and tons of assignments with other club activities like OSDG and hacking etc.
detailed_review.Other: One of the top colleges in India, it has the best CSE curriculum. Good fest culture is there.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.S. (by Research) in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am highly satisfied with this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 100% of students got placed in our course. The top recruiters are FAANG companies, and software roles are offered to the students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. We have spacious classrooms. Laboratory is well-maintained. Sports facilities are also good. LAN is also provided in every classroom. It provides a good library. Our campus is Wi-Fi-enabled. Canteen facility is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. All of them are Ph.D. scholars, so we can expect good quality teaching. Our course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for this course because it is a dual degree program that gives both B.Tech and MS in 5 years.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college teaches us many things to be balanced in life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at IIIT Hyderabad are phenomenal. Due to the strictly implemented anti-plagiarism policy, students have their skill set and in-depth understanding of various subjects. Many companies offer great salary packages to students. Every year, FAANG recruits more than 20 students from our college. The placement drive in IIIT is fair compared to other IITs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. Sports facilities are few. Workshops are available 24X7 in our college. The campus is safe. Hostels are well-maintained and are well-equipped with gyms and exercise areas. There is a vending machine in each hostel to fulfill daily requirements.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are qualified from reputed foreign universities. Their main focus is on the world-class research that students have to offer. Many teachers believe in keeping their courses flexible. Core CS subjects are from 1st year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great option to choose Computer Science and Engineering .

detailed_review.Placements: While writing this review I'm in my 3rd year and college will not encourage internships. So, there is no on-campus internship drive. But placements are official in our college which happens after 4-1. Last year it was 100% in placements. Last year, the highest package was 74 LPA and the lowest package was 18 LPA. One of the top recruiting companies is Google. It takes more students every year. The top roles offered in our course depends on what field we choose in our electives. It includes AI, ML, Computer Graphics, Game design, Entrepreneur ship, and many more. We can choose more than one of them as well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities in the college area are good. Wi-Fi speed will be around 100Mbps, rooms are fully equipped with AC's. The library contains various books in all fields including story and magazines. There are workplaces as well. Hostel facilities aren't that good though, but they can be resolved when we talk with hostel administration. There are around 5 canteens in IIIT which provide different types of food. Among them, one is a health canteen, which provides healthy food. There is aarogya center which provides basic medication and there is a 24/7 ambulance facility for emergency cases. Apart from studies, there are many sports facilities which includes football ground, basketball court, volleyball court, cricket ground, Lawn tennis, badminton and many indoor games like Table tennis, Pool, Carrom, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are very helpful. They will be very friendly with students and also provides guidance regarding our career. They mainly help in our research if we are interested. Many courses help us to work for companies. Design and analysis of software systems is a course where we directly work for a company as a part of our course project which helps in gaining real time experience. Semesters are slightly hectic. There are 2 quizzes, one mid semester, and one end semester exams. But these can be managed with the help of friendly seniors.
detailed_review.Other: During my counselling, I got IIT Bhubaneswar CSE and IIIT Hyderabad CSE among them I chose IIIT. Because at the beginning what I came to know was there a good coding culture in this college which is true and also placements were good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure. Top class facilities and pros of IIIT Hyderabad.

They give the pre placement training that helps to get the job easily and take the highest package and enjoy the life. You will enjoy the rest of your life with luxury.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In hostel, you will be provided with bed, chair, study table and a cupboard.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were helpful, qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality was mind blowing as they were experienced professor. This course curriculum is relevant and it make the students industry ready. The semester exams in this college is average. You can clear the examination with good ranks if you concentrate in study.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good college with good teaching and placements but has bad equipment.

Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Texas Instruments, abode, and Goldman Sachs. Almost all got an internship in our course as software engineers and some core jobs.

Hostel rooms are good but washrooms are pretty bad, they are cleaned every day. The mess has four different types of foods available north, south, kadhamb, and yuktahar. Extracurricular activities are okay in IIIT Hyderabad.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering

The majority of students will pass, but due to a few circumstances, some may fail a course and retake it the following year/semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering

The semester exams are of moderate difficulty, and with enough effort, it is easy to get an A. Labs are a great place for one to explore their interest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best in placements, faculty, but not that good for whom were much interested in sports activities.

Events are almost running once per week or something, the fest will be once a year and reaches good, campus crowd is too low, at max 1800 will be there in this college, campus surroundings are the best which we would get, all the things are available in this locality.

admission.title: IIIT Hyderabad Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
IIIT Hyderabad admission 2025 session will start with the registration of JEE Main. IIIT Hyderabad admission is completely entrance-based for the majority of the programmes. Candidates seeking admission must apply online on the official website. IIIT Hyderabad admission for BTech programmes is done basis of JEE Main score/ Olympiad (KVPY) or through SPEC (Special Channel of Admission). Further, admission to Dual BTech programmes at IIIT Hyderabad is subject to UGEE (Undergraduate Entrance Exam) and LEEE (Lateral Entry Entrance Exam), Direct Admissions for Students Abroad (DASA) or scores in Class 12 boards. In addition to these courses, IIIT Hyderabad also offers MTech, MS by Research, MPhil and PhD programmes along with a few courses, namely MSIT and PGSSP courses at PG and doctoral levels. For all these courses, admission is also entrance-based.

Aspirants of the IIIT-H courses can check out the following video:

Select the MTech course candidates are interested in & provide accurate information. 3. Submit the fee registration. 4. The merit list of students will be released acc to their scores.

faqs.question: Is it expensive to study BTech at IIIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: IIIT Hyderabad offers the flagship Bachelor of Technology (BTech) programme in a variety of specializations. The course is a popular programme for students seeking to build a career in Engineering. The total tuition fees for International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad BTech is INR 10 L - 18 L. Students can also check out the various scholarship schemes offered by IIIT Hyderabad.

faqs.question: Can I get a call from IIIT Hyderabad with 150 rank in UGEE?
faqs.answer: To get admission into integrated BTech courses at IIIT Hyderabad, candidate must qualify the UGEE and attain the required cutoff. The last-round closing ranks for the General AI category for admission varied between 53 and 200 . Therefore, it is possible for the General All India category candidates to get admission to the institute at 150 rank. faqs.question: What is the fee for PhD at IIIT Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: The semester-wise fee for PhD is INR 75,000. Additionally, the deemed university provides financial assistance towards the tuition fees and stipend to all research students (PhD) of good standing. Normally, full financial assistance requires the student to put in 20 hours of work per week. Financial assistance is provided to all the students during the first semester, but it is continued based on good academic performance.

faqs.question: Does IIIT Hyderabad offer any part-time courses?
faqs.answer: Yes, IIIT Hyderabad offers part-time courses as well. The professionals are encouraged by the institute to enroll in the PG programmes on a part-time basis also. IIIT Hyderabad also offers MTech, MS by Research, MPhil and PhD programmes along with a few courses, namely MSIT and PGSSP courses at PG and doctoral levels. For all these courses, admission is also entrance-based. In addition to these part-time courses, IIIT Hyderabad offers degree programmes to its aspirants at UG, PG and doctorate (PhD) levels. IIIT Hyderabad admission is entrance-based for all these full-time programmes. Candidates seeking admission must apply online on the official website and the offerd courses include MTech, MS by Research, MPhil and PhD programmes.

faqs.question: How many round of IIIT Hyderabad BTech counselling are expected to be conducted?
faqs.answer: The exact number of counselling rounds for IIIT Hyderabad BTech admissions do vary slightly from year to year. However, we can expect around four rounds. These rounds have different processes including allocation of seats based on merits, consideration of JEE Mains scores and UGEE scores. Vacant seats are offered to other eligible candidates who could not get admission due to various reasons. More rounds means lower cut-off scores required.

faqs.question: Is JEE Mains compulsory for admission to BTech at International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad?
