sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIIT Hyderabad infrastructure is well-equipped with all the basic amenities, including hostels, air-conditioned computer laboratories , and a library , among others. The campus is properly monitored by 24-hour security at the hostels, main gate, and all academic and other buildings. The IIIT Hyderabad campus is located on Gachibowli Road (Old Bombay Highway) and is very well connected by various means of transport. It also features additional facilities such as sports, a mess, and a gymnasium with a physical trainer. Furthermore, there is a dedicated yoga room with a trained instructor to guide students in enhancing their mental and physical health. The IIIT Hyderabad campus includes three separate canteens for vegetarians and one non-vegetarian mess (Kadamb) for non-vegetarian students.
Check out more on IIIT Hyderabad Infrastructure in the video below:

tables.IIIT Hyderabad Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Auditorium, Research centres, Medical services, etc.

sections.heading: IIIT Hyderabad Hostel Facilities
text: IIIT Hyderabad is a residential institute, meaning all admitted students must reside on campus. The IIIT Hyderabad hostel is separate for girls and boys. There are a total of five on-campus hostel facilities, of which three are dedicated to boys and two are allocated to girls. There is a single entry and exit point for the hostel, ensuring that the safety and security of the students are never compromised. The hostel campus is under 24-hour CCTV surveillance. Surrounded by lush green trees, the campus features a perfect pathway for an evening walk, providing a break from studying and helping students to relax. The hostels are supervised by wardens and the hostel in-charge to maintain discipline on campus.

The hostel rooms are spacious and come with basic furnishings, including beds, study tables, chairs, and wardrobes . The hostels generally offer single, double, and triple occupancy rooms on a sharing basis. On-campus facilities include a bank extension counter, an ATM, a stationery shop , and laundry services . The institute has three vegetarian ( North, South, and Yuktahar ) messes and one non-vegetarian ( Kadamb ) canteen, with Kadamb serving non-vegetarian meals five times a week. Some of the on-campus hostel facilities are listed below:
State Bank of India branch
For more details, watch the video below:

sections.heading: IIIT Hyderabad Library &Workspace
text: The International Institute of Information Technology - Hyderabad (IIIT-H) has a library facility for students. It has a rich collection of textbooks, reference books, thesis, dissertations, etc. The library has a strict rule to avail the services. No student is allowed to use the library services without their ID card. Personal books, printed books, and printed materials are not allowed inside the Library. IIIT Hyderabad library has a new reading room for students. It also has a stack area-cum-reading space where students can bring their books to study. There are a total of five library staff and four Library Committee members to manage the work load. A detailed number-wise break-up of Print Journals / Magazines, etc., availble at the institute library are tabulated below:

The institute also has a new workspace that can accommodate up to 200 students at one time. This workspace is designed keeping in mind all the modern facilities such as ergonomic chairs and desks , discussion rooms , whiteboards , etc. The space is designed for students so that they can work in a quiet and focused environment. IIIT-H has an additional two new teaching labs that are equipped with projectors, TV screens, and theater-style seating with a capacity to accommodate a total number of 100 students.

sections.heading: IIIT HyderabadSports Facilities
text: The International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad (IIIT-H) also encourages multiple sports for the holistic development of the students. The institute offers several indoor as well as outdoor games, ranging from cricket, volleyball, and soccer to basketball, table tennis , etc. IIITH also has an understanding with nearby stadiums for other sports facilities such as badminton, hockey, swimming , etc. IIIT Hyderabad also provides a gym and a yoga room to the students for their better mental and physical health. For girl students, a mini gym is also available inside the girls' hostel campus.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the IIIT HyderabadCampus
text: The International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIITH), has a very well-located campus. Students studying at IIIT Hyderabad can explore multiple nearby places such as Charminar, Golconda Fort, Birla Mandir, Osman Sagar Lake, Qutb Shahi Tombs , etc. These are some of the popular tourist attractions of HITEC City. The institute is surrounded by many academic and research institutions, including Hyderabad Central University , Indian School of Business (ISB), TCS-CMC, Indian Immunologicals and Jawaharlal Nehru Institute of Development Banking (JNIDB), and is just minutes away from the bustling HiTech City Center and Lingampally.

highlights.summary:
Indian Institute of Bhubaneswar was established in Bhubaneswar, Odisha and is one of the premier engineering institutions of the region with various national such as the NIRF 2025 ranked IITB as 80th and 39th under the Overall and Engineering categories respectively.
Furthermore, the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bhubaneswar is ranked by several international organisations. It ranks between 951-1000 by QS World University Rankings 2026 in the University category.
The establishment year of IIT Bhubaneswar was is 2008. It was formed by the Government of India. It is one of the eight new IITs. The institute offers UG, PG, and PhD courses through seven schools of study. The flagship course at IIT Bhubaneswar is BTech. IIT Bhubaneswar BTech cutoff is generally most competitive for the CSE branch. The highest package offered to BTech students during the IIT Bhubaneswar placements 2024 was INR 64 LPA. IIT Bhubaneswar course admissions are entrance-based. The institute accepts JEE Advanced scores for admission to its BTech programme.
IIT Bhubaneswar has signed 5 MOUs that help in student exchange programmes, the exchange of scholarly and pedagogical materials, the coordination of collaborative research programmes, joint workshops and conferences, and facilitating student internships and entrepreneurship. The institute receives support from sister institutions like IMMT (a CSIR institution) and Central Tool Room & Training Centre Bhubaneswar for additional workshops and laboratory facilities. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering + M.Tech. in Environmental Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very unique course and worthy in IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: The student can sit in placement in the last year of the course. Campus hiring is really good, with companies like Google, Accenture, Oracle, and Rippling also coming to the campus and offering good packages to students. Recently, Oracle offered 64 LPA packages, and the average package is around 12 LPA to 15 LPA. The internship opportunities are really good and join an internship in the third year of your course. Many companies are invited to the campus for hiring interns. Recently, companies like Google, Nvidia, and Rippling came to campus and provided up to Rs. 1,00,000 per month stipend.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a good library maintaining most of the books that are required throughout the course, and a lot of general books. The library keeps updating itself frequently. The classrooms are very good and equipped with modern technology like smart boards, projectors, and the laboratories are equipped with fully functional equipment. All the students must reside within the IIT campus. The room is a single accommodation, and for students opting for post-graduation, there are Sangam hostels where they can stay with their spouse.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is really good and teachers basic aspects of civil engineering. The contact hours are well distributed, so the pressure of studies is not too much. The exams are twice a semester, and the difficulty level is moderate to high. The faculty student ratio is really good and since the appointment of the new director, it has been increasing, and more and more faculty are being hired. All faculty are highly qualified, some of them are from IIT, and others are from foreign institutes.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: A dream college to explore.

detailed_review.Placements: IITs offer a very good package actually. Being a second generation IIT, our college is growing day by day. Our professors are working very hard to improve the placement activities. Although it is not that much bad. The average package in our college is more than 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My campus life at IIT Bhubaneswar is going very well. We have a very good infrastructure. Classrooms have centralized AC, and we get single-occupancy rooms in the hostel. Apart from all the things, the hostel facility is little bit not good on our campus. The mess caterers are good enough. They provide us different kinds of foods everyday but few times we encounter insects and caterpillars in our mess food. Library is good, and it is always open.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum needs to change so that I can take my interested course. It is all taken care of by institutions. In IITs, classes will be very less and they should be on their own most of the basics. More examples should be provided and lab equipment should be improved. Faculty members are good. They are highly educated and experienced. They all have done their masters and Ph.D.

reviews.review_title: It is a very good college where dreams start.

detailed_review.Placements: From seventh semester, students are eligible to sit for placements. Companies are brought by Career Development Cell of IIT Bhubaneswar. More than 100 companies from different domains visit every year. Few of these are Google, Nvidia, Samsung, Zomato, Accenture Japan, PSU, etc. From fourth semester, we become eligible to sit for internships. Similar to placements, many companies from different domains visit every year offering stipend upto 1.5 lakhs per month. Few students from here are also selected for PPO.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everyone gets single room accommodation with 24X7 Wi-Fi and ethernet facilities. Hostel condition is good, better than most IITs. Caterer is changed every 2 years to ensure quality food. Menu includes a variety of dishes both South and North Indian. Lab and college facilities are good with advanced equipment and software required for learning. The library is good, and all types of books are available. We also have access to the library. There are different grounds for different sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: The courses are comprehensive and give a good idea of the field of study. Few professors might not conduct class tests or surprise tests, which might completely depend on the faculty. By the end of a course, we would know its real-life application and scope. All the faculty members have done post-doctorate, and are well-versed in their respective courses. They can be easily approached for any clarification regarding both academic and career-related queries. Each semester has a mid-semester and an end-semester. The curriculum is similar to other IITs and follows MIT's exam pattern.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: The college has a tremendous placement record. The college placement committee is very supportive. They are aware of their responsibilities as they guide us and help us throughout the placement drive of the college. The college has a 100% placement record. The highest package for our batch goes up to around 45 LPA, and the average package is 20 LPA. A few of students receive pre-placement offers during the internship programme. Companies like Goldman Sachs, Arcesium, L&T, Analog Devices, Texas Instruments, Amazon, Barclays, Deloitte, Jaguar Land Rover, JIO, Tata Digital, Quantile Analytics, Microsoft, Google visit our campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facility is available at an affordable price, with students required to do registration first for the hostel and PG. There is a 24-hour water supply. Rooms are available for sharing as well as separate.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are India's best scientists. They not only teach us the subject, but also train us to think more about our subjects. We have to take some projects. In those projects, teachers teach us to innovate. They are well-disciplined and punctual. Good guidance is offered, and the caring nature of faculty helps one to move forward easily. We have 3 internal exams and one University exam. Internal exams have 2 cycle tests, which constitute 10 internal marks each, and the model exam carries 20 internal marks. Then 5 marks for assignments and 5 marks for attendance of particular subjects. The course curriculum is very good and updated. It is highly competitive, and analytical and reasoning-based studies support the betterment of students. Some teachers are a gem to learn from, but most teachers lack proper knowledge of the subject. Most students rely on self-study. The curriculum is up to the mark and follows modern norms.

reviews.review_title: Everything about IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: For my course, roles offered are graduate engineer trainee (GET), AI/ML, data science, data analytics, consulting, software engineering, etc. The highest package is 56 CTC, and the least is 6.5 CTC. In my course, less than 30% of students got internships, and some of them got off campus. But the placement percentage is around 70 percent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is 24X7 medical facility inside the college. Food items in the mess are not too bad but some of them are really good. Library is open till 12 midnight. The classrooms are too good with the AC and Wi-Fi inside the classes. Labs contain more types of equipment with more diverse projects.
detailed_review.Faculty: Till now, the old timetable has been followed. But from the coming academic year, a new timetable will start. Mechanical curriculum is a little bit hectic but the CSE curriculum is simple. Faculty members are too experienced, and many of the students are working on projects with their guidance.

reviews.review_title: Life and culture at IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now, in my course about 75 percent of students are placed. My course is mechanical engineering. BPCL, HPCL, and BEL are the PSUs that come for the placements. Recruiting companies are Tata Steel, Reliance, ZS Associate, Zomato, Flipkart, and Media. There are companies that offer different roles with a package between 10 CTC to 56 CTC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is so nice, and the college look greenery. Hostel rooms are so clean, and one student per room. Every floor or room will have a Wi-Fi or LAN network. There is a night canteen as well for every hostel which will work from evening till 2:00 AM.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the teachers are very helpful, but all the faculty members are too qualified. For our batch, in my second and third year time-table schedule is too hectic. There are more exams as well. Some of the exams are tough and require more preparation.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: I like my college and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college, a maximum of 80 to 90% students are placed in different top companies in India. Jsw, Tata Power. Mahindra automobile, and various multinational companies like Meta, and space research organisations like ISRO, NASA, etc. At a good package of 10 to 30 Lacs per annum, and it increases yearly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college hostel is very good at this price. Our college food quality is very good and hygienic. Our classrooms are very advanced and well-furnished. Our college authority provided 24-hour high-speed Wi-Fi to the college and hostel. In the college, various types of labs are provided by the college authority.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college faculty are highly qualified and knowledgeable, who have helped us during the examination and study. They are very strict in nature. In our college, two semesters are held in a year. The pass percentage is 95%; it fluctuates every year.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course for my future research and innovation. Our college provides scholarships to knowledgeable students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best material engineering college in India.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT is widely recognised as one of the premier universities in India and that is why so many students are flocking to my course. I want to be part of something like that. We have got some big names in the industry showing UPAT on our campus. Google, Amazon, Tesla, and a bunch of other major companies. Its pretty impressive. In just three years, a lot of students have managed to land internships, which is no small FEAT. Its exciting to see all these opportunities unfolding.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One standout feature of the university is its modern infrastructure paired with some extra resources. The library has a wide range of books and academic journals. The canteen is spacious and offers lots of dishes and drinks in a friendly atmosphere. Students really appreciate living in the well managed hostel where the food is not just okay but meets basic quality standards.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are approachable and they break things down step by step, making examples relatable and easy for students to grasp. The exams are manageable, mainly focusing on understanding the concepts. Semester assessments are closely tied to the high school curriculum and are generally pretty simple.

reviews.review_title: My honest review, best college in India.

detailed_review.Placements: n the B.Tech. In the Electrical Engineering course, more than 70 percent of students get placed. Companies like Google, Microsoft, Lenovo, Motel etc visit the college to recruit students. The highest package is 63 LPA and the average package is 17 LPA. Roles offered are Control System Engineer, Power System Engineer, etc. Internship is offered to nearly 100 students from the whole batch but the percentage of students who got internships is less.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi facility is available in the college and the hostel. The infrastructure is good. A night canteen is available. Sanjeevani Hospital is available. There are different courts for sports like basketball, badminton, etc. Gym facilities are also available. Food items are not so spicy but a variety of items are present. Wi-Fi facility is available 24 hours on the premises.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers have a doctorate degree. They are highly professional. Exams are difficult but can be cracked using systematic planning. The pass percentage here is more than ninety. Different labs are there to make students industry ready. They conduct different industrial visits and guest talks from industry professionals.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: The maximum number of chemical and pharmaceutical companies reserved students from our department. Companies like Vinati Organics, Henkel, Camlin Fine Sciences, MECON Ltd, Asian Paints, and Oil India Ltd compulsorily looked for deserving students in our organisation for hiring.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course had a fee structure of Rs. 80,000 per year. It could vary by Rs. 10,000 based on the selection of the course. For accommodation, three hostels for boys and two hostels for girls. Within the college, mini shopping halls for purchasing all kinds of emergency things.
detailed_review.Faculty: It was difficult to understand the point of view of teachers most of the time, as their standards were much higher. Their actions were much clearer than their words. Exams were conducted frequently. Results were revealed at least twice a month.

reviews.review_title: About the Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: As of now, around 50 percent of students were placed. Top companies are Zomato, Flipkart, Visa, HSBC, etc. For Mechanical students, top companies are ZS, Zomato, Skyroot Aerospace, Reliance, etc. Most of the students didn’t get internships as expected, but the placements are going good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are three boys’ hostels and three girls’ hostels. In new hostels, Wi-Fi is provided, but in all hostels, LAN network is available. There is a hostel for couple Ph.D. students as well. There is a night canteen facility also. Mess food items are not too bad, but not too good also.
detailed_review.Faculty: In second and third year, almost every branch has more exams, but not for CSE students. The number of courses is more in those years compared to remaining years. Faculty are also talented, and many of them provide projects to students to work under them or with their guidance.
detailed_review.Other: Throughout the year, so many events happen in the college. There are two fests and various competitions across the branches.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: The review of IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: Metallurgical and Materials Engineering at IIT Bhubhaneshwar's B.Tech in metallurgical & materials engineering is doing great in placements 89.4% placement rate, the highest package of 44 Lacs per annum, average package of 18.7 Lacs per annum and much more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Bhubhaneshwar's campus spreads over 936 acres with a modern academic block, labs, a central library, sports and green space. Hostels are fully residential with Wi-Fi, mess, recreation and single/ shared rooms offering a comfortable, secure and self-sufficient student life.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Bhubaneswar offers experienced faculty, a research-driven curriculum with core & electives courses, lab work and project-based learning. Exams include midterms, end-of-semester exams, quizzes and practicals emphasising understanding, problem-solving etc.

reviews.review_title: Strong academics with modern facilities at IIT Bhubaneswar.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year, from mechanical, around 60 percent of students got placed. But this year, more companies are coming, maybe this time a larger percentage of students will be placed. The highest package is 72 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA, and the average is around 20 LPA, according to all branches.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIT Bhubaneswar classrooms are too good with high-speed internet, neat and clean. There are so many different types of labs that provide more practical knowledge. Hostels are also clean, and the food is also good, but for someone, it may not be good because of taste differences.
detailed_review.Faculty: IIT Bhubaneswar's faculty members are among the topmost scientists in the world. All the faculty members provide both technical and practical knowledge as well. The college is starting a new curriculum from the 2026 batch. Exams are also not too tough. One can pass the exam with minimal preparation.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical because I am interested in robotics. Throughout the year, so many events will happen in the college. Fest name is Pravah and Ashvameda.

reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Bhubaneswar - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: It's pretty impressive that about 80% of students from our course land jobs. Seriously, the top salary package is a whopping 64 LPA, while the average sits around 17 LPA. We've got big names like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. Now, when it comes to internships, it is higher than job placements. In fact, only about 100 students across the entire campus manage to snag internships each year. If you're looking at roles, we see quite a few opportunities in areas like power systems, electronic engineering, and control systems.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities. You know, the on-campus housing is actually quite comfy and well-managed. A lot of students choose to live there. As for the food service, it's okay. It meets the basic standards, nothing fancy.
detailed_review.Faculty: Honestly, teachers are fantastic. Every single member really knows their stuff when it comes to their field. They are super accessible and are always ready to lend a hand to students. The way they teach works well, giving students a solid grasp of the material. The curriculum is modern, and the test questions strike a nice balance, not too easy, not too hard.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Bhubaneswar college review.

detailed_review.Placements: IIT is widely recognised as one of the premier universities in India, and that so many students are flocking to my course. I want to be part of something like that. We have got some big names in the industry showing UPAT on our campus. Google, Amazon, Tesla, and a bunch of other major companies. Its pretty impressive, In just three years, a lot of students have managed to land internships, which is no small feat. Its exciting to see all these opportunities unfolding.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: One standout feature of the university is its modern infrastructure paired with some extra resources. The library has a wide range of books and academic journals. The canteen is spacious and offers lots of dishes and drinks in a friendly atmosphere. Students really appreciate living in the well managed hostel where the food is not just okay but meets basic quality standards.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are approachable, and they break things down step by step, making examples relatable and easy for students to grasp. The exams are manageable, mainly focusing on understanding the concepts. Semester assessments are closely tied to the high school curriculum and are generally pretty simple.

reviews.review_title: My college life is what I like the most.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement opportunities at IIT Bhubaneswar are getting better day by day. Initially, it was not so good, but now it's developing a lot. Good companies with higher placement opportunities used to come here. Most of the students get placed. The average package is of 60 to 70 LPA. Mostly good for core branch members.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is very amazing. Starting from the main GATE, we move to the admin building, then the auditorium. Then seven different schools for different branches. Three large lecture halls. Then three boys' hostels and three girls' hostels. Playground for all types of sports. Then a space area for extra activities like yoga, gym, and many more. Then the community center and faculty quarters.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are moderate here. Two times exams are conducted here. Mid seems and end seems. Faculty members teach very well, and yes, attendance is also compulsory here. Assignments, quizzes, and test helps a lot in writing the exams. This also includes practical knowledge, like labs for industrial exposure.

reviews.review_title: A very good college in its developing phase.

detailed_review.Placements: From Mechanical (My course), 93.7% of students are placed. The highest package is 20.1 LPA, the lowest package is 5.5 LPA, and the average package is 14.77 LPA. The recruiting companies are Tata Steel R&T, Engineers India Limited (EIL), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL), Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL), Oil India Limited (OIL), and Jindal Steel & Power.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities provided are decent, but need improvement, to be honest. In our department, many machines are very old and need to be replaced. Classrooms are well-furnished and comfortable, with whiteboards, blackboards, and projectors. The mess is average, and the canteen provides good food. The sports facilities are decent, but the cricket facilities need to be upgraded.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers here are very highly skilled in their respective courses. But there are some faculty members who might not be able to deliver the lectures properly, not because of a lack of knowledge, but because they are only good students and not good teachers. To be honest, I wouldn't say a complete yes or a complete no when it comes to industry-ready curriculum. Some courses are there that are really of no use. Semester exams are hard, but not the Everest to climb. Studying regularly and hard, especially before the exams, will yield good grades. The pass percentage here is 90+.
detailed_review.Other: The world of machines has always fascinated me, and this was the reason that the driving force me to go ahead with this course. The best thing about Mechanical is its direct link with the fascinating realm of machines. I would really like to see in my course is to include a semester, where we would only learn software related to the theoretical courses. Pravaah 2.0 is a new fest that started in 2024-25. The campus has very high aesthetic value, with it being amidst the hills. The campus crowd is decent, connectivity is expensive, scholarships are available, and we have good extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good 2nd gen IIT. Recommended to take admission.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, 90.07% of students got placed. The highest CTC is 67.6 LPA, and the average CTC is 14.5 LPA. Total number of PPOs is 22. Top recruiters are Google, Zomato, Accenture Japan, Goldman Sachs, Nvidia, and Meesho. In the core sector, PSUs such as BEL, BPCL, HPCL, and EIL are major contributors. The season also has an international core offer from Niterra Japan.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All classrooms, library, and some labs are fully air-conditioned and equipped with all modern amenities such as Wi-Fi, smart boards, projectors, etc. In every room, there is a single LAN port with which you can use the internet 24X7. All hostels (except the 1st year girls' hostel) have single-occupancy rooms. There are various canteens on the campus, such as Nescafe, Domino's, and some tiffin centers. There is a small hospital for all types of medical emergencies.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most professors are qualified and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is also not that stressful. Semester exams are sometimes tough and sometimes easy. Students also get help for placements from the placement cell. Various reputed companies also provide paid internships to our students.

reviews.review_title: Absolutely good hostels and teachers.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 85% of students are placed. The average package is 12 LPA, the highest package is approximately 48 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA. Top companies are Oracle, Amazon, and many more. The percentage of students get internships is like 40% only.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are good as well as the library. There is free Wi-Fi all over the place. The quality of food is not so good but medical facilities are very good, I am really impressed. There is also a place to play every game and a gym.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. The course is also very interesting. The course should be more industry-based. The semester exams are quite moderate to tough. Almost 90% of students pass the exam. Some teachers have very high qualifications but do not have the experience.

reviews.review_title: About IIT Bhubaneswar experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Overall placement in B.Tech students is around 90%. The highest package is 67 LPA. A lot of well-known PSUs and MNCs come to the campus. This year, 88% students are placed from civil engineering department. The highest package for my branch is 21 LPA, minimum is 6 LPA, and average is 14.8 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Sports facilities are good. Classrooms are amazing. There are always Wi-Fi issues throughout the campus. Mess food is very bad. Hostel facilities are good. One big problem is the attendance policy. Our college has a 100% mandatory attendance policy which is complete madness.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very knowledgeable and helpful. The course curriculum is a bit old but this year it has improved quite a bit. The course curriculum is very relevant to industry and academia. Semester exams are not very hard. But some courses are very difficult.

highlights.summary:
Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology & Research Academy, or SASTRA Deemed University Thanjavur, is one of the popular deemed-to-be universities in Tamil Nadu. SASTRA University Thanjavur was founded in 1984 as Shanmugha College of Engineering and accredited by NAAC A++ Grade. It is also recognised as a Category I institution by the UGC. The engineering programmes offered by the university are recognised by the Institution of Engineering & Technology (IET), UK and the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE). The Government of India has also recognised the university as a Scientific & Industrial Research Organisation. SASTRA Thanjavur is ranked 51 by NIRF 2025 under the Overall category, 29 by NIRF 2025 under the University category, and 40 by NIRF 2025 under the Engineering category.
The university has two branches, namely the Shanmugha Polytechnic College and the Srinivasa Ramanujan Centre. Shanmugha Polytechnic College is a part of the SASTRA University main campus, while the Srinivasa Ramanujan College is located in Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu. SASTRA also comprises several schools and centres, through which it offers various undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across different streams such as Science, Engineering, Medicine, Education, Arts, Law and Management. BTech, MTech and MBA are the popular programmes. The university also offers online and distance education programmes. admission.overview_text: SASTRA (Deemed to be University) admissions are based on entrance exam scores . The university offers multiple courses such as BTech, BCom, MA, MBA, etc, at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the university also offers PhD courses. The university offers more than 30 courses in various streams such as Science, Engineering, Management, etc. The application process at SASTRA (Deemed to be University) is conducted online. Read the following article to know more about SASTRA (Deemed to be University) course admission 2026.

faqs.question: How do I get a seat at SASTRA University?
faqs.answer: SASTRA University provides various programmes and specialisations to students. These courses are available in different streams. For obtaining SASTRA University admission, candidates are selected on the basis of entrance tests. For further details, candidates may visit the official website and learn more regarding the eligibility details for their preferred course choice. Accepted exams include TANCET, GATE, JEE Main, CUET, etc.

faqs.question: How can I apply for SASTRA University admission?
faqs.answer: Earlier, SASTRA University application process was conducted in both online and offline modes. However,  2022 onwards, the process has shifted completely to online mode.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in SASTRA University?
faqs.answer: There is no such provision for getting direct admission in any courses at SASTRA University. SASTRA University admission is both a merit and entrance exam based on the course for which the candidate has applied. Given below are the eligibility and selection criteria for some of the most opted courses at SASTRA University. Course Name Eligibility & Selection Criteria BTech Eligibility: A pass in Class 12 with Maths & Physics as compulsory subjects with Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Computer Science/ Biology with 60% aggregate + Age should be less than 19 Selection: JEE Main + Class 12 scores BCA Eligibility: A pass in Class 12 with Mathematics/ Statistics as a subject Selection: Merit in Class 12 Integrated MTech Eligibility: A pass in Class 12 with Maths & Physics as compulsory subjects with Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Computer Science/ Biology with 60% aggregate Selection: JEE Main + Class 12 scores BOptom Eligibility: A pass in Class 12 in a single sitting with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics or Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology from a recognised board with at least 60% aggregate + Age should be less than 20 Selection: NEET + Class 12 scores BA LLB (Hons) Eligibility: A pass in Class 12 from a recognised board in the first attempt with at least 50% aggregate with English as a subject Selection: CLAT + Class 12 scores BBA LB (Hons) Eligibility: A pass in Class 12 from a recognised board in the first attempt with at least 50% aggregate with English as a subject Selection: CLAT + Class 12 scores BCom LLB (Hons) Eligibility: A pass in Class 12 from a recognised board in the first attempt with at least 50% aggregate with English as a subject Selection: CLAT + Class 12 scores MTech Eligibility: A pass in relevant BE/ BTech Selection: GATE (preferred, not compulsory) MBA Eligibility: A pass in any UG degree Selection: CAT / XAT / AIMAT / CMAT / AIMCAT + Merit scores in UG PhD Eligibility: A pass in any PG degree with a 55% aggregate Selection: UGC-NET/ UGC CSIR-NET/ GATE/ UPSC Selected candidates can register further for the counselling process after submitting the counselling fees; during this round, candidates will be required to report to the admission cell at SASTRA University for document verification and other admission formalities along with fee payment.

faqs.question: Who can enroll for admission at SASTRA (Deemed to be University)?
faqs.answer: Students looking for admission at SASTRA University, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. For UG courses, students must complete Class 12, and for PG courses, students must complete graduation. For eg, students looking for BTech first year admission must complete Class 12 with 60% aggregate.

faqs.question: What is the cut off for SASTRA University MBA?
faqs.answer: There are no cutoff details available on SASTRA University official website for admission to the MBA programme. SASTRA University inducts candidates for the MBA programme based on valid scores in CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ AIMCAT. Candidates based on their scores in any one of the aforementioned exam will be shortlisted for the Personal Interview (PI) round.

faqs.answer: Candidate should have passed Class 12 with Maths Physics and Chemistry/ Bio-Technology/ Computer Science/ Biology as their subjects from any recognised Board with a minimum aggregate of 60%. The total course fee for the BTech course ranges between INR 4.7 lakhs to INR 7.7 lakhs. Spread over four years and eight semesters, admission to all these courses is subject to JEE Main scores for 70% of the seats and is subject to Class 12 scores for the remaining 30% of the seats.

faqs.question: Are admissions open at SASTRA, Chennai Campus?
faqs.answer: CAT is an entrance exam which is accepted by SASTRA, Chennai Campus for admission to its MBA programme. The CAT exam date is November 26 . The official notification will soon be announced on July 31.

faqs.question: Can I join SASTRA without JEE?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates can join SASTRA University BTech courses without appearing for JEE Mains. sections.heading: Introduction
text: SASTRA University (Deemed to be University) is one of the leading institutions offering various undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs in the fields of Science and Technology, and law, among others. Situated in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, SASTRA university covers an area of 300000 square feet. SASTRA is highly sought after by students, both domestic and international, for those looking for value-driven higher education that fosters service to humanity and society.

sections.heading: SASTRA University Highlights
text: The university is spread over 232 acres of land. Its infrastructure features multiple canteens, a guest house, campus shopping stores, banks & ATMs, a post office, transport availability and a Ghoshala. It also boasts a ten-bed hospital, as well as a modern senate hall for meetings and a multi-purpose hall.
The list of SASTRA University campuses is provided below:

sections.heading: SASTRA University Sports Facilities
text: The university emphasises the importance of physical education and sportsmanship. With its top-notch and state-of-the-art sports facilities, covering both outdoor and indoor, it promotes excellence in sports. SASTRA University outdoor sports facilities include a cricket ground with pitch and nets, playing fields for football and hockey, plus basketball, volleyball, and throwball courts. It also includes a standard 200-meter running track with outdoor courts for badminton and tennis.

SASTRA University infrastructure also includes indoor badminton courts with wooden flooring, useful when the weather might not allow outdoor fields to be accessible. It also features table tennis, billiards table and carrom halls with indoor lighting facilities available. The indoor facilities include a multi-purpose gym with treadmills, weights and fitness training zone as well as a Chess room.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the SASTRA University Campus
text: Due to its location in the temple city of Thanjavur, students of the university are blessed and surrounded by many historical and recreational sites such as the Brihadeeswara Temple , Thanjavur Palace , Sivaganga Park and Saraswathi Mahal Library . These places are ideal to experience India's rich culture and are favourable for picnics and team outings.

Other local attractions around the city include Poondi Math , Rock Fort Temple (Trichy) , and Srirangam Temple , which offer a serene environment for relaxation and a peaceful environment ideal for personal explorations.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The central library contains over 1,02,600 books, the library also subscribes to 290 journals and magazines related to management, engineering, law, and many more. It also subscribes to over 35 online journal databases like science direct, IEEE, ACM, ASME, and more. The library has purchased over 18,000 Springer e-books from the various subjects. The transactions of the library are fully automated and automation covers the entire gamut of the library. The library has reprographic facilities and attracts an average of over 600 students over a day.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: SASTRA University has 9 boys hostels and 6 girls hostels which are equipped with all amenities for living, dining, and recreation that makes each inmate feel at home. Wi-Fi facility is also available for students in the hostel. SASTRA has always believed in catering to the palate and providing wholesome and balanced nutrition in a hygienic environment. A completely balanced South & North Indian Vegetarian diet is served in all hostels.
